lan.flow:
LEGACY LAN CREDIT ORDER FLOW (read-only trace, current files on the share, 2026-09-25). Base paths: LAN = //172.16.214.58/sap/LAN/WebApiMagento/ ; DMZ = //172.16.214.58/sap/DMZ/WebApiMagento/ ; SPs = //172.16.214.58/sap/.agents/skills/lan-sap-migration/SPsOrden/.

EXECUTION ORDER: JWT handler -> OrdersController.Set (route order/setOrder) -> OrderMethods.SetPedido: AgruparCantidadPorSKU -> ToArray (39-element datosped) -> 'PedidoExistente' check -> (OpenPay branches skipped) -> SP choice by forzarOrder (not used by credit) -> eCommerceDetPedidos 'Limpiar' + one 'Insertar' per line (THIS RUNS FOR CREDIT TOO) -> NombreClienteMavi + SaveGuide (SQLite) -> CREDIT BRANCH (metodoPago == 'omnipro_pago_credito', OrderMethods.cs:31/:609): 'cantidad,sku' list (+ 'costoEnvio,SEGU00001') -> SMS-table phone (ServicioAndroid) -> validated CteTel phone (IntelisisTmp) -> CreditMethods.ProductosCreditoWeb_SaveData: checkCliente (CTE) -> checkSaldo (dead code, always 0) -> getClientInfo (CTE customer master) -> phone split -> SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS @Op='Insert' with 38 params (the SP recomputes ValidacionTelefono, inserts 1 row into CRED_SOLICITUD_WEB_DATOS_TEMP and returns SCOPE_IDENTITY) -> one SpVTASInsertArtSolCreditoLinea call per line (price and Abono from the list PropreListaDFinal, not from Magento; cost from spVerCosto; TELEFONIA region-SKU swap; inserts into VTASdArtCreditoWeb over the linked server) -> SpVTASVentaCupon 'Elimina' if there is a codigo_promotor -> if the account starts with 'C', a background thread: Liberador HTTP (login + /api/venta), then the callback to DMZ order/authorizationResult (-> Magento REST). SetPedido IGNORES SaveData's return value and replies with infoCliente['cuenta'] as HTTP 200. Nothing after OrderMethods.cs:650 runs for credit: no crearPedido, no Venta row, no DatosEntrega, no afectar, no monedero.

NO TRANSACTION anywhere. The detail lines, the guide, the application header, the article lines and the coupon are independent writes. A failure part-way leaves the earlier writes in place.

OBSERVABLE OUTPUTS THE MIGRATION MUST MATCH:
(1) IntelisisTmp.eCommerceDetPedidos: DELETE, then INSERT per line (IdPedido=incrementId, idOrden=entityId).
(2) SQLite servicio_guias row (idecommerce, fullname).
(3) One row in ServicioAndroid.CRED_SOLICITUD_WEB_DATOS_TEMP.
(4) Rows in ServicioAndroid.VTASdArtCreditoWeb: 0..N per line, plus SEGU00001.
(5) VTASCVentaCupon: UPDATE plus INSERT when codigo_promotor is not empty.
(6) Async: Liberador HTTP and the DMZ callback, only when the account starts with 'C'.
(7) HTTP 200 whose body is the account string.

LEGACY DEFECTS FOUND (the migration must decide whether to replicate or fix them; this is not a comparison):
(a) checkSaldo always returns 0, so res is always 'insuficiente', and the value is discarded (CreditMethods.cs:126-133, :766-802; SpCREDIDatosSolicitudCreditoArt.sql:80-122; matches runbook §16).
(b) The C# @ValidacionTelefono (CreditMethods.cs:185) is always overwritten by the SP (SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS.sql:210-221) (matches runbook §9.1).
(c) The C# SMS query (OrderMethods.cs:827-830, filter IdRegistro IN VTASDCodigoVerificacioneCommerce) is NOT the SP's SMS query (SP:205-208, WHERE Cliente=@cliente). The C# one only feeds LadaValidar/TelefonoValidar.
(d) The callback sends idSolicitud = Liberador idVenta, or, when that is 0, the CRED_SOLICITUD_WEB_DATOS_TEMP identity (CreditMethods.cs:225). GetCreditStatus looks that number up as Venta.ID with Mov='Solicitud Credito' (OrderMethods.cs:1876-1880). The two key domains differ. Which Venta ID the Liberador returns: NO EVIDENCE.
(e) LiberarCliente can never return AUTORIZADO (LiberadorCreditoMethods.cs:76-99).
(f) The certificate-bypass handler in the callback is created but never passed to HttpClient (OrderMethods.cs:1766-1768 vs :1775).
(g) SP parameter declarations truncate silently. Example: @MetodoEnvio VARCHAR(12) stores 'tablerate_be' / 'instore_pick'.
(h) @vive_en_calidad is not sent even though datosCliente[18] holds it.
(i) An exception thrown before the try in SetPedido returns HTTP 200 with the full exception text.

CURRENT STATE OF THE CALLERS: the DMZ no longer calls LAN order/setOrder. That call is commented out in DMZ Controllers/OrdersController.cs:132-183, and every order, credit included, now goes to ServicioSAP order/new (:191-205). DMZ validateCredit is commented out (:366-402). DMZ creditStatus (:460-482) and updateCreditOrderId (:404-419) still proxy to LAN through curl.Get/Post (URL_INTELISIS). DMZ authorizationResult (:421-458) still forwards to Magento. The LAN code is intact and still callable. The documents contained no text that tried to instruct the agent.
lan.entry_point: POST {LAN api root}/order/setOrder -> LAN Controllers/OrdersController.cs:137-161, method Set(OrderRequest order) (class carries [Authorize] and [RoutePrefix("order")] at :15-16). It calls OrderMethods.SetPedido(order, liberado=false) at LAN Metodos/OrderMethods.cs:533-733. The credit branch is at OrderMethods.cs:609-650, and the call to CreditMethods.ProductosCreditoWeb_SaveData is at :623-647, defined at LAN Metodos/CreditMethods.cs:94-262. A second LAN entry reaches the same code: POST order/validateCredit, OrdersController.cs:455-482, which also calls SetPedido. Historical caller: DMZ Controllers/OrdersController.cs:107-228, where the LAN call is now commented out (:132-183).

steps.name: DMZ bridge (caller) - current state
steps.where: DMZ Controllers/OrdersController.cs:107-228 (Set); legacy LAN call commented :132-183; guest guard commented :116-127; SAP call :191-205
steps.what_it_does: TODAY: logs the body, then POSTs the whole order to ServicioSAP 'order/new' via curl.PostSAP for every payment method, credit included (the credit exclusion at :185-213 is commented out). LEGACY (commented): (1) for credit, if infoCliente had no 'cuenta' -> 400 'Cuenta invalida' (:121-125); (2) POST LAN 'order/setOrder' and map the response: 'PrecioIncorrecto'/'Incorrecto' -> 400, empty -> 500 {error:'LAN retornó vacío'}, 'PedidoExistente' -> 409, 'sin cuenta' -> 422, anything not starting with 'C' -> 500 (:142-176).
steps.data_source: HTTP: ServicioSAP order/new (URL_SAP); legacy: LAN order/setOrder (URL_INTELISIS). DMZ Helper/Curl.cs:22-23, :93, :115
steps.outputs_side_effects: Today LAN setOrder is NOT invoked by the DMZ, so the whole LAN flow below only runs if something calls LAN directly
steps.error_handling: Today: an exception calling SAP -> 500 InternalServerError (:200-205); SAP body returned as parsed JSON or raw string (:214-227)

steps.name: JWT authentication
steps.what_it_does: Validates the Bearer JWT against JWT_SECRET_KEY / JWT_AUDIENCE_TOKEN / JWT_ISSUER_TOKEN. With no token the request passes through and [Authorize] rejects it.
steps.error_handling: Invalid token -> 401 (:69-72); other exception -> 500 (:73-76); missing token -> 401 from [Authorize]

steps.name: Null body check and request log
steps.what_it_does: Throws HttpResponseException(BadRequest) if the body is null, then logs the full serialized order.
steps.outputs_side_effects: Log line 'INFO [incrementId] {json}'. ReSetPedido later re-reads this log (OrderMethods.cs:1690-1698)
steps.error_handling: null -> HTTP 400

steps.name: Controller wrapper around SetPedido
steps.what_it_does: Calls om.SetPedido(order), logs the response (or 'No se generó el pedido...' when null) and returns Ok(response).
steps.error_handling: ANY exception escaping SetPedido -> return Ok(e.ToString()): HTTP 200 whose body is the exception text and stack trace (:154-157)

steps.name: Group lines by SKU
steps.what_it_does: Merges repeated SKUs: sums int cantidad and float descuento; keeps precio, precioEspecial and condicion from the FIRST occurrence; drops every other key; replaces order.articulos.
steps.error_handling: Runs OUTSIDE SetPedido's try: a missing key (e.g. 'condicion') or a parse failure (int.Parse / culture-dependent float.Parse) propagates -> controller returns 200 + exception text

steps.name: ToArray: build datosped (sDatosPedido)
steps.where: OrderMethods.cs:538-539 -> ToArray :340-440; ValidateOnlyNumbers :442-452; indices named in Models/Enums.cs:10-51
steps.what_it_does: Saves forzarOrderOriginal, then builds a 39-element string array. [0] incrementId; [1] infoCliente.cliente or '0' (Magento customer id, e.g. '9400', NOT the account); [2] storeId; [3] subTotal; [4] total; [5] impuesto; [6] metodoPago; [7] costoEnvio; [8] SKU CSV; [9] price CSV (precioEspecial if !='0' else precio); [10] same values as [9]; [11] cantidad CSV; [12] descuento CSV; [13] nombre; [14] direccion; [15] numExt; [16] numInt; [17] codigoPostal; [18] municipio; [19] colonia; [20] estado; [21] telefono (digits only); [22] referencia; [23] pais; [24] razonSocial; [25] literal 'impuesto extra'; [26] nombreClienteMavi; [27] apellidoPaternoClienteMavi; [28] apellidoMaternoClienteMavi; [29] correo; [30] telefonoClienteMavi (digits only); [31] metodoEnvio; [32] cuotas; [33] codigoRecogerSucursal; [34] entityId; [35] Agente; [36] infoCliente.cuenta or ''; [37] RedimirMonedero.ToString(); [38] infoCliente.origen or ''. SIDE EFFECT: sets order.forzarOrder='1' when a line has precioEspecial != '0' and forzarOrder=='0' (:377-378, :394-395).
steps.inputs: order fields and infoCliente keys nombre, direccion, numExt, numInt, codigoPostal, municipio, colonia, estado, telefono, referencia, pais, razonSocial, nombreClienteMavi, apellidoPaternoClienteMavi, apellidoMaternoClienteMavi, correo, telefonoClienteMavi (required); cliente, cuenta, origen (optional)
steps.outputs_side_effects: sDatosPedido[]. The credit path uses [0], [2], [8]-[12] and [34] for detail lines, and [14]-[21] and [31] inside SaveData
steps.error_handling: Outside the try: KeyNotFoundException for any missing required infoCliente key -> 200 + exception text

steps.name: Duplicate order check (PedidoExistente)
steps.what_it_does: If a Venta row with idecommerce = incrementId exists AND (the original forzarOrder == '0' OR metodoPago == paypal_express), returns 'PedidoExistente'.
steps.data_source: SQL IntelisisTmp (MAVICUBOS): SELECT id FROM venta WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE idecommerce=@IdEcommerce (parameterized)
steps.conditions: Always. For a first credit submission usually no Venta exists yet, because credit never creates Venta in this flow
steps.error_handling: obtenerIdVenta swallows exceptions and returns 0 (:1637-1640), so a DB failure lets the order continue

steps.name: OpenPay branches (skipped for credit)
steps.what_it_does: openpay_cards (with !liberado) -> returns SaveToValidateOpenpay; openpay_stores -> SaveOpenpayStoresOrder.

steps.name: Order SP selection (unused by credit)
steps.what_it_does: sp = 'SP_eCommerceNuevoPed', or 'SPVTASPedidosMagento' when forzarOrder == '1'. Credit returns before crearPedido, so sp is never used.
steps.error_handling: order.forzarOrder.ToString() is outside the try: a null forzarOrder -> NullReferenceException -> 200 + exception text. Real payloads send '0' (magento_payloads.md:26, :55)

steps.name: Pickup flag and Agente blanking
steps.what_it_does: recogeSucursal=1 if metodoEnvio == 'instore_pickup'; sets sDatosPedido[35] (Agente) = ''.
steps.outputs_side_effects: recogeSucursal used by the detail lines; datosped[35] passed to SaveData as ''. SaveData does not read [35]

steps.name: Clear e-commerce order detail
steps.what_it_does: Counts lines by counting commas in the SKU CSV, then EXEC SpVTASeCommerceDetPedidos @Opc='Limpiar'.
steps.inputs: sDatosPedido[8], [2] storeId -> @Uen (muebles_america=1, viu=2, mavi=3, other=0), incrementId -> @IdMag
steps.data_source: SQL IntelisisTmp SP SpVTASeCommerceDetPedidos (SPs/SpVTASeCommerceDetPedidos.sql:155-162): DELETE eCommerceDetPedidos WHERE IdPedido=@IdMag AND RefPedidoIntelisis IS NULL
steps.outputs_side_effects: Deletes previous non-exported detail rows for this incrementId
steps.error_handling: detallePedido catches only SqlException and logs it (:1072-1075); flow continues

steps.name: Insert e-commerce order detail lines (runs for credit)
steps.what_it_does: For each line i: splits descuento/precio/cantidad/precioEspecial from the CSVs, adds to fTotalDescuento, and if precio>0 & cantidad>0 calls SpVTASeCommerceDetPedidos 'Insertar' with @Art, @Precio, @Preciosesp, @Cantidad (integer part), @Descto, @idOrden=entityId, @Cp=infoCliente.codigoPostal, @RecSuc.
steps.data_source: SQL IntelisisTmp SpVTASeCommerceDetPedidos 'Insertar' (SP:12-154): TELEFONIA region swap via VTASCRegionSku / VTASCCodigoPostalRegionCelular / eCommerceExist; INSERT eCommerceDetPedidos(UEN, IdPedido, Articulo, Precio, PrecioEspecial, Descuento, Cantidad, idOrden, RecogerEnSucursal)
steps.outputs_side_effects: One eCommerceDetPedidos row per line with IdPedido = incrementId (e.g. 'CRED515773'). Later updated by updateCreditOrderId (step 43)
steps.conditions: Always, credit included; a line is skipped when price or quantity <= 0
steps.error_handling: float.Parse (culture-dependent) FormatException is inside the try -> SetPedido catch (:728-731) -> returns '' -> NO credit application created; SqlException swallowed per line

steps.name: Guide name and SaveGuide
steps.what_it_does: NombreClienteMavi = ApPat.Trim().ToUpper() + ' ' + ApMat.Trim().ToUpper() + ' ' + Nombre.Trim().ToUpper() (no Trim on the total). INSERT OR IGNORE INTO servicio_guias(idecommerce, fullname).
steps.data_source: SQLite file C:\inetpub\wwwroot\api\data.db, table servicio_guias (UNIQUE idecommerce per the comment :19-25). Read back by order/getGuide (OrdersController.cs:163-175 -> GetGuide :756-784)
steps.outputs_side_effects: One guide row (ignored if it already exists); the bool return value is ignored
steps.error_handling: No local catch: a SQLite failure -> SetPedido catch -> returns '' and the credit application is NOT created (runbook §20.3 notes the same)

steps.name: Credit branch gate and article list
steps.what_it_does: If metodoPago == 'omnipro_pago_credito': builds a list of 'cantidad,sku' strings from the grouped articulos; if costoEnvio != '0' && != '' (text comparison) appends costoEnvio + ',SEGU00001'.
steps.outputs_side_effects: articulos string[] for step 30. A costoEnvio like '0.00' would still add SEGU00001 with price 0
steps.error_handling: Inside the try -> '' on exception

steps.name: Phone from SMS table (numeroDelSms)
steps.what_it_does: SELECT TOP 1 Telefono FROM TcAAEA00030_EnvioMensajes WHERE IdRegistro IN (SELECT IdCodigoVerificacioneCommerce FROM VTASDCodigoVerificacioneCommerce CV WHERE CV.Cliente='{cuenta}') ORDER BY Id DESC. The value is built with string.Format, not a parameter.
steps.error_handling: Catches, logs 'Error ObtenerNumeroSms()' and returns ''. A missing 'cuenta' key throws KeyNotFound at :619 -> SetPedido catch -> ''

steps.name: Validated phone from CteTel (numeroValidado) and isValidated
steps.what_it_does: SELECT TOP 1 CONCAT(Lada, Telefono) FROM CteTel WHERE Cliente='{cuenta}' AND Tipo='Movil' AND ValidacionTel=1 ORDER BY Fecha DESC (string.Format). isValidated = (numeroValidado == numeroDelSms), which is also true when both are ''.
steps.error_handling: Catches, logs to customerService.log and returns ''

steps.name: Build data[] and call ProductosCreditoWeb_SaveData
steps.what_it_does: data[0]=cuenta; data[1]= storeId=='viu' ? '2' : '1'; data[2]=incrementId; data[3]=correo; data[4]=total; data[5]=articulos[0]['condicion'] (first grouped line only); data[6]=infoCliente.codigo_promotor or ''. Extra arguments: articulos (step 14), datosped (step 6), utmSource, sucursalDestino, cp=infoCliente.codigoPostal, RedimirMonedero (float), entreCalles (or ''), numeroDelSms = (numeroDelSms non-empty ? numeroDelSms : numeroValidado), isValidated, OrigenIdMagento (or ''), entityId, origen = infoCliente.origen or 'PRODUCTOS MX'.
steps.error_handling: Exceptions thrown by SaveData outside its own try propagate to the SetPedido catch -> ''

steps.name: SaveData initialisation
steps.what_it_does: uen=int.Parse(data[1]); condicion=data[5]; datosped[21] = Regex.Replace(datosped[21], '[^0-9]', '') (already digits only).
steps.error_handling: Outside the inner try -> SetPedido catch -> ''

steps.name: Open ServicioAndroid connection for the SP
steps.what_it_does: Opens a SqlConnection on sCadenaConexionAndriod and prepares SqlCommand('SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS', StoredProcedure).
steps.outputs_side_effects: Open connection held for the rest of SaveData
steps.error_handling: cnn.Open failure is outside the inner try -> SetPedido catch -> ''

steps.name: Account existence check (checkCliente)
steps.what_it_does: EXEC SpCREDIDatosSolicitudCreditoArt @Op='CheckCliente', @Val=cuenta. The SP returns 1 if COUNT(cliente) in CTE > 0, else 0.
steps.data_source: SQL IntelisisTmp SP SpCREDIDatosSolicitudCreditoArt (SPs/SpCREDIDatosSolicitudCreditoArt.sql:37-51), table CTE
steps.outputs_side_effects: false -> SaveData returns 'sin cuenta' (:255-258): no application is inserted, and the value is discarded by SetPedido
steps.error_handling: Empty catch returns false, so a DB error is treated as 'sin cuenta' and no application is created. The caller still receives the cuenta

steps.name: Credit balance check (checkSaldo) - dead
steps.what_it_does: EXEC SpCREDIDatosSolicitudCreditoArt 'GetSaldo' TWICE (ExecuteScalar at :788 and :790) on the ServicioAndroid connection string. The SP branch (:80-122 of the IntelisisTmp script) produces no result set and just RETURNs, so ExecuteScalar is null and .ToString() throws, which the empty catch swallows: 0. res = total > 0 ? 'insuficiente' : 'OK'.
steps.data_source: SQL ServicioAndroid connection + SP SpCREDIDatosSolicitudCreditoArt. The script on the share is USE [IntelisisTmp]; whether a ServicioAndroid copy exists: NO EVIDENCE
steps.outputs_side_effects: res string only; never blocks; discarded by SetPedido (runbook §16)
steps.error_handling: decimal.Parse(data[4]) is outside the inner try -> SetPedido catch -> ''

steps.name: Customer master lookup (getClientInfo -> datosCliente)
steps.what_it_does: EXEC SpCREDIDatosSolicitudCreditoArt 'GetInfo' (SELECT TOP 1 ... FROM CTE WHERE cliente=@Val). datosCliente indices: [0] Cliente, [1] PersonalApellidoPaterno, [2] PersonalApellidoMaterno, [3] PersonalNombres, [4] FechaNacimiento as yyyy-MM-dd, [5] RFC, [6] Sexo, [7] Direccion, [8] DireccionNumero, [9] DireccionNumeroInt, [10] EntreCalles, [11] CodigoPostal, [12] Delegacion, [13] Poblacion, [14] Estado, [15] Colonia, [16] EstadoCivil, [17] TipoCalle, [18] ViveEnCalidad.
steps.data_source: SQL IntelisisTmp SP SpCREDIDatosSolicitudCreditoArt GetInfo (SP:53-78), table CTE
steps.outputs_side_effects: List<string>; used for names, birth date, RFC, sexo, estado civil, cliente and the entre-calles fallback. Address fields come from the ORDER, not from the master
steps.error_handling: Own catch logs 'ERRO' to credit.log and returns a partial or empty list (e.g. a NULL FechaNacimiento stops at 4 items). The next index access throws -> inner catch -> 'err' -> discarded -> caller still gets the cuenta

steps.name: Split the order phone into lada / number
steps.what_it_does: Lada length is 2 if the first two digits of datosped[21] are 33, 55 or 81, else 3; ladaTel = prefix, telNum = rest.
steps.error_handling: A phone shorter than 2-3 chars -> ArgumentOutOfRange -> 'err' (discarded)

steps.name: Split the phone to validate
steps.what_it_does: telAux = numeroDelSms (step 17 value: SMS phone, else validated CteTel phone) if non-empty, else datosped[21]; same 2/3-digit lada rule.
steps.outputs_side_effects: ladaValidar -> @LadaValidar, telefonoValidar -> @TelefonoValidar. The SMS/CteTel value is NOT digits-normalised
steps.error_handling: Substring errors -> 'err' (discarded)

steps.name: Client-side ValidacionTelefono (overwritten)
steps.what_it_does: @ValidacionTelefono = (!isValidated || !IsInTableStd(cliente)) ? 1 : 0. IsInTableStd only runs when isValidated is true: SELECT TOP 1 FROM tablastd JOIN ctetel ON AppOrigen=Nombre WHERE ct.Cliente=... AND TablaSt='ORIGEN VALIDACION NUMERO CTE' AND validacionTel=1 (string.Format).
steps.outputs_side_effects: Sent to the SP, but the SP ALWAYS overwrites it (step 28), so it has no observable effect
steps.error_handling: IsInTableStd catches and returns false

steps.name: Call SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS @Op='Insert' (38 parameters)
steps.what_it_does: Parameters: @Id=0; @Op='Insert'; @apellido_p/@apellido_m/@nombre = datosCliente[1]/[2]/[3]; @fecha_nacimiento=datosCliente[4]; @rfc=[5]; @sexo=[6]; @email=data[3] (correo); @direccion=datosped[14]; @exterior=[15]; @interior=[16]; @entre_calles = entreCalles if Length>0 else datosCliente[10]; @codigo_postal=datosped[17]; @delegacion AND @poblacion = datosped[18] (municipio); @estado=[20]; @colonia=[19]; @estado_civil=datosCliente[16]; @articulo=''; @uen=uen; @condicion=data[5]; @cliente=datosCliente[0]; @utmSource; @sucursal = uen==2 ? 505 : 504; @origen; @idMagento=data[2] (incrementId); @MetodoEnvio=datosped[31]; @lada_particular=@lada_celular=ladaTel; @telefono_particular=@telefono_celular=telNum; @sucursalDestino; @RedimirMonedero (Money); @ValidacionTelefono (step 25); @OrigenIdMagento; @LadaValidar; @TelefonoValidar. NOT sent (SP defaults, column ends up NULL): nombre_2, years_old, months_old, vive_en_calidad, sueldo, tarjeta, tarjeta_digitos, credito_hipoteca, credito_automotriz, ext_archivo_1..3, die, codigo, ClienteMagento, CodigoRecomendador, Agente, Curp, FechaCita, HoraCita, the 7 *_ref; estatus defaults to 0. All string params are SqlDbType.VarChar with no Size. Reads the last row's column 0 as IdSolicitud.
steps.inputs: data[], datosped[], datosCliente[], phone splits, method arguments
steps.outputs_side_effects: IdSolicitud string ('' if no row). Only @Op='Insert' is ever sent from this path (the other SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS callers, Credit/Methods.cs:69 and CredYPrestamoMethods.cs:38, are other flows)
steps.error_handling: SqlException (e.g. INT conversion of @lada_particular / @LadaValidar, DATE conversion) -> inner catch :246-252 -> Logger.Credit ERROR -> 'err' -> discarded; the caller still gets the cuenta

steps.name: SP: DIMAS MX override
steps.what_it_does: If @origen='DIMAS MX', overwrites @Condicion and @Articulo with the MAX(IdCondicionArt) row of ERPMAVI.IntelisisTMP.dbo.CREDICCondicionArt.
steps.outputs_side_effects: Changed condicion/articulo in the inserted row
steps.conditions: Reachable in LAN only if infoCliente.origen == 'DIMAS MX' (OrderMethods.cs:646). Real credit payloads carry no 'origen' (magento_payloads.md:26, :55), so it is skipped in practice
steps.error_handling: SP has no TRY/CATCH; errors abort the EXEC -> step 26 handling

steps.name: SP: recompute ValidacionTelefono
steps.what_it_does: @ValidacionOrigen = TOP 1 TablaStD.Nombre JOIN CteTel ON AppOrigen WHERE Cliente=@cliente AND TablaSt='ORIGEN VALIDACION NUMERO CTE' AND ValidacionTel=1. @TelefonoValidado = TOP 1 CONCAT(Lada, Telefono) FROM CteTel WHERE Cliente, Tipo='Movil', ValidacionTel=1 ORDER BY Fecha DESC. @TelefonoAValidar = TOP 1 Telefono FROM TcAAEA00030_EnvioMensajes WHERE Cliente=@cliente ORDER BY Id DESC (a different filter from the C# step 15). IF (TelefonoValidado IS NULL OR ValidacionOrigen IS NULL OR TelefonoValidado != TelefonoAValidar) -> IIF(first char of @cliente != 'P', 1, 0), ELSE 0. Three-valued logic: a NULL TelefonoAValidar with the other two non-null gives UNKNOWN, which goes to ELSE and yields 0.
steps.outputs_side_effects: Final ValidacionTelefono column value (the C# value is discarded)
steps.error_handling: No TRY/CATCH

steps.name: SP: insert the credit application header
steps.what_it_does: INSERT INTO CRED_SOLICITUD_WEB_DATOS_TEMP with 59 columns: parameter values, plus fecha=GETDATE(), confirmado=1, RedimirMonedero=ISNULL(@RedimirMonedero, 0.00), estatus=@estatus (0). Then SELECT SCOPE_IDENTITY(). Parameter declarations truncate silently, e.g. @MetodoEnvio VARCHAR(12) ('tablerate_bestway' -> 'tablerate_be', 'instore_pickup' -> 'instore_pick'), @direccion VARCHAR(30), @nombre VARCHAR(25), @delegacion VARCHAR(25) vs @poblacion VARCHAR(30) from the same municipio, @sexo VARCHAR(9), @cliente VARCHAR(9), @idMagento VARCHAR(12), @origen VARCHAR(20).
steps.data_source: SQL ServicioAndroid table CRED_SOLICITUD_WEB_DATOS_TEMP (no DDL on the share: column widths are NO EVIDENCE)
steps.outputs_side_effects: 1 persistent row; returns the new id (IdSolicitud)
steps.error_handling: No transaction; errors -> step 26 handling

steps.name: Insert credit article lines
steps.what_it_does: Opens a NEW IntelisisTmp connection (reassigns the cnn field). For each 'cantidad,sku' entry whose SKU differs from the PREVIOUS entry (only consecutive duplicates are skipped): SEGU00001 -> @SeguCost=float.Parse(costoEnvio), @Cantidad=1; others -> @SeguCost=0, @Cantidad=Int32.Parse(cantidad). @Condicion=condicion (data[5] for ALL lines), @Orden=1,2,3... (increments per call even if the SP inserts 0 rows), @Cp=infoCliente.codigoPostal. Runs as a text command 'SpVTASInsertArtSolCreditoLinea @IdCredito, ...' through SqlDataAdapter.Fill.
steps.error_handling: No local try: an exception jumps to the SaveData inner catch -> 'err' (discarded). Lines already inserted remain, the coupon is NOT burned (step 33 skipped), the Liberador is NOT started (step 34 skipped), the connection is left open

steps.name: Line SP: TELEFONIA region SKU swap
steps.what_it_does: If Art.Familia='TELEFONIA' and the SKU has a pair in VTASCRegionSku: if the CP is active in VTASCCodigoPostalRegionCelular it prefers Region6, otherwise Region5 (an empty CP counts as not active). It switches only if the target SKU has e-commerce stock > 0 (TotalArticulos, else eCommerceExist.existencia). Otherwise it keeps the original SKU. Edge case: @artRegion can end up NULL, and then 0 rows are inserted (runbook §21.2 R6).
steps.data_source: SQL IntelisisTmp: Art, VTASCRegionSku, VTASCCodigoPostalRegionCelular, eCommerceExist, VTASDEcommerceExportaArtExistencia
steps.outputs_side_effects: @artRegion used for price, cost and the stored SKU
steps.error_handling: No TRY/CATCH

steps.name: Line SP: cost, price, Abono and insert
steps.what_it_does: Cost = spVerCosto 96,'MAVI','',sku,'',Art.Unidad,Art.TipoCosteo,'PESOS',1. SEGU00001: INSERT (IdArtCreditoWeb=@IdCredito, cantidad=1, articulo, precio=@SeguCost, Orden, Abono=12, costo). Other lines: INSERT ... SELECT from PropreListaDFinal p JOIN VTASCCondicionesCredVtaLinea c ON c.CondicionPropre=p.Condicion WHERE c.Condicion=@Condicion AND p.articulo=@artRegion. precio = CEILING(p.Precio - p.Precio*DescuentoCategoria/100) when DescuentoCategoria>0, else p.Precio; Abono uses the same rule. This gives 0..N rows, with no error when there are none. The Magento price is NOT used.
steps.data_source: SQL IntelisisTmp: Art, spVerCosto, PropreListaDFinal, VTASCCondicionesCredVtaLinea; target MAVIANDROID01.ServicioAndroid.dbo.VTASdArtCreditoWeb (linked server)

steps.name: Promoter code burn (CodigoPromocion 'Elimina')
steps.what_it_does: If data[6] (codigo_promotor) has Length > 0: EXEC SpVTASVentaCupon @opcion='Elimina', @Codigo, @IdEcommerce=incrementId. The SP marks the latest unused VTASCVentaCupon row with that Codigo (FechaUtilizacion=GETDATE(), IdEcommerce) and then EXEC 'NUEVO', which INSERTs a new row with Codigo=Agente=@codigo, the Sucursal from Agente/Sucursal, and FechaEnvio=GETDATE(). Returns 'Eliminado' when no result set comes back.

steps.name: Liberador trigger (background thread)

IdVenta : IdSolicitud of the TEMP table).

steps.name: LiberarCliente HTTP
steps.what_it_does: WebClient POST AUTENTICACION_URL_LIBERADOR with {Password} returns a token. POST VETA_URL_LIBERADOR with header Authorization: <raw token, no 'Bearer'> and body {Cliente, Id=IdSolicitud, UEN}. Deserializes {id, cliente, uen, idVenta}. idVenta>0 -> {EN_ANALISIS, idVenta}; idVenta=0 -> {EN_ANALISIS, 0}. It NEVER returns AUTORIZADO.

steps.name: Callback to DMZ (CallMagentoAuthorizationCallback)
steps.what_it_does: Up to 3 attempts: POST URL_DMZ+'login/authenticate' with USER_DMZ {Username, Password} returns a token (quotes trimmed). POST URL_DMZ+'order/authorizationResult' with Bearer token and body {entityId, status, cuenta, idSolicitud}. 30 s timeout; sleeps 2 s, then 4 s. A cert-bypass HttpClientHandler is created (:1766-1768) but NOT passed to new HttpClient() (:1775), so it has no effect. It sets the global ServicePointManager TLS protocols.
steps.data_source: HTTP DMZ; LAN Web.config:21 URL_DMZ = https://localhost:44302/ in the checked-in config; :19 USER_DMZ
steps.error_handling: Every failure is logged; after 3 failures, 'ERROR CallMagentoCallback DEFINITIVO' is logged and nothing is raised

lan.final_response:
What LAN order/setOrder (OrdersController.Set) returns to its caller, by outcome:

1) No token or invalid JWT: HTTP 401. Any other token error: HTTP 500 (TokenValidationHandler.cs:69-78).

2) Null body: HTTP 400 (OrdersController.cs:141-142).

3) Exception BEFORE SetPedido's try (OrderMethods.cs:535-575):
- a missing articulos key or a parse failure in AgruparCantidadPorSKU;
- a missing required infoCliente key in ToArray;
- a null forzarOrder at :562.
Result: HTTP 200 whose body is the JSON string e.ToString(), i.e. the full exception text (OrdersController.cs:154-157).

4) A Venta with that incrementId already exists and the original forzarOrder is '0': HTTP 200 "PedidoExistente" (OrderMethods.cs:541-542).

5) Exception INSIDE the try before or around the credit call. Examples: float.Parse of the detail lines, a SQLite SaveGuide failure, a missing 'cuenta' key at :619, a failed ServicioAndroid connection open, decimal.Parse(total) failing in SaveData. Result: HTTP 200 "" (empty string). No credit application is created, but writes already made stay: eCommerceDetPedidos and possibly the guide (OrderMethods.cs:728-732).

6) Credit branch reached: HTTP 200 whose body is infoCliente['cuenta'], e.g. "C01575835" (OrderMethods.cs:649; OrdersController.cs:160). This happens WHATEVER ProductosCreditoWeb_SaveData did, because its return value is discarded:
- application + lines + coupon + Liberador all succeeded;
- 'sin cuenta' (checkCliente false or DB error): no application row;
- 'err' (master lookup, phone split, SP or line failure): header possibly written, lines possibly partial;
- IdSolicitud empty: header only, if at all.
An empty 'cuenta' ('') yields "".

7) Asynchronous, not part of the HTTP response: only when the account starts with 'C' and the header was inserted and the lines did not throw. A background thread calls the Liberador, then POSTs {entityId, status, cuenta, idSolicitud} to DMZ order/authorizationResult, which forwards to Magento rest/V1/omnipro-credito/authorizationResult.
- status is always EN_ANALISIS, or RECHAZADO if the Liberador call failed.
- Callback failures are only logged, after 3 attempts.

8) Alternate route order/validateCredit: HTTP 200 {status:'PROCESANDO', cuenta:<SetPedido result>}, or HTTP 500 if an exception escapes SetPedido (OrdersController.cs:470-481).

Historical DMZ mapping of LAN answers (commented out today, DMZ OrdersController.cs:142-176):
- 'PrecioIncorrecto'/'Incorrecto' -> 400
- empty -> 500
- 'PedidoExistente' -> 409
- 'sin cuenta' -> 422
- a response not starting with 'C' -> 500

In the CURRENT DMZ none of this applies. setOrder goes only to ServicioSAP order/new, and the DMZ returns SAP's body, or 500 if the call throws (DMZ OrdersController.cs:191-227).

steps.what_it_does: Returns cuentaBp for an existing client and infoCliente.cliente (for example "9400") for a new client. LAN always returns infoCliente["cuenta"] (LAN OrderMethods.cs:649). NOT INTENTIONAL for new clients (part of PLAN 18.5 #6).
steps.error_handling: The outer catch writes to the console and rethrows.

steps.name: SetOrderAsync credit response
steps.what_it_does: Returns Response{Resultado="Concluido", Zctefinal=cuentaCredito, Zidecomm=incrementId} and exits before FASE 4.
steps.error_handling: Exceptions are wrapped at OM:1950-1954.

steps.name: Steps that do NOT run for credit (stock, partner, SAP order)
steps.conditions: Unreachable for credit, which returns at OM:1802
steps.what_it_does:
None of these run for credit:
- ValidarPreciosConProperlistAsync (OM:1820)
- ValidarStockArticulosAsync (OM:1823-1827)
- ValidarRegionCelulares (OM:1830)
- ResolvePartnerNumberForOrderAsync / BP creation (OM:1833, OM:2546-2629; MapGender call at OM:2666)
- the second SaveGuideAsync (OM:1839)
- BuildSapOrderAsync plus POST ZAPI_SALESORDER_SRV (OM:1848-1893)
- DatosEntregaInsertAsync (OM:1925)
- GenerarMonederoSAPAsync (OM:1938)
- CallSetCAccountCallbackAsync (OM:1944)

So credit gets no stock check, no partner resolution or creation, and no SAP sales order. LAN also returns before crearPedido for credit (LAN OrderMethods.cs:649 vs :662) and has no stock check. EQUIVALENT. Who creates the credit sales order later is pending (PLAN 18.8/18.9).
steps.error_handling: n/a

steps.name: Controller response mapping
steps.what_it_does: Maps the response to {BP = Zctefinal, SalesDocument = to_result?.Salesdocument?.TrimStart('0') ?? PurchNoS (null for credit), Message = (Resultado == "Error" ? Zobservaciones : to_return first Message ?? "") ("" for credit), Resultado}. On an exception it logs Logger.SAP "[ORDER NEW ERROR]" and returns Ok("Error, " + e.Message) with HTTP 200. The 200 is kept on purpose for parity (comment at :39-44). LAN returned Ok(string): the cuenta, "", "PedidoExistente" or e.ToString() (LAN/Controllers/OrdersController.cs:147-160). The contract change is NOT INTENTIONAL / open (MATRIZ G1-24; PLAN 18.8, 19.2 #1).
steps.error_handling: If Logger.SAP throws inside the catch (Logger.cs:28-31), the exception is unhandled and the response is HTTP 500.

steps.name: DMZ pass-through to Magento
steps.what_it_does: curl.PostSAP("order/new").Trim('"'), then JsonConvert.DeserializeObject. An object is returned as Ok(object); anything else as Ok(string). The legacy mapping of LAN strings to 400/500/409/422 is commented out (:132-183). So "PedidoExistente" now arrives as a 200 object instead of 409, and errors arrive as a 200 string.
steps.error_handling: A curl exception is logged and the DMZ returns 500.

sap.final_response:
All outcomes pass through OrderController.cs:27-47. The DMZ passes them on (DMZ/Controllers/OrdersController.cs:191-227): an object as Ok(object), a string as Ok(string), and a DMZ curl failure as 500.

1. SUCCESS, existing BP (a row is written in CRED_SOLICITUD_WEB_DATOS_TEMP; lines written, or partly written):
   - HTTP 200 JSON {"BP":"<infoCliente.cuenta>","SalesDocument":null,"Message":"","Resultado":"Concluido"}.
   - LAN: HTTP 200 JSON string "<cuenta>".
2. SUCCESS, new client (cuenta empty, infoCliente.cliente set):
   - A row is inserted with cliente "".
   - HTTP 200 {"BP":"<infoCliente.cliente>",...,"Resultado":"Concluido"}.
   - LAN: no row; SetPedido returned infoCliente["cuenta"] = "", which the legacy DMZ turned into 500 "LAN retornó vacío".
3. LINES, CONDITION OR PROMO FAILURE after the header was written:
   - Same as 1 (Resultado "Concluido").
   - The header has 0 or partial lines.
   - Log "[CREDITO ARTICULOS ERROR]".
   - LAN: same outward result (the cuenta).
4. DUPLICATE (SD36 finds ZSD_ZMER_<incrementId> and forzarOrder == "0" after ToArray):
   - HTTP 200 {"BP":null,"SalesDocument":null,"Message":"","Resultado":"PedidoExistente"}. This does not happen in practice for credit, because no SAP order exists yet.
   - LAN: "PedidoExistente", which the legacy DMZ turned into 409.
5. VALIDATION FAILURE (no row inserted; the SQLite guide row IS written):
   - Guest: HTTP 200 JSON string "Error, Error en SetOrder: Los invitados no pueden pagar con crédito."
   - BP not found, or any ZB_DATOS_CLIENTE error: "Error, Error en SetOrder: El cliente BP <cuenta> no tiene crédito activo en SAP." This applies to the current real payloads with "C0...".
   - Identity 0: "Error, Error en SetOrder: No se pudo generar la solicitud de crédito."
   - LAN: a guest gets "", which becomes legacy DMZ 500. A missing client gets the cuenta with 200 and no row.
6. INFRASTRUCTURE EXCEPTION inside InsertAsync (no row inserted):
   - Triggers: BP05MA, A_GET_TelefonoValidado, CteTelSet, AWS catalog, SMS SQL, or the INSERT itself, including SQL 8152/2628 width errors.
   - HTTP 200 "Error, Error en SetOrder: <wrapped message>". The message can include SAP response content.
   - LAN swallowed these as "err" and answered with the cuenta and 200. This change is INTENTIONAL (errors propagate).
7. ANY OTHER EXCEPTION before the credit block (for example articulos null in ToArray): HTTP 200 "Error, Error en SetOrder: ...".
8. NULL BODY: HTTP 400.
9. LOGGER FAILURE: if Logger.SAP throws inside the controller catch, the response is an unhandled HTTP 500.

The liberador and the Magento authorization callback never run (commented out at OM:724-756), so after any of these outcomes the Magento order stays pending.

deep:article-lines.subject: Credit application ARTICLE LINES: LAN CreditMethods.CreditoWeb_InsertArticulo + SpVTASInsertArtSolCreditoLinea + spVerCosto vs ServicioSAP OrderMethods.InsertCreditArticlesAsync (current working tree). Abbreviations: LAN-OM = //172.16.214.58/sap/LAN/WebApiMagento/Metodos/OrderMethods.cs; LAN-CM = .../LAN/WebApiMagento/Metodos/CreditMethods.cs; OM = //172.16.214.58/sap/ServicioSAP/ServicioSap/ServicioSap/Methods/Order/OrderMethods.cs (3358 lines); FLP = .../ServicioSap/Methods/SalesDistribution/FinalListProperMethods.cs; SPL = //172.16.214.58/sap/.agents/skills/lan-sap-migration/SPsOrden/SpVTASInsertArtSolCreditoLinea.sql; SVC = .../SPsOrden/spVerCosto.sql; PLAN = .../MappingMetods/PLAN_EJECUCION_SP_CREDITO_A_CODIGO.md. Section 21 check: the OM/SPL line numbers it cites still match the current code (OM:926, :931, :933-937, :969-972, :877-880, :711-717, :720, :724-756, :1802-1807, :1816, :1830, :2086, :3325; FLP:97-98). Three statements need correcting: (1) 21.1 says 'lines without price are skipped'. Only lines with NO matching SD29 row are skipped. A matching row with price 0 is still inserted with precio 0 (OM:974-978 vs OM:997-1008). (2) 21.3 calls costo=0 a 'documented decision (PLAN:1431)'. PLAN:1431 is an open question ('does anyone read VTASdArtCreditoWeb.costo?'), and PLAN §18.9 lists the cost as deferred. So it is not a user decision. (3) 21.2 R11 says the condition-key equivalence is 'to be validated'. New evidence below suggests the SAP query reads the wrong column and in practice runs on the in-memory catalog.

items.lan: SetPedido first calls AgruparCantidadPorSKU (LAN-OM:535, :486-526). It sums quantities per SKU into a Dictionary in insertion order and keeps the first line's condicion. The credit branch then adds one 'cantidad,sku' string per grouped article (LAN-OM:611-615).
items.sap: SetOrderAsync first calls AgruparCantidadPorSKU (OM:1740, :87-104). It uses LINQ GroupBy, which keeps first-appearance order, with Sum(cantidad) and First().condicion. The credit branch then adds 'cantidad,sku' per article (OM:1789-1793). cantidad is an int in the model (Models/SAP/Order/ArticuloRequest.cs:11).
items.impact: Same strings in the same order. Both groupings are case-sensitive, so 'abc' and 'ABC' become two lines in both systems.

items.item: When the SEGU00001 shipping line is appended
items.lan: Added when the text costoEnvio != "0" && != "", using Magento's raw text: costoEnvio + ',SEGU00001' (LAN-OM:616-617). Always appended last.
items.sap: Added when the decimal costoEnvio > 0, using costoEnvio.ToString(InvariantCulture) + ',SEGU00001' (OM:1794-1795). Always appended last.
items.decision_ref: PLAN §20.1 #15 (invariant culture applied); PLAN §20.3 row 'costoEnvio is text in LAN' (the "0.00" case deliberately not aligned)
items.impact: Only differs for "0.00" or negative values: LAN inserts SEGU00001 with price 0 or a negative price, SAP inserts nothing. Real payloads carry "0" or "150" (Resources/magento_payloads.md:26, :55).

items.item: Which condition applies to the lines
items.lan: The first article's condition, order.articulos[0]["condicion"] (LAN-OM:632), becomes data[5] (LAN-CM:111) and goes to the SP for every line (LAN-CM:910).
items.sap: order.articulos?.FirstOrDefault()?.condicion ?? "" (OM:700), used for every line.
items.impact: Neither honors a different condition on the 2nd..Nth article.

items.lan: Grouped upstream (LAN-OM:486-526). Inside the loop, prevArt skips only a SKU equal to the one just processed (LAN-CM:876, :895-897).
items.sap: Grouped upstream (OM:87-104). Same consecutive prevArt check (OM:899, :922-924). The per-SKU SD29 cache is case-insensitive (OM:883) but only saves HTTP calls.
items.impact: One line per SKU with the total quantity (PLAN §18.7 P17 holds). Shared edge case: a real product with SKU 'SEGU00001' is treated as shipping in both (qty 1, price = its quantity text).

items.lan: SET @familia = (SELECT Familia FROM Art WHERE Articulo=@Articulo) (SPL:43-48), which gates the TELEFONIA logic (SPL:48).
items.sap: Not looked up anywhere in OM:857-1023. DM01 FAMILIA exists in the Product model but InsertCreditArticlesAsync does not call it.
items.decision_ref: No user decision. Deferred: PLAN §18.9 'SKU por region'; PLAN §21.4 'wait for source' (the TELEFONIA family code has no source)
items.impact: Only matters because the region substitution depends on it (next item). A non-TELEFONIA SKU behaves the same.

items.item: TELEFONIA region SKU substitution (VTASCRegionSku, VTASCCodigoPostalRegionCelular, stock check)
items.lan: For a TELEFONIA SKU that has a pair in VTASCRegionSku (SPL:56-83): if @Cp is active in VTASCCodigoPostalRegionCelular (SPL:85-89), a Region5 SKU is swapped to Region6 when Region6 ecommerce stock > 0 (SPL:90-118). Otherwise (inactive, empty or NULL CP), a Region6 SKU is swapped to Region5 when Region5 stock > 0 (SPL:127-158). Stock is global, from eCommerceExist LEFT JOIN VTASDEcommerceExportaArtExistencia (SPL:98-109, :135-146). The chosen @artRegion drives the article, price, Abono and cost (SPL:221-262). @Cp comes from infoCliente.codigoPostal (LAN-OM:639, LAN-CM:912) and is VARCHAR(5) (SPL:34). Defects: the temp table is filled twice (SPL:62-68 and :77-83), TOP 1 has no ORDER BY, and @artRegion can stay NULL, inserting 0 rows (SPL:121-125).
items.sap: codigoPostal is passed in (OM:699, :703) but never read in the method body (OM:857-1023). The Magento SKU is written as-is (OM:926). ValidarRegionCelulares (OM:2086) only runs in the cash path (OM:1830), after the credit branch has already returned (OM:1802-1807).
items.impact: Example: TELEFONIA Region5 SKU, customer CP active in the table, Region6 stock 5. LAN writes the Region6 SKU with Region6's PropreListaDFinal price and Abono. SAP writes the Region5 SKU with Region5's SD29 price. No real credit payload is telephony (PLAN §21.2), so this is unproven in production.

items.lan: C#: SeguCost = float.Parse(shipping text), qty 1 (LAN-CM:899-902). SP: precio=@SeguCost, cantidad=@Cantidad, articulo='SEGU00001', Abono=12, with no JOIN and no condition dependency (SPL:179-216).
items.sap: precio = ParsearImporte(text) (OM:935, InvariantCulture decimal, OM:308-315), qty 1 (OM:936), Abono 12 (OM:937). SKU 'SEGU00001' (OM:926).
items.impact: Same values. LAN parses to a single-precision float, so 149.99 is stored as 149.99000549..., while SAP stores 149.99. Real shipping values (150) are identical. See the cost and missing-condition items for the two real differences on this line.

items.item: General branch: price source and filtering
items.lan: INSERT...SELECT FROM PropreListaDFinal p JOIN VTASCCondicionesCredVtaLinea c ON c.CondicionPropre=p.Condicion WHERE c.Condicion=@Condicion AND p.articulo=@artRegion (SPL:243-262). No UEN, Sucursal, Canal or Vigente filter.
items.sap: SD29 GET PropreListSet?$filter=Articulo eq '{sku}' (FLP:82-110). Keeps rows where SalesOrg == DeterminarSalesOrg(order) ('04' MA, '05' VIU; OM:340-351, :870, :957-959). Takes FirstOrDefault where Condition == condicionSap, falling back to Condition == the Magento text (OM:969-972). Price = ParsearImporte(proper.Price) (OM:982). No Vigente, Sucursal, CDistr or Lista criteria.
items.decision_ref: Source swap PropreListaDFinal -> SD29. The SD29 entity key includes Idproprelistadfinal (MappingMetods/CAPTURAS_REALES_APIS.md:199)
items.impact: Same catalog through another channel. The fallback to the Magento text is effectively dead: ecommerce rows (04/05) carry codes such as 12IA or 12IV, not descriptions (CAPTURAS_REALES_APIS.md:212-216). Multiple matching rows are covered in a separate item.

items.lan: p.Abono from PropreListaDFinal, with CEILING when DescuentoCategoria > 0 (SPL:252-256).
items.sap: proper.Installment, mapped from JSON 'Abono' (Models/SAP/SalesDistribution/FinalListProper.cs, [JsonPropertyName("Abono")]), via ParsearImporte (OM:984), same CEILING (OM:993).
items.decision_ref: User decision 2026-09-23: Abono is a product configurable, no guard for 0 (CAPTURAS_REALES_APIS.md:218-219)
items.impact: The DEV capture has Abono 0.00 on the 04/05 rows (test data), so tests will write Abono 0. LAN would do the same with the same data.

items.item: Condition key translation (LAN Condicion -> CondicionPropre vs SAP CondicionMagento)
items.lan: Matches c.Condicion = the Magento text, then uses c.CondicionPropre = p.Condicion (SPL:259-261). No store filter. Legacy column meaning is confirmed elsewhere: vl.Condicion is joined to the Intelisis Condicion table (LAN-CM:2596-2611); ccvl.Condicion holds values like '12 M MA P INM' and CondicionPropre joins PropreListaDFinal.Condicion (LAN/WebApiMagento/Metodos/ProductMethods.cs:756-791). Legacy columns: Condicion, Mensualidades, TiendaVirtual, CondicionPropre, CondicionWeb (MappingMetods/_IMPLEMENTACION_SP_CREDITO/prep/contrato.md:1300).
items.sap: GetCondicionAsync (OM:3325-3357) runs on SIGMAVI: SELECT TOP 1 Condicion FROM CondicionesCredVtaLinea WHERE CondicionMagento=@c AND REPLACE(TiendaVirtual,' ','_')=@storeId (OM:3333-3335). Any exception is logged and swallowed (OM:3351-3354). With no row, it falls back to the in-memory PaymentConditionCatalog with default "" (OM:3356; Helpers/PaymentConditionCatalog.cs:61 '12 M MA P INM'->'12IA', :64 '12 M VIU P INM'->'12IV', :122-137). An empty result makes the method throw (OM:877-880).
items.decision_ref: None. PLAN §18.8 (line 1429) still asks whether SIGMAVI has a CondicionMagento column
items.impact: The SIGMAVI naming rule keeps the Intelisis column names (Checklists/CHECKLIST_DEV3_NOSAP_NOINTELISIS.md:317). If that holds, CondicionMagento does not exist, every call logs a SqlException, and the price comes from the hard-coded catalog. Even if the column existed, SAP returns the column that holds the Magento-side key, not the CondicionPropre equivalent. For the two real credit conditions (magento_payloads.md:26, :55) the catalog gives 12IA/12IV, which match the SD29 ecommerce codes, so prices are found. A condition missing from the catalog (for example '12 M VIU PP', OM:53) loses every line, where LAN would price it if VTASCCondicionesCredVtaLinea had the row. The REPLACE(TiendaVirtual) vs 'muebles_america' match relies on a case-insensitive collation (NO EVIDENCE).

items.item: Several price rows for one SKU and condition (JOIN fan-out vs FirstOrDefault)
items.lan: INSERT...SELECT inserts one line per matching row of PropreListaDFinal x VTASCCondicionesCredVtaLinea, all with the same @Orden (SPL:243-262). LAN's own catalog reader has to filter the same table by UEN, Sucursal IN (90,41,0) and Canal IN (7,3,0), order by Canal DESC, Sucursal DESC, and keep the first row per condition (ProductMethods.cs:781-808). That implies several rows per SKU and condition exist.
items.sap: At most one line: the first SD29 row in response order with a matching OrgVtas and Condition (OM:957-972). No $orderby (FLP:85). The SD29 key includes Lista, Sucursal, OrgVtas, CDistr and Sector (CAPTURAS_REALES_APIS.md:199). Rows with different CDistr exist for the same OrgVtas (CAPTURAS_REALES_APIS.md:225).
items.decision_ref: None (PLAN §21.2 R11 lists it but does not decide it)
items.impact: If a SKU has 2 matching legacy rows, LAN writes 2 lines with the same Orden and SAP writes 1. When several SD29 rows match, which price SAP picks is not deterministic. NO EVIDENCE of how often this happens with real data.

items.lan: CASE WHEN p.DescuentoCategoria > 0 THEN CEILING(p.Precio - p.Precio*p.DescuentoCategoria/100) ELSE p.Precio; same for Abono (SPL:248-256).
items.sap: descuento = ParsearImporte(proper.CategoryDiscount), mapped from 'Descuentocategoria'. If > 0: Math.Ceiling(precio - precio*desc/100m); same for Abono (OM:988-994).
items.impact: Same formula. NULL or 0 means no discount in both. For integer prices, SQL integer division gives the same result as decimal CEILING. Column types are NO EVIDENCE, so a float edge case exactly on an integer boundary is theoretical. The DEV capture has Descuentocategoria '0.00' everywhere (CAPTURAS_REALES_APIS.md:209), so P18 needs a SKU that has a discount.

items.lan: General branch: spVerCosto 96,'MAVI','',@artRegion,'',Art.Unidad,Art.TipoCosteo,'PESOS',1 (SPL:221-237). SEGU00001: the same call for SEGU00001 (SPL:188-204). The result is ROUND(...) and can be NULL, for example when TipoCosteo is NULL or 'NO' or there is no Art row (SVC, final SELECT). The xpVerCosto hook and several operators are missing from the copy (PLAN §21.3 point 6).
items.sap: costoArticulo = 0m always (OM:931), written at OM:1006. Applies to both SEGU00001 and articles.
items.decision_ref: Deferred: PLAN §18.5 #13, §18.9. PLAN:1431 is an open question, not a decision (corrects §21.3)
items.impact: Every line has costo 0 instead of the Intelisis cost, and never NULL. There is no reader in LAN, DMZ or ServicioSAP code: a grep finds only writes (OM:901, SPL:208, :243). The external Liberador service, which receives only Id, Cliente and UEN (LAN/WebApiMagento/Metodos/LiberadorCreditoMethods.cs:47-52), is the likely reader: NO EVIDENCE.

items.lan: No PropreListaDFinal/condition row: the INSERT...SELECT inserts 0 rows, raises no error, and Orden still advances (SPL:243-262; LAN-CM:914-915). A row with Precio 0 or NULL is inserted as 0 or NULL.
items.sap: No SD29 row for OrgVtas+Condition: skipped with orden++ (OM:974-978). A row with Price 0 or unparseable is inserted with precio 0 and counted in sinPrecio (OM:997-1008). The sinPrecio counter and log ignore the skipped case (OM:1022).
items.impact: Same lines and numbering (P15 holds). Differences: NULL in LAN vs 0 in SAP when the price field is empty, and a misleading log count. Corrects §21.1: a line whose row has price 0 is inserted, not skipped.

items.lan: No check. The loop over articulos inserts whatever the JOIN yields, possibly nothing (LAN-CM:891-917).
items.sap: Returns early if articulos is empty (OM:859-863). The old throw on 'insertados == 0' is gone: there is no such check in OM:857-1023. Only a Console summary remains (OM:1022).
items.impact: A header with no lines and no error in both (P16).

items.lan: orden=1 (LAN-CM:875). Assigned per call (:911) and incremented after every SP call (:915), including calls that insert 0 rows. Fan-out duplicates share the same Orden.
items.sap: orden=1 (OM:898). Assigned at OM:927, incremented on a skip (OM:976) and after each insert (OM:1010).
items.impact: Same numbers with gaps where a SKU has no price. SEGU00001 is always last. The one difference is when the condition is missing: LAN writes SEGU00001 with Orden N+1, SAP writes nothing.

items.lan: @IdCredito INT = the id returned by SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS (LAN-CM:189-201, SPL:209). Lines are inserted only if IdSolicitud != "" (LAN-CM:199).
items.sap: int.Parse(idSolicitud) (OM:925). Guarded at OM:695-696 and OM:865-866.
items.impact: None for the lines. If the id is missing, LAN silently skips the lines while SAP throws (header-level behavior, outside this item).

items.lan: 1 for SEGU00001, otherwise Int32.Parse (LAN-CM:899-907); SP @Cantidad (SPL:210, :245).
items.sap: 1 for SEGU00001 (OM:936), otherwise int.Parse (OM:941).
items.impact: None.

items.lan: @artRegion, possibly substituted (SPL:246), or 'SEGU00001' (SPL:211). The SP parameter @Articulo VARCHAR(20) (SPL:30) silently truncates longer SKUs.
items.sap: The Magento SKU as-is (OM:926), in an unsized VarChar parameter (OM:909). No truncation: if the column is narrower, SQL error 8152.
items.decision_ref: Width: decision 13 'insert as it arrived' (PLAN §18.3). The TELEFONIA substitution part is NOT intentional (see that item)
items.impact: The article differs for TELEFONIA substitutions. SKUs longer than 20 characters would fail in SAP instead of being truncated. The column width is NO EVIDENCE (the DDL query in PLAN §18.3 is still pending).

items.lan: SEGU: @SeguCost / 12 (SPL:213, :215). Articles: PropreListaDFinal Precio / Abono with CEILING (SPL:247-256).
items.sap: SEGU: shipping / 12 (OM:935, :937). Articles: SD29 Price / Abono with CEILING (OM:982-994). Sent as SqlDbType.Float (OM:910, :912).
items.impact: Equal whenever SD29 carries the same catalog values as PropreListaDFinal for the resolved condition.

items.lan: The SP runs in IntelisisTmp@MAVICUBOS (LAN/WebApiMagento/Conn/Connection.cs:26; LAN-CM:872-878) and writes MAVIANDROID01.ServicioAndroid.dbo.VTASdArtCreditoWeb through a linked server (SPL:208, :243). No transaction.
items.sap: Direct INSERT INTO VTASdArtCreditoWeb (OM:901-903) on MAVICBOSANDROID = mavicbosandroid.grupomavi.com/ServicioAndroid (ServicioSap/Web.config:13; Helpers/ConexionDB/ConexionSQL.cs:100-127; OM:888). No transaction.
items.impact: Same table, if the linked server MAVIANDROID01 points to mavicbosandroid (NO EVIDENCE: the linked server definition is not in the share). Partial lines stay in place on failure in both.

items.item: Condition does not exist: stopping the lines
items.lan: No validation. Every article runs a 0-row INSERT...SELECT. SEGU00001 is still inserted, because its branch ignores @Condicion (SPL:179-216). Then the promoter code is burned (LAN-CM:203-206) and, for a 'C...' account, the Liberador starts (LAN-CM:208-240).
items.sap: Throws at OM:877-880 before the loop. No line is inserted, not even SEGU00001. The promoter code is not burned (it sits in the try after the insert, OM:703-709).
items.decision_ref: Decision 9: 'if it does not exist ... there is no default, the result must stop and notify that the payment condition does not exist' (PLAN:1503, §20.3)
items.impact: Example: condition 'XX' with shipping 150. LAN gives the header, one SEGU00001 line (Orden N+1) and a burned promoter code. SAP gives the header only.

items.item: Condition does not exist: notification and header already written
items.lan: The Magento response is the account (LAN-OM:649). No notice.
items.sap: The header is written first (OM:694). The exception is only logged (OM:711-717) and Magento gets Resultado 'Concluido' (OM:1802-1807). Nothing notifies that the condition is missing.
items.decision_ref: The 'notify' half of decision 9 is not implemented. PLAN §18.5 #7 is still open (does 'stop' mean before writing the header?)
items.impact: An orphan header without lines, and Magento believes the order is done.

items.item: Error handling inside the line loop
items.lan: No try in CreditoWeb_InsertArticulo (LAN-CM:869-919). The exception goes up to the catch in ProductosCreditoWeb_SaveData (LAN-CM:246-252), which calls Logger.Credit and returns 'err'. SetPedido ignores that and returns the account (LAN-OM:624-649). Remaining lines, promoter code and Liberador are skipped. The Intelisis connection is not closed on the exception (LAN-CM:872-873, :918: no using).
items.sap: The inner catch logs and rethrows (OM:1015-1019). ProcessCreditPaymentAsync catches (OM:711-717) with Logger.SAP and Console. The promoter code is skipped and the method returns the account, so Magento gets Concluido. The connection is disposed (OM:888). Extra failure points that LAN does not have: SD29 HTTP errors propagate (FLP:97-98, :107-109); SIGMAVI errors are swallowed (OM:3351-3354); Logger.SAP can throw in CreateDirectory outside its try (Helpers/Logger.cs:26-31), which would escape to OM:761-765.
items.decision_ref: PLAN §20.1 #11 and the note on the line catch (the Magento response does not change, as in LAN); §17.2 (errors propagate)
items.impact: In both, a mid-loop failure leaves partial lines, the promoter code is not burned, and Magento sees success. SAP additionally depends on SD29 being available: an SD29 outage means a header with no lines.

questions_for_user: Condition lookup: can someone run a read-only SELECT TOP 1 * FROM CondicionesCredVtaLinea on SIGMAVI? LAN's key is Condicion = the Magento text, and it uses CondicionPropre to reach the price list. ServicioSAP filters on a column called CondicionMagento and returns Condicion. If SIGMAVI kept the Intelisis column names, that column does not exist and the flow runs only on the hard-coded PaymentConditionCatalog. Should the query become SELECT CondicionPropre ... WHERE Condicion=@magento (legacy meaning), and does CondicionPropre in SIGMAVI hold the SD29 codes (12IA/12IV)?
Decision 9 says there is 'no default'. Is the in-memory PaymentConditionCatalog fallback (OM:3356) acceptable as a second source, or must a condition missing from SIGMAVI stop the flow?

Decision 9, 'stop and notify': should the condition be validated BEFORE the header is written (OM:694 runs before OM:875)? Should Magento receive an error instead of 'Concluido' (OM:1802-1807)? Today the result is an orphan header with no lines, and no one is told.

Several price rows: when SD29 returns more than one row for the same SKU + OrgVtas + Condicion (different Sucursal, CDistr or Lista), which row should win? LAN inserted every matching row with the same Orden; SAP takes the first in response order. Should we filter on Sucursal 0504/0505, CDistr 02 or Vigente=true?

Cost and TELEFONIA region SKU: please confirm both are DEFERRED and not dropped. §21.3 calls costo=0 a 'documented decision', but PLAN:1431 is only an open question. Who reads VTASdArtCreditoWeb (the Liberador service, SP_CREDITO_WEB_VALORES_FORM), and does it treat a NULL cost differently from 0?
May we apply Uri.EscapeDataString to the SKU in the SD29 $filter (FinalListProperMethods.cs:85)? Otherwise the real VIU SKU 'DIB+00104' may silently get no line.

Can the DBA confirm that the linked server MAVIANDROID01 used by the legacy SP is the same server as mavicbosandroid.grupomavi.com/ServicioAndroid? Can they also run the VTASdArtCreditoWeb DDL (widths of articulo; types of precio, Abono and costo)?

questions_for_user: @TelefonoValidado: PLAN 15.1 says A_GET_TelefonoValidado does the MOVIL + ValidacionTel=1 filter. The reference code (businesspartner-dev A_GET_TelefonoValidado.py:17-36) filters only by Partner and takes max() by date, where null dates win. Your own capture (CAPTURAS_REALES_APIS.md:96) shows it returning a non-validated phone for BP 1500004598. How should we fix it? (a) Ask the API owner to filter MOVIL + Zvaltel and order by Zfecha DESC with nulls last. (b) Apply the SP's WHERE/ORDER in C# on the CteTelSet list we already download (GetCteTelAsync). (c) Accept the difference.

Gender codes in ZAPI_BP05MA_SRV: SexoLegado assumes '1' = Masculino and '2' = Femenino. That matches this project's MapGender, but the share has no evidence of the SAP domain; the only capture is Gender '9' with Xsexu. Can you confirm with one BP of known sex, or should we map from Xsexm/Xsexf instead?
estadoCivil: LAN wrote CTE.EstadoCivil; ServicioSAP writes ''. Should we accept '' for now, or wait for the Marst code table and map it?
New client with empty 'cuenta': LAN created no application; ServicioSAP creates one with an empty cliente. Should we block it (parity with LAN) or keep it?

Cases where LAN aborted with no row (no birthdate in the master, empty or short phone, non-numeric SMS phone): ServicioSAP now inserts with NULL, 0 or '0'. Should we replicate the abort, or keep inserting?

If the AWS catalog or CteTelSet returns an HTTP error while the client has a validated phone, ServicioSAP aborts the application; LAN inserted it with ValidacionTelefono=1. Should an error abort, or degrade to NULL (result 1)?

Who reads CRED_SOLICITUD_WEB_DATOS_TEMP.cliente downstream (the Liberador, credit staff)? It now holds 10-digit BP numbers instead of 9-character Intelisis codes. And can someone run the DDL query from PLAN 18.3 so we know whether MetodoEnvio (12) and cliente (9) will make every insert fail?

comparisons.name: OpenPay branches skipped for credit (openpay_cards early exit / openpay_stores side write)
comparisons.lan_source: No SQL, SP, OData or HTTP call is made on the credit path. If the branches were taken, they would write to a local SQLite file through LAN's DB class: tables openpay_orders and openpay_stores (DDL in comments at LAN Metodos/OpenpayMethods.cs:14-33). Gate constants are at LAN Metodos/OrderMethods.cs:31-34.
comparisons.lan_detail:
LAN Metodos/OrderMethods.cs:533 SetPedido(OrderRequest order, bool liberado = false). This step runs after the PedidoExistente check (:541-542) and BEFORE the try block (the try opens at :576).
- :545-549: if (order.metodoPago == OPENPAY_METHOD && !liberado) creates new OpenpayMethods() and returns openpay.SaveToValidateOpenpay(order). That method is at OpenpayMethods.cs:55-60: a Newtonsoft JsonConvert of the order, a string-concatenated INSERT into openpay_orders with status 'processing' and is_in_intelisis '0', and no try. It returns "Concluido".
- :551-555: if (order.metodoPago == OPENPAY_STORES_METHOD) calls openpay.SaveOpenpayStoresOrder(order) (OpenpayMethods.cs:62-68: INSERT into openpay_stores with status 'in_progress', no try). Its return value is ignored and the flow continues.
- The comparison is C# string == (ordinal, case-sensitive) against "openpay_cards" / "openpay_stores" (:32, :34). OrderRequest.metodoPago is a string (LAN Models/OrderRequest.cs:16), bound by the default Web API Newtonsoft formatter (App_Start/WebApiConfig.cs has no custom formatter).
- For metodoPago = "omnipro_pago_credito" (the real credit payloads at magento_payloads.md:26 and :55 use exactly this lowercase value), both conditions are false. OpenpayMethods is never constructed, so its constructor side effects (new OrderMethods, new DB, parsing openpay_env at OpenpayMethods.cs:39-53) do not run. Nothing is written and nothing is returned, and execution falls through to :557 and later to the credit branch at :609.
- A null metodoPago also gives false with no exception.
- Callers that reach this step with credit: OrdersController.cs:151 (setOrder), :470 (validateCredit) and OrderMethods.cs:1708 (ReSetPedido), all with liberado=false. The only caller with liberado=true is OpenpayMethods.cs:276, which replays rows from openpay_orders and so is never a credit order.
comparisons.sap_source: No OData or HTTP API is involved in this step, so there is nothing to map to businesspartner-dev or salesanddistribution-dev. If the branches were taken, they would write to local SQLite through SQLiteDb: the same table names openpay_orders and openpay_stores (ServicioSAP Methods/Order/OrderMethods.cs:481, :510). Gate constants are at OM:44-47 and match LAN character for character.
comparisons.sap_detail:
ServicioSAP Methods/Order/OrderMethods.cs:1728 SetOrderAsync(OrderRequest orderRequest, string tipo = ""), called from Controllers/OrderController.cs:27 with tipo "Insert". This step runs after the SD36 duplicate check (:1752-1760), inside the outer try (:1730, with its catch at :1950-1954 that rethrows). The uncommitted working-tree diff does not touch these lines: its hunks land at :1787 and later.
- :1765-1774: if (orderRequest.metodoPago == OPENPAY_METHOD) calls SaveToValidateOpenpayAsync (OM:470-492: System.Text.Json serialize plus EscapeSqlValue, then INSERT into openpay_orders; the try/catch returns "Error" on failure). It then returns new OrderResponse { Resultado = "Concluido" or "Error al guardar", Zidecomm = incrementId }. There is no liberado parameter.
- :1776-1780: if (orderRequest.metodoPago == OPENPAY_STORES_METHOD) calls SaveOpenpayStoresOrderAsync (OM:497-521: INSERT into openpay_stores with the same columns and the same date format as LAN, inside a try/catch). Its result `res` is ignored and the flow continues.
- The comparison is C# == (ordinal, case-sensitive), the same as LAN. OrderRequest.metodoPago is a string (Models/SAP/Order/OrderRequest.cs:19), bound by the default Web API Newtonsoft formatter (App_Start/WebApiConfig.cs has no custom formatter). AgruparCantidadPorSKU (OM:87-107) and ToArray (OM:198-213) do not modify metodoPago.
- For "omnipro_pago_credito", both conditions are false: nothing is written, nothing is returned, and execution falls through to the credit branch at :1785. A null metodoPago also gives false with no exception.
- The observable result for credit is identical to LAN: no SQLite write, no early response, no exception.
- Adjacent observation, outside this step's lines: other SS code detects credit with OrdinalIgnoreCase (OM:357 DeterminarPlant, OM:2199 BuildSapOrderAsync, OM:2557 ResolvePartnerNumberForOrderAsync), while this gate and the credit gate at :1785 are case-sensitive. See the last difference.
- Also adjacent, belonging to the idempotency step: SS evaluates orderRequest.forzarOrder AFTER ToArray has mutated it (OM:236-237, :253-254, used at :1752). LAN evaluates the forzarOrderOriginal it captured before ToArray (LAN :538, :541). So a credit order that carries a precioEspecial skips the duplicate check in SS but not in LAN. This decides whether a credit order reaches this step; it is not part of this step.

differences.what: Inconsistent case sensitivity when detecting credit inside ServicioSAP. This step's gate compares exactly as LAN does; the effect appears downstream.
differences.lan: Every metodoPago test uses ordinal ==. A value that is not exactly "omnipro_pago_credito" is treated as non-credit everywhere (OrderMethods.cs:545, :551, :609).
differences.sap: This gate (OM:1765, :1776) and the credit gate (OM:1785) use ordinal ==, but DeterminarPlant (OM:357), BuildSapOrderAsync (OM:2199, which sets DistrChan "02") and ResolvePartnerNumberForOrderAsync (OM:2557) use OrdinalIgnoreCase. They also trim at :2551.
differences.evidence: SS Methods/Order/OrderMethods.cs:357, :1785, :2198-2200, :2551-2558; LAN Metodos/OrderMethods.cs:609. The real payloads always send lowercase (magento_payloads.md:26, :55).
differences.concrete_case: metodoPago="Omnipro_Pago_Credito". Both systems skip the OpenPay branches and the credit branch, so no credit application is created in either. LAN then runs its cash SP path (SP_eCommerceNuevoPed). SS runs its cash SAP path, but with the credit partner resolution (ResolveCreditMAPartner) and DistrChan "02". This is theoretical: no real payload uses mixed case.

comparisons.name: Null body -> HTTP 400 (setOrder entry guard)
comparisons.lan_source: No SQL or stored procedure involved. HTTP route POST order/setOrder (attribute route), ASP.NET Web API 5.2.7 WebHost model binding with the default JsonMediaTypeFormatter (Newtonsoft 12.0.3, redirected to 12.0.0.0). Model: WebApiMagento.Models.OrderRequest.
comparisons.sap_source: No OData or HTTP API involved: this step only does model binding. HTTP route POST order/new (attribute route), same ASP.NET Web API 5.2.7 WebHost pipeline and default JsonMediaTypeFormatter (Newtonsoft 12.0.2, redirected to 12.0.0.0). Model: ServicioSap.Models.SAP.Order.OrderRequest. businesspartner-dev and salesanddistribution-dev do not apply to this step.
comparisons.lan_detail:
//172.16.214.58/sap/LAN/WebApiMagento/Controllers/OrdersController.cs:15-16 declare [Authorize] and [RoutePrefix("order")]. Lines :137-139 declare [HttpPost] [Route("setOrder")] public IHttpActionResult Set(OrderRequest order). Lines :141-142 run `if (order == null) throw new HttpResponseException(HttpStatusCode.BadRequest);`. The guard runs before Logger.SetOrder (:144), before new OrderMethods (:147) and outside the try/catch (:149-158), so on null nothing is logged, nothing is written, and the catch's Ok(e.ToString()) (:156) never applies. The result is HTTP 400 with an empty body.
Pipeline: App_Start/WebApiConfig.cs:16 maps attribute routes and :18 adds TokenValidationHandler. There are no Filters, Formatters or SerializerSettings changes anywhere in the project (grep found none), and Global.asax.cs:14 only calls Configure. TokenValidationHandler (Controllers/TokenValidationHandler.cs:32-79) lets a request with no Authorization header through, so [Authorize] returns 401 before model binding. An invalid token gets 401 from the handler, and any other exception during validation gets 500.
Binding: Models/OrderRequest.cs:6-29 uses strings for amounts (:12-17) and Dictionary<string,string> for articulos (:19) and infoCliente (:20). order is null when the body is literally null, empty (Content-Length 0), has a non-object root ([] or "x"), or is not parseable at all. Property-level conversion errors are marked handled by the formatter and still yield a non-null order.
Limits: Web.config:53-54 has <httpRuntime targetFramework="4.5"/> with no maxRequestLength (ASP.NET default 4096 KB) and no requestLimits (IIS default 30,000,000 bytes).
Context: the observable 400 that Magento gets for a null body comes from the DMZ bridge, which has the same guard at //172.16.214.58/sap/DMZ/WebApiMagento/Controllers/OrdersController.cs:111-112. In the LAN era the DMZ then forwarded JsonConvert.SerializeObject(order) to LAN order/setOrder. That forward is now commented out (DMZ :132-183).
comparisons.sap_detail:
//172.16.214.58/sap/ServicioSAP/ServicioSap/ServicioSap/Controllers/OrderController.cs:12-13 declare [Authorize] and [RoutePrefix("order")]. Lines :16-18 declare [HttpPost] [Route("new")] public async Task<IHttpActionResult> SetOrder(OrderRequest order). Lines :20-23 run `if (order == null) { throw new HttpResponseException(HttpStatusCode.BadRequest); }`. The code is textually identical to LAN. The throw happens before new OrderMethods (:24) and outside the try/catch (:25-47), so the catch's Ok("Error, " + e.Message) (:46) and its Logger.SAP call (:45) never apply to the null case. The method is async, so the synchronous throw faults the returned Task, and Web API unwraps that into the same empty-body HTTP 400. No side effects.
Pipeline: App_Start/WebApiConfig.cs:16-22 is identical to LAN (attribute routes, TokenValidationHandler, default route). There are no global filters or formatter changes (grep found none). Global.asax.cs:16-17 only adds AreaRegistration, which has no effect on Web API. Helpers/TokenValidationHandler.cs:33-80 is identical to LAN's. JWT_SECRET_KEY, JWT_AUDIENCE_TOKEN and JWT_ISSUER_TOKEN (Web.config:32-34) have the same SHA-1 and length as LAN Web.config:15-17, so the same token is accepted.
Binding: Models/SAP/Order/OrderRequest.cs:5-54 uses decimals for subTotal/total/impuesto/costoEnvio (:12, :13, :17, :21), List<ArticuloRequest> (:36; ArticuloRequest.cs:7, 9, 11, 13 are decimal/int) and InfoClienteRequest (:38; InfoClienteRequest.cs:45 idMagento int, :69 uen int). The null triggers are the same as LAN's.
Limits: Web.config:94 sets maxRequestLength="51200" (50 MB) and :102 sets maxAllowedContentLength="52428800". customErrors Off (:95) and httpErrors Detailed (:98) do not change this empty 400.
Current caller: DMZ OrdersController.cs:196 posts JsonConvert.SerializeObject(order) to URL_SAP + "order/new" only after its own null guard (:111-112), so this guard is defense in depth and cannot be reached through the DMZ. Git: OrderController.cs, OrderRequest.cs and Web.config have no uncommitted changes (last commit d8211e7, 2026-09-17).
