A later setOrderStatus 'processing' for order_id 60900 makes GetIdPedidoByOrden return '' instead of '12000048900'.

differences.what: LAN's Limpiar is the first place a null storeId or incrementId (or a non-SqlException from the DB connection) aborts the whole credit request. ServicioSAP has no such failure point. SqlExceptions are swallowed in LAN, so on DB errors both systems continue.
differences.lan: sUen.Trim() at OrderMethods.cs:970 runs outside detallePedido's try, and sIdEcommerce.Trim() at :1003 is inside a try that only catches SqlException (:1072). A NullReferenceException or InvalidOperationException propagates to the SetPedido catch (:728-731), which returns sRespuestaPedido="" (:732). No credit application is created and the liberador never starts. A SqlException (for example IntelisisTmp down) is only logged (:1074) and the flow continues to the Android credit insert.
differences.sap: storeId is null-safe in the credit path (CrearSolicitudCreditoAsync :790 storeId?.ToUpper() → uen 1). The IntelisisTmp database is not involved, so the credit application is created. The response is OrderResponse Concluido, wrapped by OrderController.cs:28-34.
differences.decision_ref: No decision; the difference is incidental. The real payloads always carry storeId (magento_payloads.md:26, :55), so it is theoretical.
differences.evidence: LAN OrderMethods.cs:344-349 (ToArray adds storeId without dereference), :582, :970-981, :998-1003, :1072-1075, :728-732. ServicioSAP OrderMethods.cs:209, :787-790, :1785-1807.
differences.concrete_case: Payload identical to magento_payloads.md:26 but with "storeId": null. LAN throws a NullReferenceException at detallePedido :970, returns HTTP 200 with body "" (LAN OrdersController.cs:151-160) and creates no CRED_SOLICITUD_WEB_DATOS_TEMP row. ServicioSAP inserts the application with Uen=1 and Sucursal=504 and answers Resultado="Concluido".

comparisons.question_for_user:
Should IntelisisTmp.eCommerceDetPedidos keep receiving (and cleaning) lines for CREDIT orders, or does it die with Intelisis? The code shows it is still read or updated by three things:
(1) LAN updateCreditOrderId (OrderMethods.cs:2019-2045). The DMZ still forwards it to LAN, DMZ OrdersController.cs:405-411.
(2) setOrderStatus → Provider.CompraArtVirtual → GetIdPedidoByOrden (Provider.cs:108-112). The docs miss this one: BAJA_getOrderId.md:24 says pickup was the only reader.
(3) Possibly the external Liberador at VETA_URL_LIBERADOR (NO EVIDENCE either way).
If nobody needs it, confirm and we close G5-21/G5-22 as INTENTIONAL. If it is needed, confirm the SIGMAVI table name. FLUJO_RECOGER_EN_SUCURSAL.md:130 claims EcommerceDetPedidos exists in SIGMAVI, but the MaviSAP DDL is not in the share. ServicioSAP would then need a DELETE WHERE IdPedido=@incrementId AND RefPedidoIntelisis IS NULL before the credit lines are staged, running before ProcessCreditPaymentAsync (OrderMethods.cs:1800).

comparisons.name: JWT authentication (TokenValidationHandler + [Authorize] + token issuance used by the caller)
comparisons.lan_source: No SQL or SP involved. Web.config appSettings JWT_SECRET_KEY / JWT_AUDIENCE_TOKEN / JWT_ISSUER_TOKEN / JWT_EXPIRE_MINUTES (LAN Web.config:15-18). Library: System.IdentityModel.Tokens.Jwt and Microsoft.IdentityModel.Tokens 6.9.0 (packages.config:12-14,27; WebApiMagento.csproj:61-68,105-106; bin assembly version 6.9.0.0). Microsoft.AspNet.WebApi 5.2.7. Login credentials: USER_/PASS_ HASH+SALT in LAN Web.config.
comparisons.lan_detail: Registration: App_Start/WebApiConfig.cs:18, a global DelegatingHandler (Global.asax.cs:14). Handler: Controllers/TokenValidationHandler.cs. TryRetrieveToken :19-30 returns false if the Authorization header is missing or appears more than once. Otherwise it takes value[0] and strips a leading "Bearer " (:28), so a raw token with no prefix is also accepted. That is what the DMZ sends. SendAsync :32-79: with no token it passes through (:38-42), and [Authorize] then answers 401 {"Message":"Authorization has been denied for this request."}. Otherwise it reads the 3 config keys (:46-48) and builds SymmetricSecurityKey(Encoding.Default bytes) (:49). Validation: ValidAudience, ValidIssuer, ValidateLifetime, ValidateIssuerSigningKey, custom LifetimeValidator :81-88 (exp must be present and later than UtcNow; nbf is ignored; no clock skew). ValidateToken runs twice (:64-65) to set Thread.CurrentPrincipal and HttpContext.Current.User. A SecurityTokenValidationException gives 401 with an empty body (:69-72). Any other exception gives 500 with an empty body (:73-78). Gate: [Authorize] (System.Web.Http) on OrdersController at Controllers/OrdersController.cs:15, not :14 as the task says. It covers order/setOrder (:137-161) and also creditStatus (:485), validateCredit (:457) and updateCreditOrderId (:507). The principal is never read afterwards: a grep for User.Identity, CurrentPrincipal and RequestContext.Principal hits only the handler. Issuance: LoginController.cs:12-37 [AllowAnonymous] POST login/authenticate with body LoginRequest{username,password} (Models/LoginRequest.cs:10-11). It runs PBKDF2 (Conn/HashService.cs, 10101 iterations, 24 bytes) and then TokenGenerator.GenerateTokenJwt (Controllers/TokenGenerator.cs:14-40): HS256, aud and iss from config, nbf=now, exp=now+JWT_EXPIRE_MINUTES (180 in Web.config). A probe run with the LAN bin DLLs shows the name claim is serialized as "name". Auth failures are never logged. Caveat: the LAN Web.config in the share redirects every IdentityModel assembly to 7.5.0.0 (Web.config:166-181), but bin and csproj have 6.9.0.0. The share copy contradicts itself, so the version actually running on LAN is NO EVIDENCE. The probes assume 6.9, the version in bin.
comparisons.sap_source: No OData or HTTP API involved: this step is local config plus a library. ServicioSAP Web.config appSettings JWT_* at :32-34,36. They can be overridden per server by appSettings file="Web.local.config" (Web.config:20). That file is not in the share, so the deployed values are NO EVIDENCE. Library: System.IdentityModel.Tokens.Jwt and Microsoft.IdentityModel.Tokens 8.14.0 (packages.config:26-29,36; ServicioSap.csproj:65-75,114-115; bin assembly version 8.14.0.0). Microsoft.AspNet.WebApi 5.2.7. Login credentials: USER_/PASS_ HASH+SALT at Web.config:37-40. businesspartner-dev and salesanddistribution-dev do not take part in this step.
comparisons.sap_detail: Registration: App_Start/WebApiConfig.cs:17 (Global.asax.cs:16-17; AreaRegistration.RegisterAllAreas has no areas). Handler: Helpers/TokenValidationHandler.cs. TryRetrieveToken is at :20-31, SendAsync at :33-80, LifetimeValidator at :82-89. A diff against LAN shows the only changes are the namespace and "using System.IdentityModel.Tokens.Jwt" (:11, :53), so the logic, branches and status codes are the same line by line. Gate: [Authorize] (System.Web.Http; OrderController has no System.Web.Mvc using) at Controllers/OrderController.cs:12, covering POST order/new (:16-48). The principal is never read afterwards either. Issuance: LoginController.cs:14-42 [AllowAnonymous] POST login/auth with body Login{Username,Password} (Models/Login.cs:10-11). It uses the same HashService (Helpers/HashService.cs; the diff only changes namespace and visibility) and TokenGenerator.GenerateTokenJwt (Helpers/TokenGenerator.cs:31-57), which is identical to LAN's. Config: SHA-256 comparison of values, which were not printed. JWT_SECRET_KEY, AUDIENCE and ISSUER are identical to LAN Web.config (41 ASCII bytes = 328 bits), and EXPIRE is 180 on both sides. Probes run today in memory with each project's own bin DLLs and a test secret: valid token -> passes; expired -> 401; token with no exp -> 401; wrong aud -> 401; wrong iss -> 401; wrong key -> 401; alg=none -> 401; "abc" or a literal "Bearer" -> 500; nbf in the future -> accepted. All of these match LAN. Tokens cross-validate in both directions (an SS token on LAN, a LAN token on SS). The differences are listed below. Caller: the DMZ now gets its token only from SS login/auth (DMZ Helper/Curl.cs:73-85) and sends it without the Bearer prefix (Curl.cs:123). DMZ setOrder posts to order/new (DMZ Controllers/OrdersController.cs:196). The old post to LAN order/setOrder is commented out (:132-183). SS Logs/sap.log has no auth entries: neither side logs auth.

differences.what: The JWT library major version differs (6.9.0 on LAN, 8.14.0 on SS). With identical handler code, a token whose payload segment cannot be decoded gets a different HTTP status.
differences.lan: 6.9: the token is rejected with SecurityTokenSignatureKeyNotFoundException, a SecurityTokenValidationException, so the catch at Controllers/TokenValidationHandler.cs:69-72 returns 401 with an empty body.
differences.sap: 8.14: the same token raises System.ArgumentException IDX12723 (cannot decode payload). The generic catch at Helpers/TokenValidationHandler.cs:74-77 returns 500 with an empty body.
differences.evidence: Probe case C11, run today against the DLLs in each bin folder (read-only, in memory). Versions: LAN packages.config:27 and csproj:105-106 (6.9.0.0); SS packages.config:36 and csproj:114-115 (8.14.0.0). The handler source is identical (diff).
differences.concrete_case: Authorization: <valid header>.<valid payload>x.<valid signature> (one character appended to the payload segment) gets 401 from LAN and 500 from SS. Through DMZ Curl.PostSAP (Curl.cs:130-141) this becomes the string 'WebException: ...(500)...' instead of '(401)', still inside the 200 that the DMZ returns to Magento (DMZ OrdersController.cs:214-227).
differences.decision_ref: None. Runbook sections 9, 10, 15-18, 20 and 21 contain no decision about auth, JWT or the library.

differences.what: The minimum HMAC key size differs: 8.14 refuses HS256 keys under 256 bits (IDX10720), while 6.9 accepts 128-bit keys.
differences.lan: 6.9 mints and validates with 16- and 18-character secrets (probes C13 and C14 pass). The LAN stage config 'Web STAGE LAN.config':12 uses an 18-character secret with 120-minute expiry (:15).
differences.sap: 8.14 throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException IDX10720 when minting with 16- or 18-character secrets, inside GenerateTokenJwt (Helpers/TokenGenerator.cs:39-55). The unhandled exception in LoginController.cs:35 gives a 500 from login/auth. The current SS Web.config:32 secret is 41 ASCII bytes (328 bits), so it passes today.
differences.evidence: Probes C13 and C14 under both library versions. Byte length and ASCII-only check of the real secret (value not printed).
differences.concrete_case: Deploy SS with an 18-character JWT_SECRET_KEY, for example by copying the LAN stage value or through Web.local.config (Web.config:20). POST login/auth then returns 500, the DMZ Curl constructor rethrows (Curl.cs:86-90), and every DMZ order and credit call fails. LAN works with the same key.
differences.decision_ref: None.

differences.what: The name claim is serialized differently in issued tokens: 'name' by LAN (6.9), 'unique_name' by SS (8.14).
differences.lan: The payload of a LAN-issued token is {"name":...,"nbf","exp","iat","iss","aud"}. An SS-issued token validated on LAN gives Identity.Name = the username.
differences.sap: The payload of an SS-issued token is {"unique_name":...,...}. A LAN-issued token validated on SS passes, but Identity.Name is empty.
differences.evidence: Probe payload dump and the XVAL cross-validation in both directions. Neither project reads the principal: a grep for User.Identity, CurrentPrincipal and RequestContext.Principal hits only the handler lines (LAN :64-65, SS :65-66). This difference has no observable effect today.
differences.concrete_case: Decode the login token: LAN has 'name', SS has 'unique_name'. It would only matter if code started reading User.Identity.Name.
differences.decision_ref: None.

differences.what: The token-issuing endpoint differs in route, body model and accepted credentials.
differences.lan: POST login/authenticate (LoginController.cs:13,17), body LoginRequest{username,password}. It verifies against the LAN USER_/PASS_ HASH+SALT.
differences.sap: POST login/auth (LoginController.cs:15,20), body Login{Username,Password}; Json.NET binding ignores case. It verifies against the SS HASH+SALT (Web.config:37-40). Those values are byte-identical to the DMZ's own Web.config, not to LAN's.
differences.evidence: PBKDF2 check run today, printing booleans only. DMZ USER_INTELISIS verifies on LAN and fails on SS. DMZ USER_SAP verifies on SS and fails on LAN. The caller is already adapted: DMZ Curl.cs:27,80 use USER_SAP and login/auth.
differences.concrete_case: POST login/authenticate to SS returns 404. Posting the LAN credential body (USER_INTELISIS) to SS login/auth returns 401.
differences.decision_ref: None in the runbook. It is already wired in the DMZ.

differences.what: The token LAN validates for the credit polling is now issued by SS, not by LAN. This couples LAN's credit endpoints to SS being available and to both systems sharing the same JWT secret.
differences.lan: Legacy: the DMZ logged into LAN login/authenticate (Curl.cs:61-71, now commented out) and used that token for its LAN calls.
differences.sap: The DMZ Curl constructor logs in only at SS (Curl.cs:73-81) and sets Token = TokenSAP (Curl.cs:84). The LAN-bound credit calls updateCreditOrderId (DMZ OrdersController.cs:411) and creditStatus (:467) therefore carry an SS token. LAN accepts it only because LAN Web.config:15-17 and SS Web.config:32-34 have the same secret, audience and issuer. Hash comparison and the XVAL probe confirm this.
differences.evidence: DMZ Helper/Curl.cs:61-90. The comment at :83 ('Unificacion de Token...') shows the choice was deliberate in code, but the runbook records no decision about it. Runbook 18.9 keeps creditStatus and updateCreditOrderId on LAN for now.
differences.concrete_case: (a) SS is down, or SS login/auth returns 401: new Curl() throws, and DMZ creditStatus/{id} returns 500 even though LAN is up. (b) LAN runs with 'Web STAGE LAN.config' (a different 18-character secret, :12): the LAN handler returns 401, Curl.Get returns the exception text (Curl.cs:259-262), DeserializeObject throws, and the DMZ returns 500 to Magento's polling.
differences.decision_ref: None in the runbook (see 18.9 for the scope of creditStatus and updateCreditOrderId).

differences.what: An unhandled exception in the auth step exposes exception details on SS but not on LAN.
differences.lan: LAN Web.config has no customErrors element, so the default RemoteOnly applies, and IncludeErrorDetailPolicy is never set. A remote caller gets 500 {"Message":"An error has occurred."}.
differences.sap: SS Web.config:95 sets customErrors mode="Off", and IncludeErrorDetailPolicy is never set. Web API follows customErrors under IIS, so the 500 body includes ExceptionMessage, ExceptionType and StackTrace. This contradicts the stated intent at SS OrderController.cs:44 not to expose stack traces.
differences.evidence: Probe: HttpHeaders.TryAddWithoutValidation("Authorization","") followed by TryGetValues returns true with 0 values. The ElementAt(0) at LAN :27 and SS :28 is outside the try, so it throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException and gives 500 on both sides. Only the body differs. The customErrors-to-Web API mapping is documented framework behavior and was not run here. Whether IIS forwards an empty Authorization header: NO EVIDENCE.
differences.concrete_case: A direct call to order/new with the header 'Authorization:' and an empty value: LAN answers 500 with a generic message, SS answers 500 with the stack trace. The DMZ never sends an empty value (Curl.cs:123).
differences.decision_ref: None.

comparisons.question_for_user: 1) Is the DMZ token unification the intended final design? DMZ Helper/Curl.cs:83-84 logs in only against ServicioSAP and reuses that token for the LAN calls creditStatus and updateCreditOrderId. That makes the LAN credit polling depend on ServicioSAP being up and on both keeping the same JWT_SECRET_KEY, audience and issuer. 2) Does the ServicioSAP server have a Web.local.config (pulled in at Web.config:20) that overrides any JWT_* key? And does LAN stage run with 'Web STAGE LAN.config', which has a different 18-character secret? If so, the SS tokens would be rejected by LAN there, and an 18-character key would break ServicioSAP's login under IdentityModel 8.14. 3) Which IdentityModel version is actually deployed on LAN? The share's Web.config redirects to 7.5.0.0 but bin and csproj contain 6.9.0.0.

comparisons.name: Pickup flag and Agente blanking
comparisons.lan_source: C# LAN Metodos/OrderMethods.cs SetPedido. SP SpVTASeCommerceDetPedidos (@RecSuc bit is written to IntelisisTmp.eCommerceDetPedidos.RecogerEnSucursal). SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS on ServicioAndroid: @MetodoEnvio VARCHAR(12)=NULL, @Agente VARCHAR(10)=NULL.
comparisons.lan_detail: 1) The pickup flag, OrderMethods.cs:568-570: `int recogeSucursal = 0; if (order.metodoEnvio == "instore_pickup") recogeSucursal = 1;`. The comparison is exact and case-sensitive, and a null metodoEnvio gives 0. The value has one consumer: detallePedido("Insertar", ..., recogeSucursal) at :599. That call sits inside the per-line loop :587-601 and runs only for lines with precio>0 and cantidad>0, after detallePedido("Limpiar") at :582. detallePedido (:963) binds @RecSuc as SqlDbType.Bit (:1030) and calls SpVTASeCommerceDetPedidos (:1036). The SP writes it as INSERT eCommerceDetPedidos(..., RecogerEnSucursal) VALUES(..., @RecSuc) at SpVTASeCommerceDetPedidos.sql:135-136 (TELEFONIA branch) and :149-150 (other articles). No code reads RecogerEnSucursal: I grepped LAN C#, DMZ and every SP in SPsOrden and found none. The code that does read eCommerceDetPedidos uses other columns: CodigoRecogerSucursal.cs:30 and :151 read idOrden, Articulo and Cantidad, :531 joins on RefPedidoIntelisis, Provider.cs:112 reads IdPedido, and UpdateCreditOrderId at OrderMethods.cs:2019-2051 updates IdPedido and IdOrden. 2) Agente blanking at :572: `sDatosPedido[(int)Venta.Agente] = ""`. Venta.Agente=35 (Models/Enums.cs:47), and ToArray fills that slot with order.Agente (:428). The credit branch (:609-650) passes sDatosPedido as datosped to CreditMethods.ProductosCreditoWeb_SaveData (:94). That method reads only datosped[14..21] and [31] (CreditMethods.cs:113, :140, :145, :160-168, :178), never index 35. It adds no @Agente parameter, so SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS.sql:151 defaults to NULL and the Agente column is written as NULL (:273/:334). CreditoWeb_InsertArticulo receives no datosped. The credit branch returns order.infoCliente["cuenta"] at :649, before the restore `sDatosPedido[Agente] = order.Agente` at :652. So on the credit path the blank is a dead store with no observable effect. The pickup-only steps after that point are also unreachable for credit: setNameToReference at :657-660 and the pickup code at :689-701. 3) The only way pickup reaches the credit application in LAN is @MetodoEnvio = datosped[31] = order.metodoEnvio (CreditMethods.cs:178; ToArray :424). The SP parameter is VARCHAR(12) (SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS.sql:147), so "instore_pickup" (14 chars) is silently cut at bind time and stored as "instore_pick". The SP never branches on @MetodoEnvio; it appears only at :147, :270 and :331.
comparisons.sap_source: None for the flag: no OData service or HTTP API receives it on the credit path. The credit application is a direct SQL INSERT into CRED_SOLICITUD_WEB_DATOS_TEMP on ServicioAndroid (Methods/Credit/SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.cs). businesspartner-dev and salesanddistribution-dev have no equivalent of eCommerceDetPedidos or RecogerEnSucursal (grep found nothing). ZFORMAENVIO exists only in the SD sales-order routes (AS_POST_EnviarPedido.py, etc.), which the credit path does not call at order time.
comparisons.sap_detail: No pickup flag is computed. METODO_ENVIO_PICKUP="instore_pickup" (OrderMethods.cs:58) is used only by contado paths (:1411, :1914). No detail-line staging exists: OrderMethods.cs:527-528 has the comment "DetallePedido() ELIMINADO - Los items van ATOMIC en BuildSapOrder().to_items". No Agente blanking either. ToArray (:198-291) puts order.Agente at [35] (:287), and the credit branch (:1785-1808) reads only sDatosPedido[36] (:1797-1798) and returns before `sDatosPedido[35] = orderRequest.Agente` (:1845). Nothing reads [35] afterwards; BuildSapOrderAsync uses orderRequest.Agente directly (:2360-2362). CrearSolicitudCreditoAsync (:787-852) never sets Agente, so SolicitudCreditoInsertRequest.Agente stays null (model SolicitudCreditoWebModels.cs:119, no default). ArmarFila copies it (SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.cs:290), and it is sent as DBNull (:212, Nulo :334-337). The Agente column is NULL, the same result as LAN. Pickup reaches the credit application only through MetodoEnvio = order.metodoEnvio ?? "" (OrderMethods.cs:830), copied in ArmarFila (:287) and bound with SqlDbType.VarChar and no Size (:209) in a direct INSERT with no truncation. InsertarSolicitudAsync (:157-218) has no try/catch. ProcessCreditPaymentAsync rethrows (:761-765), SetOrderAsync wraps the error as "Error en SetOrder: ..." (:1950-1954), and OrderController returns Ok("Error, " + e.Message) (Controllers/OrderController.cs:46). Current state of what comes after the credit application: the Liberador and the Magento callback are commented out (OrderMethods.cs:720-757), so nothing yet carries pickup into an SAP credit sales order. Out-of-scope observations, contado path only, not part of this verdict: :1919 passes sDatosPedido[16] (numInt) as the correo argument of RegisterPickupClientInfo, where LAN passes infoCliente["correo"] (LAN :659). RegisterPickupClientInfo (:1564-1578) is a stub that only calls Console.WriteLine. :1816 reads sDatosPedido[20] (estado) as codigoPostal, the known finding D-02.

differences.what: The pickup flag is not persisted anywhere. LAN writes eCommerceDetPedidos.RecogerEnSucursal on every detail line of a credit order; ServicioSAP has no detail-line staging and no other place for the flag.
differences.lan: recogeSucursal = 1 when metodoEnvio == "instore_pickup", else 0 (OrderMethods.cs:568-570). It is passed to detallePedido("Insertar") at :599, bound as @RecSuc bit (:1030), and inserted into eCommerceDetPedidos.RecogerEnSucursal (SpVTASeCommerceDetPedidos.sql:135-136, :149-150). This runs before the credit branch at :609, so it happens even when the credit application later fails.
differences.sap: Nothing is written. The DetallePedido staging was deliberately removed (OrderMethods.cs:527-528 comment). The credit branch (:1785-1808) writes only the SQLite guide, CRED_SOLICITUD_WEB_DATOS_TEMP and VTASdArtCreditoWeb.
differences.evidence: No user decision in the runbook covers eCommerceDetPedidos or the pickup bit: sections 9, 10, 15-18, 20 and 21 were checked, and the only mention is §21.4 at line 1609, which is about the TELEFONIA region rule. Two analysis documents disagree with each other: FLUJO_CREDITO_LAN_VS_SAP.md:326 says the table 'muere: no requiere equivalencia', while MATRIZ_REGLAS_CREDITO_WEB_LAN_VS_SAP.md:156 (G4-02) marks it FALTA. No reader of the RecogerEnSucursal column exists in LAN, DMZ, ServicioSAP or SPsOrden, so there is no known observable impact on the credit application or the response. Whether the external Liberador (VETA_URL_LIBERADOR, LiberadorCreditoMethods.cs:18) or Intelisis POS reads it: NO EVIDENCE. The row-level staging as a whole belongs to the detail-lines step (G4-02, G5-21, G5-22).
differences.concrete_case: Credit order: metodoPago=omnipro_pago_credito, metodoEnvio="instore_pickup", one article with precio 8198 and cantidad 1. LAN leaves 1 row in eCommerceDetPedidos (IdPedido=incrementId, RecogerEnSucursal=1). ServicioSAP leaves no row. With metodoEnvio="tablerate_bestway", LAN writes RecogerEnSucursal=0 and ServicioSAP again writes no row.

differences.what: MetodoEnvio width: this is the only channel through which pickup reaches the credit application. LAN truncated the value through the SP parameter; ServicioSAP inserts it unchanged.
differences.lan: datosped[31]="instore_pickup" (14 chars) is bound to SP parameter @MetodoEnvio VARCHAR(12) (SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS.sql:147; CreditMethods.cs:178). It is silently cut, the column stores "instore_pick", and the insert succeeds. SetPedido returns the cuenta (OrderMethods.cs:649).
differences.sap: MetodoEnvio = order.metodoEnvio ?? "" (OrderMethods.cs:830) is bound with VarChar and no Size (SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.cs:209) in a direct INSERT into CRED_SOLICITUD_WEB_DATOS_TEMP. If the column is varchar(12), SQL error 8152 is raised with no catch (:157-218). It propagates through :761-765 and :1950-1954, and Magento receives HTTP 200 with the body "Error, Error en SetOrder: String or binary data would be truncated..." (OrderController.cs:46), and no row is written. If the column is wider, the row stores all 14 chars.
differences.decision_ref: Decision 13 'insert as it arrived' (runbook §18.3). This exact case is already recorded in runbook §10.7, line 742, and in §18.5 #1.
differences.evidence: The column width is stated only by the SP change log (SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS.sql:51, 'Se agrega campo MetodoEnvio tipo varchar(12)'); the DDL itself is NO EVIDENCE (pending query B2). The problem is not specific to pickup: real payloads send "tablerate_bestway" (17 chars; magento_payloads.md:26, :55), so every credit order would hit it. Severity is critical only if the column really is 12 wide. No real instore_pickup credit payload or log entry exists (Logs/sap.log has none; magento_payloads.md has none): NO EVIDENCE of one in practice.
differences.concrete_case: Credit order with metodoEnvio="instore_pickup". LAN stores MetodoEnvio='instore_pick' and returns the cuenta, e.g. "C01575835". ServicioSAP, with a varchar(12) column, writes no application row and Magento receives "Error, Error en SetOrder: ...truncated...".

differences.what: Null metodoEnvio: LAN stores NULL in the credit application, ServicioSAP stores an empty string. The pickup check itself treats null the same way on both sides (not pickup).
differences.lan: ToArray adds a null (:424), so datosped[31] is null. The SqlParameter Value is null (not DBNull), so SqlClient sends DEFAULT and the SP default NULL applies (SP:147). MetodoEnvio column = NULL.
differences.sap: order.metodoEnvio ?? "" (OrderMethods.cs:830) produces "", and Nulo("") leaves it as "" (SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.cs:209, :334-337). MetodoEnvio column = ''.
differences.evidence: Decision 13 ('as it arrived') does not cover turning null into "". Every real payload carries metodoEnvio (magento_payloads.md:26, :55), so this is theoretical. It also belongs to the SP-parameter or MetodoEnvio step.
differences.concrete_case: Credit payload with "metodoEnvio": null, or with the key missing. LAN writes MetodoEnvio NULL; ServicioSAP writes MetodoEnvio ''.

comparisons.question_for_user: 1) Does anything outside these repos read eCommerceDetPedidos.RecogerEnSucursal, or the credit-order rows of eCommerceDetPedidos at all? Candidates are the external Liberador service (VETA_URL_LIBERADOR), the Intelisis POS or pickup desk, and reports. No reader exists in the code available. If nothing reads it, the missing flag in ServicioSAP is harmless and can be closed as intentional. Otherwise, a target table in SIGMAVI (G5-21, G5-22) needs to be decided. 2) What is the real width of CRED_SOLICITUD_WEB_DATOS_TEMP.MetodoEnvio (DDL query B2)? If it is varchar(12), decision 13 makes every credit order fail on insert, because both "instore_pickup" (14) and "tablerate_bestway" (17) are too long.

comparisons.name: DMZ bridge forwards the credit order (DMZ order/setOrder -> LAN order/setOrder [legacy] vs ServicioSAP order/new [current])
comparisons.lan_source: LAN WebApiMagento POST order/setOrder -> OrderMethods.SetPedido (Intelisis `venta` lookup for duplicates; credit branch -> CreditMethods.ProductosCreditoWeb_SaveData -> ServicioAndroid SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS). The legacy DMZ bridge logic is taken from DMZ git commit c63c0ab, the last one before the SAP migration (686699e, 2026-06-26), because the current file keeps it only as comments.
comparisons.lan_detail:
Paths are relative to //172.16.214.58/sap. LEGACY DMZ (git show c63c0ab:WebApiMagento/Controllers/OrdersController.cs): a null order returns 400 (:111-112). If metodoPago=="omnipro_pago_credito" and infoCliente has no "cuenta" key, it returns 400 "Cuenta invalida" (:116-123). Next it calls new Curl(), which logs in to LAN at login/authenticate with no try (c63c0ab Curl.cs:61-69) and then to SAP at login/auth, rethrowing on failure (:71-85). Then Post("order/setOrder").Trim('"') (:131). Curl.Post catches every exception and returns e.ToString() (Curl.cs:103-106). Response mapping (:135-166): "PrecioIncorrecto"/"Incorrecto" -> 400 "Incorrecto"; empty or whitespace -> 500 {error:"LAN retornó vacío",incrementId}; "PedidoExistente" -> 409 {error,incrementId}; "sin cuenta" -> 422 {error,cuenta}; anything not starting with "C" (case-insensitive) -> 500 {error:"Respuesta inesperada",lanResponse}. An exception -> 500 {error:"Excepción llamando a LAN",detail,incrementId} (:168-173). Credit orders were NOT posted to SAP (:175-193), and the result was 200 Ok(response), the bare LAN string such as "C01575835" (:195).
LAN receiver: LAN\WebApiMagento\Controllers\OrdersController.cs:137-161 calls SetPedido. Any exception returns Ok(e.ToString()), always HTTP 200 (:154-157); success returns Ok(response) (:160). OrderMethods.cs:533-733 runs, in order:
- AgruparCantidadPorSKU (:535, outside the try; int.Parse/float.Parse at :495-496)
- duplicate check (:541-542): obtenerIdVenta reads `venta.idecommerce` (:1602-1643) -> "PedidoExistente"
- order.forzarOrder.ToString() (:562, throws on null)
- inside the try (:576): the credit branch (:609-650) calls ProductosCreditoWeb_SaveData and DISCARDS its return value ("OK"/"insuficiente"/"err"/"sin cuenta", CreditMethods.cs:243, :251, :257), then returns order.infoCliente["cuenta"] verbatim (:649)
- the catch (:728-731) logs and returns "" (:732)
So for credit the DMZ can receive the cuenta, "", "null", "PedidoExistente" or an exception text. The DMZ "sin cuenta"/422 and "PrecioIncorrecto" branches cannot be reached on the credit path. The Liberador thread starts only when the cuenta starts with "C" (CreditMethods.cs:208-241).
comparisons.sap_source: ServicioSAP POST order/new (Controllers/OrderController.cs SetOrder) -> OrderMethods.SetOrderAsync(order,"Insert"), credit branch. Duplicate check uses SD36 (SalesMethods.CheckDocumentExistsSD36Async by PurchNoC). The BP check calls BusinessPartnerMethods.GetClientAsync. The DMZ authenticates at ServicioSAP login/auth. The DMZ targets URL_SAP=https://kdll3fhcyo-lan.grupomavi.com/SAP/ (DMZ Web.config:18).
comparisons.sap_detail:
CURRENT DMZ (DMZ\WebApiMagento\Controllers\OrdersController.cs; the DMZ repo is clean on branch ConexionSAP):
- a null order returns 400 (:111-112) and the body is logged (:114)
- the credit block is empty; the "cuenta" guard is commented out (:116-127)
- the LAN POST is commented out (:132-183), including the "C" check (:168-176), and so is the credit exclusion (:185-190, :206-213)
- new Curl() (:193) now logs in ONLY to ServicioSAP at login/auth, sets Token = TokenSAP, and rethrows on failure (Helper\Curl.cs:73-90; LAN login commented at :61-71)
- PostSAP("order/new").Trim('"') (:196). PostSAP turns a WebException into the string "WebException: <msg> Body: <body>", or "WebException: <e>" when there is no response, and any other exception into e.ToString() (Curl.cs:130-146). It never throws
- a catch around it returns 500 with no body (:200-205); in practice only the Curl constructor can throw there
- a non-empty response is parsed with JsonConvert.DeserializeObject and returned as Ok(object). If parsing fails, it returns Ok(string), still 200 (:214-227)
The DMZ serializes its own OrderRequest model (DMZ Models\OrderRequest.cs:10-34, identical to LAN Models\OrderRequest.cs:6-29), so the bytes sent are the same as the legacy LAN POST.
SS receiver (SS = ServicioSAP\ServicioSap\ServicioSap):
- Controllers\OrderController.cs:16-48: a null order returns 400 (:20-23). SetOrderAsync (:27) result is mapped to {BP=Zctefinal, SalesDocument=to_result?.Salesdocument?.TrimStart('0') ?? PurchNoS, Message, Resultado} and returned with Ok (:28-35). Any exception returns Ok("Error, "+e.Message), HTTP 200 (:37-47)
- ModelState is never checked. The typed models are OrderRequest.cs:12-21 (decimal subTotal/total/impuesto/costoEnvio), ArticuloRequest.cs (decimal precio/precioEspecial/descuento, int cantidad) and InfoClienteRequest.cs (no "origen" property)
- SetOrderAsync (Methods\Order\OrderMethods.cs:1728-1955):
  - duplicate check: SD36 on "ZSD_ZMER_<incrementId>" (:1750-1760) returns Resultado="PedidoExistente"
  - credit branch (:1785-1808) returns {Resultado="Concluido", Zctefinal=cuentaCredito, Zidecomm}. For credit, to_result/to_return are null, so SalesDocument=null and Message=""
  - exceptions are wrapped as "Error en SetOrder: ..." (:1950-1954)
- ProcessCreditPaymentAsync (:665-766):
  - guest (cuenta and cliente empty) throws (:675-676)
  - a non-empty cuenta goes through CheckClientCreditAsync (BP05 GetClientAsync), and a failure throws "no tiene crédito activo en SAP" (:679-684, :768-781)
  - an empty cuenta with a cliente is treated as a new client and skips the check (:672)
  - it returns cliente or cuenta (:759)
  - the Liberador/callback is commented out (:720-757)
- SS Logger.SAP calls Directory.CreateDirectory outside a try (Helpers\Logger.cs:28-31). If that throws inside the controller catch, SS responds 500, which reaches Magento as 200 "WebException...".
CURRENT STATE AROUND THIS STEP:
- DMZ creditStatus (:460-482) and updateCreditOrderId (:404-419) still call curl.Get/Post against URL_INTELISIS=https://localhost:44399/ (Web.config:17). That is ServicioSAP's IIS Express URL (ServicioSap.csproj:503), and SS has no creditStatus/updateCreditOrderId route (0 hits in Controllers), so both will fail.
- DMZ authorizationResult (:421-458) is live, but SS never calls it (callback commented out).
- Magento only polls rows that have id_solicitud, which the callback sets (Mavi\CreditoCheckout\Cron\PollCreditStatus.php:69-74; CreditoOrderManagement.php:135-149). So a credit order stays PENDIENTE (runbook §18.1, §18.5 #2).
- Real evidence: SS Logs\sap.log (12 lines) contains no credit order/new call. There is NO EVIDENCE of an end-to-end DMZ->SS credit run, and NO EVIDENCE that the build deployed at URL_SAP matches the working tree (OrderMethods.cs is uncommitted).

differences.lan: The legacy DMZ turned every LAN answer that did not start with "C" into a non-2xx status: 500 for empty, for an exception text, for "null" or for a transport failure (Curl.Post returns e.ToString()); 409 for PedidoExistente; 400 when the cuenta key is missing. The body was JSON {error, lanResponse or detail, incrementId}, including the full stack trace in lanResponse.
differences.sap: SS reports every business error as 200 "Error, <msg>" (OrderController.cs:37-47). Transport failures (SS down, 401 bad token, 404, 500 unhandled) come back from PostSAP as "WebException: ..." (Curl.cs:130-146). In both cases the DMZ fails to deserialize the text and returns Ok(string), HTTP 200 (DMZ :214-224). SS sends e.Message only, without the stack trace. The comment at OrderController.cs:39-43 says the DMZ "reenvia tal cual"; that is false for the legacy DMZ, which remapped statuses (c63c0ab:135-173).
differences.decision_ref: Runbook §19.2 #1 ("a Magento se le pregunta si lo tolera") and §20.1 (records the 200 as a fact): an open question, not a decision.
differences.evidence: DMZ c63c0ab OrdersController.cs:135-173 vs current :196-227; DMZ Helper\Curl.cs:93-113,115-148; SS OrderController.cs:37-47; SS Helpers\Logger.cs:28-31 (CreateDirectory outside try can turn an error into an SS 500). Mitigation, from Magento reference code: requestCreditOrder only reacts to === false (Mavi\CreditoCheckout\Model\CreditoOrderManagement.php:51-56). syncOrder never returns false except when the token fails (Omnipro\PlaceOrder\Model\Order\Order.php:22-35; Omnipro\IntelisisIntegration\Model\Adapter.php:32-44). (b) infoCliente {cuenta:"", cliente:""}: current 200 "Error, Error en SetOrder: Los invitados no pueden pagar con crédito."; legacy: LAN returns "", so 500 {error:"LAN retornó vacío"}.

comparisons.question_for_user: Two things the code cannot answer. (1) Response contract to Magento: should the DMZ keep ServicioSAP's HTTP 200 for every failure (bodies "Error, ..." and "WebException: ..."), or restore the legacy non-2xx mapping (400/409/500 with a JSON error)? And should the success body stay the {BP, SalesDocument, Message, Resultado} object, or go back to the bare account string? Magento's credit code today ignores both the status and the body (it only checks === false), but the runbook §18.8 still lists this as a question for Omnipro. (2) Which ServicioSAP build is deployed at URL_SAP=https://kdll3fhcyo-lan.grupomavi.com/SAP/? Is it the current working tree with the uncommitted OrderMethods.cs, or an older commit? Also, is it intended that DMZ creditStatus and updateCreditOrderId now go to URL_INTELISIS=https://localhost:44399/ (the ServicioSAP IIS Express URL), where no such routes exist?

comparisons.name: Error propagation to the controller (global try/catch)
comparisons.lan_source: LAN Controllers/OrdersController.cs:137-161 (route order/setOrder); Metodos/OrderMethods.cs:533-733 (SetPedido, internal try :576-731); Metodos/CreditMethods.cs:94-262 (ProductosCreditoWeb_SaveData); Helper/Logger.cs:19-27. LAN-era DMZ bridge = git commit c63c0ab (2026-06-08) of DMZ Controllers/OrdersController.cs:107-196 and Helper/Curl.cs:88-108. No SQL table/SP belongs to this step; it only wraps what the inner steps throw or return.
comparisons.lan_detail:
Chain: Magento -> DMZ order/setOrder -> LAN order/setOrder.
CONTROLLER (OrdersController.cs:137-161): a null body throws HttpResponseException 400 (:141-142). The request is logged OUTSIDE the try (:144). try { response = om.SetPedido(order); Logger.SetOrder(response) } (:149-153). catch (Exception e) { return Ok(e.ToString()); } (:154-158) = HTTP 200 with a JSON string holding the type, message and stack trace. Success returns Ok(response) (:160). The response log at :152 sits inside the try, so a logger IOException after a successful SetPedido also becomes Ok(e.ToString()). There is no global exception filter (App_Start/WebApiConfig.cs:11-25).
SETPEDIDO has two zones.
(a) BEFORE its own try (:535-573): AgruparCantidadPorSKU (:486-526: int.Parse/float.Parse and dictionary indexers), ToArray (:340-440: infoCliente[...] indexers throw KeyNotFoundException), obtenerIdVenta (:1602-1640, which swallows), and order.forzarOrder.ToString() (:562, NullReferenceException when forzarOrder is null). An exception here escapes to the controller and comes back as Ok(e.ToString()).
(b) INSIDE the try (:576-727): detallePedido Limpiar/Insertar (:582-601), float.Parse (:588, :596), the name keys (:603-605), SaveGuide on SQLite (:606; no catch in :735-753) and the credit branch (:609-650). The catch at :728-731 only logs ex.Message and falls through to :732, which returns sRespuestaPedido. That variable starts as string.Empty (:574), so the caller gets Ok("").
CREDIT BRANCH: ObtenerNumeroTablaSms (:819-851) and IsValidated (:786-817) swallow errors and return "". The value returned by ProductosCreditoWeb_SaveData ('OK', 'insuficiente', 'err' at CreditMethods.cs:251, 'sin cuenta' at :257) is DISCARDED at OrderMethods.cs:624. SetPedido then returns order.infoCliente["cuenta"] (:649). Inside SaveData, only cnn.Open (:117-119) and decimal.Parse(total) (:126) sit outside its inner try (:135-252). checkCliente (:725-763) and checkSaldo swallow their errors.
So LAN credit has three outcomes, all HTTP 200 at LAN:
- the cuenta, for success AND for every business failure;
- "", for exceptions inside the try;
- the full stack trace, for exceptions before the try.
LAN-ERA DMZ (c63c0ab OrdersController.cs):
- infoCliente without a 'cuenta' key: 400 'Cuenta invalida' (:116-123), before LAN is called.
- LAN called at :131. Curl.Post returns e.ToString() when the transport fails (Curl.cs:88-108 at c63c0ab).
- "" -> 500 {error:'LAN retornó vacío'} (:138-143).
- 'PedidoExistente' -> 409 (:145-150).
- 'sin cuenta' -> 422 (:152-159).
- Anything not starting with 'C', including a stack trace -> 500 {error:'Respuesta inesperada', lanResponse:<text>} (:161-166).
- DMZ exception -> 500 (:168-173).
- Otherwise Ok(cuenta) (:195).
LAN also has order/validateCredit (:456-482). It wraps SetPedido and answers 500 when an exception escapes, but its DMZ route is commented out (DMZ HEAD OrdersController.cs:366-402), so it is not on the active path.
comparisons.sap_source: ServicioSAP Controllers/OrderController.cs:16-48 (route order/new); Methods/Order/OrderMethods.cs:1728-1955 (SetOrderAsync), :665-766 (ProcessCreditPaymentAsync), :787-843 (CrearSolicitudCreditoAsync); Methods/Credit/SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.cs:18-33, :361-366, :427-433, :487, :499-500; Helpers/Logger.cs:8-45. Current DMZ: Controllers/OrdersController.cs:107-228 and Helper/Curl.cs:115-148. This step calls no OData or HTTP API of its own. businesspartner-dev and salesanddistribution-dev only produce the exceptions it wraps.
comparisons.sap_detail:
Chain: Magento -> DMZ order/setOrder -> ServicioSAP order/new.
CONTROLLER (OrderController.cs:16-48): a null body throws HttpResponseException 400 (:20-23), the same as LAN. new OrderMethods() runs outside the try (:24), as LAN does at :147. try { SetOrderAsync(order,'Insert'), then map to {BP=Zctefinal, SalesDocument, Message, Resultado} } (:25-35). catch (Exception e) { Logger.SAP('[ORDER NEW ERROR]', incrementId + full e) (:45); return Ok("Error, " + e.Message); } (:37-47) = HTTP 200 with a JSON string. There is no global filter (App_Start/WebApiConfig.cs:11-23).
SETORDERASYNC (OrderMethods.cs:1728-1955): the try opens at :1730, before any work: AgruparCantidadPorSKU (:1740), ToArray (:1741), the SD36 duplicate check (:1752, which swallows at :452-464, like LAN obtenerIdVenta) and the credit branch (:1785-1808). The catch at :1950-1954 rethrows new Exception("Error en SetOrder: " + ex.Message, ex). So every failure body is "Error, Error en SetOrder: <inner message>". Nothing comes back as a stack trace and nothing comes back as "".
CREDIT BRANCH:
- SaveGuideAsync swallows errors (:533-553).
- ObtenerNumeroTablaSmsAsync (:589-613) and IsValidatedAsync (:631-660) swallow errors and return "".
- ProcessCreditPaymentAsync THROWS in four cases: a guest (:675-676); a BP that is unknown, has no credit, or whose GetClientAsync failed (CheckClientCreditAsync swallows to false at :768-781, then :681-682); idSolicitud <= 0 (:695-696); any error from CrearSolicitudCreditoAsync. That last call goes through SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.InsertAsync (:18-33), which has no try/catch. ObtenerTelefonoAValidarAsync logs and rethrows (:361-366), and the HTTP reads throw messages that include the StatusCode and the remote Content (:427-433, :487, :499-500). The outer catch rethrows (:761-765).
- Line insertion and the promoter burn sit in an inner try that logs and SWALLOWS (:701-717). A line failure therefore still returns Concluido, which is EQUIVALENT to LAN (CreditMethods.cs:246-252 returns 'err', and the caller discards it). The same applies to 'condition not found' (:877-880), which is in tension with user decision 9 ("notify"). That is still open (runbook §18.5 #7, §20.3).
- Success returns OrderResponse{Resultado='Concluido', Zctefinal=cuenta, or the Magento cliente id} (:1802-1807). The controller turns it into {BP:<cuenta>, SalesDocument:null, Message:'', Resultado:'Concluido'}.
CURRENT DMZ (OrdersController.cs:107-228):
- The 'cuenta' guard is commented out (:116-127) and so is the LAN call (:132-183).
- It calls PostSAP('order/new').Trim('"') (:196). Curl.PostSAP turns any WebException or non-2xx answer into the string 'WebException: ... Body: ...' (Curl.cs:130-146).
- It then tries JsonConvert.DeserializeObject: an object goes back as Ok(obj), and on a parse failure it returns Ok(string) (:214-227).
- Net effect: every failure reaches Magento as HTTP 200 with "Error, Error en SetOrder: ...".
The controller catch was BadRequest("Error, "+e.Message) until commit b4a5036 (2026-09-15). The change rests only on the code comment at :39-44.
Runtime evidence: NO EVIDENCE. Logs/sap.log (last write 2026-09-17) has no [ORDER NEW ERROR] line.

comparisons.question_for_user:
Which contract should a failed credit setOrder follow? The code cannot decide this for you.
(a) Keep the current one: HTTP 200 with the body "Error, Error en SetOrder: <message>". The word Error appears twice; should it be cleaned up?
(b) Restore the LAN-era end-to-end statuses: 500 'LAN retornó vacío' / 500 'Respuesta inesperada' / 409 / 400. That needs the DMZ to map again, because today Curl.PostSAP turns any non-2xx into a 200 string.
(c) Something else.
Keep in mind that in the Magento248 copy on the share, requestCreditOrder reacts only to false (token failure) and never reads the setOrder status or body. If that copy is what production runs, the choice only changes logs/visibility and the clearQuote block of registerCreditQuote, not the credit state. Can you confirm Magento248 is the deployed version?
Also: are the swallowed guide-save failure (§20.3) and the swallowed 'condition not found' (decision 9, §18.5 #7) acceptable as 'Concluido'?

The SP reads the Intelisis tables Art, VTASCRegionSku, VTASCCodigoPostalRegionCelular, eCommerceExist and VTASDEcommerceExportaArtExistencia. comparisons.lan_detail:
Call chain: OrdersController.Set (LAN Controllers/OrdersController.cs:137-161) -> SetPedido (Metodos/OrderMethods.cs:533). First AgruparCantidadPorSKU runs (:486-526, outside the try; int.Parse and float.Parse at :495-496), then ToArray (:340-439). ToArray builds comma-joined strings. For each item, price is precioEspecial when it is not exactly "0", otherwise precio (:368-376, :385-393). PrecioEspecialArticulos gets the same value, so the Precio and PrecioEspecial columns are always equal. Cantidad and descuento are the grouped values.

Inside the try (:576), the step runs:
- :579 partidas = number of commas in the SKU string + 1 (totalArticulos :948-961).
- :582 Limpiar deletes this order's lines that have RefPedidoIntelisis NULL (SDP:155-162). This is a separate step, G5-21.
- :584-601 loop. For each item, separarDatos (:1081-1104) extracts descuento, precio, cantidad and precioEspecial.
- :588 float.Parse(descuento).
- :596 `if (float.Parse(precio) > 0 & float.Parse(cantidad) > 0)`. The non-short-circuit `&` means both values are parsed. Lines with price 0 or quantity 0 are silently skipped.
- :599 calls detallePedido("Insertar", partidas, storeId, incrementId, sku, precio, precioEspecial, cantidad, descuento, entityId, infoCliente["codigoPostal"], recogeSucursal). recogeSucursal comes from metodoEnvio=="instore_pickup" (:566-568).

detallePedido (:963-1079):
- UEN mapping is case-sensitive: muebles_america=1, viu=2, mavi=3, anything else 0 (:971-982).
- int.Parse of cantidad happens outside its try (:984-991).
- Every parameter is passed as VarChar, including @Precio, @Preciosesp and @Descto, which the SP declares as float (:999-1034). SP parameter widths apply: @Art varchar(20), @idOrden varchar(20), @Cp varchar(5).
- Only SqlException is caught, and it is just logged as "INFO [id]" (:1072-1075). The result 'concluido' is never checked by SetPedido.

SP Insertar:
- Non-TELEFONIA items insert as they arrived (SDP:147-153).
- TELEFONIA items that have a pair in VTASCRegionSku switch SKU. If the CP is active in VTASCCodigoPostalRegionCelular, a region-5 SKU becomes region 6; if not, region 6 becomes region 5. The switch only happens when the target SKU has ecommerce stock > 0 (SDP:21-133).
- Defect: @artRegion starts as '' (SDP:23). When neither TOP 1 matches (SDP:57-91), it inserts Articulo=''.
- It inserts (UEN, IdPedido, Articulo, Precio, PrecioEspecial, Descuento, Cantidad, idOrden, RecogerEnSucursal) (SDP:135-136).

Real credit payload (magento_payloads.md:26): the row inserted is (1,'CRED515773','OSTE00443',8198,8198,0,1,'515773',0). For credit, entityId is the quote id (:645 comment).

After the loop: SaveGuide (:606), then the credit branch (:609). ProductosCreditoWeb_SaveData runs at :624-647 and the method returns infoCliente["cuenta"] (:649).

Abort path: a FormatException at :588 or :596 goes to catch :728-732 (log only). It returns sRespuestaPedido, which is still "" (:574, :732), so the controller sends Ok("") (HTTP 200, empty body). In that case none of these happen: SaveGuide, the credit application, the promo burn or the Liberador. The rows already staged for earlier items remain.

Practical triggers: precio or precioEspecial is null, "" or non-numeric. Descuento and cantidad are re-serialized by the grouping step (:495-496, which throw earlier, outside the try, and go to the controller's Ok(e.ToString())). A SqlException in the staging, such as IntelisisTmp being down or error 512 from the scalar stock subqueries at SDP:63-74 and :101-112, does NOT abort; the application is still created.

Later: updateCreditOrderId (LAN OrdersController.cs:506-533 -> OrderMethods.cs:1998-2061) renames IdPedido CRED... to the real incrementId and sets IdOrden=entityId. It returns rowsVenta+rowsDet+rowsOrden, or -1 on exception.

LAN code that reads the table:
- CodigoRecogerSucursal.cs:23-50 (idOrden by IdPedido, used by NuevoCodigoRecogerSucursal :349-360)
- CodigoRecogerSucursal.cs:151 (items for the pickup notice)
- CodigoRecogerSucursal.cs:521-533
- Metodos/Order/Provider.cs:108-133
- The cash (contado) SPs SP_eCommerceNuevoPed.sql:118-131, :207-215, :415-423 and SPVTASPedidosMagento.sql:283-291, :421-429.

None of these runs inside the credit request. Readers outside LAN/DMZ/ServicioSAP (Liberador, Intelisis jobs, POS): NO EVIDENCE.
comparisons.sap_detail:
ServicioSAP has no equivalent write and no equivalent abort path. Call chain: OrderController.SetOrder (Controllers/OrderController.cs:16-48) -> SetOrderAsync (Methods/Order/OrderMethods.cs:1728). AgruparCantidadPorSKU (:87-107) runs on the typed model, and ToArray at :1741.

Credit branch (:1785-1808), in order:
- SaveGuideAsync at :1787 (errors swallowed, :548-552).
- Builds the "cantidad,sku" list (:1789-1795).
- SMS and validation lookups (:1797-1798).
- ProcessCreditPaymentAsync (:665-766): CrearSolicitudCreditoAsync (:694), then InsertCreditArticlesAsync (:703, body :857-1023). InsertCreditArticlesAsync writes VTASdArtCreditoWeb in the Android DB, which is the equivalent of the LAN step SpVTASInsertArtSolCreditoLinea, not of this one.
- Returns {Resultado="Concluido", Zctefinal, Zidecomm} (:1802-1807).

Nothing in the branch writes or reads eCommerceDetPedidos or any SIGMAVI equivalent. A grep of the current working tree (including uncommitted files) finds only the comment at OM:527-528: "DetallePedido() ELIMINADO - Los items van ATOMIC en BuildSapOrder().to_items". That justification does not apply to credit. The branch returns at :1802-1807, before BuildSapOrderAsync (:1848), so no to_items reach SAP. SD36 (SalesMethods.CheckDocumentExistsSD36Async, ZAPI_DOCVTAS_CHECK_CDS by PurchNoC) is named as the table's equivalent in Contratos/SP_VTASeCommerceDetPedidos.md:18, but it has no document for a credit order.

Types: ArticuloRequest has precio, precioEspecial and descuento as decimal and cantidad as int (Models/SAP/Order/ArticuloRequest.cs:7-13). There is no float.Parse. The Magento price is not used anywhere in the credit branch; InsertCreditArticlesAsync takes price and Abono from SD29 (:946-993).

The TELEFONIA region logic exists only for cash (contado): ValidarRegionCelulares at :1830, which runs after the credit return.

The downstream route updateCreditOrderId does not exist in ServicioSAP. The DMZ still forwards it to LAN (DMZ Controllers/OrdersController.cs:404-419, Curl.Post -> URL_INTELISIS, Helper/Curl.cs:22,106).

The ServicioSAP store-pickup port does not read the table (Methods/Order/StorePickupMethods.cs:185-254).
comparisons.sap_source:
NONE. Candidates that are NOT equivalent for credit:
(a) SD36 ZAPI_DOCVTAS_CHECK_CDS (SalesMethods.CheckDocumentExistsSD36Async): named as the table's equivalent in Contratos/SP_VTASeCommerceDetPedidos.md:18, but a credit order never creates a SAP sales document in order/new (OM:1802-1807 returns before :1848).
(b) SIGMAVI: the target required by the runbook's routing rule (PLAN:764, "tabla de Intelisis -> su equivalente en SIGMAVI"). No table is defined.
(c) VTASdArtCreditoWeb (Android, OM:901-903): the equivalent of a different LAN step (SpVTASInsertArtSolCreditoLinea), not of this one.

differences.what: The eCommerceDetPedidos staging rows are not written for credit orders. The per-line price, special price and discount that Magento sent are therefore not stored anywhere in the ServicioSAP credit path.

comparisons.name: Guide name and SaveGuide (SQLite servicio_guias) + read-back via order/getGuide
comparisons.lan_source: Local SQLite file C:\inetpub\wwwroot\api\data.db, table servicio_guias (id AUTOINCREMENT, idecommerce TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, fullname TEXT NOT NULL). The DDL is only a comment (LAN Metodos/OrderMethods.cs:19-25) and the table was created by hand. No SQL Server, SP or OData involved.
comparisons.lan_detail: SetPedido (LAN Metodos/OrderMethods.cs:533). The input is sDatosPedido[(int)Venta.IdEcommerce]. Venta.IdEcommerce=0 (Models/Enums.cs:12), and ToArray puts order.incrementId in slot 0 (:344), so for credit the key is e.g. "CRED515773". The name is built at :603-605 as apellidoPaterno.Trim().ToUpper() + " " + apellidoMaterno.Trim().ToUpper() + " " + nombre.Trim().ToUpper(), with NO outer Trim and no null guard. The infoCliente Dictionary keys were already read by ToArray (:418-420), which runs outside the try (:538), so a missing key fails before this step. SaveGuide is called at :606 for every payment method. This happens inside SetPedido's try (:576), after the Intelisis detail rows (detallePedido Limpiar/Insertar :582-601) and before `if (metodoPago == CREDIT_METHOD)` (:609). SaveGuide (:735-754) has no try of its own: it opens "Data Source=C:\inetpub\wwwroot\api\data.db;Version=3" (:737) and runs a parameterized `INSERT OR IGNORE INTO servicio_guias (idecommerce, fullname) VALUES (@idecommerce,@fullname)` (:745-749). It returns ExecuteNonQuery()==1 (:751), and the caller discards that value. Any exception reaches SetPedido's catch (:728-731), which logs Logger.SetOrder("Error ", ex.Message) and returns sRespuestaPedido, still string.Empty from :574, via :732. So the response is "" and ProductosCreditoWeb_SaveData (:624) is never reached, so no credit application is created. Before the migration, the DMZ turned that "" into HTTP 500 {"error":"LAN retornó vacío"} (DMZ commit 950106a; now commented at DMZ Controllers/OrdersController.cs:145-150). On a duplicate incrementId, INSERT OR IGNORE keeps the first name. Read-back: POST order/getGuide (LAN Controllers/OrdersController.cs:163-183). IdEcommerce=="" gives 404 (:167-168). A null IdEcommerce or null body gives an NRE outside the try, so 500. The lookup is GetGuide (OrderMethods.cs:756-784), parameterized, returning null when no row matches. Not found throws NotFound inside the try, and catch(Exception) turns it into 500 (:174-181). Found returns Json({IdEcommerce, FullName}).
comparisons.sap_source: Local SQLite file Path.Combine(AppSettings["SQLITE_DB_PATH"] or fallback C:\inetpub\wwwroot\sap\, "data.db"). Sources: SQLiteDb.cs:11-21, :154; Web.config:60 sets C:\inetpub\wwwroot\sap\. Same table name servicio_guias. The repo does not create it: the DDL is commented in Scripts/SQLite/01_CrearTablas_Ola3.sql:29-35, and there is no CREATE TABLE in any *.cs. No OData/HTTP API equivalent exists or is needed: I found no reference to servicio_guias or getGuide in businesspartner-dev or salesanddistribution-dev. This is local storage in both systems.
comparisons.sap_detail: SetOrderAsync (SS Methods/Order/OrderMethods.cs:1727). incrementId = sDatosPedido[0] (:1742), and ToArray puts order.incrementId in slot 0 (:202), the same value as LAN. After the SD36 duplicate check (:1752) and the Openpay exits, the credit branch (:1785) calls SaveGuideAsync first (:1787). This is an uncommitted change (git diff) and is PLAN §20 #16. The name comes from ConstruirNombreClienteMavi (:407-416): infoCliente==null returns "" (:409); each part is (x ?? "").Trim().ToUpper() (:410-412); the result is $"{P} {M} {N}".Trim() (:415), which adds an outer Trim. SaveGuideAsync (:533-553): EscapeSqlValue (:324-327, only doubles ') is applied to idEcommerce ?? "" and fullName ?? "" (:537-538). It builds the literal SQL `INSERT OR IGNORE INTO servicio_guias (idecommerce, fullname) VALUES ('..','..')` (:541-543) and runs new SQLiteDb().SetAsync (:544). SetAsync (SQLiteDb.cs:158-176) opens outside its try (OpenConnAsync :152-156). ExecuteNonQueryAsync is inside try/catch(Exception){CloseConn();} (:161-174), so SQL errors (no such table, locked, constraint) are swallowed and SaveGuideAsync returns true (:546). Only open failures reach SaveGuideAsync's catch (:548-552): Console.WriteLine, then false. The caller discards the bool (:1787), and the credit flow continues to ProcessCreditPaymentAsync (:1800) and returns Resultado="Concluido" (:1802-1807). No Logger call is made anywhere on this path. Credit returns before the cash-path SaveGuideAsync (:1839), so the guide is not written twice. Read-back: POST order/getGuide (SS Controllers/OrderController.cs:216-239). A null body gives 400 (:219-220). IdEcommerce=="" gives 404 (:222-223). A null IdEcommerce gives an NRE, so 500. GetGuideAsync (OrderMethods.cs:563-579) uses the parameterized SQLiteDb.GetAsync (SQLiteDb.cs:240-269), which propagates exceptions. Null gives NotFound inside the try, turned into 500 by the catch (:228-237). Found returns Json({IdEcommerce, FullName}); the GuideModels.cs:6-15 property names are identical to LAN Models/OrderRequest.cs:94-102. The DMZ already forwards getGuide to ServicioSAP (DMZ OrdersController.cs:238, commit fa4034e), and forwards every order, credit included, to SS order/new (:196). Deployment state of these DMZ commits: NO EVIDENCE. Equivalent, with no observable difference: parameterized SQL vs literal SQL with '' escaping (e.g. "O'HIGGINS" is stored the same way); both ToUpper() are culture-sensitive; the Data Source defaults are the same; INSERT OR IGNORE on a duplicate keeps the first row in both. With the real payload CRED515773 (magento_payloads.md:26), both store ("CRED515773", "CHECO GALINDO SERGIO").

comparisons.question_for_user: 1) If saving the guide fails, what should happen? In LAN the credit order aborted: the response was "", and before the migration the DMZ returned HTTP 500 'LAN retornó vacío', with no credit application created. Today ServicioSAP swallows the error in two layers, answers 'Concluido' and logs nothing. Do you want to (a) restore the abort, (b) keep going but write a Logger.SAP line, or (c) leave it as it is? This is the pending item in PLAN §20.3. 2) Can someone run `SELECT sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE name='servicio_guias'` against C:\inetpub\wwwroot\sap\data.db on the server? The Ola3 script ships that DDL commented out, so we have no evidence the table, or its UNIQUE(idecommerce), exists. If it is missing, every guide is being lost silently. 3) Keep the separate data.db, or either copy the historical LAN rows from C:\inetpub\wwwroot\api\data.db or point SQLITE_DB_PATH at the LAN file? The DMZ getGuide already forwards to ServicioSAP (commit fa4034e), so guides written by LAN come back as 500. And were the DMZ commits fa4034e and 686699e deployed together? 4) Keep or remove the outer Trim() on the full name (PLAN §20.3 row 2)?

comparisons.lan_detail:
Entry points: OrdersController.cs:137-161 (setOrder) and OrdersController.cs:456-482 (validateCredit). Both call OrderMethods.SetPedido (OrderMethods.cs:533).

Before the gate:
- :535 AgruparCantidadPorSKU (:486-526) runs outside the try. It groups by sku with a Dictionary (ordinal, case-sensitive) and sums int.Parse(cantidad) (:495). It also reads float.Parse(descuento) (:496) and item["condicion"] (:520).
- :539 ToArray (:340-435) indexes infoCliente keys directly (:406-423), also outside the try.
- try at :576. detallePedido 'Limpiar' (:582) and 'Insertar' (:584-601) call SpVTASeCommerceDetPedidos (:1036). This runs for credit orders too.
- NombreClienteMavi (:603-605) and SaveGuide (:606). SaveGuide (:735-754) throws on a SQLite error.

Gate at :609: order.metodoPago == CREDIT_METHOD, where CREDIT_METHOD = "omnipro_pago_credito" (:31). Ordinal and case-sensitive.

List:
- :611-615 add articulo["cantidad"] + "," + articulo["sku"] for each grouped article. cantidad is already a normalized int string from :516.
- :616-617 if costoEnvio != "0" && costoEnvio != "", add costoEnvio + ",SEGU00001". This is the raw Magento text. A null costoEnvio passes both tests and produces ",SEGU00001".

The list goes as articulos.ToArray() (:635) to ProductosCreditoWeb_SaveData (CreditMethods.cs:94) and then to CreditoWeb_InsertArticulo (:201):

- prevArt skips consecutive duplicates (:895).

Returns OrderResponse{Resultado="Concluido", Zctefinal=cuentaCredito, Zidecomm=incrementId} (OM:1802-1807). The controller maps it to {BP, SalesDocument, Message, Resultado} (OrderController.cs:28-35).

Result: for the real payloads ("costoEnvio":"0" in CRED515773 and "150" in CRED515848, magento_payloads.md:26 and :55), both sides build exactly the same list, e.g. ["1,DIB+00104","150,SEGU00001"].

differences.what: Shipping cost that is zero written in non-canonical form ('0.00', '0.0', '00') or negative
differences.lan: Text comparison. '0.00' is neither '0' nor '', so the list gets '0.00,SEGU00001' and the SP inserts a SEGU00001 line with precio 0, cantidad 1, Abono 12 and Orden N+1. '-50' inserts a SEGU line with precio -50.
differences.sap: Decimal comparison (> 0). 0.00m and -50m fail it, so no SEGU00001 line is written.
differences.decision_ref: PLAN section 20.3 row 6: found by the review and NOT applied. This is not a user decision. The runbook says matching LAN 'requires changing the model type'. That is not strictly true: Newtonsoft keeps the decimal scale, so '0.00' binds as 0.00m and ToString(Invariant) returns '0.00'. A text-equivalent check on the decimal is therefore possible. This is inferred from framework behavior and was not run.
differences.evidence: LAN OrderMethods.cs:616-617; CreditMethods.cs:899-903; SpVTASInsertArtSolCreditoLinea.sql:179-208. SS OrderMethods.cs:1794. The '0.00' format is used in a test body in 'Manual Tecnico Peticiones Hoppscotch 01092026.md':3155.
differences.concrete_case: Credit order CRED515848 with "costoEnvio":"0.00". LAN writes 2 lines in VTASdArtCreditoWeb: DIB+00104, then SEGU00001 with precio 0 and Abono 12. ServicioSAP writes 1 line (DIB+00104).

differences.what: costoEnvio missing or JSON null
differences.lan: A null value passes both != tests. null + ',SEGU00001' gives ',SEGU00001', and CreditoWeb_InsertArticulo throws FormatException on float.Parse("") after the product lines are already inserted. The catch at CreditMethods.cs:246-251 returns 'err', which SetPedido discards. Effects: no SEGU line, the promoter code is NOT burned (:203-206 skipped), and the Liberador thread is NOT started for C accounts (:208-241 skipped). Magento still receives the account.
differences.sap: Binds as 0m (Newtonsoft null into a non-nullable decimal is a handled binding error; ModelState is never checked). No SEGU line. Lines are inserted, the promoter is burned, and the response is Concluido.
differences.evidence: LAN OrderMethods.cs:616-617; CreditMethods.cs:893-901, :201-208, :246-251. SS Models/SAP/Order/OrderRequest.cs:21; OrderMethods.cs:1794, :703-709. All 37 costoEnvio samples in the corpus carry the field.

differences.what: Shipping cost with a thousands separator
differences.lan: '1,500' produces '1,500,SEGU00001'. Split gives articulosTemp[1]='500', so it is treated as article '500' with cantidad 1. The SP JOIN most likely finds no price row, so 0 rows are inserted and the shipping line is lost. This is inferred from SPL:219-263 and was not run.
differences.sap: Newtonsoft parses with NumberStyles.Number and InvariantCulture, giving 1500m. The list gets '1500,SEGU00001' and a SEGU line with price 1500 is written.
differences.evidence: LAN OrderMethods.cs:617; CreditMethods.cs:893-909. SS OrderMethods.cs:1795; ParsearImporte :308-316.
differences.concrete_case: "costoEnvio":"1,500" on a credit order. LAN has no shipping line; ServicioSAP has a SEGU00001 line at 1500. This is theoretical: real payloads send '0' or '150'.

differences.sap: decimal.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture). Because the decimal keeps its scale, canonical positive values round-trip to the same text: '150' gives '150', '150.50' gives '150.50', '150.0000' gives '150.0000'. Nothing observable changes for canonical input.

differences.evidence: LAN OrderMethods.cs:617; SS OrderMethods.cs:1795
differences.concrete_case: None for canonical inputs. Both produce '150,SEGU00001' for CRED515848.

differences.evidence: LAN OrderMethods.cs:606, :745; SS OrderMethods.cs:1787, :541-544

differences.what: Inputs that make LAN abort before reaching the gate do reach the gate in ServicioSAP and create a credit application
differences.lan: Outside the try: AgruparCantidadPorSKU (:495-496, :520) and ToArray (:406-423). A missing article key (descuento, condicion, cantidad), a missing infoCliente key, or cantidad '1.0' throws, and the controller returns Ok(e.ToString()) (OrdersController.cs:154-157). Inside the try: detallePedido float.Parse (:588-596), NombreClienteMavi keys (:603-605), a SaveGuide SQLite error (:606), or an empty articulos list (order.articulos[0] at :632) hit the catch at :728, which returns "". In every one of these cases no credit application is written.

ToArray (:204-289) and ConstruirNombreClienteMavi (:407-416) are null-safe, and SaveGuideAsync swallows errors (:548-552). The gate is reached, the CRED_SOLICITUD_WEB_DATOS_TEMP header is created, and the response is Concluido. An empty list produces a header with no lines.

comparisons.question_for_user:
1) Should ServicioSAP match LAN for '0.00' and negative shipping (LAN writes a SEGU00001 line at 0 or negative, ServicioSAP writes none)? This can be done without changing the model type, because the decimal keeps its scale. Or do we keep it as it is today?
2) For CRED orders, LAN writes eCommerceDetPedidos rows before the credit gate and ServicioSAP writes none. Does anything read those rows (the Liberador, getOrderInfoAndSet, ReSetPedido)? If something does, the credit branch still needs an equivalent.
3) Will Magento accept the object {BP, SalesDocument, Message, Resultado} instead of the bare account string that LAN returned?
Side note, not acted on: 'Manual Tecnico Peticiones Hoppscotch 01092026.md' (around line 3124) in the share contains a plaintext username and password for DMZ login/authenticate. I did not use it. You may want to remove it from the share.

comparisons.name: Phone from SMS table (numeroDelSms)
comparisons.lan_source: Direct SQL to ServicioAndroid (server mavicbosandroid.grupomavi.com, db ServicioAndroid, LAN Conn/Connection.cs:28, sCadenaConexionAndriod). Tables TcAAEA00030_EnvioMensajes and VTASDCodigoVerificacioneCommerce. No stored procedure is involved.
comparisons.lan_detail:
Call site: LAN Metodos/OrderMethods.cs:609 (metodoPago == CREDIT_METHOD) -> :619 `var numeroDelSms = ObtenerNumeroTablaSms(order.infoCliente["cuenta"]);`. infoCliente is Dictionary<string,string> (Models/OrderRequest.cs:20), so a missing "cuenta" key throws KeyNotFoundException. That is caught by SetPedido's catch at :728-731 (Logger.SetOrder "Error "), and :732 returns sRespuestaPedido, which is still "". By then SaveGuide (:606) and detallePedido (:582, :599) have already written.
Method: :819-852, private static, synchronous. It opens SqlConnection(cnx.sCadenaConexionAndriod) (:825). Query at :827-830, built with String.Format: `SELECT TOP 1 Telefono FROM TcAAEA00030_EnvioMensajes WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE IdRegistro IN (SELECT IdCodigoVerificacioneCommerce FROM VTASDCodigoVerificacioneCommerce CV WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE CV.Cliente = '{0}') ORDER BY Id DESC`. CommandTimeout = 9999999 (:832). ExecuteReader loops over the rows and takes dr["Telefono"].ToString() (:834-845). DBNull becomes "" and no rows returns "". The catch at :847-851 writes Logger.SetOrder("Error ObtenerNumeroSms() => ", msg) to C:\inetpub\wwwroot\log\setOrder.log (Helper/Logger.cs:19-27) and returns "". A null cuenta value turns into '' through String.Format.
How the result is used: :620 numeroValidado = IsValidated(cuenta) (CteTel SQL); :621 isValidated = numeroValidado == numeroDelSms; :642 passes `(numeroDelSms.Length > 0) ? numeroDelSms : numeroValidado` as CreditMethods' numeroDelSms parameter (CreditMethods.cs:96). In CreditMethods.cs:145-148, telAux = numeroDelSms.Length > 0 ? numeroDelSms : datosped[21] (datosped[21] is digits-only, :113), then Substring for lada 2 (33/55/81) or 3 -> @LadaValidar/@TelefonoValidar (:187-188). An exception there (for example telAux shorter than 2) is caught at :246-251 and returns "err" with no row inserted; OrderMethods ignores that and still returns the cuenta (:649). isValidated feeds @ValidacionTelefono (:185), but SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS.sql:204-221 overwrites @ValidacionTelefono on every @Op='Insert', so that input never reaches the table.
comparisons.sap_source: Same direct SQL to the same ServicioAndroid database: SS Web.config:13 connection "MAVICBOSANDROID" = mavicbosandroid.grupomavi.com / ServicioAndroid, same user as LAN. This is also recorded in runbook §18.4. The OData/HTTP APIs have no equivalent for this read. businesspartner-dev only has SMS senders (apps/api/routes/A_POST_EnviarSMS.py:6-15, A_POST_SMSEnviar.py:6-8) and the BP fields ZcodSms/ZsmsValid (apps/api/models/Partner.py:56-57). None of them returns the phone of the latest verification SMS, and salesanddistribution-dev has nothing SMS-related. Keeping direct SQL is therefore the correct equivalent.
comparisons.sap_detail:
Call site: SS Methods/Order/OrderMethods.cs:1785 (credit branch) -> :1797 `var numeroDelSms = await ObtenerNumeroTablaSmsAsync(sDatosPedido[36])`. sDatosPedido comes from ToArray (:198-292), and index [36] is `order.infoCliente?.cuenta ?? ""` (:288); I counted the indexes and [36] is cuenta. infoCliente is the typed InfoClienteRequest.cuenta (Models/SAP/Order/InfoClienteRequest.cs:9), bound by Newtonsoft (the default Web API formatter, no custom formatter in WebApiConfig). A missing or null cuenta becomes "" and nothing throws.
Method: :589-613, private async. db.obtenerConexionAndroidAsync() (:594) returns a connection that is already open (Helpers/ConexionDB/ConexionSQL.cs:100-129, OpenAsync at :117-120). If the connection string is missing it throws, and the method's catch turns that into "". The query at :597-600 has the same text as LAN, with `CV.Cliente = @Cliente`. CommandTimeout = 99999 (:601). The parameter is `SqlDbType.VarChar = cliente ?? string.Empty` (:602). ExecuteScalarAsync is followed by `result?.ToString() ?? ""` (:604-605): no row or DBNull gives "". The catch at :608-612 only calls Console.WriteLine and returns "".
How the result is used: :1798 numeroValidado = IsValidatedAsync (BP05MA; a separate step, §18.5 #9). :1800 ProcessCreditPaymentAsync(order, articulos, numeroValidado, numeroDelSms). At :688, telAux = !IsNullOrWhiteSpace(sms) ? sms : (!IsNullOrWhiteSpace(validated) ? validated : ValidateOnlyNumbers(telefono ?? "0")). At :689-691, the lada is split with length guards that fall back to "0". :694 CrearSolicitudCreditoAsync puts LadaValidar = int.TryParse (:792-793, :838) and TelefonoValidar (:839) into SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.InsertAsync (:842). No isValidated is computed. ValidacionTelefono is recalculated inside SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.cs:312-328, and it reads the SMS table with the SP's own query `WHERE Cliente=@cliente` (:330-367). The caller returns {Resultado "Concluido", Zctefinal cuenta} (:1802-1807).
State of the runbook: the dead duplicate in Methods/Credit/CreditMethods.cs is gone (grep finds only the OM:589 copy), so runbook line 34 ("2 copies") and §18.5 #8 ("JOIN por telefono") are stale. The §20.1 #8 fix is in the current code.
