differences.concrete_case: No input changes the stored ValidacionTelefono through this path. For example, with sms '3312345678' and validated '3312345678', LAN sends @ValidacionTelefono=0 and the SP recomputes it anyway. Observable result is the same.

differences.what: Who writes the rows this lookup reads, and whether the key still matches (upstream dependency)
differences.lan: The key is the Intelisis cuenta 'C########' everywhere. credit/getSms -> VTASCodigoSMSEcommerce writes a VTASDCodigoVerificacioneCommerce row plus an EnvioMensajes row (IdMensaje 23, validated CteTel phone) when ExistingCustomer(cliente) is found in Intelisis Cte (LAN CreditMethods.cs:2102-2189, :2116, :2208-2222). credit/SendSmsNewNumber writes too (:1991-2019).
differences.sap: ServicioSAP exposes only credit/SendSmsNewNumber (SS Controllers/CreditController.cs:17-24; CreditMethods.cs:117-228). The DMZ still sends credit/getSms and credit/validateSms to LAN (DMZ Controllers/CreditController.cs:76, :107, curl.Post) and SendSmsNewNumber to SAP (:308). If cuenta becomes a 10-digit BP (sap.log shows BPs like 1500007543), LAN's ExistingCustomer(BP) is false: getSms returns 0 (the DMZ maps that to 'Error de credenciales', :80-81) and writes no row. The lookup then only finds SendSmsNewNumber rows and otherwise returns "", falling back to numeroValidado (BP05MA).
differences.decision_ref: No decision. It connects to PLAN §18.5 #3 and the §18.8 Magento question (BP or C... in infoCliente.cuenta).
differences.evidence: LAN CreditMethods.cs:2116, :2208-2222; DMZ CreditController.cs:76, :80-81, :107, :308; SS CreditController.cs:17-24; SS Logs/sap.log (BP 1500007543)
differences.concrete_case: A BP customer 1500007543 requests the credit NIP. The DMZ sends getSms to LAN, which finds no Cte and writes nothing, so setOrder sees numeroDelSms "" and TelefonoValidar comes from BP05MA or the order phone. In LAN the same customer (C-code) had numeroDelSms = the phone the NIP was sent to. If Magento sends C... in getSms but a BP in setOrder, the keys never match.

comparisons.question_for_user: 1) After the migration, what will Magento send in infoCliente.cuenta (setOrder), in NipRequest.cuenta (credit/getSms, still routed to LAN) and in SendSmsNewNumberRequest.Cliente? The lookup only works if all three carry the same identifier. Also, will getSms/validateSms be ported to ServicioSAP? LAN's version checks the Intelisis Cte table and writes nothing for a SAP BP. 2) Can you run these read-only queries on ServicioAndroid: `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM VTASDCodigoVerificacioneCommerce WHERE Cliente = ''` (to see whether the empty-cuenta path can pick up another customer's phone), and the INFORMATION_SCHEMA widths and types of VTASDCodigoVerificacioneCommerce.Cliente and TcAAEA00030_EnvioMensajes.Cliente/Telefono? A 9-wide Cliente would reject 10-digit BPs (error 8152 on insert, swallowed), and a char Telefono would bring back padded blanks.

comparisons.name: Validated phone fallback (numeroValidado) and isValidated
comparisons.lan_source: IntelisisTmp.dbo.CteTel on MAVICUBOS (sCadenaConexion, LAN Conn/Connection.cs:26), read with inline SQL in OrderMethods.IsValidated. The result goes to SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS @LadaValidar INT / @TelefonoValidar VARCHAR(10) (SP:155-156). isValidated goes to @ValidacionTelefono (SP:153), but the SP overwrites that value in the Insert branch (SP:210-221) using the same CteTel query (SP:194-202).
comparisons.sap_source: GET ZAPI_BP05MA_SRV/BusinessPartnerSet(Partner='{cuenta}',Client='110')?$expand=to_CteTel,+11 navs (BusinessPartnerMethods.GetClientMaAsync, BusinessPartnerMethods.cs:297-340). The result is written by a direct INSERT into CRED_SOLICITUD_WEB_DATOS_TEMP (SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.cs:217-218). The reference repos never use BP05MA. Their CteTel equivalent is ZQBP_EDITARCLIENTE_SRV/CteTelSet (businesspartner-dev AS_GET_ZQBP_EditarCliente_CteTel.py:22), and their validated-phone route is A_GET_TelefonoValidado.py:17-36. ServicioSAP uses that route for ValidacionTelefono (SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.cs:476-519).
comparisons.lan_detail:
Credit branch, LAN Metodos/OrderMethods.cs:609-621:
- numeroDelSms = ObtenerNumeroTablaSms(infoCliente["cuenta"]) (:619, :819-852).
- numeroValidado = IsValidated(infoCliente["cuenta"]) (:620).
- isValidated = numeroValidado == numeroDelSms (:621).

IsValidated (:786-817) runs SELECT TOP 1 CONCAT(ct.Lada, ct.Telefono) FROM CteTel WHERE Cliente='{0}' AND Tipo='Movil' AND ValidacionTel=1 ORDER BY Fecha DESC (:794-795). CONCAT never returns NULL, so the result is "" when there is no row. On an exception it writes Logger.CustomerService and returns "" (:812-816).

What happens with the result:
- :642 passes (numeroDelSms.Length>0 ? numeroDelSms : numeroValidado) as the numeroDelSms parameter of CreditMethods.ProductosCreditoWeb_SaveData. :643 passes isValidated.
- CreditMethods.cs:145-148: telAux = param.Length>0 ? param : datosped[21], where datosped[21] is the order phone reduced to digits (:113). Lada is 2 characters if the first two are 33/55/81, otherwise 3. An input shorter than 2 characters throws, SaveData returns "err" and nothing is inserted.
- :187-188 sends @LadaValidar and @TelefonoValidar as VarChar. The SP declares them INT and VARCHAR(10) (SP:155-156), so a longer phone is cut to 10 characters without error.
- isValidated is used only in @ValidacionTelefono = (!isValidated || !IsInTableStd) ? 1 : 0 (:185). The SP overwrites this in the Insert branch (SP:172, :210-221), so isValidated has no observable effect.

Nothing from this step reaches the HTTP response: setOrder returns infoCliente["cuenta"] (:649).
comparisons.sap_detail:
Credit branch, SetOrderAsync, OrderMethods.cs:1785-1808:
- numeroDelSms = ObtenerNumeroTablaSmsAsync(sDatosPedido[36]) (:1797).
- numeroValidado = IsValidatedAsync(sDatosPedido[36]) (:1798).
- [36] is infoCliente.cuenta ?? "" (ToArray :288).
- No isValidated is computed. It was removed per §17.3.

IsValidatedAsync (:631-660):
- Calls GetClientMaAsync, which throws on non-2xx, empty or HTML responses and on d == null (BusinessPartnerMethods.cs:316-339). The Partner value is not escaped.
- Takes To_CteTel.Results and returns "" if it is null or empty (:638-640).
- Picks FirstOrDefault(t => t.Zvaltel && ZappOrig not blank && ZtelCte not blank && ZtipoCte equals "MOVIL", ignoring case) (:646-651). There is no ordering.
- Returns the raw ZtelCte, or "" (:653).
- On any exception it writes Console.WriteLine and returns "" (:655-659).
- BusinessPhone has no [JsonPropertyName] attributes (BusinessEntitiesMa.cs:5-21), and System.Text.Json matching is case-sensitive.

What happens with the result:
- ProcessCreditPaymentAsync :688: telAux = !IsNullOrWhiteSpace(sms) ? sms : (!IsNullOrWhiteSpace(validado) ? validado : ValidateOnlyNumbers(telefono ?? "0")).
- :689-691 splits it into lada and number. When the value is too short, both become "0".
- CrearSolicitudCreditoAsync: int.TryParse on the lada (:793), then assigns LadaValidar and TelefonoValidar (:838-839).
- ArmarFila :298-299 feeds a direct INSERT with @LadaValidar Int and @TelefonoValidar VarChar with no size (:217-218). Nothing is truncated.

ValidacionTelefono is computed separately in InsertAsync :25-28 → ConstruirContextoAsync :381-400 (A_GET_TelefonoValidado, CteTelSet, catalog, SMS by Cliente) → ResolverValidacionTelefono :312-328.

Extra reads: BP05MA is read a second time in ObtenerMaestroAsync (:369-379), and the BP05MA read in IsValidatedAsync still runs when an SMS number exists, where its result is unused.

With real payloads the cuenta is the Intelisis account C01575835 (magento_payloads.md:26). BP05MA then fails, IsValidatedAsync returns "" without a trace, and the flow aborts later in CheckClientCreditAsync (:681-682).

Response: Concluido plus the cuenta (:1802-1807), not affected by this step.

differences.what: The validated-phone lookup has an extra filter: ZappOrig must not be blank
differences.lan: No origin filter. Any row with Tipo='Movil' AND ValidacionTel=1 qualifies (OrderMethods.cs:794-795). The origin check (IsInTableStd, CreditMethods.cs:1967-1989) only fed isValidated, which the SP discards.
differences.sap: Requires !IsNullOrWhiteSpace(ZappOrig) (OrderMethods.cs:649). The comment calls this 'IsInTableStd', but it only checks that the field is not blank. It does not check membership in the catalog.
differences.evidence: SS OrderMethods.cs:646-651. LAN OrderMethods.cs:794-795. PLAN §17.4 (line 1298) and §18.5 #9 (line 1361) list this as pending. ServicioSAP creates BPs with ZappOrig="" (OrderMethods.cs:2853, BusinessPartnerMethods.cs:666). A_POST_ValidarTelefono.py:46-57 keeps the existing ZappOrig when it validates a phone. The ZappOrig value that ecommerce will write is still undefined (PLAN §15.2 item 1).
differences.concrete_case: BP with one MOVIL 5522122584, Zvaltel=true, ZappOrig=''; no SMS row; order telefono 3312345678. LAN (assuming CteTel Lada 55, Telefono 22122584) writes LadaValidar=55, TelefonoValidar='22122584'. SS gets '' from IsValidatedAsync, falls back to the order phone and writes LadaValidar=33, TelefonoValidar='12345678'.
differences.decision_ref: PLAN §17.4 / §18.5 #9 (pending, not decided)

differences.what: No ORDER BY Fecha DESC when more than one validated MOVIL exists
differences.lan: TOP 1 ... ORDER BY Fecha DESC returns the most recent validated Movil. SQL Server sorts NULL Fecha last in DESC.
differences.sap: FirstOrDefault in whatever order the Gateway returns to_CteTel. There is no sort on Zfecha, which arrives as a '/Date(ms)/' string or null.
differences.evidence: SS OrderMethods.cs:646-651. LAN OrderMethods.cs:795. PLAN §9.2 step 5 (line 540): 'Le falta el ORDER BY Fecha DESC'. §18.5 #9. CAPTURAS_REALES_APIS.md:60: Zfecha is null in 4 of 6 rows. More than one validated row can exist: A_POST_BPValidarTelefonoCOFETEL.py:98-118 inserts Zvaltel=true without clearing the other rows.
differences.concrete_case: Two validated MOVIL rows, no SMS: '0000000002' 3311111111 with Zfecha 2025-01-10, and '0000001213' 5522122584 with Zfecha 2026-08-11. LAN uses the newer one: 55/'22122584'. SS uses whichever row the Gateway lists first. The Gateway's order is NO EVIDENCE; if it is key order, SS writes 33/'11111111'.
differences.decision_ref: PLAN §18.5 #9 (pending)

differences.what: Format of the returned phone: raw ZtelCte instead of CONCAT(Lada, Telefono)
differences.lan: CONCAT(Lada, Telefono) built from separate Intelisis columns (OrderMethods.cs:794).
differences.sap: Raw ZtelCte (OrderMethods.cs:653). It is not reduced to digits. §20 #10 added ValidateOnlyNumbers only for the order-phone fallback (:688).
differences.evidence: CAPTURAS_REALES_APIS.md:61: ZtelCte in to_CteTel comes as 7 digits, 10 digits, or with +52. SS :688-691 and :793 (int.TryParse accepts '+52'). Whether the migrated ZtelCte equals the Intelisis CONCAT(Lada,Telefono): NO EVIDENCE.
differences.concrete_case: Validated MOVIL with ZtelCte '+525522122584', no SMS. SS: first two characters '+5' are not in {33,55,81}, so lada='+52', parsed as LadaValidar=52, and TelefonoValidar='5522122584'. LAN for the same line (if Intelisis stores Lada '55', Telefono '22122584'): 55/'22122584'. A 7-digit ZtelCte '7481532' gives 748/'1532' in SS.

differences.what: TelefonoValidar width: the SP parameter truncated, the direct INSERT does not
differences.lan: @TelefonoValidar VARCHAR(10) (SP:156) cuts longer values to 10 characters without error. @LadaValidar is INT (SP:155).
differences.sap: SqlDbType.VarChar with no size, sent in a direct INSERT (SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.cs:218). If the value is wider than the column, SQL Server raises error 8152 or 2628.
differences.evidence: SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS.sql:156. SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.cs:217-218. PLAN §18.3 (decision 13: insert values as they arrive). The real column width is NO EVIDENCE (B2 pending).
differences.concrete_case: ZtelCte '+5215522122584' gives TelefonoValidar '15522122584' (11 characters). LAN would have stored '1552212258'. SS fails the whole INSERT if the column is VARCHAR(10).
differences.decision_ref: Decision 13 (PLAN §18.3)

differences.what: Rows with a blank phone are skipped instead of producing an empty result
differences.lan: If the newest validated Movil has NULL or empty Lada and Telefono, CONCAT returns '', numeroValidado is '', and the flow falls back to the order phone (:794-795, :804).
differences.sap: Rows with a blank ZtelCte are skipped (:650), so an older validated MOVIL can be returned instead.
differences.evidence: SS OrderMethods.cs:650. LAN OrderMethods.cs:794-804. The runbook does not mention this.
differences.concrete_case: Newest validated MOVIL has an empty number; an older validated MOVIL is 5522122584; no SMS; order phone 3312345678. LAN writes 33/'12345678'. SS writes 55/'22122584'.

differences.what: How the phone type is compared
differences.lan: Tipo = 'Movil' in T-SQL. Case sensitivity depends on the column collation (NO EVIDENCE). T-SQL '=' ignores trailing spaces.
differences.sap: string.Equals(ZtipoCte, "MOVIL", OrdinalIgnoreCase) (:651). Case is ignored, but trailing spaces are not.
differences.evidence: SS OrderMethods.cs:651. LAN :795. SAP returns 'MOVIL' in uppercase (CAPTURAS_REALES_APIS.md:52-56). Padded values in SAP: NO EVIDENCE.
differences.concrete_case: ZtipoCte 'MOVIL ' (with a trailing space): LAN matches, SS does not.

differences.what: Within one request, the validated phone comes from two different sources with different rules
differences.lan: IsValidated (OrderMethods.cs:794-795) and the SP's @TelefonoValidado (SP:194-202) are the same query, so the phone used for LadaValidar/TelefonoValidar always agrees with the phone used for ValidacionTelefono.
differences.sap: numeroValidado comes from BP05MA to_CteTel with the ZappOrig filter (OrderMethods.cs:631-660). ValidacionTelefono uses A_GET_TelefonoValidado with different rules (SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.cs:476-519). BP05MA is read twice (:636 and SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.cs:378).
differences.evidence: PLAN §17.4 (line 1298): 'Duplica lo que ahora hace A_GET_TelefonoValidado ... con otra fuente. Unificarlo cambia datos en el caso limite' (pending).
differences.concrete_case: BP with validated MOVIL 5522122584 (ZappOrig non-blank) and a newer non-validated PARTICULAR. SS: LadaValidar=55, TelefonoValidar='22122584', but A_GET_TelefonoValidado returns the newest row with ZvalTel=false, so TelefonoValidado=null and ValidacionTelefono=1. In LAN and the SP, both use 5522122584.
differences.decision_ref: PLAN §17.4 (pending)

differences.what: isValidated is no longer computed or passed
differences.lan: isValidated = numeroValidado == numeroDelSms (:621) feeds @ValidacionTelefono (CreditMethods.cs:185), which the SP then overwrites unconditionally (SP:172, :210-221).
differences.sap: Not computed. ValidacionTelefono is recomputed in ResolverValidacionTelefono (SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.cs:312-328), the same way the SP recomputed it.
differences.evidence: SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS.sql:210-221. PLAN §11.3 block 3 (line 831). PLAN §17.3 (line 1291).
differences.concrete_case: Any input: LAN passed 0 or 1, but the stored row always got the SP's value. Removing isValidated changes nothing observable.
differences.decision_ref: PLAN §17.3

differences.what: Cross-step: the API that replaced the SP's internal validated-phone query does not filter Tipo='Movil' AND ValidacionTel=1, contrary to PLAN §15.1
differences.lan: SP:194-202 is the same query as IsValidated: the latest Movil with ValidacionTel=1.
differences.sap: A_GET_TelefonoValidado.py:5-15 and :30 takes max() over ALL phones by (Zfecha, ZfechaCap, ZidcteTel) and returns that row's Zvaltel. SS keeps the phone only if Zvaltel is true (:515). AS_GET_ZQBP_EditarCliente_CteTel.py:60-62 turns a null Zfecha into '00000000', which sorts above '/Date(...)/' strings ('0' > '/'), so rows without a date win.
differences.evidence: businesspartner-dev routes cited above. CAPTURAS_REALES_APIS.md:50-56 and :96. PLAN §15.1 (line 1124) says the API already does the filter, but the repo code does not. PLAN §18.8 still asks the API owner. This belongs to the ValidacionTelefono step; it is reported here because it is what now does the job isValidated's replacement depends on.
differences.concrete_case: BP 1500004598: the SP picks 5522122584, the only validated MOVIL. The API picks one of the rows with null Zfecha (1211 FIJO, 1212 MOVIL, 2 MOVIL, 0 TRABAJO). If their ZfechaCap values are equal, id 1212 (3338007830, Zvaltel=false) wins, so TelefonoValidado=null and ValidacionTelefono=1. The SP would give 0 when the origin and SMS match.

differences.what: Errors are not logged persistently
differences.lan: Logger.CustomerService('ERROR IsValidated() => ') writes to the log file (:814).
differences.sap: Only Console.WriteLine (:657), which is lost under IIS.
differences.evidence: LAN OrderMethods.cs:812-816. SS OrderMethods.cs:655-659.
differences.concrete_case: BP05MA answers 401 or 500: both sides return '' and fall back, but only LAN leaves a trace.

differences.what: SMS-number precedence: IsNullOrWhiteSpace instead of Length > 0
differences.lan: (numeroDelSms.Length > 0) ? numeroDelSms : numeroValidado (:642, CreditMethods.cs:145).
differences.sap: !IsNullOrWhiteSpace(numeroDelSms) (:688).
differences.evidence: PLAN §20.3 (line 1507): pending, together with the '0' fallbacks at :688-691.
differences.concrete_case: SMS Telefono '   ' (spaces only): LAN uses it, giving LadaValidar from '   ' and TelefonoValidar ''. SS ignores it and uses numeroValidado.

differences.what: 'cuenta' key missing from infoCliente
differences.lan: infoCliente is a Dictionary<string,string> (Models/OrderRequest.cs:20). A missing key throws KeyNotFoundException at :619; the outer catch (:728-731) handles it, setOrder returns '' (:732) and no row is written.
differences.sap: cuenta ?? '' (ToArray :288). IsValidatedAsync('') fails at BP05MA and returns '' without a trace, and the flow continues (OrderMethods.cs:672-676).
differences.evidence: The real credit payloads always include cuenta (magento_payloads.md:26, :55). Related to PLAN §18.5 #6.
differences.concrete_case: Payload without a 'cuenta' key: LAN responds '' with no insert. SS goes down the invitado or cliente-nuevo path.

differences.what: The name of the ZappOrig field in the BP05MA to_CteTel response is not confirmed
differences.lan: Not applicable: IsValidated does not read AppOrigen.
differences.sap: BusinessPhone.ZappOrig has no [JsonPropertyName] (BusinessEntitiesMa.cs:15). If BP05MA uses different casing, the field stays null and IsValidatedAsync always returns ''. OrderMethods.cs:619-626 documents the same failure mode for Partner.zvalTel.
differences.evidence: The casing of Zvaltel, ZtipoCte and ZtelCte in BP05MA is confirmed (CAPTURAS_REALES_APIS.md:52-58). ZappOrig in BP05MA: NO EVIDENCE (PLAN line 1170: 'la captura de BP05 no lo muestra').
differences.concrete_case: If BP05MA returns the field under another casing, every credit order silently falls back to the order phone for LadaValidar/TelefonoValidar.

comparisons.question_for_user:
1. PLAN §17.4 is still pending: should IsValidatedAsync match LAN (drop the ZappOrig filter and sort by Zfecha DESC with nulls last, over BP05MA to_CteTel or CteTelSet), or should it share one source with the ValidacionTelefono lookup so both agree as they did in LAN/SP?
2. Is the SAP ZtelCte a migrated copy of Intelisis CONCAT(Lada,Telefono)? Should numeroValidado be reduced to digits and have +52 removed before the lada split? The captures show 7-digit, 10-digit and +52 values.
3. Can you share a real BP05MA response whose to_CteTel includes ZappOrig, ideally for a BP with a validated MOVIL, to confirm the field name?
4. Does the deployed A_GET_TelefonoValidado filter MOVIL and Zvaltel=true? The repo version does not: it takes max(Zfecha, ZfechaCap, id) over all phones, and rows with a null Zfecha win. That contradicts PLAN §15.1.
5. After the migration, will the SMS tables (VTASDCodigoVerificacioneCommerce / TcAAEA00030) be keyed by the BP number or by the Intelisis C... account? If they stay keyed by the Intelisis account, the SMS lookup by BP will come back empty and the numeroValidado fallback will be used far more often.

No text in the documents I read tried to give instructions. All work was read-only.

comparisons.name: Credit balance check (LAN checkSaldo, dead code; removed in ServicioSAP)
comparisons.lan_source: SQL SP SpCREDIDatosSolicitudCreditoArt @Op='GetSaldo', @Val=cuenta. It is called over the ServicioAndroid connection (LAN Conn/Connection.cs:28), but the only script in the share is the IntelisisTmp version (SPsOrden/SpCREDIDatosSolicitudCreditoArt.sql:1). Branch at SP:80-122.
comparisons.lan_detail:
Call chain: OrdersController.Set (LAN Controllers/OrdersController.cs:151) -> OrderMethods.SetPedido, credit branch (LAN Metodos/OrderMethods.cs:609). That branch calls cm.ProductosCreditoWeb_SaveData(...) at :624-647 with data[4] = order.total (:631), and order.total is a string (Models/OrderRequest.cs:13). The branch then ALWAYS returns order.infoCliente["cuenta"] (:649), so the method's return value is DISCARDED.
Inside ProductosCreditoWeb_SaveData (Metodos/CreditMethods.cs): the check only runs if checkCliente(data[0]) passes (:124). Then :126 does `if (decimal.Parse(data[4]) > checkSaldo(data[0])) res = "insuficiente"; else res = "OK";`.
- This line sits OUTSIDE the inner try, which starts at :135 (catch at :246-252).
- The value is only returned at :243 (`return res;`). Nothing blocks: the insert goes ahead either way.
checkSaldo (:766-802):
- Opens sCadenaConexionAndriod (:772). checkCliente uses sCadenaConexion/IntelisisTmp (:730).
- Declares @retValue as Decimal ReturnValue (:783) and never reads it.
- Runs ExecuteScalar twice (:788 and :790), so the SP executes twice, with CommandTimeout 60 (:787).
- Parses the second result with `decimal.Parse(cmd.ExecuteScalar().ToString())` (:790). The empty catch (:796-799) swallows everything, then `return 0` (:801).
The SP GetSaldo branch (SP:80-122) only ASSIGNS variables:
- @Saldo = pending Venta 'Analisis Credito'/'Pedido' UNION ALL CXC PENDIENTE (SP:84-106).
- @Credito = ISNULL(CRMCantidad, 0) from cte (SP:109-112).
- @CreditoDisponible (SP:115-120).
- A bare RETURN (SP:121). There is NO output SELECT.
So ExecuteScalar returns null, .ToString() throws NullReferenceException, the catch swallows it, and checkSaldo returns 0. If the SP does not exist in ServicioAndroid, the SqlException is swallowed the same way and it still returns 0. Whether a different SP version exists in ServicioAndroid: NO EVIDENCE. Either way checkSaldo can never throw, and its result only feeds `res`, which the caller throws away.
Net effect: any total > 0 gives res = "insuficiente", and total <= 0 gives "OK". Both are dropped at OrderMethods.cs:624/649.
The only effects you can observe:
- Two read-only SP round trips (latency, up to 60 s per command timeout).
- decimal.Parse(data[4]) at :126 can throw when total is ""/null/non-numeric. The exception escapes ProductosCreditoWeb_SaveData and is caught by SetPedido's catch (OrderMethods.cs:728-731, logs "Error " + message). SetPedido then returns sRespuestaPedido = "" (:574, :732), and the controller returns Ok("") (OrdersController.cs:152, :160).
- In that failure case NOTHING is written: no SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS row, no article lines, no promoter code burned, no Liberador thread.
Real credit payloads send total as a numeric string ("8198", "594": Resources/magento_payloads.md:26, :55), so the abort path has not been seen in production captures.
checkSaldo has a second, out-of-scope caller: InsertUnificationWallet (CreditMethods.cs:1687). ServicioSAP has no UnificationWallet code (0 grep hits).
comparisons.sap_source:
NONE. No balance or available-credit query exists in the credit path. The former CheckClientBalanceAsync read BusinessPartner Zcrmimporte (ZB_DATOS_CLIENTE_CDS via BusinessPartnerMethods.GetClientAsync). It and its commented-out call were removed in the uncommitted working tree (git diff HEAD of Methods/Order/OrderMethods.cs). Candidate sources, used by no one in this path:
- BP API ZlimCred / Zcrmcantidad / Zcrmimporte (businesspartner-dev apps/api/models/Partner.py:14-15, :27; ServicioSAP Models/SAP/BusinessPartner/Partner.cs:33). Covers only the credit-limit half.
- CXC via AbonoMethods.GetDocumentosNoCompensadosAsync (Methods/Abono/AbonoMethods.cs:19). The pending Venta/VentaD half of SP:86-99 has no OData source (PLAN §13.4 E.2, §16.5).
comparisons.sap_detail:
OrderController.SetOrder (Controllers/OrderController.cs:18-47) -> SetOrderAsync, credit branch (Methods/Order/OrderMethods.cs:1785-1808) -> ProcessCreditPaymentAsync (:665-766).
The only pre-insert checks are:
- Guest rejection (:675-676).
- For an existing account, an EXISTENCE check only: CheckClientCreditAsync (:679-684, :768-781), which asks whether GetClientAsync returns a BusinessPartner.
There is no balance or available-credit computation anywhere before CrearSolicitudCreditoAsync (:694). order.total is `decimal` (Models/SAP/Order/OrderRequest.cs:13), and nothing in the credit path reads it:
- In OrderMethods it appears only in ToArray :211 and in the returns path :1670. Of sDatosPedido the credit branch reads only [36] (:1797-1798).
- Methods/Credit/SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.cs and CreditMethods.cs: 0 hits.
On success the branch returns OrderResponse{Resultado="Concluido", Zctefinal=cuenta} (:1802-1807). Errors are rethrown (:761-765), and the controller turns them into HTTP 200 "Error, <msg>" (OrderController.cs:37-46).
The removed code (git diff HEAD) had:
- a commented-out block `//decimal saldoDisponible = await CheckClientBalanceAsync(cuentaBp); //if (saldoDisponible < order.total) throw new Exception("Saldo insuficiente...")`. Enabling it would have BLOCKED orders, which LAN never did.
- CheckClientBalanceAsync itself, which returned Zcrmimporte, or 0 on any error.
Leftover stale comments still claim a balance validation: the summary at :663 ("Valida cliente, saldo y crea solicitud") and :678 ("validamos existencia y saldo en SAP").

differences.what: ServicioSAP no longer runs a balance check. LAN runs checkSaldo (2 SP executions), which always returns 0 and sets res = "insuficiente"/"OK". The caller throws that value away.
differences.lan: CreditMethods.cs:126-133 computes res from decimal.Parse(total) > checkSaldo(cuenta). checkSaldo (:766-802) always returns 0 because the SP GetSaldo branch emits no result set (SP:80-121), and the empty catch swallows the NullReferenceException (:796-801). res is returned at :243 and discarded by OrderMethods.cs:624-649, which always returns the cuenta.
differences.sap: No equivalent call. ProcessCreditPaymentAsync (OrderMethods.cs:665-766) only checks guest status and BP existence (:675-684), then inserts. CheckClientBalanceAsync and the commented-out call were deleted (git diff HEAD).
differences.evidence: PLAN_EJECUCION_SP_CREDITO_A_CODIGO.md §16.2-16.4 (GetSaldo never returned anything; checkSaldo is always 0; res is discarded; 'no hay comportamiento que replicar'), §16.5 option A (literal parity: no available-credit validation), §17.3 (CheckClientBalanceAsync and the commented balance call removed). Also §11.3 Block 0: making it block 'seria una regresion'.
differences.concrete_case: CRED515848 payload with a valid BP and total "594". LAN runs GetSaldo twice against ServicioAndroid, sets res="insuficiente", inserts the application anyway and returns the cuenta. ServicioSAP skips the check, inserts, and returns Resultado="Concluido"/BP. Same rows written, and only response time differs (LAN adds 2 SP round trips, up to 60 s each on timeout).

differences.what: LAN's balance line parses the total OUTSIDE the inner try. A malformed total aborts the whole credit-application creation. ServicioSAP never parses total in this path, so it goes ahead and inserts.
differences.lan: decimal.Parse(data[4]) at CreditMethods.cs:126 is outside the try at :135. On ''/null/non-numeric it throws FormatException/ArgumentNullException, which propagates to SetPedido catch (OrderMethods.cs:728-731, logs 'Error ...'). SetPedido returns sRespuestaPedido = "" (:574, :732), and the controller answers HTTP 200 with body "" (OrdersController.cs:152, :160). Nothing is written: no SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS row, no lines, no promoter code burned, no Liberador thread.
differences.sap: total is a decimal model property (OrderRequest.cs:13) and is not read in the credit path. With default Web API 2/Newtonsoft binding, an unparseable value is expected to become a ModelState error with total left at 0, and the controller never checks ModelState (OrderController.cs:18-35). This binding behaviour is not verified by a run: NO EVIDENCE, since it cannot be tested without SAP. The application is then inserted normally, and the response is 200 {BP, Resultado:"Concluido"}.
differences.evidence: The runbook §16.4 says the balance check 'nunca tuvo efecto observable', but it does not analyse the decimal.Parse abort path. No decision covers it. Real credit payloads send numeric strings ("total":"8198" magento_payloads.md:26; "total":"594" :55), so this is an edge case with no production evidence of occurring.
differences.concrete_case: Credit order with an existing account/BP and "total":"" (or the total key omitted, or "total":"N/A"). LAN writes nothing and returns HTTP 200 "". ServicioSAP (expected) inserts the credit application and lines and returns HTTP 200 {BP:<cuenta>, Resultado:"Concluido"}.
differences.decision_ref: none (not covered by PLAN §16/§17; recommend recording it as accepted under §16.5 option A)

differences.what: Stale documentation in ServicioSAP still claims a balance validation that no longer exists
differences.lan: N/A
differences.sap: OrderMethods.cs:663 summary 'Valida cliente, saldo y crea solicitud de crédito' and :678 comment 'validamos existencia y saldo en SAP'. Only existence is validated (:679-684).
differences.evidence: PLAN §17.3 removed CheckClientBalanceAsync and the commented call but did not update these two comments (current code :663, :678).
differences.concrete_case: No runtime effect. A reviewer reading :663/:678 would wrongly assume insufficient-credit orders are rejected.
differences.decision_ref: PLAN §17.3 (cleanup incomplete)

comparisons.question_for_user:
Two points to confirm:
1) PLAN §16.5 lists option A ("paridad literal": no available-credit validation) and option B (build a real check from ZlimCred minus EX01 CXC minus pending orders, which has no OData source). §17.3 removed CheckClientBalanceAsync as a zero-caller cleanup, which in effect applies option A, but the runbook never records you choosing A. Is option A final?
2) With a malformed total ("" / missing / non-numeric), LAN aborts and writes no credit application (HTTP 200 ""), while ServicioSAP would insert it normally. Should we accept this as-is? I recommend accepting it: the real payloads always send a numeric total, and copying the abort would reintroduce a bug.

comparisons.name: Open ServicioAndroid connection before checks
comparisons.lan_source: ServicioAndroid database (mavicbosandroid.grupomavi.com / ServicioAndroid), connection string hardcoded in LAN Conn/Connection.cs:28 (sCadenaConexionAndriod). The connection opened here is used only for SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS, which lives in ServicioAndroid (SPsOrden/SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS.sql:1 `USE [ServicioAndroid]`, INSERT into CRED_SOLICITUD_WEB_DATOS_TEMP at :223, SCOPE_IDENTITY at :346).
comparisons.lan_detail:
LAN Metodos/CreditMethods.cs:115-122, in ProductosCreditoWeb_SaveData (:94-262). `using (cnn = new SqlConnection(cadenac.sCadenaConexionAndriod)) { cnn.Open(); SqlCommand command = new SqlCommand("SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS", cnn); ...` cnn is a class field (:20). The Open at :119 sits OUTSIDE the inner try (:135-252), and the method has no outer try. It runs BEFORE checkCliente (:124), checkSaldo (:126) and getClientInfo (:137).
None of those checks uses this connection. Each opens its own: checkCliente on Intelisis (:730), checkSaldo on a second Android connection (:772, swallows errors and returns 0), getClientInfo on Intelisis (:812), IsInTableStd on Intelisis (:1972, called while the parameters are built at :185). The opened connection is used for exactly one statement, command.ExecuteReader() at :190. The reader is never disposed. The connection stays open through CreditoWeb_InsertArticulo (:201, which reassigns the `cnn` field to a new Intelisis connection at :872; the `using` still disposes the original Android object), CodigoPromocion (:205) and the start of the liberador thread (:215-240), until the using closes at :260.
FAILURE: if ServicioAndroid is unreachable, the SqlException from :119 escapes ProductosCreditoWeb_SaveData. The caller SetPedido (OrderMethods.cs:623-647, return value ignored) catches it at :728-731 (`Logger.SetOrder("Error ", ex.Message)`) and returns sRespuestaPedido = string.Empty (:574, :732). The controller returns `Ok("")`, HTTP 200 (Controllers/OrdersController.cs:151-160).
Nothing is written to CRED_SOLICITUD_WEB_DATOS_TEMP or the article lines, the promoter code is not burned, and no liberador runs. Two writes happened earlier in SetPedido and stay: detallePedido on Intelisis (:582, :599) and SaveGuide (:606). Those belong to other steps.
Before this step, ObtenerNumeroTablaSms (OrderMethods.cs:619, :819-852) also opens an Android connection (:825-833). On failure it swallows the error, returns "" and logs via Logger.SetOrder (:849).
Contrast: if Open succeeds and the SP later fails, the inner catch returns "err" (:246-252). SetPedido ignores it and returns the account (:649), HTTP 200.
Legacy end to end: the pre-migration DMZ (commit 950106a of 2026-04-08, commented out by 686699e on 2026-06-26; still visible commented at DMZ Controllers/OrdersController.cs:145-150) turned LAN's "" into HTTP 500 {error:"LAN retornó vacío", incrementId}.
comparisons.sap_source: Same database: Web.config:13 connection string MAVICBOSANDROID (server mavicbosandroid.grupomavi.com, database ServicioAndroid, same user as LAN; runbook §18.4 confirms). It is read by conexionSQL.obtenerConexionAndroidAsync (Helpers/ConexionDB/ConexionSQL.cs:100-129), which returns the connection already open. It is opened per statement at SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.cs:160 (INSERT CRED_SOLICITUD_WEB_DATOS_TEMP), :336 (TcAAEA00030_EnvioMensajes read), OrderMethods.cs:594 (SMS lookup) and :888 (article lines). No OData or HTTP API takes part in this step. It is a plain SQL connection to the same ServicioAndroid database, so no businesspartner-dev or salesanddistribution-dev equivalent applies.
comparisons.sap_detail:
No discrete step. ServicioSAP never opens an Android connection ahead of the checks. The credit branch in SetOrderAsync (Methods/Order/OrderMethods.cs:1785-1808) runs in this order:
1. SaveGuideAsync (:1787).
2. ObtenerNumeroTablaSmsAsync (:1797, :589-613). It opens Android at :594. On failure it catches, calls Console.WriteLine (:610) and returns "". Same result as LAN.
3. IsValidatedAsync (:1798): OData BP05MA.
4. ProcessCreditPaymentAsync (:665-766): guest throw (:675-676), then CheckClientCreditAsync over OData (:679-684), then CrearSolicitudCreditoAsync (:694, :787-843), which calls SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.InsertAsync (:842, SCW:18-33).
5. InsertAsync: ObtenerMaestroAsync (OData), then ConstruirContextoAsync (SCW:381-400). That calls GetTelefonoValidadoAsync over HTTP (:385). Only when the validated phone is not null does it also call GetCteTelAsync, GetCatalogoConfiguracionAsync and ObtenerTelefonoAValidarAsync (:397). That last one is the first Android open inside the class (SCW:336); on failure it logs "[CREDIT ObtenerTelefonoAValidar ERROR]" and rethrows (:361-366).
6. InsertarSolicitudAsync (SCW:157-227) opens Android at SCW:160, with no try/catch.
FAILURE: ConexionSQL.cs:124-127 wraps the error as `Exception("Error en obtenerConexionAndroidAsync: " + msg)`. It propagates through InsertAsync and CrearSolicitudCreditoAsync, is rethrown by ProcessCreditPaymentAsync (:761-765), and is wrapped by SetOrderAsync (:1950-1953) as "Error en SetOrder: ...". OrderController.cs:37-46 logs `[ORDER NEW ERROR]` to sap.log and returns `Ok("Error, " + e.Message)`, HTTP 200.
The current DMZ forwards that body (DMZ OrdersController.cs:196, :214-227). Newtonsoft cannot parse it, so the DMZ returns Ok(string), HTTP 200.
Nothing is written to Android (neither the header nor the lines) and the promoter code is not burned. The liberador is commented out (:720-757).
Timeouts match: the default 15 s connect timeout in both connection strings, and the default 30 s command timeout on the INSERT (SCW:161-223) as on LAN's SP command (:121-190).

differences.what: Where the connection opens and how long it lives: once and early in LAN, per statement and at the point of use in ServicioSAP
differences.lan: One Android connection opened at CreditMethods.cs:117-119 before any check. It is held open across checkCliente, checkSaldo, getClientInfo, IsInTableStd, the SP (:190), the article lines and the promoter call, until :260.
differences.sap: Separate `using` connections per statement (OrderMethods.cs:594; SCW:336; SCW:160 where INSERT and SCOPE_IDENTITY share one command and connection; OrderMethods.cs:888).
differences.evidence: LAN CreditMethods.cs:115-122, :190, :260. SS ConexionSQL.cs:100-129, SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.cs:157-227, :336. Runbook §2 item 3 (line 69) mandates the per-statement `using (... obtenerConexionAndroidAsync())` pattern. §9.2 steps 10-11 want the INSERT and SCOPE_IDENTITY on the same command and connection. §18.4 confirms the same server and database.
differences.decision_ref: Runbook §2 item 3; §9.2 steps 10-11; §18.4
differences.concrete_case: ServicioAndroid reachable and a valid customer: the same row reaches CRED_SOLICITUD_WEB_DATOS_TEMP and nothing observable differs. Only pool and session usage differ, and only in SQL Server metadata.

differences.what: Response body when ServicioAndroid is unreachable
differences.lan: The SqlException from cnn.Open escapes. SetPedido catch (OrderMethods.cs:728-731) sets the response to "" (:732). The controller returns Ok(""), HTTP 200. The log line is Logger.SetOrder("Error ", ex.Message).
differences.sap: HTTP 200 with body "Error, Error en SetOrder: Error en obtenerConexionAndroidAsync: <SqlException message>" (ConexionSQL.cs:127; OrderMethods.cs:1953; OrderController.cs:46). The full exception is logged to sap.log as [ORDER NEW ERROR].
differences.evidence: LAN CreditMethods.cs:119, OrderMethods.cs:574, :728-732, OrdersController.cs:151-160. SS SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.cs:160, ConexionSQL.cs:124-127, OrderMethods.cs:761-765, :1950-1953, OrderController.cs:37-46. Runbook §17.2 says InsertarSolicitudAsync has no try/catch and errors propagate. §17.3 says CrearSolicitudCreditoAsync no longer swallows the error. §20.1 acknowledges the 200 "Error, ...". Magento's tolerance of the new body is still an open question (§19.2 #1, §18.8 Magento row).
differences.decision_ref: §17.2, §17.3 (CrearSolicitudCreditoAsync propagates errors); §20.1
differences.concrete_case: Existing customer with credit and no validated phone, mavicbosandroid down. LAN setOrder returns "". ServicioSAP order/new returns "Error, Error en SetOrder: Error en obtenerConexionAndroidAsync: A network-related or instance-specific error...". Neither writes a header, lines or a promoter burn.

differences.what: HTTP status Magento sees for this failure, end to end through the DMZ: 500 in legacy, 200 now
differences.lan: Legacy chain Magento -> DMZ -> LAN: LAN "" hit the DMZ check `string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(response)` and got HTTP 500 {"error":"LAN retornó vacío","incrementId":...}. This was introduced in DMZ commit 950106a (2026-04-08) and active until commit 686699e (2026-06-26).
differences.sap: Current chain Magento -> DMZ -> ServicioSAP: the DMZ forwards the body (OrdersController.cs:196). DeserializeObject fails on "Error, ..." and it returns Ok(responseSAP), HTTP 200 with "Error, ..." (:214-227). The legacy empty-response check is commented out (:145-150).
differences.evidence: DMZ Controllers/OrdersController.cs:132-183 (commented legacy), :191-227. `git show 686699e^:WebApiMagento/Controllers/OrdersController.cs` lines 137-143 show the active 500. SS OrderController.cs:39-43 claims parity because LAN returned 200 and the DMZ forwards as-is. That holds for the LAN controller but not for the legacy DMZ, which mapped "" (and any response not starting with "C") to 500. No runbook decision covers this. How Magento reacts to 200 versus 500 here: NO EVIDENCE in the share. The SS comment says a non-200 stops Magento's credit polling.
differences.concrete_case: mavicbosandroid down during a credit checkout. Before migration Magento got HTTP 500 {"error":"LAN retornó vacío"}. Now it gets HTTP 200 "Error, Error en SetOrder: Error en obtenerConexionAndroidAsync: ...". If Magento treats any 200 as accepted, it may poll for a credit application that was never created (Magento behaviour: NO EVIDENCE).

differences.what: Which error wins when Android is down and another check also fails (order of checks)
differences.lan: cnn.Open runs first (:119), so the answer is "" whatever the customer's state. checkCliente, checkSaldo and getClientInfo never run.
differences.sap: All SAP checks run before any Android write connection: guest check (OM:675-676), CheckClientCreditAsync (:679-684), BP05MA, A_GET_TelefonoValidado (SCW:385), CteTelSet and catalog. Their errors win over the Android error.
differences.evidence: LAN CreditMethods.cs:117-126. SS OrderMethods.cs:675-694, SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.cs:25-32, :381-400. No runbook decision on precedence. It follows from the per-statement pattern.
differences.concrete_case: Android down and account C01575835 (not a BP in SAP). LAN returns "". ServicioSAP returns "Error, Error en SetOrder: El cliente BP C01575835 no tiene crédito activo en SAP." Similarly, Android down with URL_BP_API invalid: ServicioSAP reports the A_GET_TelefonoValidado error rather than the Android one.

differences.what: Different Android failure point, plus an extra log line, depending on customer data
differences.lan: Always fails at the single cnn.Open (:119), with one log line from SetPedido (:730).
differences.sap: If the customer has a validated phone (ConstruirContextoAsync continues past :387-390), the first failing Android open is ObtenerTelefonoAValidarAsync (SCW:336). It logs "[CREDIT ObtenerTelefonoAValidar ERROR]" (SCW:361-365) before the final [ORDER NEW ERROR]. Otherwise it fails at InsertarSolicitudAsync (SCW:160). The final body is the same.
differences.evidence: SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.cs:336, :361-366, :387-397. Runbook §18.5 (after the table) and §17.4 list this log, which LAN lacks, as pending and not decided.
differences.concrete_case: Android down, BP whose A_GET_TelefonoValidado returns ZvalTel=1. sap.log gets two error entries and the response is "Error, ... obtenerConexionAndroidAsync ...". LAN logs one "Error " line and returns "".

differences.what: Asymmetry inside LAN (open failure versus statement failure) that ServicioSAP collapses into one outcome
differences.lan: Android open failure returns "". Android failure after a successful open (SP error, deadlock, permission) is caught by the inner catch, which returns "err" (:246-252). SetPedido ignores it and returns the account (:649), HTTP 200.
differences.sap: Both cases produce HTTP 200 "Error, ...", because InsertarSolicitudAsync has no catch (SCW:157-227).
differences.evidence: LAN CreditMethods.cs:135, :190, :246-252, OrderMethods.cs:624-649. SS SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.cs:223, OrderController.cs:46. Runbook §17.2 and §17.3 (errors propagate). Decision 13 in §18.3 (insert as received; if a width breaks, we find out). This is also covered by the error-propagation pairs.
differences.concrete_case: Android reachable but the INSERT raises an error (for example insufficient INSERT permission for usrintranet). LAN returns "C0xxxxxx" and the order looks successful. ServicioSAP returns "Error, Error en SetOrder: ...".

differences.what: Logging of the swallowed SMS lookup when Android is down
differences.lan: ObtenerNumeroTablaSms catches, calls Logger.SetOrder("Error ObtenerNumeroSms() => ", msg) (OrderMethods.cs:847-850, a persisted file) and returns "".
differences.sap: ObtenerNumeroTablaSmsAsync catches, calls Console.WriteLine only (OrderMethods.cs:608-611, not persisted under IIS) and returns "".
differences.evidence: LAN OrderMethods.cs:819-852. SS OrderMethods.cs:589-613. §20.1 #8 aligned only the query, not the logging.
differences.concrete_case: Android down: both continue with numeroDelSms = "". LAN leaves a trace in setOrder.log. ServicioSAP leaves none for this call.

differences.what: Where the connection configuration comes from, and SQL session metadata
differences.lan: Connection string hardcoded (Conn/Connection.cs:28). Default ApplicationName.
differences.sap: Read from Web.config:13 MAVICBOSANDROID. ApplicationName is set to the calling assembly name (ConexionSQL.cs:114-115; runtime value NO EVIDENCE). There is an extra failure mode if the entry is missing: "No se encontró la cadena de conexión MAVICBOSANDROID en el Web.config." (:107-108), which surfaces as "Error, ...".
differences.evidence: LAN Connection.cs:28. SS Web.config:13, ConexionSQL.cs:106-119. Runbook §18.4 confirms the same server and database. §2 item 3 prescribes this helper.
differences.concrete_case: Web.config without MAVICBOSANDROID: every credit order returns "Error, Error en SetOrder: Error en obtenerConexionAndroidAsync: No se encontró la cadena...". This is configuration only; LAN has no equivalent failure.

comparisons.question_for_user: When ServicioAndroid is unreachable, the legacy chain returned HTTP 500 {"error":"LAN retornó vacío","incrementId":...} to Magento. LAN itself answered "", and the DMZ check added in commit 950106a turned that into a 500. That check was commented out on 2026-06-26 in commit 686699e. Now Magento receives HTTP 200 "Error, Error en SetOrder: Error en obtenerConexionAndroidAsync: ...". The comment at ServicioSAP OrderController.cs:39-43 justifies the 200 by saying the DMZ forwarded as-is, but the legacy DMZ did not do that for an empty or non-"C" response. Do you accept the 200 "Error, ..." for this case, or should the DMZ (or ServicioSAP) return a 5xx so Magento treats the order as failed, as it did before migration? A second, lower-priority question: do you care that ServicioSAP now reports SAP-side errors (for example "no tiene crédito activo") ahead of an Android outage, while LAN always failed on the Android open first?

comparisons.name: Split order phone into lada/number (particular/celular)
comparisons.lan_source: Magento payload infoCliente["telefono"] -> ToArray index [21] (LAN Metodos/OrderMethods.cs:414, digits-only via ValidateOnlyNumbers :442-452) -> CreditMethods.ProductosCreditoWeb_SaveData (CreditMethods.cs:113, :139-143) -> SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS @Op='Insert' params @lada_particular INT, @telefono_particular VARCHAR(10), @lada_celular INT, @telefono_celular VARCHAR(10) (SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS.sql:120-123) -> columns ladaParticular/telefonoParticular/ladaCelular/telefonoCelular of ServicioAndroid.CRED_SOLICITUD_WEB_DATOS_TEMP (SP:250-253, :311-314). No SQL read or SP involved in the split itself.
comparisons.lan_detail: Input: sDatosPedido[21] = ValidateOnlyNumbers(order.infoCliente["telefono"]) (LAN OrderMethods.cs:414). Index verified by counting ToArray :344-414 (0 incrementId ... 20 estado, 21 telefono), which matches PLAN §18.2. ValidateOnlyNumbers joins the matches of "[0-9]+" (:442-452). CreditMethods.cs:113 strips non-digits from datosped[21] again, which changes nothing. The split is at CreditMethods.cs:139-143, inside the try that opens at :135. It runs after getClientInfo (:137, a read-only SQL call) and before the ladaValidar split (:145-148). ladaDeDos = {"33","55","81"}. ladaLength = 2 if Substring(0,2) is in the list, otherwise 3 (:141). ladaTel = Substring(0,ladaLength) and telNum = Substring(ladaLength) (:142-143). The same ladaTel/telNum go to both particular and celular (:179-182). The lada is sent as SqlDbType.VarChar and the SP converts it implicitly to INT (SP:120, :122), so "013" is stored as 13. The number is sent as VarChar with no Size, and the SP parameter VARCHAR(10) cuts it silently to 10 characters (SP:121, :123). No length guard. If the phone has fewer than 2 digits, Substring(0,2) at :141 throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException. If it has 2 digits and the prefix is not 33/55/81, Substring(0,3) at :142 throws. The catch at :246-252 writes Logger.Credit("ERROR ", ex.Message) to C:\inetpub\wwwroot\log\credit.log (Helper/Logger.cs:79-86) and returns "err". Nothing is written: no SP call, no CreditoWeb_InsertArticulo, no CodigoPromocion 'Elimina', no liberador thread (:190-241 skipped). The caller discards the return value (OrderMethods.cs:624) and returns order.infoCliente["cuenta"] (:649). OrdersController.Set returns Ok(cuenta) with HTTP 200 (Controllers/OrdersController.cs:150, :159). The guide was already saved before the branch (OrderMethods.cs:606). Exactly 2 digits with a listed prefix (e.g. "33") does not throw: lada 33 and number "" are inserted. The DMZ forwards the body unchanged (DMZ Controllers/OrdersController.cs:196).
comparisons.sap_source: Magento payload OrderRequest.infoCliente.telefono (string, Models/SAP/Order/InfoClienteRequest.cs:11) -> OrderMethods.CrearSolicitudCreditoAsync (Methods/Order/OrderMethods.cs:795-801, :831-834) -> SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.InsertAsync/ArmarFila (Methods/Credit/SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.cs:262-265) -> direct parameterized INSERT into ServicioAndroid.CRED_SOLICITUD_WEB_DATOS_TEMP (SCW:62-65, :122-125, :189-192). No OData or HTTP API is involved in this step: the source is the same payload field as LAN, so the source is equivalent.
comparisons.sap_detail: The phone is re-derived from info.telefono, not from datosArray[21], but both are the same value: ToArray OM:273 also does ValidateOnlyNumbers(order.infoCliente?.telefono ?? "") at index 21. telefonoPedido = ValidateOnlyNumbers(info.telefono ?? "") (OM:796). ValidateOnlyNumbers (OM:318-322) returns "" for null or whitespace, otherwise Regex.Replace "[^0-9]" -> "", which matches LAN's output for any non-null input. info is order.infoCliente ?? new InfoClienteRequest() (OM:789). Same list {33,55,81} (OM:795). largoLada = 2 if Length >= 2 and the prefix is listed, otherwise 3 (OM:797). Guards: ladaPedido = Length >= largoLada ? Substring(0,largoLada) : "" and numeroPedido = the same guard ? Substring(largoLada) : "" (OM:798-799). int.TryParse(ladaPedido) ignores the bool result, so "" becomes 0 and "013" becomes 13 (OM:800-801). LadaParticular = LadaCelular = ladaPedidoNumero (int) and TelefonoParticular = TelefonoCelular = numeroPedido (OM:831-834). These are copied unchanged in ArmarFila (SCW:262-265) and bound as SqlDbType.Int (lada) and SqlDbType.VarChar with no Size (number) (SCW:189-192). Nulo() only maps null, so 0 and "" are written as 0 and '' (SCW:307-310). Nothing in this step can throw. For a too-short phone the row IS inserted with lada 0 and number ''. InsertCreditArticlesAsync, the promo coupon 'Elimina' (OM:703-709) and the return of cuenta follow (OM:759). SetOrderAsync returns Resultado="Concluido", Zctefinal=cuenta (OM:1800-1807), and OrderController returns Ok({BP, SalesDocument, Message, Resultado}) with 200 (Controllers/OrderController.cs:26-34). No log line. For a phone of 3 or more digits (all real payloads: "8888888888" -> 888/8888888, "3123213213" -> 312/3213213, magento_payloads.md:26, :55) the four stored values match LAN exactly.

differences.what: A phone shorter than its lada creates a credit application in ServicioSAP; LAN aborted with 'err' and wrote nothing.
differences.lan: Substring throws at CreditMethods.cs:141 (fewer than 2 digits) or :142 (2 digits, prefix not 33/55/81). The catch at :246-252 logs 'ERROR <msg>' to credit.log and returns 'err'. No CRED_SOLICITUD_WEB_DATOS_TEMP row, no VTASdArtCreditoWeb lines, coupon not burned, no liberador or callback. The caller ignores 'err' (OrderMethods.cs:624) and Magento gets the account string with 200 (OrderMethods.cs:649; OrdersController.cs:159).
differences.sap: Guards at OM:797-799 give lada '' / number ''. TryParse gives 0 (OM:800-801). The row is inserted with ladaParticular=0, telefonoParticular='', ladaCelular=0, telefonoCelular='' (OM:831-834 -> SCW:262-265 -> SCW:189-192). Lines are inserted and the coupon is burned (OM:703-709). Response is Resultado 'Concluido' with BP=cuenta (OM:1802-1807; OC:26-34). Nothing is logged.

If it is narrower, error 8152/2628 is raised and not caught (SCW:223 -> OM:842 -> rethrow OM:761-765 -> SetOrderAsync wrap), and Magento gets Ok('Error, Error en SetOrder: ...') (OC:37-46) with no row. Column width: NO EVIDENCE (no DDL of CRED_SOLICITUD_WEB_DATOS_TEMP in the share; the SP changelog at SP:88 only says the phones went from bigint to varchar(10)).

comparisons.question_for_user: LAN never created a credit application when the delivery phone was shorter than its lada: 0-1 digits, or 2 digits whose prefix is not 33/55/81 (for example "12", "5", empty, or null). It still answered Magento with the account. ServicioSAP inserts the application with lada 0 and number ''. (1) Do you confirm the parity fix? In CrearSolicitudCreditoAsync (OM:797-801) the code would throw instead of defaulting, so there is no row, no lines and no coupon burn. With your decision that CrearSolicitudCreditoAsync propagates errors, Magento would then receive 'Error, ...' instead of the account. Is that acceptable, or should the response stay the account like LAN? (2) Does Magento enforce a 10-digit phone at checkout? If it does, this difference is only theoretical: every real payload in magento_payloads.md has 10 digits.

comparisons.name: Call into the credit application (argument marshalling)
comparisons.lan_source: Arguments are built in memory from OrderRequest (Dictionary infoCliente) plus sDatosPedido from ToArray. They go into CreditMethods.ProductosCreditoWeb_SaveData, which calls SpCREDIDatosSolicitudCreditoArt (CheckCliente/GetSaldo/GetInfo, Intelisis), SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS @Op='Insert' (ServicioAndroid), SpVTASInsertArtSolCreditoLinea (@Cp) and SpVTASVentaCupon, then starts the Liberador thread.
comparisons.lan_detail:
Abbreviations: LAN OM = //172.16.214.58/sap/LAN/WebApiMagento/Metodos/OrderMethods.cs, LAN CM = .../Metodos/CreditMethods.cs.

1. Branch entry is LAN OM:609 (metodoPago == "omnipro_pago_credito"). The articulos list is built at OM:611-617 as "cantidad,sku" per item. It adds "costoEnvio,SEGU00001" when costoEnvio (a string) is neither "0" nor "".
2. The phone inputs are read at OM:619-621: numeroDelSms, numeroValidado and isValidated = (validado == sms).
3. The call itself is at OM:623-647, positional against the CM:94-98 signature:
   - data[0] = infoCliente["cuenta"] (KeyNotFound if the key is missing)
   - data[1] = storeId == "viu" ? "2" : "1" (exact, case-sensitive)
   - data[2] = incrementId
   - data[3] = correo
   - data[4] = total (string)
   - data[5] = articulos[0]["condicion"]
   - data[6] = codigo_promotor if the key exists, else ""
   - articulos array; datosped = sDatosPedido (ToArray OM:340-440: [14] direccion, [15] numExt, [16] numInt, [17] codigoPostal, [18] municipio, [19] colonia, [20] estado, [21] ValidateOnlyNumbers(telefono) at OM:414, [31] metodoEnvio at OM:424)
   - utmSource, sucursalDestino (int), cp = infoCliente["codigoPostal"], RedimirMonedero (float)
   - entreCalles if the key exists, else ""
   - numeroDelSms = sms.Length > 0 ? sms : validado (OM:642)
   - isValidated; OrigenIdMagento if the key exists, else ""
   - entityId
   - origen if the key exists, else "PRODUCTOS MX" (OM:646)
4. SaveData initialisation (CM:107-113): res = "", IdSolicitud = "", uen = int.Parse(data[1]), condicion = data[5] with no translation, and datosped[21] is stripped to digits again in place. CM:113 runs outside any try.
5. Inside SaveData:
   - checkCliente(data[0]) at CM:124 (CTE count). If false it returns "sin cuenta" (CM:255-258).
   - decimal.Parse(data[4]) > checkSaldo at CM:126-133, outside the try.
   - Inside the try (CM:135-252):
     - Phone split with Substring at CM:139-148, no length guard.
     - SP parameters at CM:150-188: @uen = uen, @sucursal = uen == 2 ? 505 : 504, @origen = origen, @idMagento = data[2], @MetodoEnvio = datosped[31], @LadaValidar passed as VarChar to an SP INT parameter, @ValidacionTelefono computed (the SP overwrites it at SP:210-221).
     - Lines with cp (CM:201), promoter (CM:203-206), Liberador thread when data[0] starts with "C" (CM:208-241).
     - Any exception returns "err" (CM:246-252).
6. The SP parameter declarations (SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS.sql:94-159) silently truncate to their widths.
7. Return value: SaveData's result ("OK" / "insuficiente" / "err" / "sin cuenta") is DISCARDED. SetPedido returns infoCliente["cuenta"] (OM:649). If something throws outside SaveData's try, the SetPedido catch returns "" (OM:728-732). The controller answers Ok(string) with HTTP 200 (LAN OrdersController.cs:151,160; exceptions at :156).
8. Before the branch, LAN also runs detallePedido Limpiar/Insertar and SaveGuide for credit orders (OM:582-606). Those belong to other steps.
comparisons.sap_source: In-memory OrderRequest (typed InfoClienteRequest / ArticuloRequest) goes to ProcessCreditPaymentAsync. It calls BusinessPartnerMethods.GetClientAsync (ZB_DATOS_CLIENTE_CDS) as the existence check. SolicitudCreditoInsertRequest is then passed to SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.InsertAsync, which uses BP05MA master data, A_GET_TelefonoValidado, CteTelSet, the AWS CatalogoConfiguracion and the ServicioAndroid SMS table, and does a direct INSERT into CRED_SOLICITUD_WEB_DATOS_TEMP. After that come InsertCreditArticlesAsync (SD29, VTASdArtCreditoWeb) and HandlePromoCodeAsync (VentasCupones). The response goes back as OrderResponse, then the controller's anonymous object, then the DMZ.
comparisons.sap_detail:
Abbreviations: SS OM = //172.16.214.58/sap/ServicioSAP/ServicioSap/ServicioSap/Methods/Order/OrderMethods.cs, SCW = .../Methods/Credit/SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.cs.

1. The credit branch is SS OM:1785-1808. SaveGuideAsync runs first (OM:1787).
2. articulos is built as "cantidad,sku" at OM:1789-1793. SEGU00001 is added only when costoEnvio (decimal) > 0, formatted with InvariantCulture (OM:1794-1795).
3. sms and validado are read with sDatosPedido[36] = infoCliente.cuenta ?? "" (ToArray OM:288) at OM:1797-1798.
4. ProcessCreditPaymentAsync(orderRequest, articulos, numeroValidado, numeroDelSms) is called at OM:1800. Parameter order matches the OM:665 signature.
5. Inside ProcessCreditPaymentAsync (OM:665-766), data is read directly from order/infoCliente, not from sDatosPedido:
   - cuentaBp = cuenta ?? "", idClienteMagento = cliente ?? "" (OM:669-673).
   - Guest throws (OM:675-676). A non-new client that fails CheckClientCreditAsync (a BP-existence check; any exception counts as false) throws (OM:679-684).
   - telAux = IsNullOrWhiteSpace-chained sms, then validado, then ValidateOnlyNumbers(telefono ?? "0"), with length guards that default to "0" (OM:687-691).
   - CrearSolicitudCreditoAsync (OM:694). idSolicitud <= 0 throws (OM:695-696).
   - Lines, then promoter inside a try whose errors are logged and swallowed (OM:699-717). codigoPostal is passed but never read inside InsertCreditArticlesAsync (OM:857-1023).
   - The Liberador/callback block is commented out (OM:720-757).
   - Returns esClienteNuevo ? idClienteMagento : cuentaBp (OM:759). Everything else is rethrown (OM:761-765).
6. CrearSolicitudCreditoAsync (OM:787-843):
   - uen = storeId?.ToUpper() == "VIU" ? 2 : 1 (OM:790), so it is case-insensitive.
   - lada = int.TryParse(ladaValidar) with the result not checked (OM:792-793).
   - The particular/mobile phone comes from ValidateOnlyNumbers(info.telefono ?? "") with guards (OM:796-801).
   - Request fields are `?? ""` from info/order (OM:803-840): Sucursal 504/505, Origen fixed "PRODUCTOS MX" (OM:828; InfoClienteRequest has no `origen` property), IdMagento = incrementId ?? "0" (OM:829), no isValidated and no total.
7. InsertAsync (SCW:18-33):
   - ArmarFila (SCW:229-305) replaces names, RFC, sex, birth date and cliente with BP05MA data when a master record exists. EntreCalles falls back to ZentCalles (SCW:245).
   - Parameters have no Size (SCW:163-221), so values go in as they arrived.
8. Return: SetOrderAsync returns OrderResponse{Resultado = "Concluido", Zctefinal = cuentaCredito} (OM:1802-1807). Errors are wrapped as "Error en SetOrder: ..." (OM:1950-1953).
9. The controller answers Ok({BP, SalesDocument, Message, Resultado}), or Ok("Error, " + msg) with HTTP 200 (Controllers/OrderController.cs:27-35, 46). The DMZ deserialises the body and forwards it (DMZ Controllers/OrdersController.cs:196, 214-227).

differences.what: UEN / sucursal derivation from storeId is case-insensitive in ServicioSAP, exact in LAN
differences.lan: order.storeId == "viu" ? "2" : "1" (LAN OM:628). int.Parse at CM:109. @sucursal = uen==2 ? 505 : 504 (CM:175). Liberador capturedUen = uen (CM:213)

ServicioSAP returns "Error, Error en SetOrder: El cliente BP C01575835 no tiene crédito activo en SAP." and writes nothing. This happens on every real payload until Magento sends a BP

differences.lan: telAux.Substring(0,2) / Substring(0,ladaLength) with no length guard (CM:139-148), inside the try. The exception returns "err" (discarded): no row, no lines, no promoter burn, no Liberador; body = account
differences.sap: Guards at OM:689-691 and OM:797-801: LadaParticular/LadaCelular = 0, TelefonoParticular/TelefonoCelular = "", LadaValidar = 0, TelefonoValidar = "0". The row and lines are inserted and the response is Concluido

ServicioSAP: row with ladaParticular 0, telefonoParticular '', LadaValidar 0, TelefonoValidar '0'. The same applies when numeroValidado = "5" and the SMS is empty

comparisons.name: Client-side @ValidacionTelefono + IsInTableStd (overwritten by SP)
comparisons.lan_source: C#: //172.16.214.58/sap/LAN/WebApiMagento/Metodos/CreditMethods.cs:185 (parameter expression) -> CreditMethods.IsInTableStd :1967-1989 (inline SELECT TablaStD JOIN CteTel on IntelisisTmp via Connection.sCadenaConexion, Conn/Connection.cs:26). Input isValidated built in Metodos/OrderMethods.cs:619-621 from ObtenerNumeroTablaSms (:819-845, Android TcAAEA00030_EnvioMensajes) and IsValidated (:786-817, IntelisisTmp CteTel). The value goes to SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS @ValidacionTelefono BIT (SPsOrden/SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS.sql:153), which the @Op='Insert' branch always overwrites at :210-221 before the INSERT (:276 column, :337 value).
comparisons.lan_detail:
1) Caller, LAN OrderMethods.cs:619-621: numeroDelSms = ObtenerNumeroTablaSms(cuenta) (Android: SELECT TOP 1 Telefono FROM TcAAEA00030_EnvioMensajes WHERE IdRegistro IN (SELECT IdCodigoVerificacioneCommerce FROM VTASDCodigoVerificacioneCommerce WHERE Cliente='{0}') ORDER BY Id DESC, :827-830). numeroValidado = IsValidated(cuenta) (IntelisisTmp: SELECT TOP 1 CONCAT(Lada,Telefono) FROM CteTel WHERE Cliente='{0}' AND Tipo='Movil' AND ValidacionTel=1 ORDER BY Fecha DESC, :794-795; returns "" on error, :812-816). isValidated = (numeroValidado == numeroDelSms), which is also true when both are "". It is passed as a positional argument at :643.
2) CreditMethods.cs:185: @ValidacionTelefono (SqlDbType.Bit) = ((!isValidated) || !IsInTableStd(datosCliente[0])) ? 1 : 0. `||` binds tighter than `?:`, and it short-circuits, so IsInTableStd runs only when isValidated == true. Truth table: isValidated=false -> 1 with no DB call; true + in table -> 0; true + not in table or exception -> 1. datosCliente[0] is cte.Cliente from SpCREDIDatosSolicitudCreditoArt @Op=GetInfo (:831).
3) IsInTableStd :1967-1989: new SqlConnection(sCadenaConexion = MAVICUBOS/IntelisisTmp). string.Format query at :1974-1976: SELECT TOP 1 rtrim(ltrim(tsdt.Nombre)) FROM tablastd JOIN ctetel ON rtrim(ltrim(ct.AppOrigen))=rtrim(ltrim(tsdt.Nombre)) WHERE ct.Cliente='{0}' AND tsdt.TablaSt='ORIGEN VALIDACION NUMERO CTE' AND ct.validacionTel=1. CommandTimeout 99999 (:1978), no Connect Timeout in the string (default applies). It returns dr.HasRows (:1981). Every exception is caught, logs "ERROR IsPhoneValidated() => msg" via Logger.CustomerService (:1986) and returns false. It can never throw to the caller.
4) SP overwrite: in SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS.sql, @Op='Insert' (:172-349) runs the same TablaStD JOIN CteTel lookup itself (:186-191), plus CteTel Movil (:194-202) and the SMS table (:205-208). The IF/ELSE at :210-221 then assigns @ValidacionTelefono on both branches. Both are SELECT assignments with no FROM, so the assignment always happens. Between :153 and :337 the SP never reads the incoming value. The SP change log at :71-78 (2023) records this logic moving into the SP, which made the C# value dead.
5) Observable result of the step:
- Written column: none. CRED_SOLICITUD_WEB_DATOS_TEMP.ValidacionTelefono always gets the SP-computed value.
- Return value: none. ProductosCreditoWeb_SaveData returns res regardless, and setOrder discards it and returns cuenta (OrderMethods.cs:624, :649).
- Failure: cannot fail.
- Only side effects: one extra SELECT round-trip to IntelisisTmp (latency) and, on error, one CustomerService log line.
OUT-OF-STEP NOTE: IsInTableStd also has two other callers. CreditMethods.cs:1802 is GetPhoneValidatedClientSecretName (route credit/GetPhoneValidatedClientSecretName, LAN Controllers/CreditController.cs:541-545, forwarded by DMZ Controllers/CreditController.cs:290-296); there it IS observable, as is_phone_validated. The other is CredyPrestamoMethods.cs:562 (Credilana, out of scope).
comparisons.sap_source: NONE for this step (removed by design). The column is produced only by the port of the SP overwrite (a different step). That port uses: URL_BP_API /A_GET_TelefonoValidado (SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.cs:476-519), ZQBP_EDITARCLIENTE_SRV/CteTelSet (:402-441), the AWS AI_GET_CatalogoConfiguracion catalog 'ORIGEN VALIDACION NUMERO CTE' through ProductMethods.GetConfiguracionCatalogoAsync (:521-530, :544), and SQL Android TcAAEA00030_EnvioMensajes (:330-367). The only remnant of the IsInTableStd idea is a ZappOrig filter inside OrderMethods.IsValidatedAsync (:645-651), which reads ZAPI_BP05MA_SRV to_CteTel through GetClientMaAsync (:636).
comparisons.sap_detail:
ServicioSAP (//172.16.214.58/sap/ServicioSAP/ServicioSap/ServicioSap, current working tree) has no client-side precomputation of ValidacionTelefono and no isValidated:
- SetOrder credit branch (Methods/Order/OrderMethods.cs:1785-1808) gets numeroDelSms (:1797) and numeroValidado (:1798), but never compares them. ProcessCreditPaymentAsync(order, articulos, numeroValidado, numeroDelSms) (:665) has no isValidated parameter, and it uses both strings only to build ladaValidar/telefonoValidar (:688-691).
- CrearSolicitudCreditoAsync (:787-843) builds SolicitudCreditoInsertRequest with no ValidacionTelefono. The model has no such property (Models/SAP/Credit/SolicitudCreditoWebModels.cs:21-134), so no caller can inject a value.
- The column value is computed only inside SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.InsertAsync (:27-28): ConstruirContextoAsync (:381-400) -> ResolverValidacionTelefono (:312-328, the three-valued port of SP:210-221) -> ArmarFila fila.ValidacionTelefono = validacionTelefono != 0 (:295) -> bound as @ValidacionTelefono Bit (:215). So the SAP row is built the same way as LAN's effective row: the overwrite's result, never a caller-supplied value.
- A grep for IsInTableStd / isValidated / HasValidPhoneOriginSAPAsync in the ServicioSAP .cs files (excluding bin/obj) finds nothing, apart from the private IsValidatedAsync method and a comment at OrderMethods.cs:645. This matches PLAN §17.3.
- DMZ (//172.16.214.58/sap/DMZ/WebApiMagento) has no isValidated, IsInTableStd or ValidacionTelefono code either.
- Remnant: IsValidatedAsync (OrderMethods.cs:631-660) filters to_CteTel with t.Zvaltel && !IsNullOrWhiteSpace(t.ZappOrig) && !IsNullOrWhiteSpace(t.ZtelCte) && ZtipoCte=='MOVIL' and takes FirstOrDefault. The comment at :645 says 'IsInTableStd -> ZappOrig con origen registrado'. This changes numeroValidado, and through it the LadaValidar/TelefonoValidar columns (see differences).
CROSS-STEP OBSERVATION (does not belong to this step; reported for the @TelefonoValidado recompute step): in the reference repo, businesspartner-dev/apps/api/routes/A_GET_TelefonoValidado.py:17-35 filters CteTelSet only by Partner. It returns max() over ALL phones by (Zfecha, ZfechaCap, ZidcteTel) with that phone's Zvaltel. It does NOT apply Tipo='Movil' or ValidacionTel=1, contrary to PLAN §15.1. NO EVIDENCE for what the deployed version does (PLAN §18.8 asks the API owner).

differences.what: LAN computes a client-side @ValidacionTelefono (isValidated = numeroValidado == numeroDelSms, plus IsInTableStd) and sends it to the SP. ServicioSAP computes and sends nothing. The only value it writes is the one recomputed in InsertAsync, the equivalent of the SP overwrite.
differences.lan: CreditMethods.cs:185 sends 1/0 from (!isValidated || !IsInTableStd(datosCliente[0])); isValidated comes from OrderMethods.cs:619-621,643
differences.sap: No equivalent: the request model has no ValidacionTelefono (SolicitudCreditoWebModels.cs:21-134); the column comes only from ResolverValidacionTelefono (SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.cs:27-28, :295, :215)
differences.evidence: SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS.sql:210-221 assigns @ValidacionTelefono on both IF/ELSE branches before the INSERT (:276, :337); the incoming value is never read (only :153, :216, :220, :337 mention it). Runbook decisions: PLAN §9.1 point 3 ('@ValidacionTelefono ... el SP lo PISA siempre, es salida'), §10.2 table, §11.3 Block 3 note (irrelevant because the SP overwrites it), §17.3 (isValidated removed, HasValidPhoneOriginSAPAsync removed).
differences.concrete_case: Client with a validated MOVIL 3312345678 whose AppOrigen is in TablaStD, last SMS for the client 3312345678, but numeroDelSms (IdRegistro IN VTASDCodigoVerificacioneCommerce) returns 5598765432. LAN: isValidated=false, so the client side sends 1 and IsInTableStd is not called; the SP recomputes 0 and the column stores 0. ServicioSAP: sends nothing, ResolverValidacionTelefono returns 0, and the column stores 0. The stored value and the caller's result are the same, so this difference cannot be observed.

differences.what: LAN IsInTableStd side effects: an extra round-trip to IntelisisTmp (CommandTimeout 99999, default connect timeout), and on any error a 'ERROR IsPhoneValidated() =>' line in the CustomerService log. ServicioSAP makes no such call and writes no such log.
differences.lan: When isValidated==true: opens a connection to MAVICUBOS/IntelisisTmp and runs a SELECT built with string.Format; exceptions are swallowed and return false (CreditMethods.cs:1970-1988)
differences.sap: No call and no log. The same TablaStD/CteTel lookup exists only inside the SP-recompute port (CteTelSet + catalog), which runs only when a validated phone exists (SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.cs:387-397)
differences.evidence: CreditMethods.cs:1972 (sCadenaConexion), :1974-1976 (query), :1978 (timeout 99999), :1984-1988 (catch, log, false). Conn/Connection.cs:26 (IntelisisTmp; the string sets no Connect Timeout). The removal follows from the same decisions as the first difference. It also drops a string.Format SQL-injection surface (low risk: the value is cte.Cliente from the DB, CreditMethods.cs:831).
differences.concrete_case: IntelisisTmp unreachable and isValidated==true (for example, a client with no validated phone and no SMS, so both strings are ""). LAN blocks for the connection timeout (ADO.NET default, about 15 s: NO EVIDENCE of another value), writes 'ERROR IsPhoneValidated() => ...' to the CustomerService log, and continues to the SP. ServicioSAP has no such wait or log line. Only latency and logs differ; the row and the response do not.

differences.what: The IsInTableStd idea was folded into ServicioSAP's IsValidatedAsync as an extra filter, !IsNullOrWhiteSpace(ZappOrig). LAN IsValidated has no origin filter, and LAN's IsInTableStd never affected LadaValidar/TelefonoValidar. The SAP filter also does not match IsInTableStd itself: it checks 'ZappOrig not empty', not 'ZappOrig in catalog ORIGEN VALIDACION NUMERO CTE'. It uses FirstOrDefault instead of ORDER BY Fecha DESC.
differences.lan: IsValidated returns the latest (ORDER BY Fecha DESC) Movil phone with ValidacionTel=1, with no AppOrigen condition (OrderMethods.cs:794-795); that value becomes the telAux fallback (OrderMethods.cs:642, CreditMethods.cs:145-148), and from it LadaValidar/TelefonoValidar

differences.evidence: ServicioSAP OrderMethods.cs:645 comment 'IsInTableStd -> ZappOrig con origen registrado', :649 filter. LAN OrderMethods.cs:786-817 has no such filter. BPs created by ServicioSAP write ZappOrig="" and ZvalTel=false (OrderMethods.cs:2853, BusinessPartnerMethods.cs:666). The runbook lists this as pending, not decided: PLAN §17.4 bullet 2 and §18.5 #9 ('IsValidatedAsync filtra por ZappOrig ... Decision del usuario').
differences.decision_ref: PENDING: PLAN §17.4 (2nd bullet), §18.5 #9. No decision recorded.
differences.concrete_case: BP whose only phone is MOVIL 3312345678 with Zvaltel=true and ZappOrig='' (for example, created from an ecommerce order, which writes ZappOrig="", and validated later). The client has no SMS row, and the order has infoCliente.telefono='5598765432'. LAN: numeroValidado='3312345678', so the row gets LadaValidar=33 and TelefonoValidar='12345678'. ServicioSAP: numeroValidado='', so it falls back to the order phone and writes LadaValidar=55 and TelefonoValidar='98765432'.

comparisons.question_for_user: 1) IsValidatedAsync (ServicioSAP OrderMethods.cs:645-651) keeps an IsInTableStd-inspired filter, !IsNullOrWhiteSpace(ZappOrig), that LAN IsValidated does not have. It changes LadaValidar/TelefonoValidar whenever there is no SMS row. Should it be removed, to match LAN IsValidated literally, or kept? This is the open item in PLAN §17.4 / §18.5 #9. 2) credit/GetPhoneValidatedClientSecretName uses IsInTableStd with a visible effect (is_phone_validated), is exposed by the DMZ, and has no ServicioSAP counterpart.
