comparisons.name: Customer master lookup (CTE GetInfo vs BP05MA)
comparisons.lan_source: IntelisisTmp.dbo.CTE through SpCREDIDatosSolicitudCreditoArt @Op='GetInfo', @Val=cuenta (SpCREDIDatosSolicitudCreditoArt.sql:53-78: SELECT TOP 1 of 19 columns FROM CTE WHERE cliente=@Val). It runs on connection sCadenaConexion (LAN Conn/Connection.cs:26, MAVICUBOS / IntelisisTmp). The values are then passed as parameters to SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS @Op='Insert' (SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS.sql:94-130 parameter widths, :285-321 VALUES).
comparisons.lan_detail:
1) Gate: CreditMethods.cs:124 checkCliente(data[0]) runs 'CheckCliente' on the same CTE table (:725-763). If it is false, the method returns "sin cuenta" (:255-258) and GetInfo never runs. data[0] = order.infoCliente["cuenta"] (OrderMethods.cs:627), which is the Intelisis account, e.g. C01575835.
2) Lookup: CreditMethods.cs:137 calls getClientInfo(data[0]) (:804-868). It sets no CommandTimeout, runs ExecuteReader, and builds a List<string> of 19 items by column name (:831-849). FechaNacimiento goes through Convert.ToDateTime(...).ToString("yyyy-MM-dd") (:835). Every other field goes through .ToString(), so NULL becomes "".
3) Null and error handling inside getClientInfo: no rows means an empty list (:852 is skipped, :867). Any exception is caught (:860-865): it logs Logger.Credit("ERRO ") and returns whatever was added so far. A NULL FechaNacimiento throws InvalidCastException at :835, so the list stops at 4 items.
4) Which fields LAN uses: [1] @apellido_p :152, [2] @apellido_m :153, [3] @nombre :154, [4] @fecha_nacimiento as a 'yyyy-MM-dd' string :156, [5] @rfc :157, [6] @sexo :158, [10] @entre_calles only when the Magento entreCalles.Length == 0 (:163), [16] @estado_civil :169, [0] @cliente :173 (and IsInTableStd(datosCliente[0]) :185, which the SP overwrites anyway at SP:210-221). Items [7-9], [11-15], [17] and [18] are read but never used (the address comes from datosped). @vive_en_calidad is not passed, so it is NULL.
5) Widths: the SP parameters silently truncate the master values: @nombre VARCHAR(25), @apellido_p/@apellido_m VARCHAR(30), @rfc VARCHAR(13), @sexo VARCHAR(9), @estado_civil VARCHAR(11), @cliente VARCHAR(9) (SP:94-130). @fecha_nacimiento is DATE (SP:98).
6) Failure path: an empty or partial list makes datosCliente[n] throw ArgumentOutOfRangeException at :152 or :156. The outer catch (:246-252) returns "err". No row is written, no lines are written (:199-201), the promo code is not burned (:203-206) and the Liberador does not run.
7) What the caller returns: OrderMethods.cs:624-647 discards the result and :649 returns order.infoCliente["cuenta"]. OrdersController.cs:150-160 answers Ok(cuenta), HTTP 200. The guide was already saved at OrderMethods.cs:606.
comparisons.sap_source: S/4 OData ZAPI_BP05MA_SRV/BusinessPartnerSet(Partner='{cuenta}',Client='110')?$expand=to_CteTel,to_CteDomicilio,to_CteSociedad,to_CtePersonalAdr,to_CteContacto,to_CteCliente,to_CteDatosComerciales,to_Cte,to_CtePersonaContacto,to_CteDatosBancarios,to_CteFuncInterlocutor,to_CteImpuestos&sap-client=110 (BusinessPartnerMethods.cs:297-340). The fields used replace CTE: Partner, NameLast, NameLst2, NameFirst, Birthdt, Gender, to_CteCliente.Stcd1 and to_Cte.ZentCalles (plus to_Cte.ZtipoCliente for EsProspecto). businesspartner-dev and salesanddistribution-dev have no BP05MA route, so they give NO EVIDENCE either way. Equivalence rests on PLAN §9.2, §12.3 and the real capture in CAPTURAS_REALES_APIS.md:7-70 (Partner 1500004598: NameLast MEDINA, NameFirst ELIZABETH, NameLst2 HERRERA, Gender "9", Xsexu true, Birthdt /Date(11491200000)/ = 1970-05-14, Stcd1 MEHE700514CP7, ZentCalles MINA).
comparisons.sap_detail:
1) Gate: OrderMethods.cs:669-684 (ProcessCreditPaymentAsync). cuentaBp = infoCliente.cuenta. If cuenta is blank and cliente is not, esClienteNuevo=true (:672) and the existence check is skipped. Otherwise CheckClientCreditAsync (:768-781) runs against ZB_DATOS_CLIENTE_CDS, a different service from BP05MA, and a false result throws "El cliente BP X no tiene crédito activo en SAP." Then comes the phone split (:687-691), then CrearSolicitudCreditoAsync (:787-843), which builds the request with Cliente = info.cuenta ?? "" (:825), names from *ClienteMavi (:805-807), FechaNacimiento null, Rfc "", Sexo "" (:808-810), EntreCalles = info.entreCalles ?? "" (:815) and EstadoCivil "" (:821). It calls SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.InsertAsync (:842).
2) Lookup: SCW = Methods/Credit/SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.cs. SCW:25 calls ObtenerMaestroAsync(req.Cliente) (:369-379). A null or whitespace cliente returns null with no HTTP call. Otherwise it calls GetClientMaAsync(cliente), which uses no trim and no escaping of the key (BusinessPartnerMethods.cs:301-302). A non-2xx or empty body throws (:316-319), so does HTML (:321-324) and a missing "d" (:326-330). Everything is re-wrapped as "Ocurrio un error al intentar obtener el cliente BP05MA: ..." (:336-339). The method never returns null.
3) Mapping in ArmarFila (SCW:229-305). If maestro != null the master wins, with ?? "" (§17.2): ApellidoP=NameLast (:233), ApellidoM=NameLst2 (:234), Nombre=NameFirst (:235), FechaNacimiento=FechaSap(Birthdt) ?? req (null) (:237, decoder :575-600, /Date(ms)/ read as UTC and bound as SqlDbType.Date :167), Rfc=to_CteCliente.Stcd1 (:238), Sexo=SexoLegado(Gender) (:239, :558-573: "1"->Masculino, "2"->Femenino, anything else->"NO ESPECIFICADO"), EntreCalles = Magento value if !IsNullOrEmpty, otherwise to_Cte.ZentCalles ?? "" (:245), Cliente=Partner ?? "" (:274). EstadoCivil=req.EstadoCivil, always "" (:254). Marst exists in the model (BusinessPartnerMa.cs:66) but is not used. ViveEnCalidad=req, null (:255). If maestro == null (blank cliente), every value comes from the Magento request.
4) The same maestro feeds EsProspecto (SCW:384, :532-542). The phone-validation reads use the raw req.Cliente (SCW:27, :385, :392, :397), while the column gets maestro.Partner.
5) Insert: SCW:157-226, direct parameterized INSERT with no Size (full values, per decision 13). No try/catch, so errors propagate.
6) Error path: InsertAsync, then CrearSolicitudCreditoAsync (no catch), then ProcessCreditPaymentAsync rethrows (:761-765), then SetOrderAsync wraps it as "Error en SetOrder: ..." (:1950-1954), then OrderController.cs:37-46 logs Logger.SAP and returns Ok("Error, " + message), HTTP 200. No credit row, no lines, no promo burn. The guide was already saved (:1787).
7) Success: OrderResponse{Resultado="Concluido", Zctefinal = cuentaBp, or idClienteMagento for a new customer} (:759, :1802-1807).
8) Extra read: for the same cuenta, BP05MA was already read once before this step in IsValidatedAsync (OrderMethods.cs:636, called at :1798 with sDatosPedido[36]=cuenta). That read swallows errors and returns "".

I cannot confirm that SAP stores them the same way for BPs registered in stores (the only capture has Gender '9' with Xsexu=true). Please also confirm the width of CRED_SOLICITUD_WEB_DATOS_TEMP.sexo: 'NO ESPECIFICADO' is 15 characters and the old SP parameter cut it to 9. 2) estadoCivil: do you have the Marst -> CTE.EstadoCivil code table, or do we accept '' for now? 3) Missing birth date: LAN silently created no credit application when CTE.FechaNacimiento was NULL, while ServicioSAP now creates one with NULL. comparisons.name: Split phone to validate (LadaValidar/TelefonoValidar)
comparisons.lan_source: Inputs: (1) SMS phone, SQL on ServicioAndroid: SELECT TOP 1 Telefono FROM TcAAEA00030_EnvioMensajes WHERE IdRegistro IN (SELECT IdCodigoVerificacioneCommerce FROM VTASDCodigoVerificacioneCommerce WHERE Cliente='{cuenta}') ORDER BY Id DESC (LAN Metodos/OrderMethods.cs:819-852). (2) Validated phone, SQL on Intelisis: SELECT TOP 1 CONCAT(Lada,Telefono) FROM CteTel WHERE Cliente=... AND Tipo='Movil' AND ValidacionTel=1 ORDER BY Fecha DESC (LAN OrderMethods.cs:786-817). (3) Checkout phone: datosped[21] = ValidateOnlyNumbers(infoCliente["telefono"]) (LAN OrderMethods.cs:414, :442-452), cleaned again with Regex [^0-9] (LAN CreditMethods.cs:113). Output goes to SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS @LadaValidar INT / @TelefonoValidar VARCHAR(10) (SPsOrden/SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS.sql:155-156). The SP passes them straight into CRED_SOLICITUD_WEB_DATOS_TEMP.LadaValidar/TelefonoValidar (SP:278-279, :339-340) and runs no logic on them.
comparisons.lan_detail: LAN Metodos/OrderMethods.cs:619-620 reads numeroDelSms and numeroValidado. :642 (the step note said :640; the real line is 642) passes `(numeroDelSms.Length > 0) ? numeroDelSms : numeroValidado` into the numeroDelSms parameter of ProductosCreditoWeb_SaveData (:624). In LAN Metodos/CreditMethods.cs, :113 strips datosped[21] to digits outside the try. Inside the try (from :135), after checkCliente (:124) and getClientInfo (:137), :140-143 splits datosped[21] first (the particular/cellular phone). That call throws when datosped[21] is shorter than the lada. Then :145 `telAux = numeroDelSms.Length > 0 ? numeroDelSms : datosped[21]`, which makes the effective chain SMS -> validated -> checkout phone. :146 uses ladaLength=2 if telAux.Substring(0,2) is in {33,55,81}, otherwise 3. :147-148 compute ladaValidar=Substring(0,ladaLength) and telefonoValidar=Substring(ladaLength), with no length guard. :187-188 send both as SqlDbType.VarChar with no Size. SQL Server converts @LadaValidar varchar to INT ('' or blanks become 0; '(33' raises a conversion error) and silently truncates @TelefonoValidar to 10 characters. On any exception (Substring ArgumentOutOfRange, SQL conversion error), :246-251 runs Logger.Credit("ERROR ", ex.Message) and returns "err". No row, no article lines, no promoter burn, no liberador thread. The caller ignores the return value (OrderMethods.cs:624, no assignment) and returns order.infoCliente["cuenta"] (:649). OrdersController.cs:151/:160 then sends HTTP 200 with the account string, so Magento sees the same response as a success. The SMS and CteTel values are not stripped to digits in LAN.
comparisons.sap_source: Inputs: (1) SMS phone, same SQL and same Android DB, parameterized (ServicioSAP Methods/Order/OrderMethods.cs:589-613; §20 #8). (2) Validated phone from OData ZAPI_BP05MA_SRV BusinessPartnerSet(Partner,Client)?$expand=to_CteTel... (Methods/BusinessPartner/BusinessPartnerMethods.cs:297-302). IsValidatedAsync filters to_CteTel on Zvaltel && ZappOrig non-empty && ZtelCte non-empty && ZtipoCte=='MOVIL', takes FirstOrDefault with no date ordering, and returns ZtelCte (OrderMethods.cs:631-660). Real captures show ZtelCte is unformatted: 7 digits, 10 digits or '+52...' (CAPTURAS_REALES_APIS.md:49-61). (3) Checkout phone from the model: ValidateOnlyNumbers(order.infoCliente?.telefono ?? "0") (OrderMethods.cs:688, :318-322). Output goes to a direct INSERT into CRED_SOLICITUD_WEB_DATOS_TEMP with no SP: @LadaValidar SqlDbType.Int, @TelefonoValidar SqlDbType.VarChar with no Size (Methods/Credit/SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.cs:90-91, :150-151, :217-218, :298-299).
comparisons.sap_detail: SetOrderAsync credit branch: OrderMethods.cs:1797-1798 reads numeroDelSms (sDatosPedido[36]=cuenta ?? "", :288) and numeroValidado, then :1800 calls ProcessCreditPaymentAsync (:665). After the guest check (:672-676) and CheckClientCreditAsync (only for non-new clients, :679-684), :687 uses the same ladaDeDos {33,55,81}. :688: telAux = !IsNullOrWhiteSpace(sms) ? sms : (!IsNullOrWhiteSpace(validado) ? validado : ValidateOnlyNumbers(infoCliente?.telefono ?? "0")). :689 guards Length>=2 before Substring(0,2). :690-691 return "0"/"0" whenever telAux.Length < ladaLength, and never throw. :694 CrearSolicitudCreditoAsync(order, ladaValidar, telefonoValidar). :792-793 int.TryParse(ladaValidar, out lada) ignores the bool, so a non-numeric value becomes 0. :838-839 set LadaValidar=lada and TelefonoValidar as a string. :842 InsertAsync. SCW:298-299 copies both to the row, and :217-218 binds them. The split never produces an error. Insert errors propagate (no try/catch in SCW:156-226; this is intentional, CrearSolicitudCreditoAsync propagates). ProcessCreditPaymentAsync rethrows (:761-765), SetOrderAsync wraps the error as 'Error en SetOrder: ...' (:1950-1954), and Controllers/OrderController.cs:37-46 returns HTTP 200 'Error, ...'. On success, :1802-1807 returns Resultado='Concluido', Zctefinal=cuenta, and OrderController.cs:28-35 returns {BP, SalesDocument, Message, Resultado}. Lookup failures return "" and are written only to Console (:607-611, :655-659). The split is identical to LAN for normal data: SMS '3312345678' gives 33/'12345678', '4771234567' gives 477/'1234567', and '+523333333333' gives 52/'3333333333' in both (SQL accepts '+52' as INT and int.TryParse accepts a sign). The fallback digit-stripping matches LAN CreditMethods.cs:113 (INTENTIONAL, PLAN §20 #10; git diff shows it was added in the uncommitted change).

comparisons.question_for_user: 1) When the selected phone (SMS, validated or checkout) is shorter than its lada, or its lada is not numeric, should ServicioSAP stop, as LAN did, with no row, no article lines and no promoter burn? Or should it keep writing LadaValidar=0 / TelefonoValidar='0' (OrderMethods.cs:688-691, :792-793)? If it should stop, what goes back to Magento: LAN returned the account string (a success-looking 200), while ServicioSAP's natural path would be 200 'Error, ...'. 2) Should a blank SMS phone count as present (LAN Length>0) or absent (current IsNullOrWhiteSpace)? 3) Please run B2 to get the real width and type of CRED_SOLICITUD_WEB_DATOS_TEMP.LadaValidar and TelefonoValidar; without it the >10-character and non-numeric cases cannot be predicted (the LAN SP cut at VARCHAR(10)). 4) Does BP05MA to_CteTel actually return ZappOrig? If not, IsValidatedAsync always returns '' and the validated phone is never used as the second choice.

comparisons.name: Guest / new-client classification
comparisons.lan_source: Legacy chain: DMZ setOrder guard (git branch origin/Production, head c352009 2026-08-11) -> LAN POST order/setOrder -> OrderMethods.SetPedido -> CreditMethods.ProductosCreditoWeb_SaveData -> checkCliente -> SP SpCREDIDatosSolicitudCreditoArt @Op='CheckCliente' (Intelisis table CTE). LAN has no explicit guest or new-client step. The gate is (1) whether the DMZ finds a 'cuenta' key and (2) whether the cuenta value exists in CTE.
comparisons.lan_detail:
1) PRODUCTION DMZ (this corrects the task's LAN-only view and MATRIZ G1-09). DMZ origin/Production Controllers/OrdersController.cs:117-124: a credit order with no 'cuenta' key gets 400 "Cuenta invalida" and LAN is never called, so nothing is written. The current DMZ file has the same block commented out at :116-127 with the note "SAP/ServicioSAP valida internamente el BP".
2) THE DMZ READS LAN'S ANSWER. Production :131 posts to LAN and trims the quotes. An empty or whitespace answer gets 500 {error:"LAN retornó vacío",incrementId} (:138-143). The 'sin cuenta' check at :152-159 is dead, because SetPedido never returns that text. Any answer not starting with 'C' gets 500 {error:"Respuesta inesperada",lanResponse} (:161-166). Only 'C...' is passed on as 200 (:175).
3) LAN SetPedido (OrderMethods.cs:533). ToArray puts cuenta at [36] and uses "" when the key is missing (:429-432). 'cliente' goes to [1], or "0" when missing (:346-349). The credit path never reads cliente.
4) BEFORE THE GATE. PedidoExistente check (:541-542), Intelisis staging detallePedido Limpiar/Insertar (:582, :599), SQLite guide (:606).
5) CREDIT BRANCH (:609). ObtenerNumeroTablaSms and IsValidated are called with order.infoCliente["cuenta"] (:619-620). If the key is missing: KeyNotFoundException, caught at :728-730, returns "" (:732). If the key is present with ""/null, both queries run with '' (string.Format at :827-830 and :794-795).
6) THE ACTUAL GATE. ProductosCreditoWeb_SaveData (:624-647) calls checkCliente(data[0]) (CreditMethods.cs:124). That runs the SP (CreditMethods.cs:725-763; SpCREDIDatosSolicitudCreditoArt.sql:37-50: RETURN 1 if COUNT(cliente) FROM CTE WHERE cliente=@Val > 0). For '' the count is 0. For null, @Val is not supplied, and the exception is swallowed (:756-759), which gives false. Result: "sin cuenta" (:257). No header row, no lines, no coupon burn, no liberador.
7) RETURN. SetPedido throws away the SaveData result and returns order.infoCliente["cuenta"] (:649), i.e. "" or null. The LAN controller answers Ok(response) with HTTP 200 (OrdersController.cs:151-160).
8) LIBERADOR. It starts only for a cuenta starting with 'C' (CreditMethods.cs:208-241).
9) validateCredit. LAN's validateCredit (OrdersController.cs:455-482) runs the same SetPedido and answers {status:"PROCESANDO",cuenta:""}. The DMZ proxy is commented out and ServicioSAP has no such route (MATRIZ G1-03, out of this step).
comparisons.sap_source: Current DMZ setOrder (no guard) -> ServicioSAP POST order/new (OrderController.SetOrder) -> OrderMethods.SetOrderAsync -> ProcessCreditPaymentAsync. The gate is pure string checks on infoCliente.cuenta and infoCliente.cliente, with no OData or API lookup. The new-client branch writes to ServicioAndroid CRED_SOLICITUD_WEB_DATOS_TEMP through SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.InsertAsync.
comparisons.sap_detail:
1) DMZ. The guard is commented out (:116-127). Every order is forwarded to order/new (:196). The DMZ answers Ok with the parsed JSON, or with the raw string if parsing fails (:216-227).
2) OrderController.cs:16-47. SetOrderAsync(order,"Insert") returns Ok({BP=Zctefinal, SalesDocument, Message, Resultado}) (:28-35). The catch returns Ok("Error, "+e.Message) (:37-46).
3) SetOrderAsync (OrderMethods.cs:1728). ToArray puts cuenta ?? "" at [36] (:288) and cliente or "0" at [1] (:204-207). Then the SD36 idempotency call (:1752). The credit branch (:1785) runs, before the gate: SaveGuideAsync (:1787, which does INSERT OR IGNORE into SQLite servicio_guias at :541-544), ObtenerNumeroTablaSmsAsync(cuenta) (:1797, :589-605), and IsValidatedAsync(cuenta) (:1798, :631-661). GetClientMaAsync('') throws and the error is swallowed, returning "". Then ProcessCreditPaymentAsync (:1800).
4) ProcessCreditPaymentAsync (:665-766). It reads cuentaBp = cuenta ?? "" and idClienteMagento = cliente ?? "" (:669-670). esClienteNuevo = IsNullOrWhiteSpace(cuenta) && !IsNullOrWhiteSpace(cliente) (:672). esInvitado = both blank (:673).
   - Guest: throws "Los invitados no pueden pagar con crédito." (:675-676). It is rethrown (:761-765), wrapped as "Error en SetOrder: ..." (:1953), and answered as 200 "Error, Error en SetOrder: Los invitados no pueden pagar con crédito.". No row (same as LAN).
   - Existing client: CheckClientCreditAsync (:679-684, :768).
   - New client: skips any check. Parses the phone (:687-691). CrearSolicitudCreditoAsync (:694, :787-842) sends Cliente = info.cuenta ?? "" without trimming (:825). InsertAsync (SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.cs:18-33) then runs: ObtenerMaestroAsync returns null for a blank cliente (:369-374), GetTelefonoValidadoAsync returns null (:476-481), so ValidacionTelefono = 1 (:312-327), and fila.Cliente = req.Cliente (:274). The row is INSERTed, lines are added (:703) and codigo_promotor is burned (:708). The liberador block under esClienteNuevo is commented out (:720-757). The method returns idClienteMagento (:759), which becomes Zctefinal (:1805) and then BP.
5) DEAD RULE. ResolveCreditMAPartner (:2580-2586) throws "Credito MA requiere cuenta logeada en el body." That is the same rule as LAN/DMZ, but it can never run for credit: credit returns at :1801-1807, before ResolvePartnerNumberForOrderAsync (:1833).
6) SOURCE EQUIVALENCE. LAN's gate reads CTE; ServicioSAP's new-client path reads nothing. businesspartner-dev exposes ZidMagento on the BP (apps/api/models/ZBDatosCliente.py:34, routes/AS_ZQBP_CTE.py:40), which could map a Magento cliente to a BP. Neither side uses it.
7) PAYLOAD EVIDENCE.
   - Real credit payloads always carry cuenta and cliente (magento_payloads.md:26, :55).
   - Contado guest orders carry neither key (Hoppscotch manual :592-608).
   - A contado first purchase by a logged-in customer sends "cuenta":null with "cliente":"9860" (:620, :659-661).
   - A credit payload without cuenta: NO EVIDENCE.
8) No text in the share documents tried to give instructions.

differences.lan: Both keys absent: DMZ 400 'Cuenta invalida'. infoCliente null: the DMZ ContainsKey call throws a NullReferenceException, giving 500. cuenta '' present with no cliente: LAN returns '', so the DMZ answers 500 'LAN retornó vacío'.

comparisons.question_for_user:
1) PLAN §18.5 #6: for a credit order with an empty, null or missing cuenta and a Magento 'cliente' id, what should ServicioSAP do?
   (a) Reject it like LAN/DMZ did, with no row. The rule already exists in the code as ResolveCreditMAPartner, OrderMethods.cs:2580-2586 ("Credito MA requiere cuenta logeada en el body."), but credit never reaches it.
   (b) Keep creating the application as a first-purchase credit, which is new behaviour. If (b): what should the row's cliente be (today it is ''), and what should Magento get in 'BP' (today it is the Magento customer id)?
2) Before the migration, Magento got HTTP 400 'Cuenta invalida' or 500 for these cases (DMZ origin/Production OrdersController.cs:117-124, :138-143). Now it gets HTTP 200 with 'Error, ...' or 'Concluido'. Does Magento/Omnipro rely on the HTTP status, and should the DMZ guard be restored?
3) Does Magento ever send a credit order without cuenta? The only real credit payloads (CRED515773, CRED515848) carry it. The contado first-purchase example sends "cuenta": null.

comparisons.name: Account existence check (checkCliente vs ZB_DATOS_CLIENTE)
comparisons.lan_source: SQL SP IntelisisTmp.dbo.SpCREDIDatosSolicitudCreditoArt @Op='CheckCliente', @Val=cuenta -> SELECT COUNT(cliente) FROM CTE WHERE cliente=@Val; RETURN 1/0 (SpCREDIDatosSolicitudCreditoArt.sql:22-23, :37-51). The connection is sCadenaConexion = MAVICUBOS / IntelisisTmp (Conn/Connection.cs:26). This is the Intelisis customer master, so existence means "row in CTE".
comparisons.lan_detail: Entry: OrdersController.setOrder (LAN Controllers/OrdersController.cs:137-161) and validateCredit (:455-482) both call OrderMethods.SetPedido. Credit branch LOM (Metodos/OrderMethods.cs):609-650. It passes data[0]=order.infoCliente["cuenta"] (:627) to CreditMethods.ProductosCreditoWeb_SaveData (:624-647) and DISCARDS its return value; then it always does `return order.infoCliente["cuenta"]` (:649). Before the check, SetPedido has already written detallePedido rows (:582-601) and SaveGuide (:606). Inside SaveData (Metodos/CreditMethods.cs), these run before the check: Regex on datosped[21] (:113) and opening the ServicioAndroid connection (:117-119). An exception in either escapes SaveData, and SetPedido's catch (:728-732) returns "". Check: `if (checkCliente(data[0]))` at :124, else `return "sin cuenta"` at :255-258, which is lost at LOM:624. checkCliente (:725-763): runs the parameterized SP on sCadenaConexion (:730), with @Op='CheckCliente' and @Val=cliente as VarChar (:739-740), CommandTimeout 60 (:745), and returns true only when @retValue==1 (:748). Any exception goes to an empty catch (:757-760) and returns false (:762), with no log. SP semantics: @Val varchar(20) (silently truncates longer input). The comparison is SQL Server `=`, where trailing spaces are insignificant; case sensitivity depends on the collation (NO EVIDENCE of the collation). There is no filter on blocked, prospect or credit status. On true, the flow continues with saldo (no-op, PLAN §16), GetInfo, the INSERT and the liberador when data[0] starts with "C" (:208). On false, no solicitud row is created and no liberador runs, and Magento still gets HTTP 200 with the cuenta string (LOC:160). The legacy DMZ had a "sin cuenta" -> 422 branch (DMZ Controllers/OrdersController.cs:159-166, now commented). LAN never actually produced that value to the DMZ.
comparisons.sap_source: OData ZB_DATOS_CLIENTE_CDS/ZB_DATOS_CLIENTE (BP05 "exposicion de datos BP"), called as GET collection ?$filter=BusinessPartner eq '{x}'&$top=1&sap-client=110&$format=json over S/4 direct with Basic auth and a 60 s timeout (BusinessPartnerMethods.cs:30; Helpers/TokenGenerator.cs:113-133). The reference repos use the same view keyed/filtered by BusinessPartner (businesspartner-dev apps/api/routes/AS_GET_ZB_DATOS_CLIENTE.py:24; AS_GET_BusinessPartner.py:47-51) and dedupe multiple rows per BP (:15-22). The CDS DDL (joins/WHERE) is not in the share: NO EVIDENCE of whether every BP appears in the view.
comparisons.sap_detail: Entry: OrderController.SetOrder route order/new (Controllers/OrderController.cs:16-48). The DMZ forwards setOrder to it verbatim (DMZ Controllers/OrdersController.cs:196, :214-227). No validateCredit route exists: the DMZ proxy is commented at :366-402. SetOrderAsync credit branch (Methods/Order/OrderMethods.cs:1785-1808): it runs SaveGuideAsync (:1787), then ObtenerNumeroTablaSmsAsync and IsValidatedAsync (:1797-1798, both swallow errors, :608-612, :655-659), then ProcessCreditPaymentAsync (:1800). ProcessCreditPaymentAsync (:665-766): cuentaBp = infoCliente?.cuenta ?? "" (:669), with no Trim and no normalization. idClienteMagento = infoCliente?.cliente ?? "" (:670). esClienteNuevo = cuenta blank AND cliente not blank (:672). esInvitado = both blank (:673) and throws "Los invitados no pueden pagar con crédito." (:675-676). Only when !esClienteNuevo: `if (!await CheckClientCreditAsync(cuentaBp)) throw new Exception($"El cliente BP {cuentaBp} no tiene crédito activo en SAP.")` (:679-684). CheckClientCreditAsync (:768-781) calls GetClientAsync and returns partner != null && !IsNullOrEmpty(partner.BusinessPartner) (:774). Any exception goes to Console.WriteLine and returns false (:776-780). GetClientAsync (BusinessPartnerMethods.cs:27-69) builds the URL by raw interpolation of clientId, with no quote escaping or URL encoding (:30). A non-2xx or empty response throws (:43-46), HTML throws (:48-51), it deserializes with System.Text.Json and no options (:53-55), 0 rows throws "No se encontraron clientes" (:56-59), and everything is wrapped as "Ocurrio un error al intentar obtener el listado de clientes: ..." (:65-68). Property binding of BusinessPartner is case-sensitive, but the JSON name is exactly "BusinessPartner" (businesspartner-dev AS_GET_BusinessPartner.py:19; models/ZBDatosCliente.py:7; the $filter at BPM:30 would be rejected otherwise). So the always-false risk in PLAN §13.3 #1 does not materialize, but there is no real captured response in the share. Partner has non-nullable int/bool members (Models/SAP/BusinessPartner/Partner.cs:13-14, :29, :36, ...). Error propagation: ProcessCreditPaymentAsync rethrows (:761-765), SetOrderAsync wraps it as "Error en SetOrder: ..." (:1950-1953), and the controller logs it with Logger.SAP (:45) and returns HTTP 200 "Error, " + message (:46). On success the flow continues to CrearSolicitudCreditoAsync (:694), whose InsertAsync re-reads the BP from a DIFFERENT service, BP05MA (Methods/Credit/SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.cs:25, :369-379). The liberador and callback are commented out (OM:719-757), so no order is released.

differences.what: Account key domain: LAN validates the Intelisis account (C########) against CTE. ServicioSAP looks the same string up as a BusinessPartner number in ZB_DATOS_CLIENTE. Magento's real credit payloads still send the Intelisis C-account.

differences.sap: GetClientAsync('C01575835') -> 0 rows -> throws 'No se encontraron clientes' -> CheckClientCreditAsync false -> throw 'El cliente BP C01575835 no tiene crédito activo en SAP.' -> HTTP 200 'Error, Error en SetOrder: ...', no row (OM:681-682, :776-780; BPM:56-59; OC:46)
differences.evidence: magento_payloads.md:26 (CRED515773, cuenta C01575835) and :55 (CRED515848, cuenta C00000020); BusinessPartnerMethods.cs:30; OrderMethods.cs:669, :679-684; LAN CreditMethods.cs:124. differences.lan: checkCliente('') -> COUNT(cliente) WHERE cliente='' = 0 -> false -> 'sin cuenta' (discarded) -> no row, no liberador; SetPedido returns '' (LCM:124, :255-258; LOM:649). With cuenta null the SqlParameter value is not sent, the SP errors, the empty catch returns false, and the result is the same no-row outcome.
differences.sap: esClienteNuevo=true -> CheckClientCreditAsync not called -> CrearSolicitudCreditoAsync inserts a row with Cliente='' and Magento data -> returns {BP:'9400', Resultado:'Concluido', ...} (OM:672, :679, :694, :759, :825, :1802-1807; OC:28-35)
differences.evidence: OrderMethods.cs:672-684, :759; SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.cs:371-374 (null master for blank cliente); LAN CreditMethods.cs:124, :255-258
differences.decision_ref: PLAN §18.5 #6 (pending user decision); MATRIZ G1-10; PLAN §11.3 Bloque 0 (line 797)
differences.concrete_case: infoCliente {cuenta:'', cliente:'9400'} credit order: LAN writes no CRED_SOLICITUD_WEB_DATOS_TEMP row and returns ""; ServicioSAP writes one row with cliente='' and returns Resultado 'Concluido', BP '9400'.

differences.what: What the caller receives when the account does not exist or the lookup fails. LAN silently returns the account, the same as on success. ServicioSAP returns an error string.
differences.lan: HTTP 200, body = the cuenta string (LOM:624 discards 'sin cuenta', :649 returns cuenta; LOC:160). Magento cannot tell a missing account from success.
differences.sap: HTTP 200, body = "Error, Error en SetOrder: El cliente BP X no tiene crédito activo en SAP." (OM:682, :1953; OC:37-47). On success the body is a JSON object {BP, SalesDocument, Message, Resultado} instead of a plain string (OC:28-35).
differences.evidence: LAN Metodos/OrderMethods.cs:624-649; LAN Controllers/OrdersController.cs:151-160; SAP Controllers/OrderController.cs:27-47; OrderMethods.cs:1950-1953. The legacy DMZ intended 'sin cuenta' -> 422 (DMZ OrdersController.cs:159-166, commented), but LAN never emitted it.
differences.decision_ref: None. The 'CrearSolicitudCreditoAsync now propagates errors' decision covers the insert, not this check. PLAN §11.5 (line 864) records the contract change without deciding it. MATRIZ G1-24 / G5-14.
differences.concrete_case: cuenta='1234567890' (no such BP / no such CTE row): LAN -> 200 "1234567890"; ServicioSAP -> 200 "Error, Error en SetOrder: El cliente BP 1234567890 no tiene crédito activo en SAP."

differences.what: Infrastructure errors collapse into 'does not exist' on both sides (equivalent semantics). ServicioSAP reports them with a misleading business message, and the root cause only goes to Console.
differences.lan: SQL timeout (60 s) or connection error -> empty catch -> false -> 'sin cuenta' (discarded), nothing logged (LCM:745, :757-762)
differences.sap: HTTP timeout (60 s), 401/5xx, HTML page or JSON conversion error -> GetClientAsync throws -> Console.WriteLine only -> false -> 'no tiene crédito activo en SAP'. Logger.SAP stores only the wrapper message (OM:776-780; OC:45; TokenGenerator.cs:127)

comparisons.question_for_user: 1) After the migration, will Magento send infoCliente.cuenta as the 10-digit SAP BP or keep sending the Intelisis 'C########' account? If it keeps sending C-accounts, should ServicioSAP translate them to a BP before this check? ZB_DATOS_CLIENTE exposes a ZclienteBp field (Partner.cs:11) that may hold the legacy account, but nothing in the share shows its contents. 2) For a new client (cuenta blank, cliente present), which behavior do you want: LAN parity (no solicitud, 'sin cuenta') or the current ServicioSAP behavior (insert with cliente '')? This is PLAN §18.5 #6. 3) For a non-existent account, which response should Magento get: the LAN behavior (HTTP 200 with the cuenta string, indistinguishable from success) or the current 'Error, ... no tiene crédito activo en SAP'?

comparisons.name: IdSolicitud check before lines
comparisons.lan_source: SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS @Op='Insert' on ServicioAndroid (SPsOrden/SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS.sql:168 sets @IdSolicitud=0, :223-344 INSERT INTO CRED_SOLICITUD_WEB_DATOS_TEMP, :346 SET @IdSolicitud = SCOPE_IDENTITY(), :348 SELECT @IdSolicitud). Connection sCadenaConexionAndriod = mavicbosandroid.grupomavi.com / ServicioAndroid (LAN Conn/Connection.cs:28). The id is read with ExecuteReader in LAN CreditMethods.cs:190-197.
comparisons.lan_detail:
LAN/WebApiMagento/Metodos/CreditMethods.cs::ProductosCreditoWeb_SaveData. :107-108 res="" and IdSolicitud="". :126-133 res becomes "insuficiente" or "OK". checkSaldo (:766-802) always returns 0, so any total > 0 gives "insuficiente". :151 @Op="Insert". :190 ExecuteReader. :191-197 loops over every row of the first result set and keeps dr[0].ToString() of the LAST row. A DBNull gives "". The SP returns exactly one INT row (SPD:348), so the value is the new id as a string. The variable-assignment SELECTs at SPD:186-208 produce no result set.
:199 if (IdSolicitud != "") runs three things:
- :201 CreditoWeb_InsertArticulo(articulos, IdSolicitud, condicion, cp) (:869-919). It uses sCadenaConexion (:872) and binds the string to the Int @IdCredito (:882, :898).
- :203-206 CodigoPromocion(data[6], "Elimina", data[2]) if the promoter code is not empty.
- :208-241 if the cuenta starts with 'C': int.Parse(IdSolicitud) (:212) and a background thread with LiberarCliente plus CallMagentoAuthorizationCallback.
There is NO else branch. :243 `return res` runs in both cases, with no log. So a missing id silently skips the lines, the promoter burn and the liberador.
:246-252 any exception in the INSERT/SP means Logger.Credit ERROR and return "err". The check is never reached.
The caller LAN Metodos/OrderMethods.cs:624-647 DISCARDS the return value. :649 `return order.infoCliente["cuenta"]`. Controllers/OrdersController.cs:151-160 logs it (:152) and returns Ok(response): HTTP 200 with a JSON string such as "C01575835", whether the id was obtained, missing, "err" or "insuficiente". validateCredit (:455-482) wraps the same value as {status:"PROCESANDO", cuenta}.
A missing id is only possible when SCOPE_IDENTITY() is NULL, for example with an INSTEAD OF trigger or a table without an identity column. NO EVIDENCE either way: the share has no DDL (runbook §9.5, §18.3 B2 pending).
comparisons.sap_source: Same table and same database: a direct parameterized INSERT into ServicioAndroid.dbo.CRED_SOLICITUD_WEB_DATOS_TEMP followed by `; SELECT CAST(SCOPE_IDENTITY() AS INT)` (SS Methods/Credit/SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.cs:35-155, :157-227), on connection MAVICBOSANDROID (SS Web.config:13, ConexionSQL.cs:100-129). It is the same server and database as LAN. No OData or HTTP API takes part in producing or checking the id, so businesspartner-dev and salesanddistribution-dev do not apply to this step. The response path is OrderController order/new (SS Controllers/OrderController.cs:16-47) and then the DMZ bridge (DMZ Controllers/OrdersController.cs:196-227).
comparisons.sap_detail:
SS Methods/Order/OrderMethods.cs::ProcessCreditPaymentAsync.
- :694 `int idSolicitud = await CrearSolicitudCreditoAsync(...)` (:787-843). That calls SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.InsertAsync (SCW:18-33), which calls InsertarSolicitudAsync (SCW:157-227). ExecuteScalarAsync (SCW:223) reads the first column of the first row. null or DBNull gives 0 (SCW:225). There is no try/catch, so SqlException and HTTP errors from ObtenerMaestroAsync and ConstruirContextoAsync (SCW:25-27) propagate and the check is never reached.
- :695-696 `if (idSolicitud <= 0) throw new Exception("No se pudo generar la solicitud de crédito.")`.
- On success: :699-717 InsertCreditArticlesAsync plus HandlePromoCodeAsync("Elimina") inside a try whose catch only logs (:711-717). :865-866 in InsertCreditArticlesAsync repeats the <=0 guard; it is unreachable because of :695.
- :719-757 the liberador and Magento callback block is COMMENTED OUT ("PENDIENTE" :722). It sits under esClienteNuevo (:720), not the LAN 'C' prefix. Current state: nothing is liberated and no callback is sent.
- :759 returns esClienteNuevo ? idClienteMagento : cuentaBp.
- :761-765 catch: Console.WriteLine, then `throw;`.
- The caller at :1800-1807 wraps a success as OrderResponse{Resultado="Concluido", Zctefinal=cuenta, Zidecomm=incrementId}. On an exception, :1950-1954 rethrows as "Error en SetOrder: " + message.
- OrderController.cs:27-35 turns success into {BP, SalesDocument (null for credit), Message "", Resultado "Concluido"}. :37-47 logs Logger.SAP("[ORDER NEW ERROR] ", full exception) and returns Ok("Error, " + e.Message): HTTP 200 with "Error, Error en SetOrder: No se pudo generar la solicitud de crédito.".
- The DMZ (OrdersController.cs:196) trims the quotes. JsonConvert fails on the plain text, so :221-224 returns Ok(string) to Magento. For the success object it returns the parsed JSON (:218-219).
- Equivalences confirmed: ExecuteScalar takes the first row and LAN's loop takes the last, but the SP and the batch emit exactly one row. DBNull maps to "" in LAN and to 0 in SS, and both mean "no id". A string versus int type makes no observable difference. SCOPE_IDENTITY ignores trigger inserts in both.

The caller discards it and returns the cuenta (LAN OrderMethods.cs:649). HTTP 200 body "C01575835" (OrdersController.cs:160). No error log.
differences.sap: idSolicitud == 0 (SCW:225). OM:695-696 throws "No se pudo generar la solicitud de crédito.", rethrown at OM:764 and wrapped at OM:1953. HTTP 200 body "Error, Error en SetOrder: No se pudo generar la solicitud de crédito." (OC:46). No lines and no promoter burn, the same as LAN.
differences.decision_ref: None of the listed decisions covers it. The runbook and matrix record it as an open difference: MATRIZ G2-38 (DIF, 'only the response changes'), G1-24/G5-14 and PLAN §19.2 #1 (contract to be agreed with Magento, not decided). §17.3 'CrearSolicitudCreditoAsync propagates errors' is about exceptions, not about this <=0 guard.

If the cuenta starts with 'C', the liberador thread starts with idSolicitud 0 (:208-240). Magento gets the cuenta.

differences.evidence: LAN CreditMethods.cs:199-212, :869-919; SS OrderMethods.cs:695-696; SCW:225

There is NO EVIDENCE of the real seed: the DDL is pending (PLAN §18.3 B2). LAN writes lines under solicitud 0 and burns the promoter coupon. SS writes nothing more and returns the error text.

differences.what: Failure before the check (the INSERT or the reads before it throw): neither system reaches the check, but the answer to Magento differs
differences.lan: SqlException (conversion, linked-server read, overflow) goes to catch :246-252: Logger.Credit ERROR, return "err". The caller discards it, so the answer is 200 with the cuenta. The SP parameter declarations silently truncate widths (e.g. @MetodoEnvio VARCHAR(12), SPD:147), so 'tablerate_bestway' is stored as 'tablerate_be' and the INSERT succeeds.
differences.sap: Exceptions from GetClientMaAsync, A_GET_TelefonoValidado, CteTelSet, the AWS catalog, the SMS query or the INSERT propagate (SCW:25-32, no try/catch at SCW:157-227). The answer is 200 "Error, Error en SetOrder: <cause>". With no SqlParameter Size, a column narrower than the value raises 8152/2628 and the check is never reached.
differences.decision_ref: PLAN §17.2 ('InsertarSolicitudAsync without try/catch… errors propagate') and §17.3 (CrearSolicitudCreditoAsync no longer swallows the error); decision 13 / §18.3 (insert as it arrived, no truncation). The resulting change of the Magento response is still open: MATRIZ G2-39/G3-16 and PLAN §19.2 #1.
differences.evidence: LAN CreditMethods.cs:135, :246-252; LAN OrderMethods.cs:649; SPD:147; SS SCW:18-33, :157-227; SS OrderMethods.cs:761-765, :1950-1954; SS OrderController.cs:37-47; MATRIZ G2-27
differences.concrete_case: CRED515848 with its cuenta replaced by a QA BP and metodoEnvio 'tablerate_bestway' (17 chars). If the column is varchar(12) (SPD:51 changelog says the column was added as varchar(12)), LAN inserts 'tablerate_be', gets an id and continues to the lines. SS fails with 8152 before the check and answers "Error, Error en SetOrder: String or binary data would be truncated…".

differences.lan: Bare JSON string with the cuenta, e.g. "C01575835" (LAN OrderMethods.cs:649, OrdersController.cs:160). validateCredit returns {status:"PROCESANDO", cuenta}. The idSolicitud is not returned.

differences.lan: The missing-id branch writes no log in SaveData. OrdersController logs the returned cuenta as INFO in the SetOrder log (OrdersController.cs:152). HTTP is always 200.

comparisons.question_for_user: 1) The code cannot settle how Magento reacts, both in PollCreditStatus and in the setOrder caller. LAN always returns a bare cuenta string: "C…", or a BP after the migration. ServicioSAP returns an {BP, SalesDocument, Message, Resultado} object on success and "Error, …" with HTTP 200 when idSolicitud <= 0 or when anything upstream throws. Can Magento handle both, or should ServicioSAP return the bare cuenta string like LAN? This is PLAN §19.2 #1 and MATRIZ G1-24/G2-38, still undecided. 2) For the practically unreachable no-id case: do you want strict LAN parity (answer silently with the cuenta), or do you keep the explicit error on purpose? 3) Can someone run the DDL query from PLAN §18.3 B2? It would confirm that CRED_SOLICITUD_WEB_DATOS_TEMP has an IDENTITY seeded at 1 or higher and no INSTEAD OF trigger, which is what makes the no-id and id=0 branches unreachable.

comparisons.lan_source: C#: LAN/WebApiMagento/Metodos/CreditMethods.cs ProductosCreditoWeb_SaveData (+ checkCliente, checkSaldo, getClientInfo, CreditoWeb_InsertArticulo, CodigoPromocion); Metodos/OrderMethods.cs SetPedido; Controllers/OrdersController.cs Set (setOrder) and ValidateCredit. SQL: SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS (Android, no TRY/CATCH, SELECT @IdSolicitud SPD:346-348), SpCREDIDatosSolicitudCreditoArt (CheckCliente SPC:36-50, GetInfo, GetSaldo), SpVTASInsertArtSolCreditoLinea, SpVTASVentaCupon. Bridge era LAN: DMZ git commit 950106a (history only, not current code).
comparisons.lan_detail: Caller: OrdersController.Set (LAN Controllers/OrdersController.cs:137-161) calls SetPedido inside try; returns Ok(response) (:160); only exceptions that escape SetPedido reach catch -> Ok(e.ToString()) (:154-157). SetPedido credit branch (Metodos/OrderMethods.cs:609-650) sits inside the try at :576; it calls ObtenerNumeroTablaSms/IsValidated (:619-620, both swallow errors and return "": :812-816, :847-851), then calls cm.ProductosCreditoWeb_SaveData(...) and DISCARDS its return value (:624-647), then always returns order.infoCliente["cuenta"] (:649). Any exception that escapes SaveData goes to the outer catch (:728-731, Logger.SetOrder) and SetPedido returns sRespuestaPedido = "" (:574, :732). Inside SaveData (Metodos/CreditMethods.cs:94-262): OUTSIDE the inner try are int.Parse(data[1]) (:109), Regex on datosped[21] (:113), new SqlConnection + cnn.Open() on the Android DB (:117-119), checkCliente (:124, swallows every error and returns false: :757-762), decimal.Parse(data[4]=order.total) and checkSaldo (:126, checkSaldo always 0 per PLAN §16.3). If checkCliente is false -> returns "sin cuenta" (:255-258) -> discarded -> caller gets cuenta. If true, res = "insuficiente"/"OK" (:126-133, discarded). INNER try (:135-245): getClientInfo (:137; swallows errors and returns a possibly empty/partial list :860-867, so a missing row or NULL FechaNacimiento (:835) makes datosCliente[n] throw at :152-169), phone split with Substring (:139-148; throws for <2/3 digits), entreCalles.Length (:163; NRE if null), SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS ExecuteReader (:190; SqlException for any SP/linked-server/insert error, the SP has no TRY/CATCH), if IdSolicitud != "" (:199): CreditoWeb_InsertArticulo (:201; no try, :869-919, writes lines one by one, partial on failure), CodigoPromocion 'Elimina' (:203-206; swallows internally and returns "err" :424-428, logged as INFO), and for cuenta starting with 'C' a background liberador thread with its own try/catch that calls the Magento callback with RECHAZADO on error (:208-241). Inner catch (:246-252): Logger.Credit("ERROR ", ex.Message) to credit.log and return "err" -> discarded -> caller still gets cuenta. No transaction: header written by the SP stays if lines fail. Net observable contract of LAN setOrder for this step: HTTP 200 with the cuenta string for success, 'err', 'sin cuenta' and 'insuficiente' alike (indistinguishable); HTTP 200 with "" when the exception escapes SaveData (Android DB unreachable at :119, non-numeric total at :126) or when cuenta key missing (KeyNotFound at OrderMethods.cs:619). Error text is never sent to the caller from this step. Second LAN caller: ValidateCredit (OrdersController.cs:455-482) returns {status:"PROCESANDO", cuenta: resultado} for the same SetPedido result. In the LAN era the DMZ (git 950106a, OrdersController.cs Set, history only) mapped LAN "" -> 500, non-'C' -> 500, "sin cuenta" -> 422, 'C...' -> 200.

comparisons.question_for_user: The code cannot settle three things. (1) When the credit application fails inside ServicioSAP (BP not found, BP05MA / A_GET_TelefonoValidado / CteTelSet / AWS catalog / Android INSERT error), what should Magento get through the DMZ? (a) Strict LAN parity: HTTP 200 with the cuenta string, which hides the failure. (b) The current HTTP 200 "Error, Error en SetOrder: <detail>". If you keep (b), should the SAP/SQL detail be stripped from the body? (c) Something Magento can tell apart, such as a non-200 status or Resultado="Error" inside the object. (2) The success body changed from the plain cuenta string to {BP, SalesDocument:null, Message:"", Resultado:"Concluido"}. Has Magento/Omnipro confirmed it reads this format (PLAN §18.8)? (3) For cuenta "" with cliente present (esClienteNuevo), should ServicioSAP stop the way LAN does ("sin cuenta", nothing written), or keep inserting a solicitud with an empty cliente (PLAN §18.5 #6)?

comparisons.name: Liberador background thread trigger (after the credit application is written)
comparisons.lan_source: HTTP, not SQL. (1) Liberador service: AUTENTICACION_URL_LIBERADOR / VETA_URL_LIBERADOR = http://172.16.215.51:3026/api/login/authenticate and /api/venta (LAN Web.config:37-39). (2) DMZ callback: URL_DMZ + "login/authenticate" and "order/authorizationResult" (LAN Web.config:19-21, localhost; Web STAGE LAN.config:16 = kdll3fhcyo.mavi.mx:7022). The DMZ then forwards to Magento rest/V1/omnipro-credito/authorizationResult (DMZ Controllers/OrdersController.cs:421-458). The gate reads no data source: it is a string-prefix test on the Intelisis account, after SpCREDIDatosSolicitudCreditoArt @Op='CheckCliente' (COUNT in CTE, SpCREDIDatosSolicitudCreditoArt.sql:37-51) has passed.
comparisons.lan_detail:
Entry: setOrder (LAN Controllers/OrdersController.cs:138,151) or validateCredit (:456-482), both call OrderMethods.SetPedido. The credit branch (LAN Metodos/OrderMethods.cs:609-649) calls CreditMethods.ProductosCreditoWeb_SaveData with data[0]=infoCliente["cuenta"], data[1]= storeId=="viu" ? "2" : "1" (a case-sensitive test, :628), and entityId=order.entityId (:645). It throws away the return value and returns infoCliente["cuenta"] (:649). validateCredit answers {status:"PROCESANDO", cuenta} (OrdersController.cs:475).
Inside SaveData (LAN Metodos/CreditMethods.cs), the order is:
- checkCliente(data[0]) must be true, otherwise it returns "sin cuenta" (:124, :255-258).
- The balance result ("insuficiente"/"OK", :126-133) does NOT gate the trigger.
- SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS returns IdSolicitud (:190-197). The trigger runs only if IdSolicitud != "" (:199).
- CreditoWeb_InsertArticulo runs next (:201). It has no try (:869-919), so a failure there jumps to the outer catch, which returns "err" (:246-252), and the Liberador is NOT started.
- The promoter code is burned (:203-206).
- Gate: data[0].ToUpper().StartsWith("C") (:208). This is an Intelisis "casa" account and excludes 'P...' prospects.
- Captured values: entityId, cliente=data[0], idSol=int.Parse(IdSolicitud), uen (:210-213).
- A background Thread starts (:215-240).
- The thread calls LiberadorCreditoMethods.LiberarCliente(cliente, idSol, uen) (:219-220). That method (LAN Metodos/LiberadorCreditoMethods.cs:40-101) POSTs {Password} to get a token, then POSTs {Cliente,Id,UEN} to /api/venta with Authorization: <token>. It returns EN_ANALISIS in both the idVenta>0 and idVenta=0 cases, and RECHAZADO on an exception. It logs to Logger.LiberadorCredito.
- The thread then calls the static OrderMethods.CallMagentoAuthorizationCallback(entityId, status, cuenta, idVenta>0 ? idVenta : idSol) (CreditMethods.cs:221-226; OrderMethods.cs:1751-1833). That method authenticates with USER_DMZ and POSTs {entityId,status,cuenta,idSolicitud} (camelCase, :1803) with Bearer. It makes 3 attempts with a 2 s and a 4 s sleep, logs to Logger.SetOrder, and writes a final "DEFINITIVO" log.
- If the thread fails, it logs and sends the callback with RECHAZADO (:228-236).
The trigger is fire-and-forget and never changes the HTTP response.
comparisons.sap_source: No trigger runs. What exists but is never called: ServicioSap Methods/Credit/LiberadorCreditoMethods.cs, which targets the SAME LAN host (ServicioSAP Web.config:41-43), and OrderMethods.CallMagentoAuthorizationCallbackAsync (URL_DMZ localhost, Web.config:56-57). No OData or API is a functional equivalent of the Liberador service. businesspartner-dev A_POST_ComLibera.py:17-64 (ZAPIFI_COMLIBERA_SRV/LiberadorVentasSet(Vbeln)) only reads or updates Zcomlibera on an EXISTING SAP sales document (Vbeln), and in this flow none exists yet, because credit "no va a SAP aqui" (OM:1807). salesanddistribution-dev only READS ZSOC/ZANC credit documents (A_GET_DatosSolicitudCredito.py:17-21, A_GET_ValidarIdSolicitud.py:17-22). No ServicioSAP code creates them. NO EVIDENCE of a SAP-side Liberador.
comparisons.sap_detail:
Entry: POST order/new (ServicioSAP Controllers/OrderController.cs:16-48) calls SetOrderAsync. The credit branch (Methods/Order/OrderMethods.cs:1785-1808) calls ProcessCreditPaymentAsync (OM:665-766) and returns Resultado="Concluido" with Zctefinal = the returned account (OM:1802-1807). There is no validateCredit route in ServicioSAP (no match in Controllers/), and the DMZ validateCredit proxy is commented out (DMZ OrdersController.cs:366-402).
Inside ProcessCreditPaymentAsync:
- esClienteNuevo = cuenta empty AND Magento cliente non-empty (OM:672).
- The header is inserted (OM:694). Lines and the promoter code are handled inside a try/catch that swallows errors (OM:701-717).
- Then: if (esClienteNuevo) { /* commented */ } (OM:719-757). The comment block OM:724-756 is marked "PENDIENTE: Servicio de Liberador y Callback a Magento estan incompletos en DMZ" (OM:722-723).
If uncommented as written, the block would:
- capture entityId = order.entityId ?? "" (OM:725), cliente = idClienteMagento, i.e. the Magento customer id (OM:726), idSol (OM:727), and uen = storeId?.ToUpper()=="VIU" ? 2 : 1 (OM:728);
- start a Thread with a NON-async lambda that contains 'await' (OM:736, OM:746). That is CS4034 and does not compile (PLAN 18.6 B1).
- It returns esClienteNuevo ? idClienteMagento : cuentaBp (OM:759).
Dead code: LiberateClientCredit (OM:1175-1187) has no callers. CallMagentoAuthorizationCallbackAsync (OM:1192-1280) sends snake_case {entity_id,status,customer_account,credit_request_id} (OM:1249-1255), logs to Console only, and has no final "DEFINITIVO" log. The SAP LiberarCliente (LiberadorCreditoMethods.cs:48-107) is a 1:1 copy of LAN, plus a guard that returns RECHAZADO when appSettings are missing (:50-56) and Console logging. comparisons.question_for_user:
Three decisions are needed before this step can be re-enabled. The code cannot answer them.
(1) Which rule should start the Liberador in SAP? LAN starts it for existing 'C...' (casa) accounts and never for new customers. The ServicioSAP comment does the opposite: it starts it only for new customers identified by the Magento id. Should the SAP rule be 'the BP exists and is not a prospect', using the existing EsProspecto(bp) / To_Cte.ZtipoCliente logic the way salesanddistribution-dev does it, or something else?
(2) Which customer value should go to the Liberador: the 10-digit BP, the old Intelisis 'C...' account, or the Magento id? And will the Liberador at 172.16.215.51:3026, which writes to Intelisis Venta, still be used after the migration, or is it replaced by something on the SAP side? Nothing in businesspartner-dev or salesanddistribution-dev creates the credit document.
(3) Which callback payload does the DMZ order/authorizationResult endpoint expect: camelCase {entityId, status, cuenta, idSolicitud} as the DMZ code in the share binds it, or snake_case {entity_id, status, customer_account, credit_request_id} as ServicioSAP sends it?

comparisons.lan_detail:
CALL SITE, LAN Metodos/CreditMethods.cs, inside ProductosCreditoWeb_SaveData. Everything below only runs when these hold:
- checkCliente(data[0]) is true (:124). Otherwise it returns "sin cuenta" (:255-258).
- SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS returned an IdSolicitud (:199; it comes from SCOPE_IDENTITY in SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS.sql:346-348).

It then captures entityId, cliente = data[0], idSol = int.Parse(IdSolicitud) and uen (:210-213). It starts a background Thread (:215, :239-240) that calls LiberarCliente(cliente, idSol, uen) (:219-220) and then OrderMethods.CallMagentoAuthorizationCallback(entityId, resultado.Status, cliente, IdVenta>0 ? IdVenta : idSol) (:221-226). If the thread throws, it writes Logger.SetOrder and sends a RECHAZADO callback with idSol (:228-237). The status is not checked (res "insuficiente" or "OK"). It is fire-and-forget, and the method returns res (:243).
INPUTS, from LAN Metodos/OrderMethods.cs SetPedido:
- data[0] = infoCliente["cuenta"] (:627), for example "C00000020"
- uen = storeId == "viu" ? 2 : 1 (:628, case-sensitive)

SetPedido returns infoCliente["cuenta"] no matter what happened (:649). It is also reachable from POST /validateCredit (Controllers/OrdersController.cs:456-482), which answers {status:"PROCESANDO", cuenta}.
METHOD, LAN Metodos/LiberadorCreditoMethods.cs:40-101:

- WebClient with Content-Type application/json and UTF8 (:56-59). POST {"Password":...} to the auth URL (:61-64). The token is the raw body with quotes trimmed, sent as the Authorization header without a "Bearer" prefix (:66). Content-Type is added again (:67).

- idVenta>0: logs and returns EN_ANALISIS with IdVenta (:76-86). Otherwise: logs and returns EN_ANALISIS with IdVenta 0 (:88-93). Any exception: logs "Error [id] Type - msg" and returns RECHAZADO with 0 (:96-100). AUTORIZADO is never returned.

comparisons.question_for_user: 1) Is the liberador service at 172.16.215.51:3026 still part of the flow once SAP replaces Intelisis? The LAN comment at LiberadorCreditoMethods.cs:78-80 and PLAN line 1045 say it creates an Intelisis Venta. If yes, what should trigger it in place of cuenta.StartsWith("C") now that accounts are numeric BPs? comparisons.lan_source: SpVTASInsertArtSolCreditoLinea (IntelisisTmp; INSERT...SELECT into MAVIANDROID01.ServicioAndroid.dbo.VTASdArtCreditoWeb, SPL:208, :243-262) called once per line from CreditoWeb_InsertArticulo; SpVTASVentaCupon via CodigoPromocion(...,"Elimina",...); Logger.Credit -> C:\inetpub\wwwroot\log\credit.log (Helper/Logger.cs:79-87, no try)

A condition not in VTASCCondicionesCredVtaLinea or a SKU without PropreListaDFinal price is NOT a failure: the SP's INSERT...SELECT JOIN returns 0 rows silently (SPL:243-262) while SEGU00001 still inserts (SPL:179-217), the promo is burned and the Liberador still runs for 'C' accounts. Inner try OM:701-710 wraps InsertCreditArticlesAsync (OM:703) and, only if it returns, HandlePromoCodeAsync(...,"Elimina") (OM:705-709; PLAN 20.1 fix #11). catch OM:711-717 logs Logger.SAP("[CREDITO ARTICULOS ERROR] ", "solicitud=.. incrementId=.. cuenta=.. :: msg") plus Console "quedo SIN LINEAS DE ARTICULO", then continues; the commented Liberador block OM:719-757 comes after the catch; returns cuenta (OM:759). comparisons.question_for_user: Decision 9 says a missing payment condition must 'stop and notify'. Which of these do you want? (a) Check the condition BEFORE the header insert at OM:694 and return 'Error, ...' to Magento, with no solicitud written. (b) Keep the header and just mark or notify, and if so, through which channel: the Resultado/Message of order/new, an email, or a status column. Also, should every line failure (for example an SD29 HTTP error mid-loop) keep LAN's 'log and answer success', or be notified too? Last, can Magento/Omnipro confirm how they treat an HTTP 200 'WebException: ...' body from the DMZ (the Logger-throw case): do they retry? A retry would create a second solicitud.

comparisons.name: Promoter code burn and regeneration (credit setOrder)
comparisons.lan_source: SP IntelisisTmp.dbo.SpVTASVentaCupon, called with @opcion='Elimina'. It then calls itself with 'NUEVO'. It reads and writes table VTASCVentaCupon and reads Intelisis Agente JOIN Sucursal. Connection: sCadenaConexion = MAVICUBOS / IntelisisTmp (LAN Conn/Connection.cs:26), not ServicioAndroid.
comparisons.lan_detail:
Abbreviations: LAN = //172.16.214.58/sap/LAN/WebApiMagento, SP = .agents/skills/lan-sap-migration/SPsOrden/SpVTASVentaCupon.sql.
(1) Input. data[6] = infoCliente["codigo_promotor"] if the key exists, otherwise "" (LAN Metodos/OrderMethods.cs:633). data[2] = order.incrementId (:629). infoCliente is a Dictionary<string,string> (Models/OrderRequest.cs:20), so a JSON null stays null.
(2) Gate. The burn runs only if all of these hold: checkCliente(cuenta) is true (CreditMethods.cs:124, otherwise "sin cuenta" at :255-258); SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS returned an IdSolicitud (:199); CreditoWeb_InsertArticulo did not throw (:201; it has no try, :869-919); data[6].Length > 0 (:203). It runs before the Liberador thread starts (:208-241). Insufficient balance does not block it (res is only computed at :126-133).
(3) CodigoPromocion(code, "Elimina", idMagento) at CreditMethods.cs:392-463. It logs the input (:394). It runs the SP with @opcion, @Codigo, @IdEcommerce = idMagento ?? "" (:405-410), CommandTimeout 120 (:414). Any exception is logged to file and returns "err" (:424-428).
(4) SP 'Elimina' (SP:115-136). UPDATE TOP(1) on the newest free row: Codigo=@codigo AND FechaUtilizacion IS NULL ORDER BY IdVentaCupon DESC, SET FechaUtilizacion=GETDATE(), IdEcommerce=@IdEcommerce (:118-128). Then it always runs EXEC 'NUEVO' with @Agente=@codigo (:130-135), even if 0 rows were updated and without any promoter validation.
(5) 'NUEVO' (SP:137-165). @Sucursal comes from Agente JOIN Sucursal ON SucursalEmpresa WHERE Agente=@Agente (:139-144). INSERT VTASCVentaCupon(Codigo, Agente, FechaEnvio, Cliente, Sucursal) VALUES(@Agente, @Agente, GETDATE(), NULL, @Sucursal) (:146-159). Because @Nuevo=0 it returns SELECT @Agente AS cupon (:161-164).
(6) Parameter widths silently truncate: @Codigo VARCHAR(30), @IdEcommerce VARCHAR(20), @Agente VARCHAR(10) (SP:52-54). The regenerated Codigo/Agente is at most 10 characters.
(7) Return value. The result set has 1 row, so "Eliminado" (CreditMethods.cs:454-460) is never set and the method returns "" on success. The caller only logs it (:205). setOrder always returns infoCliente["cuenta"] (OrderMethods.cs:649).
(8) Related step (validation). LAN ValidarCupon inserts a free row for a valid employee who has no row yet (SP:91-105, @Nuevo=1). That row is what 'Elimina' later stamps with the order.
comparisons.sap_source: Inline SQL on SIGMavi.VentasCupones (Helpers/ConexionDB/ConexionSQL.cs:72-79, server alias DEVMAVI in Web.config:159-161). Android API employees/get_personalById (SuccessFactors, BusinessPartnerMethods.cs:342-374). AWS AI_GET_CatalogoConfiguracion?NOMBRECATALOGO=Código de promotor (ProductMethods.cs:708-735). businesspartner-api AS_GET_ZQBP_AGENTE: ZQBP_AGENTE_SRV/AgenteAttrSet, which zero-pads Zagente to 10 characters and returns Werks (businesspartner-dev/apps/api/routes/AS_ZQBP_AGENTE.py:72-114). S/4 ZAPI_SUCURSALES_SRV/SucursalesSet $filter=Sucursal eq '<Werks>' (AccountMethods.cs:185-221).
comparisons.sap_detail:
Abbreviations: SS = //172.16.214.58/sap/ServicioSAP/ServicioSap/ServicioSap, OM = SS/Methods/Order/OrderMethods.cs.
(1) Input. order.infoCliente?.codigo_promotor ?? "" (OM:705; the model field is a string, Models/SAP/Order/InfoClienteRequest.cs:56). idMagento = order.incrementId (OM:708).
(2) Gate. The burn needs all of these: the customer is not a guest (OM:675-676); if not a new customer, CheckClientCreditAsync(BP) passes (OM:679-682); CrearSolicitudCreditoAsync > 0 (OM:694-696); InsertCreditArticlesAsync did not throw (OM:701-703, same try, PLAN §20 #11); !IsNullOrWhiteSpace(code) (OM:706). The return value is discarded (OM:708). Any exception is swallowed by the catch at OM:711-717. The caller returns Resultado="Concluido" with Zctefinal=cuenta (OM:1800-1807). The Liberador and callback are commented out (OM:719-757).
(3) HandlePromoCodeAsync (OM:1028-1170). A blank code returns "OK" (OM:1032-1033). Validity check first:
 (a) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM VentasCupones WHERE Codigo=@Codigo AND FechaUtilizacion IS NULL on SIGMavi (OM:1039-1051);
 (b) if the count is 0: SuccessFactors get_personalById?user_id={code}&status=0 (BusinessPartnerMethods.cs:350), then AWS catalog 'Código de promotor'. The code is valid if any row has Valor1==Department AND Valor2==Title (case-insensitive, OM:1059-1076). Errors are swallowed (OM:1079-1082).
(4) Only when operacion=="Elimina" && cuponValido (OM:1091):
 - UPDATE VentasCupones SET FechaUtilizacion=GETDATE(), IdEcommerce=@IdEcommerce WHERE Codigo=@Codigo AND FechaUtilizacion IS NULL. This updates every free row, not TOP 1 (OM:1093-1102).
 - URL_BP_API is required, otherwise it throws after the UPDATE (OM:1106-1107).
 - HTTP GET AS_GET_ZQBP_AGENTE?Zagente={code}, unescaped, with no try around it (OM:1108-1122). It reads d.results[0].Werks.
 - GetSucursalAsync(Werks) filters on Sucursal eq Werks and returns Sucursal, so it only echoes or validates Werks. It has its own try (OM:1124-1140).
 - INSERT VentasCupones(Codigo, Agente, FechaEnvio, BP, Centro) VALUES(@Agente, @Agente, GETDATE(), NULL, @Centro), with Centro = int.TryParse(Sucursal) or NULL (OM:1142-1158).
 - Returns "OK" (OM:1160).
(5) Otherwise it returns "OK" or "NO_VALIDO" and writes nothing (OM:1163). Any exception gives Console.WriteLine and "err" (OM:1165-1169).
(6) Values go through AddWithValue (nvarchar) with no truncation (OM:1098-1099, 1154-1155). SQL commands use the default 30 s timeout. HttpClient calls use the default 100 s timeout.
(7) The SS validation endpoint (order/validatecupon, Controllers/OrderController.cs:102-120) never inserts a row (OM:1085-1088). However, the DMZ still sends Magento's credit/codigoPromocion to LAN: DMZ Controllers/CreditController.cs:135, then Helper/Curl.cs:106 with Ip=URL_INTELISIS. Credit setOrder goes to SS order/new (DMZ OrdersController.cs:196).

differences.what: Different data store, and validation and burn now write to two different databases
differences.lan: IntelisisTmp.dbo.VTASCVentaCupon on MAVICUBOS (SP:1, :121, :146; CreditMethods.cs:401; Connection.cs:26). LAN ValidarCupon inserts the employee's row in the same table that 'Elimina' later stamps (SP:97-105).
differences.sap: SIGMavi.VentasCupones on alias DEVMAVI (ConexionSQL.cs:79; OM:1041, 1095, 1144). Validation still goes to LAN through the DMZ (DMZ CreditController.cs:135, Curl.cs:106 URL_INTELISIS), so rows LAN creates at validation are never visible to the SS burn. IntelisisTmp rows are never stamped again.
differences.evidence: There is no DDL or data-migration evidence for VentasCupones. PLAN §18.8 (SIGMAVI row) leaves open whether VentasCupones equals VTASCVentaCupon. LAN would have stamped the IntelisisTmp row with FechaUtilizacion and IdEcommerce=CRED511270. In SS that row stays free and nothing in IntelisisTmp records the sale.

differences.lan: 'Elimina' always runs the UPDATE and then always EXEC 'NUEVO', with no validation, even when 0 rows were updated or the code is unknown (SP:115-136).
differences.sap: UPDATE and INSERT run only if cuponValido (OM:1091): there is a free row (OM:1041-1049), or SuccessFactors plus the AWS catalog accept the code (OM:1054-1083). Otherwise it writes nothing and returns NO_VALIDO, which is discarded (OM:1163, 708).
differences.evidence: SP:130-135 against OM:1091. The runbook has no decision on gating the burn.
differences.concrete_case: Code E016881 has no free row in VentasCupones, and get_personalById?user_id=E016881 returns [] (captures only show numeric IDs such as 30001558). LAN would insert a new row Codigo=E016881, Agente=E016881, Sucursal=<agent branch>. SS writes nothing, so the promoter never gets a free row and later SS validations return NO_VALIDO.
differences.decision_ref: None

differences.what: On a promoter's first use, no row records the order (IdEcommerce)
differences.lan: LAN ValidarCupon inserts the row (SP:97-105, @Nuevo=1). 'Elimina' then stamps that row with FechaUtilizacion and IdEcommerce (SP:118-128), and a new free row is inserted.
differences.sap: SS ValidarCupon returns without inserting (OM:1085-1088). At burn time the UPDATE matches 0 rows (OM:1095), and only a new free row is inserted (OM:1144). The order number is not stored anywhere.
differences.concrete_case: The employee is valid in SuccessFactors and the catalog, and VentasCupones has no rows. Order CRED600001 runs. SS result: 1 free row and 0 rows with IdEcommerce='CRED600001'. LAN result: 1 row used by CRED600001 plus 1 free row.

differences.what: UPDATE scope: TOP 1 newest free row versus all free rows
differences.lan: WITH Cupon AS (SELECT TOP(1) ... WHERE Codigo=@codigo AND FechaUtilizacion IS NULL ORDER BY IdVentaCupon DESC) UPDATE Cupon (SP:118-128)
differences.sap: UPDATE VentasCupones ... WHERE Codigo=@Codigo AND FechaUtilizacion IS NULL, with no TOP (OM:1095)
differences.evidence: SP:120-124 against OM:1095

SS marks both as used by CRED511270, so after the insert there is 1 free row. Reports that count stamped rows would see 2 sales for 1 order.
differences.decision_ref: None

differences.what: The branch/centro of the regenerated row comes from a different source and ID space, and may be NULL
