comparisons.question_for_user:
1) Where should the promoter code live? The options are SIGMavi `VentasCupones` (what the code uses), SIGMavi `VentaCupon` (the name agreed in CHECKLIST_DEV3:315-317), or IntelisisTmp.VTASCVentaCupon for now. Today the DMZ still sends credit/codigoPromocion (validation) to LAN, which writes IntelisisTmp. The credit setOrder goes to ServicioSAP, which reads and writes SIGMavi. Will the existing VTASCVentaCupon rows be migrated, and will validation move to order/validatecupon at the same time?
2) After the migration, will Magento send the Intelisis employee code (for example E016881) or the SAP/SuccessFactors personnel number (for example 300xxxxx) in codigo_promotor? SuccessFactors lookups and ZQBP_AGENTE (Zagente zero-padded to 10) only make sense with the SAP number.
3) Should the burn match LAN exactly: stamp TOP 1 newest free row and always regenerate, with no validation? Or do you want the current gate (all free rows, regenerate only when valid)?
4) Who reads the stamped rows (FechaUtilizacion/IdEcommerce), for example commission reports, and from which database?
Runbook notes: PLAN:102 says LAN reads 'VentasCupones'; it is actually VTASCVentaCupon. PLAN:1161 says the catalog name goes through Uri.EscapeDataString, but ProductMethods.cs:711 builds the URL without escaping. System.Uri most likely percent-encodes it, so no functional impact was shown. No embedded instructions were found in the documents read. The Hoppscotch manual contains plaintext credentials, which were not copied here.

comparisons.name: Stock/price/region validation (not run for credit)
comparisons.lan_source: LAN/WebApiMagento/Metodos/OrderMethods.cs SetPedido (:533-733) -> detallePedido (:963-1079) -> SP IntelisisTmp.dbo.SpVTASeCommerceDetPedidos (SPsOrden/SpVTASeCommerceDetPedidos.sql), @Opc='Limpiar' and @Opc='Insertar'. Tables: eCommerceDetPedidos (write), Art.Familia, VTASCRegionSku, VTASCCodigoPostalRegionCelular, eCommerceExist and VTASDEcommerceExportaArtExistencia (read). The price/region/stock validation that can block (SP_eCommerceNuevoPed.sql:146-200 and :728 'PrecioIncorrecto') is only reached through crearPedido (:662).
comparisons.lan_detail:
The claim "LAN side: NONE for credit" is only half right. LAN has no validation that can block a credit order. But between AgruparCantidadPorSKU/ToArray and the credit branch, it does run the e-commerce detail staging, and that staging contains region and stock logic.
1) The try block opens at OrderMethods.cs:576. At :582, detallePedido("Limpiar") calls the SP with @Opc='Limpiar', which runs DELETE FROM eCommerceDetPedidos WHERE IdPedido=@IdMag AND RefPedidoIntelisis IS NULL (SP:155-162).
2) The loop at :584-601 goes over each line. :588 runs float.Parse(descuento), and :596 checks float.Parse(precio) > 0 & float.Parse(cantidad) > 0. For each line that passes, :599 calls detallePedido("Insertar", storeId, incrementId, sku, precio, precioEspecial, cantidad, descuento, entityId, infoCliente["codigoPostal"], recogeSucursal). detallePedido maps UEN to muebles_america=1, viu=2 or mavi=3 (:971-982) and runs int.Parse on cantidad (:984-990).
3) SP 'Insertar' (SP:12-153) reads Art.Familia. For TELEFONIA items that have a pair in VTASCRegionSku (SP:21-53), the SP may swap Region5 and Region6, but only when the target variant has global e-commerce stock > 0 (eCommerceExist / VTASDEcommerceExportaArtExistencia, SP:63-72 and :101-110). The CP decides the target region: an active CP in VTASCCodigoPostalRegionCelular means R6, anything else means R5. The SP then runs INSERT INTO eCommerceDetPedidos (UEN, IdPedido, Articulo = swapped or original SKU, Precio, PrecioEspecial, Descuento, Cantidad, idOrden, RecogerEnSucursal) (SP:135 and :149). Nothing in this path blocks the order.
4) detallePedido catches only SqlException and logs it (:1072-1075), so a DB error does not abort. Any other exception inside the try, for example a FormatException from float.Parse at :588 or :596, goes to catch :728-730, and :732 returns sRespuestaPedido = "".
5) :606 SaveGuide. The credit branch starts at :609 and returns order.infoCliente["cuenta"] at :649.
Price validation is not run for credit. 'PrecioIncorrecto' comes only from SP_eCommerceNuevoPed (:186, :728) through crearPedido (:662), and CorreoErrorPrecio is commented out (:723-726). Blocking stock validation is also not run: no SQL stock check exists before :649 other than the non-blocking swap in step 3.
Downstream readers of the staged rows in LAN: UpdateCreditOrderId renames CRED... to the real incrementId and sets IdOrden (:2019-2045, route updateCreditOrderId OrdersController.cs:506-534). CodigoRecogerSucursal.OrderId reads idOrden by IdPedido (StorePickup/CodigoRecogerSucursal.cs:28-31).
Caller: setOrder returns Ok(cuenta) (OrdersController.cs:151-160). validateCredit returns {status:"PROCESANDO", cuenta} (:470-475).
comparisons.sap_source: ServicioSAP/Methods/Order/OrderMethods.cs SetOrderAsync (:1728-1953), FASE 4 (:1810-1830). ValidarPreciosConProperlistAsync (:1965) uses SD29 FinalListProper by SKU. ValidarStockArticulosAsync (:2026) uses DIM11 through _productMethods.GetStockAsync(material, plant). ValidarRegionCelulares (:2086) is SKU-string heuristic code with no data source. There is no counterpart of SpVTASeCommerceDetPedidos or eCommerceDetPedidos (comment at :527-528). There is no updateCreditOrderId route (grep in ServicioSAP *.cs returns zero hits).
comparisons.sap_detail:
For credit, none of the FASE 4 validations run.
- SetOrderAsync runs AgruparCantidadPorSKU/ToArray (:1740-1742) and the idempotency check (:1747-1759).
- The credit branch is `if (orderRequest.metodoPago == CREDIT_METHOD)` at :1785, with CREDIT_METHOD = "omnipro_pago_credito" at :44. The comparison is case-sensitive, the same as LAN :31 and :609.
- Inside the branch: SaveGuideAsync (:1787), then the articulos list (:1789-1795), the SMS and validated number (:1797-1798), and ProcessCreditPaymentAsync (:1800). It then returns OrderResponse{Resultado="Concluido", Zctefinal=cuentaCredito, Zidecomm=incrementId} at :1802-1807.
- ValidarPreciosConProperlistAsync (:1820), ValidarStockArticulosAsync (:1823-1827) and ValidarRegionCelulares (:1830) come after that return, so credit never reaches them.
- Nothing is staged for credit, and no region or stock read happens on the credit path. The comment at :527-528 says DetallePedido was removed because the lines travel in BuildSapOrder().to_items, but credit never builds an SAP order here (comment at :1807).
- Precio and cantidad are typed: decimal precio and int cantidad in Models/SAP/Order/ArticuloRequest.cs:7 and :11. No float.Parse abort path exists.
- An exception inside the credit branch is caught at :1950 and rethrown. OrderController.cs:36-47 then answers Ok("Error, " + message). On success the controller answers {BP, SalesDocument, Message, Resultado} (OrderController.cs:27-35). That response-contract difference belongs to the response step, not this one.
Latent contado-only defects, unreachable for credit (reported for context, not counted as credit differences):
- :1816 takes sDatosPedido[20], which is estado (:272), not codigoPostal (:269). This is D-02 in the runbook, §21.4.
- DeterminarPlant has a credit plant (0504/0505, :370-377) that SetOrderAsync can never use, because credit exits at :1802.

differences.what: LAN stages the credit order's lines in eCommerceDetPedidos (DELETE by IdPedido, then one INSERT per line with precio>0 and cantidad>0) before the credit branch. ServicioSAP writes no staging row at all for credit.
differences.lan: OrderMethods.cs:582 runs detallePedido('Limpiar'), which is the SP DELETE at SpVTASeCommerceDetPedidos.sql:155-162. The loop at :584-601 calls detallePedido('Insertar') per line, which is the SP INSERT at :135/:149. All of this happens before `if CREDIT_METHOD` at :609. The rows are later renamed by UpdateCreditOrderId (:2019-2045) and read by CodigoRecogerSucursal.OrderId (StorePickup/CodigoRecogerSucursal.cs:28-31).
differences.sap: No equivalent. OrderMethods.cs:527-528 says DetallePedido was removed. The credit branch at :1785-1807 writes only the guide and the credit application. No updateCreditOrderId route exists in ServicioSAP.
differences.evidence: LAN OrderMethods.cs:576-609. SPsOrden/SpVTASeCommerceDetPedidos.sql:12-162. SS OrderMethods.cs:527-528 and :1785-1808. The runbook sections 9, 10 and 15-21 contain no decision on this. Other documents disagree: FLUJO_CREDITO_LAN_VS_SAP.md:326 says the table 'muere: no requiere equivalencia'; MATRIZ_REGLAS_CREDITO_WEB_LAN_VS_SAP.md:156 (G4-02) and :219-220 (G5-21/22) mark it FALTA; AUDITORIA_INTEGRAL_LAN_DMZ_SAP.md:856 lists it as a pending decision.
differences.concrete_case: Real payload CRED515773 (magento_payloads.md:26): storeId muebles_america, OSTE00443, cantidad 1, precio 8198.0000, entityId 515773. LAN runs DELETE eCommerceDetPedidos WHERE IdPedido='CRED515773' AND RefPedidoIntelisis IS NULL, then INSERTs (UEN=1, IdPedido='CRED515773', Articulo='OSTE00443', Precio=8198, PrecioEspecial=8198, Descuento=0, Cantidad=1, idOrden='515773', RecogerEnSucursal=0). ServicioSAP writes no such row anywhere, so a later updateCreditOrderId(CRED515773 to the real id) has nothing to rename and no route to call.

differences.what: TELEFONIA region-SKU substitution with a stock check (global e-commerce stock) runs for credit in LAN inside the staging SP. ServicioSAP has no region or stock logic on the credit path, and its only region code (ValidarRegionCelulares, a -R5/-R6 heuristic) is unreachable for credit.
differences.lan: SpVTASeCommerceDetPedidos.sql:16-133: Art.Familia='TELEFONIA' plus a VTASCRegionSku pair. An active CP in VTASCCodigoPostalRegionCelular targets R6, otherwise R5. The SKU is swapped only if the target has stock > 0 in eCommerceExist/VTASDEcommerceExportaArtExistencia (:63-72, :101-110). The swapped SKU is written to eCommerceDetPedidos.Articulo (:135). The CP comes from infoCliente['codigoPostal'] (OrderMethods.cs:599).
differences.sap: None for credit (return at OrderMethods.cs:1802). ValidarRegionCelulares (:2086-2151) is only on the contado path (:1830), and it also receives estado instead of CP (:1816 vs :272).
differences.evidence: The runbook §21.4 (lines 1596-1622) covers the same rule for the credit lines SP (SpVTASInsertArtSolCreditoLinea) and records 'Recomendación: esperar fuente'. That is pending, not a decision to drop. §21.4 line 1609 also calls SpVTASeCommerceDetPedidos 'el contado de LAN', which is inaccurate: LAN runs it for credit too (OrderMethods.cs:582-601 run before :609).
differences.concrete_case: Credit order for a TELEFONIA SKU that is SkuRegion5 of a VTASCRegionSku pair, CP active in VTASCCodigoPostalRegionCelular, and the Region6 SKU with e-commerce stock > 0. LAN stages the Region6 SKU in eCommerceDetPedidos. ServicioSAP stages nothing and reads no stock. Magento's response is the same in both, because the swap never blocks.

differences.what: Failure mode that exists only in LAN: a non-numeric precio makes the staging loop throw, and LAN aborts the credit order without creating the credit application. ServicioSAP has typed fields and no staging parse, so it continues and creates the application.
differences.lan: float.Parse(precio) at OrderMethods.cs:596 (or float.Parse(descuento) at :588) is inside the try. A FormatException goes to catch :728-730, and :732 returns "". No credit application is created, because :609 is never reached. SQL errors do NOT abort, because detallePedido swallows SqlException at :1072-1075. The legacy DMZ answered 500 'LAN retornó vacío' for "" (DMZ OrdersController.cs:145-150, now commented out).
differences.sap: ArticuloRequest.precio is decimal (ArticuloRequest.cs:7). No parse happens on the credit path, so the flow reaches ProcessCreditPaymentAsync (:1800) and returns Resultado='Concluido' (:1802-1807). NO EVIDENCE from a real request of how Web API 2 binds a malformed decimal; MATRIZ_REGLAS_CREDITO_WEB_LAN_VS_SAP.md:35 says it defaults to 0 but admits it was not tested.
differences.evidence: LAN OrderMethods.cs:576-601, :728-732, :1072-1075. SS Models/SAP/Order/ArticuloRequest.cs:7 and OrderMethods.cs:1785-1807. The runbook has no decision on this. Real payloads always carry numeric prices (magento_payloads.md:26 '8198.0000', :55 '444.0000'), so this is theoretical.
differences.concrete_case: Credit payload with articulos[0].precio = "" (other fields as CRED515848). LAN: AgruparCantidadPorSKU does not parse precio, :596 float.Parse("") throws, and setOrder returns "" with no row in CRED_SOLICITUD_WEB_DATOS_TEMP. ServicioSAP: the credit application is created and the response is Resultado='Concluido'.

comparisons.question_for_user:
1) For credit orders, should ServicioSAP keep any counterpart of LAN's eCommerceDetPedidos staging (SetPedido writes it at OrderMethods.cs:582-601, before the credit branch)? Or is the table officially dropped? The documents disagree: FLUJO_CREDITO_LAN_VS_SAP.md:326 says it "muere: no requiere equivalencia", MATRIZ G4-02/G5-21/G5-22 mark it FALTA, and AUDITORIA:856 lists it as a pending decision. The runbook has no decision. This matters because LAN's updateCreditOrderId renames those rows (CRED... to the real incrementId), and that route does not exist in ServicioSAP either.
2) If the planned post-authorization SAP credit order reuses SetOrderAsync without the early exit at :1785-1808, FASE 4 would run a blocking DIM11 stock check at plant 0504/0505 (OM:1823-1827, :370-377). LAN never blocked a credit order on stock. Should credit ever be blocked on stock?

comparisons.name: Partner resolution / BP creation (not run for credit)
comparisons.lan_source: No partner lookup and no account creation for credit. The customer identifier is OrderRequest.infoCliente["cuenta"] (a Dictionary<string,string>), used exactly as received. The only master-data touch is an existence check inside ProductosCreditoWeb_SaveData: SpCREDIDatosSolicitudCreditoArt @Op='CheckCliente', which runs COUNT(cliente) on the Intelisis CTE table.
comparisons.sap_source: ResolvePartnerNumberForOrderAsync reads no data for its credit branch. BP creation POSTs to ZAPI_BP01_PARTNER_SRV/BPartnerSet (BusinessPartnerMethods.cs:76; the same service appears in businesspartner-dev apps/api/models/config.py:14). Neither can run for a canonical credit order. On the credit path the customer is identified from infoCliente.cuenta plus an existence check: GET ZB_DATOS_CLIENTE_CDS/ZB_DATOS_CLIENTE?$filter=BusinessPartner eq '{cuenta}' (BusinessPartnerMethods.cs:30). The reference route AS_GET_ZB_DATOS_CLIENTE.py:23-26 confirms this CDS view is keyed by BusinessPartner.
comparisons.lan_detail:
Abbreviations: LAN = //172.16.214.58/sap/LAN/WebApiMagento. DMZ = //172.16.214.58/sap/DMZ/WebApiMagento.

1. How LAN detects credit. LAN Metodos/OrderMethods.cs:31 sets CREDIT_METHOD = "omnipro_pago_credito". SetPedido (:533) enters the credit branch at :609 only on an exact, case-sensitive match (order.metodoPago == CREDIT_METHOD).

2. Which customer the credit branch uses. The branch takes order.infoCliente["cuenta"] exactly as received, with no trim or lookup: it is passed to ObtenerNumeroTablaSms (:619), IsValidated (:620) and data[0] of ProductosCreditoWeb_SaveData (:627). The branch then returns that same value at :649.

3. No partner resolution or account creation. For credit, LAN never calls crearPedido, GetCreatedAccount, SP_eCommerceNuevoPed or any Cte creation. Lines :652-732 are unreachable because :649 returns first.

4. Existence check. Metodos/CreditMethods.cs:124 calls checkCliente(data[0]) (:725-763), which runs SpCREDIDatosSolicitudCreditoArt @Op='CheckCliente'. The SP returns 1 when COUNT(cliente) FROM CTE > 0 (SPsOrden/SpCREDIDatosSolicitudCreditoArt.sql:37-51).
   - Any SQL error is swallowed and treated as false (:757-762).
   - When the check fails, the method returns "sin cuenta" (:255-258) and inserts nothing. SetPedido ignores that return value.

5. What the caller gets. Controllers/OrdersController.cs:151 and :160 return Ok(<cuenta>), HTTP 200.
   - If the "cuenta" key is missing, :619 throws KeyNotFoundException. The catch at :728 swallows it and :732 returns "".
   - If "cuenta" is present but empty, the result is also "", with no row inserted.

comparisons.sap_detail:
Abbreviations: OM = //172.16.214.58/sap/ServicioSAP/ServicioSap/ServicioSap/Methods/Order/OrderMethods.cs. BP = .../Methods/BusinessPartner/BusinessPartnerMethods.cs. Line numbers are from the current working tree.

1. Why the step never runs for credit. SetOrderAsync starts at OM:1728. The credit early exit at OM:1785 compares orderRequest.metodoPago == CREDIT_METHOD (OM:44, "omnipro_pago_credito") exactly and case-sensitively, the same test as LAN :609. It returns at OM:1802-1807 with {Resultado="Concluido", Zctefinal=cuentaCredito, Zidecomm}. So the only call to ResolvePartnerNumberForOrderAsync (OM:1833) is never reached for credit.

2. Call-graph check (whole project, *.cs):
   - ResolvePartnerNumberForOrderAsync: only caller is OM:1833.
   - CreatePartnerNumberFromOrderAsync (OM:2612-2627): called only from OM:2575, :2577 and :2604.
   - BuildBpClientFromOrder (OM:2629-2951): called only from OM:2614.
   - SubmitClientInfoAsync: called only from OM:2618 and BusinessPartnerController.cs:47 and :68.
   - MapGender (BP:777-796): used only at BP:482 (BuildClientFromCustomerRequest, customer sign-up) and OM:2666 (BuildBpClientFromOrder).
   - BP address creation (OM:1490) and the setCAccount webhook (OM:1944) both sit after the early exit.
   - Conclusion: no BP lookup, BP creation, address creation or setCAccount call happens on the credit path, exactly as in LAN.
   - The MapGender unification is INTENTIONAL (PLAN §17.3) but has no effect on credit. CrearSolicitudCreditoAsync sends Sexo="" (OM:810) and never calls MapGender.

3. Dead code. The credit branch inside the resolver (OM:2557-2558) leads to ResolveCreditMAPartner (OM:2580-2586), which trims cuenta and throws if it is empty. It is unreachable for the canonical value and contradicts ProcessCreditPaymentAsync, which accepts an empty cuenta. ValidarOrdenCompleta (OM:387) and ValidateOrderRequest (OM:2537) have no live callers.

4. What actually identifies the customer on the credit path: ProcessCreditPaymentAsync (OM:665-766).
   - cuentaBp = infoCliente.cuenta ?? "", untrimmed (OM:669).
   - A request with no cuenta but a Magento cliente is treated as a new client; with neither it is a guest, and a guest throws (OM:672-676).
   - Otherwise CheckClientCreditAsync runs (OM:681-682, :768-781). It calls GetClientAsync (BP:27-69), which throws when there are no rows (BP:56-58). The catch turns any failure, including HTTP or auth errors, into false.
   - Despite the message "no tiene credito activo", the check is only an existence check, the same as LAN checkCliente.
   - Return value: new client ? idClienteMagento : cuentaBp (OM:759). It becomes Zctefinal (OM:1805) and then BP in the response (Controllers/OrderController.cs:30).
   - Errors are wrapped at OM:1953 and returned as Ok("Error, " + message), HTTP 200 (OrderController.cs:46).
   - sDatosPedido[36] is cuenta (ToArray OM:288), which is correct.

5. Liberador and Magento callback (current state only). Both are OFF: the block at OM:719-757 is commented out. Its trigger is the new-client flag, where LAN uses StartsWith("C"), and it would pass idClienteMagento as the cliente/cuenta. The runbook flags this at PLAN §21.6. LiberateClientCredit (OM:1175) has no callers. CallMagentoAuthorizationCallbackAsync (OM:1192) is referenced only inside the comment.

6. Runtime evidence. Logs/sap.log lines 1-10 show [SAP BP AUTO-CREATION] only for ZMER orders with DistrChan "01" (2000055001 and 12000055001). "CRED" appears 0 times in the log, so there is no runtime evidence for credit either way; the structural proof above is the evidence.

7. Stale runbook reference. PLAN §17.4 cites the Gender default at OM:2686; it is now at OM:2666.

8. Two out-of-scope contado bugs next to OM:1833 (not classified):
   - OM:1816 reads sDatosPedido[20] as the postal code, but ToArray puts estado there (OM:272); the postal code is [17] (OM:269).
   - OM:1919 passes sDatosPedido[16], which is numInt (OM:268), as the correo argument of RegisterPickupClientInfo (OM:1564).

comparisons.name: Authorization callback to DMZ -> Magento (result of LiberarCliente sent to rest/V1/omnipro-credito/authorizationResult)
comparisons.lan_source: No SQL/SP. HTTP chain: LAN CreditMethods.ProductosCreditoWeb_SaveData background thread -> LiberadorCreditoMethods.LiberarCliente (HTTP VETA_URL_LIBERADOR) -> OrderMethods.CallMagentoAuthorizationCallback -> DMZ POST login/authenticate + POST order/authorizationResult (body CreditAuthorizationRequest {entityId,status,cuenta,idSolicitud}) -> Magento POST rest/V1/omnipro-credito/authorizationResult (Mavi\CreditoCheckout CreditoOrderManagement::authorizationResult, writes table omnipro_credito_pending). Config: URL_DMZ, USER_DMZ (LAN Web.config:19-21; Web STAGE LAN.config:16-18).
comparisons.lan_detail: Where it starts: Magento registerCreditQuote sends entityId=quoteId, infoCliente.cliente=customerId, infoCliente.cuenta=CuentaIntelisis to the setOrder endpoint (Magento248 app/code/Omnipro/PlaceOrder/Model/OrderManagement.php:657, :703, :719, :755-771). LAN OrdersController.cs:137-160 calls SetPedido. The credit branch is at OrderMethods.cs:609-649: it calls ProductosCreditoWeb_SaveData with data[0]=infoCliente["cuenta"] (:627), UEN = storeId=="viu"?2:1 (:628) and entityId=order.entityId (:645), then returns the cuenta (:649). The callback does not change what setOrder returns. In CreditMethods.cs the callback is gated five ways: checkCliente(data[0]) must pass, otherwise it returns "sin cuenta" (:124, :255-258); an Id comes back from SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS (:199); CreditoWeb_InsertArticulo does not throw (:201; there is no try, so a throw goes to the outer catch that returns "err" at :246-252); the cuenta StartsWith("C") (:208). If all pass, it starts a background Thread (:215-240) that runs LiberarCliente(cuenta, idSolicitud, uen) (:220) and then CallMagentoAuthorizationCallback(entityId, resultado.Status, cuenta, IdVenta>0 ? IdVenta : idSolicitud) (:221-226). On an exception it logs and sends the callback with "RECHAZADO" (:228-236). Liberator statuses are only EN_ANALISIS (idVenta>0 or 0) or RECHAZADO (LiberadorCreditoMethods.cs:85, :93, :99). CallMagentoAuthorizationCallback (OrderMethods.cs:1751-1833): builds URL_DMZ+"login/authenticate" and URL_DMZ+"order/authorizationResult" (:1753-1755); deserializes USER_DMZ OUTSIDE the try (:1757-1760); retries 3 times (:1762); creates an HttpClientHandler that accepts any certificate but never uses it: `new HttpClient()` gets no handler (:1766-1768, :1775), so certificates are validated by default; 30s timeout (:1777); token POST, where a non-2xx throws (:1786-1793); trims quotes from the token (:1795); Bearer header (:1800-1801); Newtonsoft payload `new { entityId, status, cuenta, idSolicitud }` (:1803); returns on 2xx (:1816), otherwise throws (:1818); the catch writes to setOrder.log and sleeps 2s/4s (:1821-1828); after 3 failures it writes "ERROR CallMagentoCallback DEFINITIVO" (:1831-1832). It never throws to the caller. Logger.SetOrder appends to C:\inetpub\wwwroot\log\setOrder.log (LAN Helper/Logger.cs:19-27). DMZ (the same DMZ for both systems): the controller is [Authorize] (DMZ Controllers/OrdersController.cs:14). AuthorizationResult (:421-458) binds CreditAuthorizationRequest {entityId,status,cuenta,idSolicitud} (DMZ Models/CreditRequest.cs:212-218) with the default Newtonsoft formatter (no custom resolver: DMZ App_Start/WebApiConfig.cs, Global.asax.cs:14). It re-serializes the model and POSTs it to URL_MAGENTO+"rest/V1/omnipro-credito/authorizationResult" with the Magento bearer token and a 120s timeout (:427-441). Magento 2xx -> Ok(body); anything else -> 500 (:447-456). Magento: an anonymous route (Mavi/CreditoCheckout/etc/webapi.xml:39-44) with signature authorizationResult(string $entityId, string $status, string $cuenta, int $idSolicitud=0) (Api/CreditoOrderInterface.php:27). It casts entityId to a quoteId (CreditoOrderManagement.php:86) and moves the row from PENDIENTE to EN_PROCESO (:96-100); if the row is missing it throws (:102-126). EN_ANALISIS stores cuenta and id_solicitud (:135-149). AUTORIZADO places the order (:151-190). Anything else reactivates the quote (:192-205). The Magento cron (every 5 min) only polls rows with status='EN_ANALISIS' AND id_solicitud IS NOT NULL (Cron/PollCreditStatus.php:69-74; etc/crontab.xml), so this callback is the ONLY thing that moves a credit quote out of PENDIENTE.
comparisons.sap_source: No equivalent running. The code exists but is unreachable: ServicioSAP Methods/Order/OrderMethods.cs CallMagentoAuthorizationCallbackAsync (private) -> same DMZ routes login/authenticate + order/authorizationResult, same config keys URL_DMZ/USER_DMZ (SS Web.config:56-57, where URL_DMZ = https://localhost:44302/; Web.Release.config has no transform for it). Liberator port: SS Methods/Credit/LiberadorCreditoMethods.cs:48-107 (no caller). No OData/S4 API is involved in this step.
comparisons.sap_detail: The credit branch of SetOrderAsync (OM:1785-1808) calls ProcessCreditPaymentAsync and returns OrderResponse{Resultado="Concluido", Zctefinal=cuenta}. OrderController returns {BP, SalesDocument, Message, Resultado} with HTTP 200 (OrderController.cs:16-47). ProcessCreditPaymentAsync (OM:665-766): cuentaBp=infoCliente.cuenta and idClienteMagento=infoCliente.cliente (:669-670); esClienteNuevo = empty cuenta AND non-empty cliente (:672); existing customers are checked with CheckClientCreditAsync (:679-684); the solicitud is created at :694-696; lines and the promoter code run inside try/catch (:701-717, the catch only logs). THEN, outside that try, `if (esClienteNuevo)` (:720) holds the whole liberator+callback block COMMENTED OUT (:724-756), with the note that the DMZ liberator/callback are "incompletos" (:722-723). That premise is stale: the DMZ endpoint exists and works (DMZ OrdersController.cs:421-458). If the block were uncommented it would: send capturedCliente = idClienteMagento (:726); compute UEN with storeId.ToUpper()=="VIU" (:728); use `await` inside a non-async Thread lambda (:730-753, awaits at :736 and :746), which is compile error CS4034. The runbook already says not to uncomment it (PLAN 18.6 B1). It returns esClienteNuevo ? idClienteMagento : cuentaBp (:759). LiberateClientCredit (OM:1175-1187) has no caller. CallMagentoAuthorizationCallbackAsync (OM:1192-1280) is referenced only inside the comment (:736, :746), so it is dead code. What it does: same URLs (:1195-1197); USER_DMZ is passed through as raw JSON, or {Username:"",Password:""} if empty (:1200-1209); 3 attempts (:1211); HttpClientHandler that accepts ANY certificate and IS used (:1215-1216, :1223); 30s timeout (:1225); token POST, where a non-2xx throws (:1233-1239); trimmed token (:1241); Bearer (:1245-1246); System.Text.Json payload {entity_id, status, customer_account, credit_request_id} (:1249-1260); returns on 2xx (:1267), otherwise throws (:1269); the catch writes Console.WriteLine only and waits 2s/4s (:1272-1278); there is no final 'DEFINITIVO' log and nothing is written to sap.log (Logger.SAP at Helpers/Logger.cs:8-45 is not used here). The comment at OM:1283-1284 says the callback's 'connection lives in Curl', but this method does not use Helpers/ConexionDMZ/Curl.cs. Equal to LAN (if it were ever called): URL composition, the token flow, 30s timeout, 3 attempts with 2s/4s backoff, success = 2xx, never throws to the caller, RECHAZADO on a liberator exception, idSolicitud = IdVenta>0 ? IdVenta : solicitud. The liberator port matches LAN's statuses (SS LiberadorCreditoMethods.cs:92-105 vs LAN :76-99). Downstream state, report only: ServicioSAP has no creditStatus and no updateCreditOrderId routes (SS Controllers grep: none), and the DMZ still proxies creditStatus to LAN (DMZ OrdersController.cs:460-482). The runbook line references for this block (PLAN 18.5 #2 ':740-772', §3 ':755-787') are stale; the current lines are OM:719-757.

comparisons.name: Promoter code validation before burning (setOrder credit path, 'Elimina')
comparisons.lan_source: SP SpVTASVentaCupon @opcion='Elimina' on IntelisisTmp @ MAVICUBOS (LAN Conn/Connection.cs:26, used via sCadenaConexion at CreditMethods.cs:401). Tables touched in 'Elimina': VTASCVentaCupon (UPDATE + INSERT), Agente JOIN Sucursal (read, in the nested 'NUEVO' call). 'Elimina' never reads Comercializadora.dbo.Personal or TablaStD. Those two are read only in the 'ValidarCupon' branch (SCU:60-114), and nothing in the credit setOrder path calls that branch.
comparisons.lan_detail: Caller: LAN OrderMethods.cs:609 (credit branch) builds data[6] = infoCliente.ContainsKey("codigo_promotor") ? infoCliente["codigo_promotor"] : "" (:633) and data[2] = incrementId (:629). CreditMethods.ProductosCreditoWeb_SaveData: once the header returns an IdSolicitud, it calls CreditoWeb_InsertArticulo (:201, which has no try: :868-918). Then, if data[6].Length > 0 (:203), it runs Logger.Credit("INFO ", CodigoPromocion(data[6], "Elimina", data[2])) (:205). All of this sits inside the try at :135-252, so if a line fails, the catch at :246-252 returns "err" and the coupon is not burned. CodigoPromocion (:392-463): it logs "INFO codigo idMagento" to the CodigoPromocion log (:394) and executes SpVTASVentaCupon with @opcion, @Codigo, @IdEcommerce=(idMagento??"") (:403-414, CommandTimeout 120). A SQL exception logs ERROR and returns "err" (:424-428). For 'Elimina', respuesta stays "" because the SP returns one row (see below), so "Eliminado" (:456-459) is never set. The caller only logs the return value. SP 'Elimina' (SCU:115-136) has NO validation. It runs UPDATE TOP(1) VTASCVentaCupon WHERE Codigo=@codigo AND FechaUtilizacion IS NULL ORDER BY IdVentaCupon DESC SET FechaUtilizacion=GETDATE(), IdEcommerce=@IdEcommerce (:118-128), which is a silent no-op if no row matches. Then, unconditionally, it runs EXEC SpVTASVentaCupon 'NUEVO' @Agente=@codigo (:130-135). @Agente is VARCHAR(10) (:54), so the code is truncated to 10 characters. NUEVO (:137-165) takes @Sucursal from Agente JOIN Sucursal ON s.Sucursal=a.SucursalEmpresa (:139-144), NULL if the agent does not exist. It INSERTs VTASCVentaCupon(Codigo=@Agente, Agente=@Agente, FechaEnvio=GETDATE(), Cliente=NULL, Sucursal=@Sucursal) (:146-159) and returns SELECT @Agente AS cupon because @Nuevo defaults to 0 (:161-164). Net effect: every non-empty code always gets a fresh unused coupon row. What setOrder returns to Magento does not depend on this step (LAN OrderMethods.cs:649 returns the cuenta).

Only if the gate passes, the regeneration step also uses businesspartner-api AS_GET_ZQBP_AGENTE?Zagente= (OData ZQBP_AGENTE_SRV/AgenteAttrSet, businesspartner-dev/apps/api/routes/AS_ZQBP_AGENTE.py:72-176, Zagente zero-padded to 10 at :95-96) and S/4 ZAPI_SUCURSALES_SRV/SucursalesSet $filter=Sucursal eq Werks (AccountMethods.cs:185-221).
comparisons.sap_detail: Caller: ProcessCreditPaymentAsync (OM:665). Inside the try at OM:701-717, after InsertCreditArticlesAsync (OM:703), it reads codigoPromotor = infoCliente?.codigo_promotor ?? "" (OM:705). If !IsNullOrWhiteSpace (OM:706), it calls await HandlePromoCodeAsync(codigoPromotor, order.incrementId, "Elimina") (OM:708) and ignores the return value. The ordering matches LAN (runbook §20.1 #11, line 1483). HandlePromoCodeAsync (OM:1028-1170): (1) a blank code returns "OK" (OM:1032-1033; unreachable from the credit path). (2) THE GATE, which LAN does not have: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM VentasCupones WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE Codigo=@Codigo AND FechaUtilizacion IS NULL (OM:1039-1051). If the count is 0, it calls GetSuccessFactorEmployeeAsync(codigo) (OM:1059), takes element [0].Department and [0].Title (OM:1061-1064), loads catalog "Código de promotor" (OM:1066), and sets valid = any row with Valor1==Department AND Valor2==Title, whole-string OrdinalIgnoreCase with no trim (OM:1068-1071). Any exception in SF or the catalog is swallowed with a Console.WriteLine and counts as invalid (OM:1079-1082). (3) Elimina with an invalid code writes nothing and returns "NO_VALIDO" (falls through to OM:1163). (4) Elimina with a valid code runs UPDATE VentasCupones SET FechaUtilizacion=GETDATE(), IdEcommerce=@IdEcommerce WHERE Codigo=@Codigo AND FechaUtilizacion IS NULL, with no TOP 1 (OM:1093-1102). It then throws if URL_BP_API is empty (OM:1106-1107), calls the agent API and takes d.results[0].Werks (OM:1108-1122), and gets Sucursal from SucursalesSet, swallowing errors (OM:1124-1140). It INSERTs VentasCupones(Codigo=@Agente, Agente=@Agente, FechaEnvio=GETDATE(), BP=NULL, Centro=int.TryParse(Sucursal) or NULL) with the full untruncated code (OM:1142-1158) and returns "OK" (OM:1160). Any other exception returns "err" (OM:1165-1169). Nothing is written to a file log. What SetOrder returns is unaffected: "Concluido" plus the cuenta (OM:1800-1807).

differences.what: 'Elimina' is gated by a validation that LAN does not perform. If the code has no unused row and fails the SuccessFactors + AWS check, ServicioSAP writes nothing. LAN always regenerates a coupon.
differences.lan: No validation. UPDATE TOP 1 (a no-op if there is no free row), then NUEVO unconditionally INSERTs a new free coupon for the code (SCU:115-136, :146-159).
differences.sap: COUNT of free rows = 0, then SF + catalog. If invalid: no UPDATE, no INSERT, returns "NO_VALIDO" (OM:1054-1088, :1091, :1163), and the caller ignores it (OM:708).
differences.evidence: SCU:115-136; OM:1041, :1054-1083, :1091, :1163; MATRIZ_REGLAS_CREDITO_WEB_LAN_VS_SAP.md:205-206 (G5-07/G5-08) and :245-249 (4.1 #4: 'sin validación previa en Elimina, y regenerar siempre'). No runbook decision endorses the gate.
differences.decision_ref: None. MATRIZ 4.1 #4 lists it as something ServicioSAP must fix.
differences.concrete_case: codigo_promotor='E016881' (the code in the Hoppscotch 'Orden con Promotor' payload). VentasCupones has no row for it with FechaUtilizacion IS NULL, and get_personalById?user_id=E016881 returns []. LAN: UPDATE touches 0 rows, then INSERT VTASCVentaCupon(Codigo='E016881', Agente='E016881', FechaEnvio=now, Cliente=NULL, Sucursal=<agent's>). ServicioSAP: no row written, returns 'NO_VALIDO', and the promoter has no free coupon for the next sale. If the open coupons in IntelisisTmp are not migrated to SIGMAVI, every promoter takes this path at go-live.

differences.what: The gate adds two external HTTP dependencies, and it treats their failures as 'invalid' without any signal. It also adds latency to setOrder.
differences.lan: No network calls. One SP call, CommandTimeout 120 s (CreditMethods.cs:414). The only failure mode is a SQL error, which is logged to a file (:426).
differences.sap: If URL_ANDROID_API is missing, BusinessPartnerMethods.cs:345-348 throws. A non-2xx response throws at :366. AWS non-2xx or an empty body throws (ProductMethods.cs:724-725). JSON that is not a list throws. All of these are swallowed at OM:1079-1082 and treated as invalid, with Console output only. SF uses new HttpClient() with the default 100 s timeout (BP:352). AWS has a 60 s timeout (TokenGenerator.cs:103). All of this is awaited before SetOrder returns (OM:708, :1800-1807).
differences.evidence: BusinessPartnerMethods.cs:342-374; ProductMethods.cs:708-735; TokenGenerator.cs:98-111; OM:1079-1082. Moving the data to SF/AWS is intentional (resumen_dudas.md:12, runbook §15.2 lines 1138-1161). Making their outage silently disable coupon regeneration is not.
differences.decision_ref: Source routing: runbook §15.2 and Resources/resumen_dudas.md:12. The failure behavior has no decision.
differences.concrete_case: Android API unreachable, or URL_ANDROID_API absent from Web.config, for a code with no free row. LAN: a new coupon is inserted. ServicioSAP: the console shows 'Error al consultar SuccessFactors en HandlePromoCodeAsync', nothing is written, and setOrder can be delayed up to ~100 s before answering 'Concluido'.

differences.what: The validation rule is not LAN's rule, not even LAN's own 'ValidarCupon' (the only place LAN validates). Free-row check, active-employee filter, catalog shape and data domain all differ.
differences.lan: ValidarCupon (SCU:60-114): the code is valid if ANY row has that Codigo, used or not (:64-70). Otherwise Personal must have Personal=@Codigo AND Estatus='Alta' (:80-84), with Departamento and Puesto as VARCHAR(5) codes (:76-78). TablaStD must have a row TablaSt='Código de promotor' AND Nombre=Departamento, whose Valor is a comma-separated list of puestos, split and trimmed by fnSplit (:86-95; fnSplit.sql:17-21, the ServicioAndroid copy).
differences.sap: Only free rows count (OM:1041). SF lookup uses status=0 (BP:350), and AccountStatus is never checked. It compares the SF Department and Title names (OM:1063-1064), ignoring DepartmentCode and TitleCode, which the DTO does have (SuccessFactorEmployee.cs:64-77). It needs one catalog row with Valor1==Department AND Valor2==Title as whole strings, case-insensitive, with no trim (OM:1068-1071).
differences.evidence: SCU:60-114; OM:1041, :1059-1071; BusinessPartnerMethods.cs:350. The meaning of status=0 has NO EVIDENCE (the Android API source is not in the share). The catalog shape has NO EVIDENCE: the Hoppscotch 'GetCupones' request (AI_GET_CatalogoConfiguracion?NOMBRECATALOGO=Código de promotor) has empty responses, and CAPTURAS_REALES_APIS.md has none. Manual Tecnico Servicio SAP 26082026.md:293 reports that the AWS catalog holds legacy keys ('D40') while the API returns SF identifiers ('ALMACEN (20000001)'), so promoters are rejected. The data source is intentional; the rule is not.
differences.decision_ref: Source: runbook §15.2 and resumen_dudas.md:12. The rule shape has no decision.
differences.concrete_case: The catalog was loaded in the TablaStD shape: VALOR1='D40', VALOR2='P01,P02'. SF returns Department='D40', Title='P02'. LAN rule: fnSplit yields 'P02', so it matches. ServicioSAP: 'P01,P02' != 'P02', so it is invalid. A second case: the code's only row is already used. LAN ValidarCupon returns OK, but ServicioSAP requires SF again.

differences.what: In the gate, null equals null. An employee with no Title matches a catalog row with a NULL VALOR2. SQL, as LAN uses it, never matches NULL.
differences.lan: fnSplit(NULL) returns no rows, and '=' with NULL is false under ANSI_NULLS ON (SCU:4, :86-95), so the result is not valid.
differences.sap: string.Equals(null, null, OrdinalIgnoreCase) is true (OM:1068-1071), so the result is valid.
differences.evidence: OM:1068-1071. CatalogoConfiguracion.csv shows that AWS catalog rows carry NULL in their value columns (for ORIGEN VALIDACION NUMERO CTE). The contents of 'Código de promotor' have NO EVIDENCE.
differences.decision_ref: None
differences.concrete_case: SF returns Department='D40' and Title=null. The catalog has a row VALOR1='D40', VALOR2=NULL. ServicioSAP: valid, so it burns and regenerates. LAN's rule would reject it (and LAN 'Elimina' regenerates regardless).

differences.what: For a first-time promoter, the order is recorded on no coupon row. ServicioSAP's ValidarCupon (same method) does not create the coupon, so at setOrder the UPDATE matches nothing and the IdEcommerce is lost.
differences.lan: At checkout Magento calls ValidarCupon (omnipro_pago_credito-method.js:784-800) and places the order only on "OK". For a valid employee with no row, the SP inserts R1 through NUEVO @Nuevo=1 (SCU:91-105). At setOrder, 'Elimina' burns R1 with IdEcommerce=incrementId (SCU:118-128) and inserts R2.
differences.sap: ValidarCupon returns "OK" without inserting (OM:1085-1088; endpoint OrderController.cs:102-120). At setOrder the free-row count is 0, so SF + AWS run a second time. Then the UPDATE matches 0 rows (OM:1095), so this order's incrementId is stored nowhere, and the INSERT creates R2.
differences.evidence: SCU:91-105, :118-128; OM:1085-1088, :1093-1102; Magento app/code/Omnipro/MaviCredito/view/frontend/web/js/view/payment/method-renderer/omnipro_pago_credito-method.js:784-800. The ValidarCupon endpoint itself is outside the setOrder scope. It is reported because it changes what this step writes. Note also that Magento expects the string 'OK'/'Erroneo'/'Utilizado' (js:793-799), while ServicioSAP answers {status:'OK'|'NO_VALIDO'|'err'}.
differences.decision_ref: None
differences.concrete_case: Promoter 'E016881' has never had a coupon. Checkout validates it, then order CRED600001 is placed. LAN ends with R1(FechaUtilizacion=now, IdEcommerce='CRED600001') plus a free R2. ServicioSAP ends with only a free R2, and no row links CRED600001 to the promoter.

differences.what: Burn scope once the gate passes: ServicioSAP burns ALL free rows of the code, where LAN burns only the most recent one. This is the burn step; it is reported because it sits behind this gate and uses the same predicate.
differences.lan: UPDATE TOP(1) ... ORDER BY IdVentaCupon DESC (SCU:118-128).
differences.sap: UPDATE ... WHERE Codigo=@Codigo AND FechaUtilizacion IS NULL, with no TOP (OM:1095).
differences.decision_ref: None
differences.concrete_case: Two free rows exist for 'E016881' (NUEVO inserts a new row on every call regardless of existing ones: SCU:45-46, :146-159). LAN: 1 burned, leaving 2 free after regeneration. ServicioSAP: 2 burned with the same IdEcommerce, leaving 1 free.

differences.what: Burned but not regenerated, then locked out by the gate. The ServicioSAP UPDATE commits before steps that can throw. After that the code has no free row, and the next order depends on SF + AWS.
differences.lan: UPDATE and NUEVO run in the same SP call, and NUEVO reads only local tables (SCU:118-135). No network step can interrupt them.
differences.sap: The UPDATE commits (OM:1093-1102). Then the URL_BP_API check throws (OM:1106-1107), or httpClient.GetAsync to the agent API throws on a connection error or timeout (OM:1111). Either way the catch returns 'err' and nothing is inserted (OM:1165-1169). On the next order the count is 0, so the gate runs, and if SF or the catalog rejects the code it is never regenerated.
differences.decision_ref: None
differences.concrete_case: businesspartner-api is unreachable (TaskCanceledException after 100 s) while processing a code that has a free row. The row is burned, no new row is inserted, and the method returns 'err' (ignored). The next order with the same code, whose SF department is not in the catalog, writes nothing at all.

differences.what: A promoter code made only of spaces is sent to the coupon logic in LAN and skipped in ServicioSAP.
differences.lan: Guard data[6].Length > 0 (CreditMethods.cs:203), so the SP runs, and NUEVO inserts a row with Codigo='   '.
differences.sap: Guard !IsNullOrWhiteSpace (OM:706), so nothing is called.
differences.evidence: CreditMethods.cs:203; OM:706; runbook §20.3 last row (line 1509): found and not applied, 'Teórico'. The real payloads send "".
differences.decision_ref: None (runbook §20.3 lists it as not applied, without a decision)
differences.concrete_case: infoCliente.codigo_promotor='   '. LAN inserts a VTASCVentaCupon row with Codigo '   '. ServicioSAP writes nothing.

differences.what: Return value and logging of the step differ. The caller-visible result is the same.
differences.lan: Successful 'Elimina' returns "" (the SP emits SELECT @Agente AS cupon, SCU:161-164, so 'Eliminado' at :456-459 is never set). A SQL error returns "err". It writes the CodigoPromocion log INFO (:394) and ERROR (:426), and the Credit log INFO with the result (:205).
differences.sap: Returns "OK", "NO_VALIDO" or "err" (OM:1160, :1163, :1168), ignored at OM:708. No file log, only Console.WriteLine (OM:1081, :1138, :1167). Magento receives 'Concluido' plus the cuenta either way (OM:1800-1807), as LAN returns the cuenta (LAN OrderMethods.cs:649).
differences.evidence: CreditMethods.cs:205, :394, :426, :454-460; SCU:161-164; OM:708, :1081, :1160-1168. MATRIZ G5-20 (line 218) treats LAN's log as the maximum, so having fewer logs does not break that rule.
differences.decision_ref: None
differences.concrete_case: Any promoter order: the LAN logs show 'INFO E016881 CRED600001' and the result line. ServicioSAP leaves no trace in Logs/ of whether the coupon was burned, rejected or failed.

differences.what: The target table is VentasCupones, but the agreed SIGMAVI name is VentaCupon. Equivalence to VTASCVentaCupon (columns Cliente→BP, Sucursal→Centro) is unconfirmed, and so is the migration of open coupons.
differences.lan: IntelisisTmp.VTASCVentaCupon (IdVentaCupon, Codigo, Agente, FechaEnvio, Cliente, Sucursal, FechaUtilizacion, IdEcommerce), per SCU:120-128 and :146-159.
differences.sap: SIGMavi.VentasCupones (Codigo, Agente, FechaEnvio, BP, Centro, FechaUtilizacion, IdEcommerce), per OM:1041, :1095, :1144-1145.
differences.evidence: Moving the data to SIGMAVI is intentional (resumen_dudas.md:12; runbook routing rule, line 764). But _NUESTROS_ENDPOINTS/_DECISIONES_ODS.md:175 records VTASCVentaCupon → 'VentaCupon' as Confirmado, and Checklists/CHECKLIST_DEV3_NOSAP_NOINTELISIS.md:315-317 says 'Falta alinear el nombre de la tabla'. Runbook §18.8 (line 1429) still asks whether VentasCupones equals VTASCVentaCupon. The DDL has NO EVIDENCE. The migration of existing free coupons has NO EVIDENCE.
differences.decision_ref: Target DB: resumen_dudas.md:12 and _DECISIONES_ODS.md:175 (which names VentaCupon, not VentasCupones)
differences.concrete_case: If SIGMAVI only has 'VentaCupon', the COUNT at OM:1045 throws 'Invalid object name VentasCupones', the catch at OM:1165-1169 returns 'err', and no promoter coupon is ever burned or regenerated, silently. If the table exists but is empty at cutover, every promoter goes through the gate (first difference).

differences.what: The promoter code is passed verbatim as the SuccessFactors user_id and as the SAP Zagente. LAN resolved it natively against Intelisis ids.
differences.lan: Personal=@Codigo (SCU:83, ValidarCupon only) and Agente=@Agente (SCU:144), both on Intelisis ids such as 'E016881'.
differences.sap: user_id={codigo} (BP:350) and Zagente={codigo} (OM:1108), neither URL-escaped. The agent API zero-pads to 10 (AS_ZQBP_AGENTE.py:95-96). SF ids look like '30001558' (Hoppscotch 'GetSuccesFactor'), and a SAP Zagente looks like '0030056889' (AS_ZQBP_AGENTE.py:339).
differences.evidence: OM:1059, :1108; BusinessPartnerMethods.cs:350; AS_ZQBP_AGENTE.py:95-96. Hoppscotch 'Servicios SAP y Middleware (Unificado).json' has 'Orden con Promotor' with codigo_promotor 'E016881' and 'GetSuccesFactor' with user_id=30001558. What Magento will send after the migration has NO EVIDENCE (Omnipro/PlaceOrder/Model/OrderManagement.php:461-468 just forwards promoCodeN or quote.bank).
differences.decision_ref: None
differences.concrete_case: codigo_promotor='E016881'. SF presumably finds no employee, so ServicioSAP rejects it (first difference). Even with a free row, the agent lookup queries Zagente '000E016881', gets no Werks, and the regenerated coupon has Centro=NULL. LAN resolves the sucursal from Agente='E016881'.

differences.what: Width of the regenerated coupon code: LAN truncates to 10 characters, ServicioSAP inserts the code as received.
differences.lan: @Codigo VARCHAR(30) is passed into NUEVO's @Agente VARCHAR(10), a silent truncation (SCU:52, :54, :130-135).
differences.sap: Full code via AddWithValue (OM:1154). The column width has NO EVIDENCE.
differences.decision_ref: Decision 13 'insertar a como llegaba' (runbook §18.3). It was stated for SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS; applying it here is an extension.
differences.concrete_case: codigo_promotor='PROMO1234567' (12 characters). LAN's new row has Codigo='PROMO12345'. ServicioSAP inserts 'PROMO1234567', or fails with 8152/2628 if the column is narrower (swallowed as 'err').

comparisons.question_for_user: 1) MATRIZ 4.1 #4 says 'Elimina' should work like LAN: no validation, burn only the most recent free row, and always create a new coupon. Do you confirm that, so the SuccessFactors + AWS check in HandlePromoCodeAsync is removed from the credit path? Or is that check a new business rule you want to keep? 2) After the migration, what will Magento send in infoCliente.codigo_promotor: the Intelisis Personal id (like 'E016881') or the SuccessFactors / SAP agent id (like '30001558')? 3) In SIGMAVI, is the coupon table called VentasCupones (what the code uses) or VentaCupon (what _DECISIONES_ODS.md:175 records as confirmed)? And will the open coupons in IntelisisTmp.VTASCVentaCupon be migrated before go-live? 4) If the check stays: what do the rows of the AWS catalog 'Código de promotor' look like (VALOR1 = department? VALOR2 = one job title or a comma list?), and does status=0 in get_personalById mean active employees only?

comparisons.name: Credit branch return value (what SetPedido / SetOrderAsync hand back to the caller and to Magento)
comparisons.lan_source: LAN Metodos/OrderMethods.cs SetPedido :533-733 (credit branch :609-650, catch :728-732); Metodos/CreditMethods.cs ProductosCreditoWeb_SaveData :94-262, which calls SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS (ServicioAndroid) and checkCliente :725-763 (SpCREDIDatosSolicitudCreditoArt @Op='CheckCliente', a COUNT on CTE, SP lines 37-51); Controllers/OrdersController.cs setOrder :137-161. Legacy DMZ bridge that mapped LAN's string to HTTP codes: git 7170f9c WebApiMagento/Controllers/OrdersController.cs :87-175.
comparisons.sap_source: ServicioSAP Methods/Order/OrderMethods.cs: SetOrderAsync :1728-1955 (credit early exit :1785-1808, catch :1950-1954) and ProcessCreditPaymentAsync :665-766 (return :759). The existence check CheckClientCreditAsync :768-781 calls BusinessPartnerMethods.GetClientAsync :27-69, i.e. OData ZB_DATOS_CLIENTE_CDS/ZB_DATOS_CLIENTE $filter BusinessPartner eq, which is the functional equivalent of the CTE COUNT. The insert path is CrearSolicitudCreditoAsync :787-843, then SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.InsertAsync :18-33, then an INSERT into CRED_SOLICITUD_WEB_DATOS_TEMP (:157-227, no try). Controllers/OrderController.cs order/new :16-48. Current DMZ Controllers/OrdersController.cs setOrder :107-228 is a pass-through to order/new.
comparisons.lan_detail:
1) SetPedido (OrderMethods.cs:533). AgruparCantidadPorSKU, ToArray (:539) and obtenerIdVenta/PedidoExistente (:541-542) run OUTSIDE the try. sRespuestaPedido starts as string.Empty (:574) and the try opens at :576. Inside the try, before the credit branch: detallePedido Limpiar/Insertar (:582-601), float.Parse of prices (:588, :596), NombreClienteMavi built with Trim/ToUpper on dictionary keys (:603-605), and SaveGuide to SQLite (:606, :735-754, no try).
2) Credit branch (:609-650): it builds articulos (:611-617), then ObtenerNumeroTablaSms / IsValidated with infoCliente["cuenta"] (:619-620; both swallow errors and return "", :812-816 and :847-851). It calls cm.ProductosCreditoWeb_SaveData(...) and DISCARDS its return value (:624-647). It then returns order.infoCliente["cuenta"] verbatim (:649): no trim, no validation, and null if Magento sent "cuenta": null.
3) ProductosCreditoWeb_SaveData (CreditMethods.cs:94). Its possible results ("OK" or "insuficiente" :126-133, "err" :246-252, "sin cuenta" :255-258) never reach the caller. checkSaldo always returns 0, so the result is always "insuficiente" (PLAN 16.3-16.4). Errors inside the inner try (:135-252) become "err" and are thrown away, so SetPedido still returns the cuenta. That covers getClientInfo, the phone Substring, the SP ExecuteReader, CreditoWeb_InsertArticulo and CodigoPromocion; in those cases no liberador thread starts. Errors in the outer part DO propagate: cnn.Open() on the Android DB (:117-119), and decimal.Parse(data[4]) (:126) when checkCliente is true. checkCliente swallows errors and returns false (:757-762), so an unknown account produces "sin cuenta", which is discarded, and the cuenta is still returned.
4) The catch at :728-731 only logs. Line :732 then returns sRespuestaPedido.Equals("Concluido") ? ... : sRespuestaPedido, which is "" for any exception raised inside the try.
5) Controller setOrder (OrdersController.cs:149-160) returns Ok(response): HTTP 200 with a JSON string such as "C01575835". An exception raised outside SetPedido's try returns Ok(e.ToString()) (:154-157): HTTP 200 with the full stack trace.
6) Legacy DMZ (git 7170f9c OrdersController.cs). A missing cuenta key gives 400 "Cuenta invalida" (:97-101). Otherwise it calls LAN and applies these rules in order: empty or whitespace gives 500 "LAN retornó vacío" (:117-122); "PedidoExistente" gives 409 (:124-129); "sin cuenta" gives 422 (:131-138, unreachable for credit because SetPedido never returns it); anything not starting with "C" gives 500 "Respuesta inesperada" (:140-145); a transport exception gives 500 (:147-152). Credit skips the SAP call (:154-171) and the method returns Ok(response) (:174), i.e. 200 "C01575835".
7) The LAN validateCredit wrapper (OrdersController.cs:455-482) returns {status:"PROCESANDO", cuenta:resultado}. Its DMZ route is commented out (DMZ OrdersController.cs:366-402) and Magento does not call it (grep of Magento248/app/code finds no caller).
comparisons.sap_detail:
1) SetOrderAsync (OrderMethods.cs:1728). Everything is inside one try; the catch rethrows as new Exception("Error en SetOrder: "+msg) (:1950-1954). The duplicate check (:1752) uses SAP PurchNoC ZSD_{docType}_{incrementId}, which the credit branch never creates.
2) Credit branch (:1785-1808). SaveGuideAsync runs first (:1787) and swallows errors (:533-553). Then articulos (:1789-1795), then ObtenerNumeroTablaSmsAsync / IsValidatedAsync on sDatosPedido[36], which is cuenta (:1797-1798; both swallow errors, :608-612 and :655-659). Then cuentaCredito = ProcessCreditPaymentAsync(...) (:1800), and the branch returns new Response{Resultado="Concluido", Zctefinal=cuentaCredito, Zidecomm=incrementId} (:1802-1807).
3) ProcessCreditPaymentAsync (:665-766):
- cuentaBp = infoCliente?.cuenta ?? "" and idClienteMagento = infoCliente?.cliente ?? "" (:669-670).
- esClienteNuevo = cuenta blank and cliente not blank; esInvitado = both blank (:672-673).
- A guest throws "Los invitados no pueden pagar con crédito." (:675-676).
- For a non-new client, CheckClientCreditAsync (a ZB_DATOS_CLIENTE lookup that swallows errors and returns false, :768-781) returning false throws "El cliente BP {cuentaBp} no tiene crédito activo en SAP." (:679-683).
- CrearSolicitudCreditoAsync then InsertAsync propagates every error (:694, :787-843; SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.cs:18-33, :157-227). An idSolicitud <= 0 throws (:695-696).
- Errors in the article lines and the promoter code are caught and logged, and the method still returns the account (:701-717).
- The liberador and callback are commented out (:720-757).
- It returns esClienteNuevo ? idClienteMagento : cuentaBp (:759). The outer catch rethrows (:761-765).
4) Controller order/new (OrderController.cs:16-48). On success it returns Ok(new{BP=Zctefinal, SalesDocument=to_result?.Salesdocument?.TrimStart('0') ?? PurchNoS, Message=Resultado=="Error" ? Zobservaciones : (to_return?...Message ?? ""), Resultado}). For credit that is HTTP 200 {"BP":"<cuenta>","SalesDocument":null,"Message":"","Resultado":"Concluido"}. Default Web API JSON formatter (App_Start/WebApiConfig.cs has no formatter settings). On any exception it returns Ok("Error, "+e.Message), i.e. HTTP 200 "Error, Error en SetOrder: <msg>" (:37-47).
5) Current DMZ (OrdersController.cs:107-228). There is no cuenta pre-check (commented out, :116-127) and no LAN call. It calls PostSAP("order/new").Trim('"') (:196); transport errors are turned into a string by Curl.PostSAP (Helper/Curl.cs:130-146). If the body parses as JSON it returns Ok(JObject), otherwise Ok(string) (:214-227). Every SS answer reaches Magento as HTTP 200.
6) Magento consumers (Magento248, as in the share):
- Initial credit request: registerCreditQuote (Omnipro/PlaceOrder/Model/OrderManagement.php:628-855) sends cliente=(int)customerId (:703) and cuenta=session getCuentaIntelisis() (:719), and only logs the response. requestCreditOrder (Mavi/CreditoCheckout/Model/CreditoOrderManagement.php:51-76) reacts only to false, which happens only when the token fails (Adapter.php:32-43). It deactivates the quote whatever the status or body.
- After authorization, the order is re-synced through registerOrder (CreditoOrderManagement.php:173, then OrderManagement.php:591-610). That path DOES read the reply: HTTP 200 sets synced=1, and a body of exactly 10 characters triggers setCAccount.

differences.what: First-time customer (cuenta null/empty/whitespace, cliente = Magento customer id): SS writes a credit application row and returns the Magento customer id as the BP
differences.lan: cuenta null or "": checkCliente fails (CreditMethods.cs:124), SaveData returns "sin cuenta" (:257) and the caller discards it, so nothing is inserted. SetPedido returns the raw cuenta, null or "" (OrderMethods.cs:649). The legacy DMZ answered 500 ("LAN retornó vacío" at 7170f9c:117-122, or "Respuesta inesperada" at :140-145 for a null/"null" body; the exact body for null is not verified: NO EVIDENCE).
differences.sap: esClienteNuevo=true (OrderMethods.cs:672), so no existence check runs. It inserts into CRED_SOLICITUD_WEB_DATOS_TEMP with Cliente="" (:825, :694) and returns idClienteMagento (:759). The client gets HTTP 200 {"BP":"9400","SalesDocument":null,"Message":"","Resultado":"Concluido"}.

differences.evidence: LAN OrderMethods.cs:619-649, CreditMethods.cs:124,:255-258; SS OrderMethods.cs:669-684,:759,:1802-1807; Magento OrderManagement.php:703,:719 (cuenta comes from the session and is null when the customer has no Intelisis account)

differences.what: The guest guard does not fire for Magento guests, because Magento sends cliente as integer 0

differences.evidence: Magento OrderManagement.php:596-605 does `str_replace('"','',body)` and calls setCAccount only if strlen(trim)==10. CreditoOrderManagement.php:173 re-syncs every authorized credit order through that path. registerCreditQuote only logs the body (OrderManagement.php:771-845).
differences.concrete_case: Authorized credit order re-sync with cuenta = BP 1500004598. If the body were a bare string, "1500004598" (10 chars) would trigger setCAccount. The actual body, once quotes are stripped, is {BP:1500004598,SalesDocument:null,Message:,Resultado:Concluido}, which is never 10 chars, so customer_credit_account is never updated from this reply. The initial credit request (requestCreditOrder) behaves the same in both, because it ignores the body.

differences.what: Errors that ended as "" in LAN (non-200 through the legacy DMZ) are now HTTP 200 "Error, ..."
differences.lan: Any exception inside SetPedido's try (e.g. Android DB down at CreditMethods.cs:117-119, SQLite failure in SaveGuide :606, missing dictionary key, decimal.Parse of total :126) is caught at :728-731 and returns "" (:732). The legacy DMZ turned that into 500 "LAN retornó vacío" (7170f9c:117-122). An exception outside the try gives Ok(e.ToString()) with the stack trace (OrdersController.cs:154-157), which the legacy DMZ turned into 500 "Respuesta inesperada" (:140-145).
differences.sap: Any exception is wrapped as "Error en SetOrder: <msg>" (:1950-1954). The controller returns HTTP 200 "Error, Error en SetOrder: <msg>" without the stack trace (OrderController.cs:37-47). The current DMZ forwards it as 200.
differences.decision_ref: Letting CrearSolicitudCreditoAsync errors propagate is INTENTIONAL (PLAN 17.2/17.3). Returning HTTP 200 is not a runbook decision: PLAN 19.2 #1 says to ask Magento whether it tolerates it. The SS controller comment (OrderController.cs:39-44) justifies 200 as 'parity' with the DMZ as a pass-through, but the legacy DMZ was not a pass-through for these cases.
differences.evidence: LAN OrderMethods.cs:574,:728-732; legacy DMZ git 7170f9c OrdersController.cs:117-152; SS OrderMethods.cs:1950-1954, OrderController.cs:37-47; Magento OrderManagement.php:608-610 (status==200 sets synced=1)
differences.concrete_case: ServicioAndroid unreachable during a credit order. LAN: "" and legacy DMZ 500, so on the registerOrder path Magento leaves synced=0 and the cron retries. SS: the INSERT throws (SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.cs:160,:223, no try) and the reply is 200 "Error, Error en SetOrder: <SqlException msg>", so Magento sets synced=1 and never retries. requestCreditOrder behaves the same either way.

Only line and promoter errors are still swallowed, returning the account (:711-717), like LAN.
differences.decision_ref: Insert-error propagation is INTENTIONAL (PLAN 17.3). The blocking existence check and the guest error have no decision. PLAN 19.2 #1 and 18.5 #3 are open (Magento sends C... accounts).
differences.evidence: LAN OrderMethods.cs:624-649 (return discarded), CreditMethods.cs:124-133,:246-258,:757-762; SS OrderMethods.cs:679-683,:694-696,:701-717,:768-781
differences.concrete_case: Real payload CRED515773 as is (cuenta C01575835, magento_payloads.md:26). LAN: 200 "C01575835" and no row. SS: 200 "Error, Error en SetOrder: El cliente BP C01575835 no tiene crédito activo en SAP." and no row (PLAN 18.7 P10).

comparisons.question_for_user: 1) For a first-time credit customer, Magento sends "cuenta": null or empty and cliente = Magento customer id (OrderManagement.php:703, :719); guests arrive as cliente 0. Which should ServicioSAP do? (a) Match LAN: write no row and return an error or empty reply. (b) Keep inserting the credit application row, and then decide what goes back in BP: the Magento customer id (today), empty, or nothing until the liberador creates the BP. Should cliente "0" also count as a guest? 2) Should credit errors stay as HTTP 200 "Error, ..."? The legacy DMZ turned LAN's "" into 500 and "PedidoExistente" into 409. Magento's requestCreditOrder ignores the status, but the post-authorization registerOrder sets synced=1 on any 200, so failed re-syncs are no longer retried. 3) Magento's migrated check (OrderManagement.php:602) expects a bare 10-character BP in the setOrder body. ServicioSAP plus the DMZ send a JSON object instead, so setCAccount never fires for credit. Should the DMZ or ServicioSAP return the bare BP for credit, or should Magento parse the "BP" field?

comparisons.name: Alternate entry order/validateCredit
comparisons.lan_source: HTTP route POST order/validateCredit on LAN WebApiMagento. It has no logic of its own and delegates to OrderMethods.SetPedido, the same method setOrder uses. The credit branch of SetPedido calls CreditMethods.ProductosCreditoWeb_SaveData: SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS @Op='Insert' on ServicioAndroid, SpCREDIDatosSolicitudCreditoArt CheckCliente/GetSaldo, and CreditoWeb_InsertArticulo. It then starts a background Liberador thread, which calls CallMagentoAuthorizationCallback, which calls DMZ order/authorizationResult, which calls Magento rest/V1/omnipro-credito/authorizationResult.
comparisons.lan_detail:
Prefix LAN = //172.16.214.58/sap/LAN/WebApiMagento. Controller: LAN/Controllers/OrdersController.cs:15-16 [Authorize][RoutePrefix("order")]; :456-458 [HttpPost][Route("validateCredit")] ValidateCredit([FromBody] OrderRequest order). There is no null check. :462 logs only entityId/incrementId, and a null body throws a NullReferenceException here, inside the try. :470 calls om.SetPedido(order), the same call setOrder makes at :151. :472 logs the result. :475 returns Ok(new { status = "PROCESANDO", cuenta = resultado }): the status is ALWAYS the literal PROCESANDO, whatever SetPedido returned. :477-481 catch: logs "ERROR ValidateCredit" and returns InternalServerError(ex) (HTTP 500). By contrast, setOrder answers 400 on a null body (:141-142) and 200 Ok(e.ToString()) on an exception (:154-157).
SetPedido (Metodos/OrderMethods.cs:533-733): AgruparCantidadPorSKU (:535, int.Parse/float.Parse and dictionary indexers at :494-496) and ToArray (:539, dictionary indexers at :406-423) run OUTSIDE the try, so their exceptions reach ValidateCredit and become HTTP 500. :541 returns "PedidoExistente" when a Venta row with that IDEcommerce exists (obtenerIdVenta :1602-1613, Intelisis) and forzarOrder=="0". Magento always sends forzarOrder "0" (Omnipro/PlaceOrder/Model/OrderManagement.php:38, :752). There is no payment-method guard: OPENPAY returns early at :545-549, and any non-credit method runs the full contado path (:652-732). The try block is :576-731. Credit branch :609-650: it builds "cantidad,sku" items plus "costoEnvio,SEGU00001" (:611-617), reads SMS/validated numbers (:619-621), calls ProductosCreditoWeb_SaveData (:623-647), DISCARDS its return value ("OK"/"insuficiente"/"err"/"sin cuenta") and returns order.infoCliente["cuenta"] (:649). The catch at :728-731 logs and falls to :732, which returns sRespuestaPedido = "" (initialised at :574).
The consequence for validateCredit is 200 {status:"PROCESANDO", cuenta:"<infoCliente.cuenta>"} on success AND on every SaveData failure, and 200 {status:"PROCESANDO", cuenta:""} when anything inside the try throws, including a missing "cuenta" key at :619.
Async half (Metodos/CreditMethods.cs:199-241): only when IdSolicitud != "" AND data[0] (cuenta) starts with "C" (:208), a background thread runs LiberadorCreditoMethods.LiberarCliente and then OrderMethods.CallMagentoAuthorizationCallback (:215-240). On an exception it still calls back with RECHAZADO (:228-236). The callback (OrderMethods.cs:1751-1809+) authenticates against URL_DMZ login/authenticate and POSTs {entityId, status, cuenta, idSolicitud} to URL_DMZ order/authorizationResult, up to 3 attempts.
Reachability today: the DMZ proxy is commented out (DMZ/WebApiMagento/Controllers/OrdersController.cs:365-402), so the LAN route can only be reached from inside the LAN. Magento does not call it: requestCreditOrder then registerCreditQuote POSTs to getSetOrderEndpoint() (Magento248/app/code/Omnipro/PlaceOrder/Model/OrderManagement.php:628, :755-757, :771), and a grep of all of Magento248/app for "validateCredit" matches only the unrelated validateCreditPrice (Omnipro/ProductUpdate/Model/QueueRepository.php:204). The configured value of setorder_endpoint lives in Magento DB config: NO EVIDENCE of the literal URL. PollCreditStatus.php:93-95 and :279-281 derive creditStatus/updateCreditOrderId from dirname() of that URL, which fits a .../order/setOrder URL. There is no real capture of validateCredit in CAPTURAS_REALES_APIS.md or magento_payloads.md (0 matches), and no trace in SS Logs/sap.log.
comparisons.sap_source: NONE. ServicioSAP has no order/validateCredit route, and there is no FI/FICA credit validation anywhere in SS/Methods. The closest functional equivalent of what the LAN route triggered is POST order/new, which runs OrderMethods.SetOrderAsync(order,"Insert") and takes the credit early exit through ProcessCreditPaymentAsync. Magento reaches it today through DMZ order/setOrder with curl.PostSAP("order/new").
comparisons.sap_detail:
Prefix SS = //172.16.214.58/sap/ServicioSAP/ServicioSap/ServicioSap (current working tree, uncommitted changes included). Route table: Controllers/OrderController.cs:12-13 [Authorize][RoutePrefix("order")], with routes new :17, testnew :51, setreturn :73, validatecupon :103, checkDocument :123, cancelOrder :144, cancelInvoice :177, getGuide :216, generateNewStorepickupCode :241, createStorepickupCode :261, GetPickUpCode :283, getCondicion :310. There is no validateCredit. A grep of all SS *.cs/*.config/*.json for validateCredit|PROCESANDO returns 0 matches. The convention route "api/{controller}/{id}" (App_Start/WebApiConfig.cs:18-22) cannot match order/validateCredit, so a POST there returns 404. Other controllers have no credit-validation route either (CreditController.cs routes :17-134).
Equivalent entry order/new (OrderController.cs:16-48): null body returns 400 (:20-23). Otherwise it calls SetOrderAsync(order,"Insert") and returns Ok({BP=Zctefinal, SalesDocument=to_result?.Salesdocument?.TrimStart('0') ?? PurchNoS, Message, Resultado}) (:27-35). On an exception it returns 200 Ok("Error, " + e.Message) (:37-47); the comment there says it keeps parity with LAN setOrder, not with validateCredit.
SetOrderAsync (Methods/Order/OrderMethods.cs:1728-1955): AgruparCantidadPorSKU/ToArray use the typed model (Models/SAP/Order/OrderRequest.cs, ArticuloRequest.cs), so missing fields default instead of throwing. The duplicate check (:1749-1760) looks up SD36 PurchNoC ZSD_ZMER_{incrementId}; ValidarPedidoExistenteSAPAsync returns false on error (:452-464). Credit early exit :1785-1808: SaveGuideAsync, items with InvariantCulture shipping cost, ObtenerNumeroTablaSmsAsync/IsValidatedAsync(sDatosPedido[36]), then ProcessCreditPaymentAsync. It returns OrderResponse{Resultado="Concluido", Zctefinal=cuentaCredito, Zidecomm=incrementId}, so the controller body is {BP:<cuenta>, SalesDocument:null, Message:"", Resultado:"Concluido"}. Any exception is rethrown as "Error en SetOrder: ..." (:1950-1954) and reaches the controller as 200 "Error, Error en SetOrder: ...".
ProcessCreditPaymentAsync (:665-766): a guest throws (:673-676). A client that is not new (cuenta not empty) must pass CheckClientCreditAsync, which only tests that the BP exists via BusinessPartnerMethods.GetClientAsync (:768-781); otherwise it throws "El cliente BP X no tiene crédito activo en SAP." (:679-684). CrearSolicitudCreditoAsync propagates errors (:694-696). Line failures are logged and swallowed (:701-717). It returns esClienteNuevo ? idClienteMagento : cuentaBp (:759).
Liberador and callback: the whole block is COMMENTED OUT (:719-757). It sits under the inverted condition esClienteNuevo, where LAN uses StartsWith("C"), and it would not compile as written (await inside a non-async lambda, runbook §18.6 B1). The helpers LiberateClientCredit (:1175-1187) and CallMagentoAuthorizationCallbackAsync (:1192-1280) have no live callers; the only calls are inside the comment at :736 and :746. The dormant callback payload uses keys {entity_id, status, customer_account, credit_request_id} (:1249-1255), which do not bind to the DMZ CreditAuthorizationRequest {entityId, status, cuenta, idSolicitud} (DMZ/WebApiMagento/Models/CreditRequest.cs:212-218). This is already recorded as G5-11 in MATRIZ_REGLAS_CREDITO_WEB_LAN_VS_SAP.md:209.
DMZ state: the validateCredit proxy is commented out (DMZ/WebApiMagento/Controllers/OrdersController.cs:365-402). Its comment says it was "Reemplazado por validación nativa de SAP a través de OData FI/FICA en ServicioSAP". NO EVIDENCE supports that: SS/Methods has no FI/FICA call. Even the commented proxy was broken: it built URL_INTELISIS + "validateCredit" without the "order/" prefix (:375) and sent no Authorization header (:377-385) to a LAN controller marked [Authorize] (LAN OrdersController.cs:15). DMZ setOrder forwards EVERY payment method, credit included, to curl.PostSAP("order/new") (:191-205). DMZ creditStatus/updateCreditOrderId still go to LAN through curl.Post, which uses URL_INTELISIS, today https://localhost:44399/ (DMZ Web.config:17; Curl.cs:22, :106).
Correction to earlier docs: AUDITORIA_INTEGRAL_LAN_DMZ_SAP.md R-07 says "hoy Magento recibe 404". Nothing in the Magento code in the share calls validateCredit, so that claim is not supported. The route is dead in both LAN (for Magento) and SAP. The pending plan items (ENDPOINTS_DMZ_VS_SAP.csv:89, PLAN_MAESTRO_GANTT_POR_DEV.md:233 due 01/09/2026, AUDITORIA §852) would re-create an endpoint that has no caller.

comparisons.name: Downstream updateCreditOrderId (swap the temporary CRED id for the real Magento increment_id and entity_id)
comparisons.lan_source: Intelisis SQL on clsConexion.sCadenaConexion, run as inline SQL with no stored procedure: UPDATE Venta.IdEcommerce, UPDATE eCommerceDetPedidos.IdPedido, UPDATE eCommerceDetPedidos.IdOrden. LAN setOrder writes the eCommerceDetPedidos rows through SpVTASeCommerceDetPedidos (SPsOrden/SpVTASeCommerceDetPedidos.sql:135-158). The Intelisis credit process writes the Venta rows (Solicitud Credito / Analisis Credito / Pedido). No evidence in the share shows exactly which code writes those Venta rows. The runbook (line 1045) attributes them to the Liberador.
comparisons.lan_detail:
CALLER: the Magento cron Mavi/CreditoCheckout/Cron/PollCreditStatus.php. It calls creditStatus (:95-97). Only when the status is AUTORIZADO does it place the real order (:178), then finalizeAutorizado (:254-264) and notifyIntelisisOrderId (:273-287) POST {CreditIncrementId, IncrementId, EntityId}. CreditIncrementId = omnipro_credito_pending.credit_increment_id = 'CRED'+quoteId (CreditoOrderManagement.php:44, :292-295). IncrementId = the real increment_id. EntityId = (int) the real sales_order.entity_id. Magento only logs the HTTP status and swallows errors (:289-299). Its comment says 'C# GetPendingCreditOrders' will retry, but that method does not exist in LAN, DMZ or ServicioSAP (grep = 0), so a failed call is never retried.
DMZ: Controllers/OrdersController.cs:404-419 passes the body through unchanged with Curl.Post(URL_INTELISIS + 'order/updateCreditOrderId') and returns Ok(JsonConvert.DeserializeObject(response)). On any non-2xx response, Curl.Post returns the exception text (Helper/Curl.cs:108-111). DeserializeObject then throws, so the DMZ answers 500 (:414-418). The DMZ does no validation of its own.
LAN CONTROLLER: Controllers/OrdersController.cs:16 (RoutePrefix 'order'), :506-533. Model: Models/OrderRequest.cs:204-209 {string CreditIncrementId, string IncrementId, int EntityId}. A null request or a null/empty CreditIncrementId or IncrementId returns 400 'Parámetros inválidos' (:510-513). EntityId is not validated. The input is logged (:515-516). The controller always returns 200 {success=true, rowsUpdated=rows} (:526). Its catch that returns 500 (:528-532) is effectively unreachable because the method swallows its own errors.
LAN METHOD: Metodos/OrderMethods.cs:1998-2061 opens one Intelisis connection (:2002) and runs 3 independent autocommit statements, with no transaction and a 30 s timeout each:
(1) UPDATE Venta SET IdEcommerce=@new WHERE IdEcommerce=@old (:2007-2017). This renames every movement that shares the CRED id: the Solicitud Credito, Analisis Credito and Pedido rows that GetCreditStatus reads at :1876-1953.
(2) UPDATE eCommerceDetPedidos SET IdPedido=@new WHERE IdPedido=@old (:2020-2030). These are the staging lines that LAN setOrder wrote for the credit order: detallePedido 'Limpiar' then 'Insertar' per line (:582, :599), with IdPedido = CRED id and idOrden = the quote entityId (:340-344 ToArray, :963-1045).
(3) Only if entityId > 0: UPDATE eCommerceDetPedidos SET IdOrden=@EntityId WHERE IdPedido=@new (:2033-2046).
It logs the counts (:2048-2051) and returns rowsVenta+rowsDet+rowsOrden (:2053). Any exception is caught and returns -1 (:2056-2060), so a SQL failure reaches the caller as 200 {success:true, rowsUpdated:-1}. A partial failure (for example, step 2 times out) leaves Venta renamed and eCommerceDetPedidos not. A repeated call returns only the step-3 count.
NOT RENAMED BY LAN: SQLite servicio_guias (SaveGuide :606, :735), CRED_SOLICITUD_WEB_DATOS_TEMP.idMagento, VentasCupones.IdEcommerce.
The inline rename in SetPedido (:666-671, UpdateIdEcommerceEnVenta :1837-1863) can never run, because sId == order.incrementId (:344, :580).
Downstream LAN readers of the renamed staging rows: StorePickup/CodigoRecogerSucursal.cs:23-47 (idOrden by IdPedido), :151, :531-533, and Order/Provider.cs:108-130 (IdPedido by idOrden).
Stale doc: Resources/Flujo_Orden_Credito.md:103-107 says the response is a bare integer '3'. The code returns an object (:526).
comparisons.sap_source: NONE. ServicioSAP has no HTTP route, no method and no OData/API call for this step. Possible SAP services exist but ServicioSAP uses none of them (grep = 0). salesanddistribution-dev AS_POST_SituacionesEventos calls ZAPI_SITUEVENTOS_UPDATE_SRV/HEADERSet with a ZSDT_VBAK block that includes Zidecomm. AS_POST_ZSDT_VBAK calls ZAPI_ZSDT_VBAK_SRV/ZSDT_VBAKSet, which only inserts. ZAPI_SALESORDER_SRV: the reference repo has no PATCH of PurchNoC/Zidecomm.
comparisons.sap_detail:
NO ENDPOINT: Controllers/OrderController.cs:13 (RoutePrefix 'order') exposes only new, testnew, setreturn, validatecupon, checkDocument, cancelOrder, cancelInvoice, getGuide, generateNewStorepickupCode, createStorepickupCode, GetPickUpCode and getCondicion (:17-311). A grep for UpdateCreditOrderId/CreditOrderId over the whole project returns 0. There is also no creditStatus and no authorizationResult route.
NOTHING TO RENAME: the credit branch of SetOrderAsync (Methods/Order/OrderMethods.cs:1785-1808) writes only three things:
- SQLite servicio_guias with the CRED id (SaveGuideAsync :1787, :533-553).
- CRED_SOLICITUD_WEB_DATOS_TEMP with IdMagento = order.incrementId (:829).
- The VTASdArtCreditoWeb lines.
It returns Concluido / Zctefinal / Zidecomm = CRED id with the comment 'Crédito no va a SAP aquí' (:1802-1807). It writes no Venta rows and no eCommerceDetPedidos rows (grep eCommerceDetPedidos/DetPedido = 0), and creates no SAP sales order for credit. The contado rename was removed on purpose: 'UpdateIdEcommerceEnVenta() ELIMINADO — SAP mantiene Zidecomm' (:1373-1374). The Liberador thread and the Magento callback are commented out (:719-757).
ACTUAL WIRING TODAY: the DMZ Curl.Post base is URL_INTELISIS = https://localhost:44399/ (DMZ Web.config:17). That is the ServicioSAP IIS Express port (ServicioSap.csproj:21, :503); LAN is on :44303 (LAN WebApiMagento.csproj:256). The LAN URL is commented out (DMZ Web.config:16). The DMZ itself notes that legacy Post calls now land on ServicioSAP and return 404 (DMZ OrdersController.cs:132-134). The DMZ token comes from URL_SAP login/auth (Curl.cs:73-85), and the JWT settings of LAN and ServicioSAP are identical (compared by hash), so the token is accepted. Result: DMZ order/updateCreditOrderId goes to ServicioSAP, gets 404 (no route), and the DMZ returns 500. The step's premise that the DMZ 'still proxies to LAN' only holds if Web.config:16 is restored. MATRIZ G5-19 is stale on this point.
UPSTREAM STATE: DMZ creditStatus (DMZ OrdersController.cs:460-482) also goes to ServicioSAP and gets 404, so the DMZ returns 500. Magento's callCreditStatus then throws (PollCreditStatus.php:364-371) and the row stays EN_ANALISIS (:118-127). notifyIntelisisOrderId is therefore never reached in the ServicioSAP flow.
SAP EQUIVALENT: not implemented. In salesanddistribution-dev, the only writes that carry Zidecomm are:
- AS_POST_ZSDT_VBAK: an insert (AS_POST_ZSDT_VBAK.py:46, :56-68).
- AS_POST_SituacionesEventos: ZAPI_SITUEVENTOS_UPDATE_SRV/HEADERSet with a ZSDT_VBAK model that includes Zidecomm (AS_POST_SituacionesEventos.py:36-78, :90-102).
Whether either one overwrites Zidecomm/PurchNoC on an existing Vbeln: NO EVIDENCE. This is still the open question 'revisar con Alan' (AUDITORIA_INTEGRAL_LAN_DMZ_SAP.md:851, :1148; Resources/dmz_orders_sap_mapping.md:47-56).
No text in the documents I read tried to instruct me.
