comparisons.question_for_user:
1) Who will create the SAP sales order for an approved credit: the Liberador, Magento re-sending setOrder with the real increment_id, or a new ServicioSAP job? And which value will it put in PurchNoC/Zidecomm, the CRED id or the real Magento increment_id? If the order is created with the real increment_id, ServicioSAP only needs order/updateCreditOrderId as a no-op 200 so the DMZ stops returning 500. If it is created with CRED..., we need an SAP update service. One possibility is ZAPI_SITUEVENTOS_UPDATE_SRV/HEADERSet, which carries ZSDT_VBAK.Zidecomm, but nobody has confirmed it overwrites the field. This is still the open 'revisar con Alan' item.
2) While LAN and ServicioSAP run side by side, should DMZ updateCreditOrderId and creditStatus keep going to LAN? Today DMZ URL_INTELISIS points to ServicioSAP's port 44399, so both return 500 and Magento never gets past EN_ANALISIS.
3) Does anything on the SAP side still need the Magento entity_id for credit orders (LAN's IdOrden), for example store pickup? If not, the IdOrden part of the rename can be dropped.

comparisons.name: Downstream creditStatus polling (GET order/creditStatus/{idSolicitud})
comparisons.lan_source: Intelisis SQL, inline queries (no SP): table IntelisisTmp.dbo.Venta on MAVICUBOS (LAN Conn/Connection.cs:26, opened through clsConexion at Metodos/OrderMethods.cs:37,:41,:1871). The route is GET order/creditStatus/{idSolicitud} (LAN Controllers/OrdersController.cs:15-16 [Authorize][RoutePrefix("order")], :484-504). The caller is Magento cron Mavi/CreditoCheckout/Cron/PollCreditStatus.php (runs every 5 minutes, etc/crontab.xml:8) through DMZ Controllers/OrdersController.cs:460-482.
comparisons.lan_detail:
CONTROLLER (LAN Controllers/OrdersController.cs:484-504): if idSolicitud <= 0 it returns 400 "idSolicitud debe ser mayor a 0" (:488-489). Otherwise it returns 200 with Json(new { status }) (:497) and logs only when status != "EN_ANALISIS" (:495-496). The catch at :499-503 returns 500 but is unreachable in practice because the method swallows its own exceptions.
METHOD OrderMethods.GetCreditStatus (Metodos/OrderMethods.cs:1867-1996). It is read-only (every query uses WITH(NOLOCK)) and writes nothing. It returns exactly one of three strings:
Step 1 (:1876-1911): SELECT TOP 1 IDEcommerce, Estatus FROM Venta WHERE ID=@IdSolicitud AND Mov='Solicitud Credito'.
 - No row -> "EN_ANALISIS" (:1891-1892).
 - Estatus equals "CANCELADO" (case-insensitive) -> "RECHAZADO" plus a log (:1903-1909).
 - IDEcommerce NULL or empty -> "EN_ANALISIS" (:1913-1914).
Step 2 (:1917-1945): SELECT TOP 1 Estatus FROM Venta WHERE IDEcommerce=@IDEcommerce AND Mov IN ('Analisis Credito','Análisis Crédito'). There is NO ORDER BY, so when several rows exist, which one is read is not defined. CANCELADO (case-insensitive) -> "RECHAZADO".
Step 3 (:1948-1988): SELECT TOP 1 Situacion, Estatus FROM Venta WHERE IDEcommerce=@IDEcommerce AND Mov='Pedido' ORDER BY ID DESC.
 - No row -> "EN_ANALISIS" (:1962-1963).
 - Situacion == "Rechazado" (ordinal, case-sensitive) OR Estatus CANCELADO (case-insensitive) -> "RECHAZADO" (:1973-1980).
 - Anything else -> "AUTORIZADO" (:1982-1986). A Pedido is enough: Situacion='Liberado' is NOT required, although the comment at LiberadorCreditoMethods.cs:79-80 says the cron waits for 'Liberado'.
Any exception (SQL down, timeout) -> logged and "EN_ANALISIS" (:1991-1995). The caller then gets HTTP 200 and keeps waiting.
Null handling: DBNull becomes "" for Estatus/Situacion and null for IDEcommerce (:1894-1900, :1932-1934, :1965-1971).
The Intelisis document chain is Solicitud Credito -> Analisis Credito -> Pedido -> Factura, linked by Origen/OrigenID (SPsOrden/FNCXCPagoLiquidaBBVA.sql:55-67). LAN correlates by IDEcommerce instead.
WHERE idSolicitud COMES FROM (LAN): SetPedido credit branch (OrderMethods.cs:609-649) -> CreditMethods.ProductosCreditoWeb_SaveData. SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS returns the SCOPE_IDENTITY of ServicioAndroid CRED_SOLICITUD_WEB_DATOS_TEMP (SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS.sql:223, :346-348; read at CreditMethods.cs:190-196). Only when the account starts with "C" (CreditMethods.cs:208), a background thread calls the Liberador. It then POSTs the callback {entityId,status,cuenta,idSolicitud}, with idSolicitud = Liberador IdVenta if > 0, otherwise the Android temp Id (CreditMethods.cs:215-240), to DMZ order/authorizationResult (OrderMethods.cs:1751-1833, payload :1803). The DMZ binds CreditAuthorizationRequest{entityId,status,cuenta,idSolicitud} (DMZ Models/CreditRequest.cs:212-218) and forwards it to Magento rest/V1/omnipro-credito/authorizationResult (DMZ OrdersController.cs:421-458). Magento then sets status=EN_ANALISIS and id_solicitud (CreditoOrderManagement.php:135-142). The Liberador never returns AUTORIZADO (LiberadorCreditoMethods.cs:85,93,99), so authorization arrives only through this polling.
CALLER (Magento PollCreditStatus.php): it selects rows WHERE status='EN_ANALISIS' AND id_solicitud IS NOT NULL (:69-74) and calls dirname(setorder_endpoint)+'/creditStatus/'+id (:93-95). Non-2xx -> exception, attempts++, and the row stays EN_ANALISIS (:118-128, :369-371). There is no maximum number of attempts (:13-14). body.status defaults to EN_ANALISIS (:377). Only the exact strings 'AUTORIZADO' and 'RECHAZADO' act (:106-109). AUTORIZADO -> placeOrder, then updateCreditOrderId (:131-301). RECHAZADO -> row RECHAZADO (:303-324).
comparisons.sap_source:
NONE. ServicioSAP has no route and no method for this. Evidence: the ServicioSAP routes in Controllers/OrderController.cs (:17 new, :51 testnew, :73 setreturn, :103 validatecupon, :123 checkDocument, :144 cancelOrder, :177 cancelInvoice, :216 getGuide, :241, :261, :283, :310) include no creditStatus, and a grep for creditStatus/GetCreditStatus/EstatusCredito over the whole ServicioSap tree returns 0 matches. There is no OData read of credit-application status. Reference-only candidates, none of them used by ServicioSAP (0 matches for ZVTACONTCRED / A_SalesOrder( in SS Methods/Models/Web.config):
- ZAPI_ZVTACONTCRED_SRV/ZVTACONTCREDSet, which exposes Auart, Zsituacion, Zliberado, Zidecomm, Zobsreanalisis (salesanddistribution-dev/apps/api/models/VtaContCred.py:109-139,:177; routes/AS_GET_VtaConcred.py:25,:36).
- API_SALES_ORDER_SRV/A_SalesOrder(SalesOrder=...), "SD13 Consultar Estado del Pedido" (routes/AS_GET_EstatusPedido.py:10-28).
The FLUJO doc maps Venta to SD01 and Venta.IdEcommerce to ZIDECOMM (FLUJO_CREDITO_LAN_VS_SAP.md:69-73). NO EVIDENCE of which SAP document type is equivalent to 'Solicitud Credito' or 'Analisis Credito'.
comparisons.sap_detail:
1) The SS credit branch creates no SAP document and returns no idSolicitud. SetOrderAsync FASE 3 (Methods/Order/OrderMethods.cs:1785-1808) calls ProcessCreditPaymentAsync (:665-766). CrearSolicitudCreditoAsync (:694, :787-843) inserts into ServicioAndroid CRED_SOLICITUD_WEB_DATOS_TEMP and returns SCOPE_IDENTITY (Methods/Credit/SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.cs:18,:35,:155), which is the same key space as the LAN SP. That id is used only for the article lines and for logs (:703, :715). The method returns the account or the Magento client id (:759). The response is OrderResponse{Resultado="Concluido", Zctefinal=cuenta, Zidecomm=incrementId} (:1802-1807). The controller flattens it to {BP, SalesDocument:null, Message:"", Resultado:"Concluido"} (Controllers/OrderController.cs:28-35).
2) The Liberador and the Magento callback are commented out (OrderMethods.cs:719-757, marked "PENDIENTE ... incompletos en DMZ" at :722-723). CallMagentoAuthorizationCallbackAsync exists (:1192-1280) but nothing calls it. As a result the Magento omnipro_credito_pending row stays in its initial status PENDIENTE (CreditoOrderManagement.php:48) with id_solicitud NULL. The cron filter (PollCreditStatus.php:72-73) never selects it, so creditStatus is never called for SS orders, and the order is never placed.
3) Current state of the DMZ creditStatus (DMZ Controllers/OrdersController.cs:460-482): new Curl() first logs in to ServicioSAP (IpSAP+"login/auth"). If that login fails it throws and the endpoint returns 500 (Helper/Curl.cs:73-90). It then reuses that SAP token for Curl.Get(URL_INTELISIS + "order/creditStatus/"+id) (Curl.cs:84, :245-265). Curl.Get returns exception text instead of throwing (:259-262). JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<dynamic> of that text throws, so the endpoint returns 500 (:469, :477-480). In the share's DMZ Web.config, URL_INTELISIS (:17) is https://localhost:44399/, which is the ServicioSAP IIS Express port (ServicioSap.csproj:21,:503), not LAN (LAN IIS Express 44303, WebApiMagento.csproj:256). The LAN URL line is commented out (:16). The deployed value: NO EVIDENCE. A SAP token is accepted by LAN only because LAN and SS share JWT_SECRET_KEY/AUDIENCE/ISSUER in the share's Web.config files (compared by hash; values not printed; LAN TokenValidationHandler.cs:46-60, SS Helpers/TokenValidationHandler.cs:47-57).
Note: FLUJO_CREDITO_LAN_VS_SAP.md:373 says the DMZ uses curl.Post for creditStatus. The current code uses curl.Get (DMZ OrdersController.cs:467), so that doc line is stale.

differences.what: The creditStatus endpoint and its status logic do not exist in ServicioSAP
differences.lan: GET order/creditStatus/{id} makes 3 reads of Intelisis Venta (Solicitud Credito by ID -> Analisis Credito by IDEcommerce -> latest Pedido by IDEcommerce) and returns 200 {"status":"AUTORIZADO"|"EN_ANALISIS"|"RECHAZADO"}. Errors also become 200 EN_ANALISIS.
differences.sap: No route and no method. With the share's DMZ config the proxy reaches ServicioSAP, gets 404, and the DMZ returns 500.
differences.evidence: LAN Controllers/OrdersController.cs:484-504 and Metodos/OrderMethods.cs:1867-1996. SS Controllers/OrderController.cs route list :17-311 has no creditStatus, and grep over the SS tree returns 0. DMZ OrdersController.cs:460-482, Helper/Curl.cs:245-265, Web.config:17 (localhost:44399 = ServicioSap.csproj:21,:503). This is not a behavior decision: it is a deferred item, listed as out of weekend scope in runbook §18.9 (PLAN_EJECUCION_SP_CREDITO_A_CODIGO.md:1435) and scheduled for 12/11/2026-24/11/2026 in _NUESTROS_ENDPOINTS/PLAN_MAESTRO_GANTT_POR_DEV.md:249.
differences.concrete_case: Magento cron calls GET <dmz>/order/creditStatus/12345 where Venta ID 12345 is a 'Solicitud Credito' whose IDEcommerce has a non-cancelled Pedido. LAN returns 200 {"status":"AUTORIZADO"} and Magento places the order (PollCreditStatus.php:106-107). SS path (DMZ URL_INTELISIS=https://localhost:44399/): SS returns 404, Curl.Get returns the exception text, JSON parse throws, and the DMZ returns 500. Magento throws at PollCreditStatus.php:369-371, increments attempts, and polls again every 5 minutes forever (no maximum attempts, :13-14).
differences.decision_ref: None. Deferral only: runbook §18.9 (line 1435) and PLAN_MAESTRO_GANTT_POR_DEV.md:249.

differences.what: No idSolicitud reaches Magento in the SS flow, so polling never starts
differences.lan: For accounts starting with 'C', a background thread runs the Liberador, then POSTs {entityId,status:'EN_ANALISIS',cuenta,idSolicitud} to DMZ authorizationResult. Magento stores id_solicitud and status EN_ANALISIS, and the cron starts polling.
differences.sap: The Liberador and callback are commented out. The setOrder response carries only {BP, SalesDocument:null, Message:'', Resultado:'Concluido'}; the id from CrearSolicitudCreditoAsync is never returned.
differences.evidence: LAN CreditMethods.cs:208-241, OrderMethods.cs:1751-1833 (payload :1803), DMZ OrdersController.cs:421-458, Magento CreditoOrderManagement.php:48, :135-142, PollCreditStatus.php:69-74. SS OrderMethods.cs:694, :719-757 (commented), :759, :1802-1807, Controllers/OrderController.cs:28-35. Runbook §18.5 #2 (line 1354) lists it as a Critical pending item ('Lunes, otros equipos'); runbook §18.1 (line 1313) says the order stays PENDIENTE in Magento.
differences.concrete_case: Credit checkout with a valid BP (a copy of payload CRED515773 with the account replaced by a BP). LAN: the omnipro_credito_pending row moves PENDIENTE -> EN_ANALISIS with id_solicitud=<id> and is polled every 5 minutes. SS: the row stays PENDIENTE with id_solicitud NULL, the cron query never selects it, creditStatus is never called, and no Magento order is ever placed.
differences.decision_ref: None. Open item: runbook §18.5 #2 and §18.8 (lines 1427-1428).

differences.what: The dormant SS callback payload does not match the DMZ contract, so it would deliver idSolicitud=0 even if re-enabled
differences.lan: Payload {entityId, status, cuenta, idSolicitud} matches DMZ CreditAuthorizationRequest field for field.
differences.sap: Payload {entity_id, status, customer_account, credit_request_id}. The DMZ model binds only 'status'; entityId and cuenta arrive null and idSolicitud 0. The commented thread block also does not compile (await inside a non-async lambda, CS4034).
differences.evidence: SS OrderMethods.cs:1248-1255 (payload), :736, :746 (await inside new Thread(() => {...})). DMZ Models/CreditRequest.cs:212-218 and OrdersController.cs:423-441 (forwards the bound object). Magento CreditoOrderManagement.php:84-86 needs entityId as the quote id. Runbook §18.6 B1 (line 1378) warns not to uncomment it because of CS4034.
differences.concrete_case: The block is uncommented, fixed to compile, and the Liberador returns EN_ANALISIS with idVenta=555. SS POSTs {entity_id:'9876',status:'EN_ANALISIS',customer_account:'9400',credit_request_id:555}. The DMZ forwards {entityId:null,status:'EN_ANALISIS',cuenta:null,idSolicitud:0}. Magento fails to resolve quote 0 or null and returns an error, the DMZ returns 500, and SS retries 3 times and gives up (OrderMethods.cs:1211-1279). The row stays PENDIENTE. If it did get through, id_solicitud=0 would make the cron call creditStatus/0, which LAN answers with 400 (OrdersController.cs:488-489).
differences.decision_ref: None

differences.what: The trigger that decides which orders get polled at all is inverted
differences.lan: The Liberador and callback (and so the idSolicitud and the polling) run only when the account starts with 'C', i.e. existing Intelisis clients. An empty account returns 'sin cuenta' and nothing is created.
differences.sap: In the commented code the trigger is esClienteNuevo (account empty and Magento client id present). Existing BP clients would never get a callback or polling.
differences.evidence: LAN CreditMethods.cs:124, :208, :255-258. SS OrderMethods.cs:672, :720. Runbook §21.6 (PLAN_EJECUCION_SP_CREDITO_A_CODIGO.md:1647) flags the inverted condition; §18.8 (line 1427) asks what trigger replaces StartsWith('C') for numeric BPs.
differences.concrete_case: infoCliente.cuenta='C01575835': LAN launches the Liberador and callback, and Magento polls. SS as written (if re-enabled): no callback, never polled. infoCliente.cuenta='' with cliente='9400': LAN creates no application ('sin cuenta'); SS inserts an application and would launch the callback.
differences.decision_ref: None. Open question in runbook §18.8 (line 1427).

differences.what: The data source has no SAP equivalent: SAP holds nothing to poll
differences.lan: Status comes from Intelisis Venta movements (Estatus CANCELADO, Pedido Situacion 'Rechazado', Pedido existence), correlated by Venta.IDEcommerce.
differences.sap: The SS credit branch returns before BuildSapOrderAsync, so no SD01 or other SAP document exists for the application. The only record is the ServicioAndroid temp row. ZAPI_ZVTACONTCRED_SRV (Auart, Zsituacion, Zliberado, Zidecomm) and API_SALES_ORDER_SRV/A_SalesOrder exist as reference APIs but SS does not use them. NO EVIDENCE of SAP document types equivalent to 'Solicitud Credito' and 'Analisis Credito'.
differences.evidence: LAN Conn/Connection.cs:26, OrderMethods.cs:1876-1953. SS OrderMethods.cs:1785-1808 ('Crédito no va a SAP aquí'), SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.cs:35,:155. salesanddistribution-dev/apps/api/models/VtaContCred.py:109-139, routes/AS_GET_VtaConcred.py:25,:36, routes/AS_GET_EstatusPedido.py:24-28. FLUJO_CREDITO_LAN_VS_SAP.md:379-400: decision 2026-09-11 'la solicitud nace al enviar la orden, el liberador sólo notifica', leaving open whether a SAP sales document should also be created at submit time.
differences.concrete_case: After Intelisis shutdown, an application approved by credit staff: LAN's Step 3 query finds no Pedido in Venta and returns EN_ANALISIS forever. SS has no SAP document keyed by ZIDECOMM='CRED<quoteId>' to read, so a port cannot compute AUTORIZADO without a new source.
differences.decision_ref: FLUJO_CREDITO_LAN_VS_SAP.md §8 decision (2026-09-11): the open sub-question at :397-400 is unresolved.

differences.what: The polling key means different things (pre-existing LAN hazard that a port must not copy blindly)
differences.lan: GetCreditStatus treats idSolicitud as Intelisis Venta.ID of the 'Solicitud Credito'. The callback, however, sends the Liberador IdVenta (which Venta row it points to: NO EVIDENCE; the comment says a Pedido was created) or, when IdVenta=0, the ServicioAndroid CRED_SOLICITUD_WEB_DATOS_TEMP identity, which is a different key space.
differences.sap: The only id SS has is the ServicioAndroid temp identity (same key space as the LAN SP). A port of GetCreditStatus fed this id would query Venta.ID with an Android id.
differences.evidence: LAN OrderMethods.cs:1876-1880 (WHERE ID=@IdSolicitud AND Mov='Solicitud Credito'), CreditMethods.cs:212, :225, LiberadorCreditoMethods.cs:76-93 (comment :78 'Pedido creado en Intelisis'). SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS.sql:223, :346-348. SS SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.cs:155, OrderMethods.cs:694, :740 (commented).
differences.concrete_case: The Liberador returns EN_ANALISIS with idVenta=0 for Android application 88123. LAN sends idSolicitud=88123, and the cron polls Venta WHERE ID=88123 AND Mov='Solicitud Credito': either no row (EN_ANALISIS forever) or an unrelated application's row. If idVenta is a Pedido ID, the Mov='Solicitud Credito' filter never matches and the result is also EN_ANALISIS forever.
differences.decision_ref: None

differences.what: The DMZ creditStatus transport was changed: it authenticates against ServicioSAP and, in the share config, targets ServicioSAP
differences.lan: Legacy Curl logged in to LAN (login/authenticate) and called LAN with a LAN-issued token.
differences.sap: Curl always logs in to ServicioSAP (login/auth) and reuses that token for URL_INTELISIS. If SS login is down the DMZ returns 500 even if LAN is healthy. URL_INTELISIS in the share is the ServicioSAP dev port, where the route does not exist. It works against LAN only because the JWT settings are identical in the LAN and SS Web.config files.
differences.evidence: DMZ Helper/Curl.cs:61-71 (legacy LAN login, commented), :73-90 (SAP login, throw), :83-84 ('Unificación de Token para llamadas legacy redirigidas hacia ServicioSAP'), :245-265. DMZ Web.config:16-18. ServicioSap.csproj:21,:503; LAN WebApiMagento.csproj:256. JWT keys hash-equal between LAN and SS Web.config (DMZ differs). No runbook decision covers the creditStatus redirection.
differences.concrete_case: ServicioSAP /login/auth is unavailable while LAN is up. GET <dmz>/order/creditStatus/12345: the Curl constructor throws, the DMZ returns 500, and Magento keeps the row EN_ANALISIS and retries. Before the change LAN would have answered 200 {"status":"AUTORIZADO"}.
differences.decision_ref: None

comparisons.question_for_user: 1) After Intelisis is shut down, what is the source of truth for the credit decision that LAN reads today from Venta (Solicitud Credito / Analisis Credito / Pedido with Estatus and Situacion)? Is it SAP ZAPI_ZVTACONTCRED_SRV (Auart/Zsituacion/Zliberado by Zidecomm), a SAP sales order, or the Liberador / ServicioAndroid? And which SAP document types stand for 'Solicitud Credito' and 'Analisis Credito'? 2) In the SS flow, which id should Magento poll with (the ServicioAndroid CRED_SOLICITUD_WEB_DATOS_TEMP identity or a SAP document number), and who delivers it: the re-enabled callback (whose payload field names must match the DMZ CreditAuthorizationRequest) or the setOrder response? 3) What value does the production DMZ use for URL_INTELISIS? The share has https://localhost:44399/ (ServicioSAP), with the LAN URL commented out. 4) Does the Liberador's idVenta return the Venta.ID of the 'Solicitud Credito' or of the 'Pedido'? LAN GetCreditStatus only matches Mov='Solicitud Credito'.

comparisons.name: HTTP response contract of setOrder (LAN) vs order/new (ServicioSAP), credit path
comparisons.lan_source: LAN POST order/setOrder (Controllers/OrdersController.cs:137-161) -> Metodos/OrderMethods.cs SetPedido (:533-733) -> CreditMethods.ProductosCreditoWeb_SaveData (Metodos/CreditMethods.cs:94-262, SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS on ServicioAndroid; its return value is discarded). PedidoExistente comes from Intelisis table Venta (obtenerIdVenta, OrderMethods.cs:1602-1640). Caller: the legacy DMZ (git c63c0ab, Controllers/OrdersController.cs:107-196), which turned LAN's string into HTTP statuses.
comparisons.lan_detail: Controller (OrdersController.cs:137-161): null body -> HttpResponseException 400 (:141-142). om.SetPedido(order) inside try (:149-153). Any exception that reaches the controller -> Ok(e.ToString()), so HTTP 200 with the full exception type and stack trace (:154-156). Otherwise Ok(response), HTTP 200 with a JSON string (:160). What SetPedido can return on the credit path: (a) "PedidoExistente" when an Intelisis Venta exists for IdEcommerce and the ORIGINAL forzarOrder=="0" or PayPal (OrderMethods.cs:538, :541-542). (b) order.infoCliente["cuenta"] exactly as Magento sent it (:649), after ProductosCreditoWeb_SaveData (:624-647), whose result ("OK"/"insuficiente"/"err"/"sin cuenta", CreditMethods.cs:128-132, :246-252, :255-258) is DISCARDED. So a missing master record, a failed INSERT or a failed line insert all still return the cuenta. (c) "" when anything throws inside the try at :576-727: missing 'cuenta' key at :619, detallePedido :582/:599, SaveGuide :606, NombreClienteMavi keys :603-605, Android connection open at CreditMethods.cs:119, int.Parse(data[1]) at :109. The catch at :728-731 logs and :732 returns sRespuestaPedido, which is still string.Empty. (d) e.ToString() for exceptions before the try: AgruparCantidadPorSKU int.Parse/float.Parse (:492-496), ToArray KeyNotFound on infoCliente keys (:406-423), forzarOrder null (:562). SetPedido never returns "sin cuenta", so the legacy DMZ 422 branch (c63c0ab :152-159) was dead code. The legacy DMZ caller (c63c0ab :128-195) mapped the result: no 'cuenta' key -> 400 "Cuenta invalida" (:118-122, request never reached LAN); "PrecioIncorrecto"/"Incorrecto" -> 400; "" -> 500 {error:"LAN retornó vacío"}; "PedidoExistente" -> 409; anything not starting with 'C' (including e.ToString()) -> 500 {error:"Respuesta inesperada"}; otherwise 200 with the cuenta string. For credit it did NOT call SAP order/new (:175-193). Sibling route order/validateCredit (OrdersController.cs:455-482) wraps the same SetPedido as {status:"PROCESANDO", cuenta}.
comparisons.sap_source: ServicioSAP POST order/new (Controllers/OrderController.cs:16-48) -> Methods/Order/OrderMethods.cs SetOrderAsync (:1728-1955), credit early exit (:1785-1808) -> ProcessCreditPaymentAsync (:665-766) -> CrearSolicitudCreditoAsync/SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.InsertAsync (:787-843). PedidoExistente comes from S/4 OData SD36 ZAPI_DOCVTAS_CHECK_CDS/ZAPI_DOCVTAS_CHECK filtered by PurchNoC (Methods/SalesDistribution/SalesMethods.cs:132-166; the same service as salesanddistribution-dev apps/api/routes/AS_GET_ListadoDocumentosVentas.py:43-75, which returns the sales documents list). Caller: current DMZ Controllers/OrdersController.cs:107-228 via Curl.PostSAP (Helper/Curl.cs:115-148).
comparisons.sap_detail: Controller (OrderController.cs:16-48): null body -> 400 (:20-23). newOrder = await SetOrderAsync(order,"Insert") (:27), then it is mapped to an anonymous object {BP=Zctefinal, SalesDocument=to_result?.Salesdocument?.TrimStart('0') ?? PurchNoS, Message=(Resultado=="Error" ? Zobservaciones : to_return?.results?.FirstOrDefault()?.Message ?? ""), Resultado} (:28-34) and returned with Ok, HTTP 200 (:35). It is serialized by the default Web API JSON formatter (App_Start/WebApiConfig.cs:11-23 has no formatter config), so nulls are emitted. Catch (:37-47): Logger.SAP(...) (:45), then Ok("Error, " + e.Message), HTTP 200 with a JSON string and no stack trace (:46). Values on the credit path: (a) success: the credit branch returns a bare OrderResponse{Resultado="Concluido", Zctefinal=cuentaCredito, Zidecomm=incrementId} (OrderMethods.cs:1802-1807), giving {"BP":cuentaCredito,"SalesDocument":null,"Message":"","Resultado":"Concluido"}. cuentaCredito = infoCliente.cuenta for an existing client, or infoCliente.cliente (the Magento customer id) when cuenta is empty and cliente is present (:669-673, :759). Line-insert failures and a missing condition are swallowed and still give Concluido (:701-717; condition throw at :877-880). A guide save failure is swallowed (:533-552, called at :1787). (b) PedidoExistente: OrderResponse{Resultado="PedidoExistente", Zidecomm} (:1752-1760) -> {"BP":null,"SalesDocument":null,"Message":"","Resultado":"PedidoExistente"}. The check uses SD36 by PurchNoC "ZSD_{docType??ZMER}_{incrementId}" (:1749-1750) and the forzarOrder value AFTER ToArray changed it (:236-237, :253-254). An SD36 error is treated as "not existing" (:452-464). (c) errors: guest (:673-676), BP not found by CheckClientCreditAsync (:679-684, :768-781), idSolicitud<=0 (:694-696), InsertAsync exceptions (propagated), and NREs (e.g. articulos null at ToArray :222) are all rewrapped as "Error en SetOrder: {msg}" (:1950-1954) -> 200 "Error, Error en SetOrder: {msg}". Caller today: the DMZ posts every order to order/new (DMZ OrdersController.cs:191-205; the LAN call and the 'cuenta' check are commented out at :116-183). It Trim('"')s the body, JSON-parses it and returns Ok(object) or, if parsing fails, Ok(string) (:214-227). PostSAP turns any non-2xx from ServicioSAP into the string "WebException: ... Body: ..." (Curl.cs:130-141), so Magento gets 200 for everything except a DMZ-side SAP login failure (500 at :200-205). No validateCredit route exists in ServicioSAP.

differences.what: Success payload type and shape changed from a JSON string (the cuenta) to a JSON object {BP, SalesDocument, Message, Resultado}.
differences.lan: HTTP 200, body is a JSON string with the cuenta as sent: "C01575835" (OrderMethods.cs:649 -> OrdersController.cs:160).
differences.sap: HTTP 200, body {"BP":"<cuenta>","SalesDocument":null,"Message":"","Resultado":"Concluido"} (OrderMethods.cs:1802-1807 -> OrderController.cs:28-35). Errors come back as a JSON string, so one caller now has to handle two JSON types.
differences.evidence: LAN Controllers/OrdersController.cs:160, Metodos/OrderMethods.cs:649; SS Controllers/OrderController.cs:28-35, Methods/Order/OrderMethods.cs:1802-1807. Magento's credit path ignores the body: CreditoOrderManagement.php:51-56 only fails on `=== false`, which Adapter.php:32-43 returns only when there is no token.
differences.concrete_case: CRED515848 payload with infoCliente.cuenta replaced by an existing QA-110 BP (e.g. placeholder '0012345678'): LAN returns "0012345678"; SS returns {"BP":"0012345678","SalesDocument":null,"Message":"","Resultado":"Concluido"}.
differences.decision_ref: Open, not decided: PLAN §19.2 #1, §18.8 (Magento/Omnipro row: 'el contrato de respuesta'); MATRIZ G1-24 / G5-14.

differences.evidence: LAN OrderMethods.cs:619, :649, :728-732; CreditMethods.cs:124, :255-258. SS OrderMethods.cs:669-673, :679-684, :759, :1802-1807.
differences.concrete_case: CRED515773 with "cuenta":"" and "cliente":"9400": LAN returns "" and no row; SS returns {"BP":"9400",...,"Resultado":"Concluido"} and one row.

comparisons.question_for_user: 1) Magento's credit flow never reads the setOrder body or status. CreditoOrderManagement.php:51-56 only fails when registerCreditQuote returns false (token failure), and it answers PROCESANDO in every other case. Given that, do you accept {BP, SalesDocument, Message, Resultado} on success and "Error, ..." (always HTTP 200) on failure as the new contract? Or should order/new return LAN's string: the cuenta, "" or "PedidoExistente"? And should the DMZ bring back the legacy status mapping (400/409/500)? 2) New client (cuenta empty, cliente present): LAN returned "" and created no request. ServicioSAP creates one and puts the Magento customer id in BP. Which one do you want (PLAN §18.5 #6)?

comparisons.name: DMZ mapping of the backend setOrder response to Magento (credit path)
comparisons.lan_source: DMZ Controllers/OrdersController.cs Set(): the legacy block is now commented (:118-126 and :132-183). The pre-migration version is at commit c63c0ab (OrdersController.cs:108-195). It called LAN POST order/setOrder (LAN Controllers/OrdersController.cs:138-160), which runs OrderMethods.SetPedido (LOM:533-733) and then CreditMethods.ProductosCreditoWeb_SaveData (LCM:94-262, SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS on ServicioAndroid). Duplicate check: Intelisis table `venta.idecommerce` via obtenerIdVenta (LOM:1602-1643). Transport: DMZ Helper/Curl.cs Post (:93-113), which swallows every exception and returns e.ToString().

That runs OrderMethods.SetOrderAsync (OM:1728-1955): duplicate check at :1752-1760 using SD36 OData ZAPI_DOCVTAS_CHECK_CDS/ZAPI_DOCVTAS_CHECK with $filter PurchNoC eq 'ZSD_{docType}_{incrementId}' (SalesMethods.cs:132-166; the reference repo salesanddistribution-dev apps/api/routes/AS_GET_ListadoDocumentosVentas.py:33-50 is a generic sales-document listing with $filter). comparisons.lan_detail:
Legacy DMZ, for metodoPago == 'omnipro_pago_credito' (DMZ@c63c0ab):
(0) order null -> 400 (:111-112, unchanged).
(1) infoCliente has no key 'cuenta' -> 400 "Cuenta invalida" (c63c0ab:118-122; now commented at DMZ:121-125).
(2) new Curl() logs into LAN and SAP. A throw goes to the catch -> 500 {error:"Excepcion llamando a LAN", detail, incrementId} (c63c0ab:168-173).
(3) response = Post("order/setOrder").Trim('"').
(4) Response mapping: 'PrecioIncorrecto' or 'Incorrecto' -> 400 "Incorrecto"; blank -> 500 {error:"LAN retorno vacio", incrementId}; 'PedidoExistente' -> 409 {error, incrementId}; 'sin cuenta' -> 422 {error, cuenta}; anything not starting with 'C' -> 500 {error:"Respuesta inesperada", lanResponse} (DMZ:142-176 commented, identical to c63c0ab:135-166).
(5) SAP is skipped for credit (c63c0ab:175-193).
(6) return Ok(response): 200 with a JSON string such as "C01575835" (c63c0ab:195).

What LAN can actually return on the credit path:
- "PedidoExistente" when a venta row exists and forzarOrder=="0" (LOM:538, :541-542; Magento sends "0", OrderManagement.php:38).
- The cuenta echoed back (LOM:649). The return value of ProductosCreditoWeb_SaveData is discarded (LOM:624), so 'sin cuenta' (LCM:255-258), 'err' (LCM:246-252) and 'insuficiente' never reach the DMZ.
- "" when any exception is thrown outside LCM's inner try (cnn.Open at LCM:119, SaveGuide at LOM:606/735-754 which has no try) and caught at LOM:728-732.
- e.ToString() if the controller throws (LOC:156).
- Curl.Post e.ToString() on a transport failure (Curl.cs:108-111).

So the 400 "Incorrecto" and 422 "sin cuenta" mappings were dead code for credit: the credit branch returns at LOM:649, before crearPedido.

Effective legacy outcomes: success -> 200 "C..."; duplicate -> 409; internal exception or empty cuenta -> 500 (the 'vacio' or 'inesperada' body); non-C cuenta (BP or prospect) -> 500; LAN unreachable -> 500 'Respuesta inesperada'; DMZ login failure -> 500 JSON.
comparisons.sap_detail:
Current DMZ:
- The credit 'cuenta' pre-check is commented (:116-127). The LAN call is commented (:132-183; comment says it caused a 404).
- Every order goes to PostSAP("order/new").Trim('"') (:191-199).
- The catch at :200-205 -> InternalServerError() (500, empty body) fires ONLY if new Curl() throws (SAP login, Curl.cs:73-90 rethrow) or Logger.SetOrder at :197 throws (DMZ Logger.cs:8-13 has no try). PostSAP itself never throws: WebException with a response -> "WebException: <msg> Body: <body>"; without a response -> "WebException: " + e.ToString(); any other exception -> e.ToString() (Curl.cs:130-146).
- Mapping at :214-227: non-empty -> try JsonConvert.DeserializeObject -> Ok(JToken). If parsing fails -> Ok(string). Empty -> Ok(""). Always 200.

ServicioSAP order/new:
- null -> 400 (OC:20-23).
- Success -> Ok({BP=Zctefinal, SalesDocument=to_result?.Salesdocument?.TrimStart('0') ?? PurchNoS, Message=(Resultado=="Error" ? Zobservaciones : to_return?...Message ?? ""), Resultado}) (OC:27-35).
- Any exception -> Ok("Error, " + e.Message), a 200 on purpose (OC:37-47 comment claims LAN parity).

Credit outcomes:
- Duplicate -> {"BP":null,"SalesDocument":null,"Message":"","Resultado":"PedidoExistente"} (OM:1752-1760).
- Success -> {"BP":"<infoCliente.cuenta, or infoCliente.cliente when cuenta is empty>","SalesDocument":null,"Message":"","Resultado":"Concluido"} (OM:1785-1808, :759).
- Errors -> "Error, Error en SetOrder: <msg>" (OM:1950-1954), for example: guest (OM:675-676), BP not found (OM:681-682), idSolicitud<=0 (OM:695-696), CrearSolicitudCreditoAsync propagating SQL errors. Line-insert errors are swallowed and still return Concluido (OM:701-717).
- ServicioSAP returning 500 (e.g. Logger.cs:28-31 CreateDirectory throwing inside the OC catch) or 401/503/timeout -> the DMZ still answers 200 with the "WebException: ..." text.

Liberador and callback are commented out (OM:719-757). No runtime evidence: Logs/sap.log contains only 2026-07-17 cash orders and a 2026-09-17 BP creation, with no credit order/new call. NO EVIDENCE of a real DMZ credit response.

Magento consumer (reference):
- registerCreditQuote treats status 100/200 as success: it sets quote is_active=false and clears the checkout session (OrderManagement.php:788-817). Otherwise it only logs.
- requestCreditOrder fails only when the response === false (CreditoOrderManagement.php:53-56). Adapter::post returns false only when getting the token fails (Adapter.php:32-43). Any HTTP status therefore gives is_active=0 plus success=true / 'PROCESANDO' (:58-76). This answers runbook §18.8 "requestCreditOrder solo reacciona a false?" from code: yes.
- registerOrder sets synced=1 on 200 (OrderManagement.php:608-610); the cron re-sends synced=0/null (:219-232, :988-996).

comparisons.question_for_user:
Which response contract do you want for the credit setOrder through the DMZ?
(a) Restore LAN's HTTP mapping in the DMZ: 409 when Resultado=='PedidoExistente', and 500 when the body starts with 'Error, ' or 'WebException:' or when PostSAP fails. Note that PostSAP never throws, so the catch at DMZ:200-205 does not cover this today.
(b) Keep 200 for everything and confirm with Omnipro/Magento that they accept it. Their requestCreditOrder only fails on `false` (CreditoOrderManagement.php:53), but registerCreditQuote clears the checkout session on 200 only (OrderManagement.php:803-817), and registerOrder marks synced=1 on 200, which stops the retry cron.
(c) Make ServicioSAP return LAN's plain string (the cuenta, "" or "PedidoExistente").
Separately: should a credit request with an empty cuenta and a Magento customer id create an application and answer 'Concluido' (runbook §18.5 #6)? LAN answered 500 and created nothing.

findings: The verdict holds for credit. I found no credit input that gives a different observable result in this step. With metodoPago="omnipro_pago_credito", both OpenPay gates are false in both systems. Nothing is written, nothing is returned and nothing is thrown. Evidence: LAN Metodos/OrderMethods.cs:545 and :551 (constants at :32 and :34). SS Methods/Order/OrderMethods.cs:1765 and :1776 (constants at :45 and :47, identical text). Both use ordinal C# string ==. A null metodoPago also gives false in both, with no exception.

metodoPago reaches the gate unchanged on both sides. It is a plain string in LAN Models/OrderRequest.cs:16, SS Models/SAP/Order/OrderRequest.cs:19 and the DMZ Models/OrderRequest.cs:20. Neither AgruparCantidadPorSKU nor ToArray changes it: LAN OrderMethods.cs:486-524 and :354, SS OrderMethods.cs:87-107 and :213. The DMZ re-serializes the order and sends it as is.

Credit orders really do reach this step in SS today. In the DMZ, the credit exclusion (`if (order.metodoPago != CREDIT_METHOD)`) and the LAN setOrder call are commented out, so every order, credit included, is POSTed to order/new: DMZ Controllers/OrdersController.cs:185-205. SS OrderController.cs:27 then calls SetOrderAsync(order, "Insert").
The uncommitted working-tree diff does not touch the step. `git diff` hunk headers for OrderMethods.cs jump from @@ -1104 straight to @@ -1870,0 +1787,2. Lines 1765-1780 are unchanged.

Step placement matches the comparison. LAN: after the PedidoExistente check (:541-542) and before the try that opens at :576. SS: inside the outer try at :1730, whose catch at :1950-1954 rethrows. For credit, no code inside the step can throw, so this placement difference has no observable effect.

Difference #2 is wrong as written. LAN's SQLite wrapper swallows INSERT errors: Conn/DB.cs:26-44 wraps ExecuteNonQuery in try/catch and only calls CloseConn(). SS does the same: Helpers/ConexionDB/SQLiteDb.cs:158-175. So a UNIQUE violation on openpay_stores.increment_id does NOT propagate in LAN. LAN still creates the order, just like SS. The claim that LAN answers 200 with the exception text and creates no order is false for that input. The only real divergence is a failure to open the connection, which sits outside the try in both wrappers: DB.cs:28 calls OpenConn at :15-19, and SQLiteDb.cs:160 calls OpenConnAsync. It is out of credit scope either way.

The comparison's LAN caller list is incomplete. LAN Conn/Magento.cs:406 (getOrderInfoAndSet, exposed at OrdersController.cs:437-442) also calls SetPedido with liberado=false and can carry a credit order. SS has no validateCredit, getOrderInfoAndSet or ReSetPedido equivalent: a grep of SS Controllers finds only order/new (OrderController.cs:17) as the entry to SetOrderAsync. This concerns the caller step, not this one.

Difference #1 is confirmed as current state. SS has no liberado parameter and no OpenPay replay: a grep for CheckStatus/checkOpenpay/liberado finds only the credit Liberador. SS writes to its own file at Web.config:60, SQLITE_DB_PATH=C:\inetpub\wwwroot\sap\, which is different from LAN's C:\inetpub\wwwroot\api\data.db (LAN DB.cs:17). So LAN's replay cannot pick up SS rows either. NO EVIDENCE that any other process reads SS's openpay_orders. The runbook has no OpenPay decision: its grep hits are only for the Liberador.

Difference #3 is confirmed. LAN returns the string "Concluido" (OpenpayMethods.cs:59, OrdersController.cs:160). SS returns an OrderResponse that the controller maps to {BP:null, SalesDocument:null, Message:"", Resultado:"Concluido"} (OrderController.cs:28-35). It is out of credit scope.

Difference #4 is confirmed. The case-insensitive credit checks are at SS OrderMethods.cs:357, :2199 (DistrChan "02" at :2200) and :2551-2558 (with Trim). The gates at :1765/:1776/:1785 use ordinal comparison. It is downstream of this step and theoretical, since the real payloads send lowercase. One small imprecision in its concrete case: LAN chooses SPVTASPedidosMagento instead of SP_eCommerceNuevoPed when forzarOrder=="1" (LAN :557-565).

The adjacent idempotency observation is confirmed, and the runbook has no decision on it. SS ToArray changes forzarOrder at OrderMethods.cs:237 and :254 before the check at :1752. LAN compares forzarOrderOriginal, captured at :538 and used at :541. Section 20 of the runbook does not list this among its six applied fixes. It belongs to the idempotency step.

Non-credit, low. added_differences: Realistic trigger for differences 3 and 5 (not only a misconfigured folder): a concurrent write collision on LAN's setOrder.log. File.AppendText opens the file with FileShare.Read, so a second writer gets an IOException. Many LAN writers share this file: other setOrder requests (:144, :152), creditStatus polling (LAN Controllers/OrdersController.cs:496), the LiberadorThread error log (LAN Metodos/CreditMethods.cs:230), CallMagentoCallback (LAN Metodos/OrderMethods.cs:1796-1831) and SetPedido's own logs (:664, :730). Concrete input: CRED515773 arrives while a creditStatus poll for another order is appending. If the collision hits :144, LAN answers HTTP 500 and creates no application. If it hits :152, LAN answers 200 with e.ToString() although the application row was inserted and the Liberador thread started (CreditMethods.cs:190-240). ServicioSAP has neither write, so it answers 200 {BP, SalesDocument, Message, Resultado}. On the DMZ host the race remains the same in both chains (DMZ :114, and :197 inside the try, which leads to 500 at :204). NOT INTENTIONAL, low.

The error record moved and changed format. LAN writes credit-branch failures as '[ts] Error <ex.Message>' in setOrder.log (LAN OrderMethods.cs:730, no incrementId) and '[ts] ERROR <ex.Message>' in credit.log (LAN CreditMethods.cs:250), and the caller still gets 200 with "" or the account. ServicioSAP writes '[ts] [ORDER NEW ERROR] incrementId=<id> :: <full exception with stack>' to sap.log (SS OrderController.cs:45), and the caller gets 200 'Error, ...'. Concrete input: the literal CRED515773 payload (magento_payloads.md:26, cuenta C01575835, an Intelisis account and not a BP). In ServicioSAP, CheckClientCreditAsync returns false (SS OrderMethods.cs:681-682, 768-780; runbook P10 expects 'no tiene credito activo'). The result is the sap.log line '[ORDER NEW ERROR] incrementId=CRED515773 :: System.Exception: Error en SetOrder: El cliente BP C01575835 no tiene crédito activo en SAP. ...' and no body anywhere in ServicioSAP. LAN writes the body line and then '[ts] INFO [CRED515773] C01575835'. NOT INTENTIONAL, low (no runbook decision).

Input: articulos:[{"SKU":"OSTE00443","cantidad":"1","precio":"8198.0000","precioEspecial":"0","descuento":"0","condicion":"12 M MA P INM"}]. An empty-SKU line could only be attempted if the null-SKU article is not first, and even then it depends on what SD29 returns for an empty SKU: NO EVIDENCE.

DIFF 6 (articulos null) REMOVED. Unreachable, because a Magento order always carries items, and the observable outcome is identical: HTTP 200, nothing written (LAN :492 then OrdersController.cs:156; SS guard at OM:89-90, NRE in ToArray at OM:222, wrapped at :1953, Ok at OrderController.cs:46). The code documents it as deliberate (OrderController.cs:39-44), but no runbook decision records it. Report it under the entry step as NOT INTENTIONAL per the runbook.

DIFF 7 (forzarOrder mutated before the idempotency check) REMOVED from this step, and its 'medium' severity is inflated for the credit scope. The code facts are right: SS ToArray mutates forzarOrder at OM:236-237 and :253-254 before the check at :1752, while LAN saves the original first (:536-541). But in the credit path the mutation changes nothing observable. The SD36 lookup of ZSD_ZMER_CRED<id> cannot match, because the credit branch never posts a SAP order (it returns at OM:1802-1807) and the Liberador that could create one is commented out (OM:720-757). ValidarPedidoExistenteSAPAsync also swallows errors and returns false (OM:452-464). Skipping the check or running it therefore both lead to 'proceed'. The real credit-path gap (a retry of the same CRED creates another application, where LAN can answer PedidoExistente) exists regardless of forzarOrder and is already recorded in runbook §18.5 #17 ('Un reintento del mismo CRED crea otra solicitud', deferred 'Fuera del fin de semana').

CARRY-OVER for the idempotency step (shared code, contado): the forzarOrder mutation IS observable for cash methods. Real payload magento_payloads.md:45 (VIU openpay_cards, precioEspecial "6990", forzarOrder "0"): if that order is re-sent, LAN runs the duplicate check with "0" (:541) and can return PedidoExistente. SS sees "1" and skips the check (:1752), then saves the Openpay order again (:1765-1767). Severity medium there, but it is outside this credit step.

ADJACENT, not added (downstream of grouping and unreachable): with articulos = [] both groupers return an empty list with no error. They diverge later. LAN order.articulos[0]["condicion"] (:632) throws inside the try, the catch logs it (:728-731), and the order returns "" with no credit application. SS FirstOrDefault()?.condicion ?? "" (OM:700, :824) creates the header with an empty condicion and returns Concluido. If it matters, it belongs to the condicion-extraction step.

QUESTION FOR USER, reframed: (1) Keep only the input-validation question. LAN rejects an order with a missing article key, a non-integer cantidad or descuento, or a null sku, before writing anything. ServicioSAP accepts it with defaults and returns Concluido, possibly with an application that has no lines. No real payload triggers this. Validate or accept? (2) Remove the forzarOrder question from this step. It has no effect on credit and should be asked in the idempotency step as a contado issue.
